"use client";
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
import { fetchAppointments, updateAppointmentStatus, subscribeToAppointments, type AppointmentRow } from "@/lib/supabase/appointment-management";
import type { AppointmentStatus } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import AppointmentStats from "@/components/admin/appointments/AppointmentStats";
import AppointmentFilters, { type FilterState } from "@/components/admin/appointments/AppointmentFilters";
import AppointmentsTable from "@/components/admin/appointments/AppointmentsTable";
import AppointmentDetailModal from "@/components/admin/appointments/AppointmentDetailModal";
import AdminRescheduleModal from "@/components/admin/appointments/AdminRescheduleModal";
import Pagination from "@/components/admin/Pagination";
import FeedbackDialog from "@/components/admin/operations/FeedbackDialog";

const PAGE_SIZE = 10;
const STATUS_PRIORITY: Record<AppointmentStatus, number> = {
  pending: 0, confirmed: 1, checked_in: 2, completed: 3, cancelled: 4,
};
function compareAppointments(a: AppointmentRow, b: AppointmentRow): number {
  const priority = STATUS_PRIORITY[a.status] - STATUS_PRIORITY[b.status];
  if (priority !== 0) return priority;
  const createdDifference = b.created_at.localeCompare(a.created_at);
  if (createdDifference !== 0) return createdDifference;
  const dateDifference = b.scheduled_date.localeCompare(a.scheduled_date);
  if (dateDifference !== 0) return dateDifference;
  const timeDifference = (b.scheduled_time ?? "").localeCompare(a.scheduled_time ?? "");
  if (timeDifference !== 0) return timeDifference;
  return a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
}
function manilaDate() {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit" }).formatToParts(new Date());
  const find = (type: string) => parts.find(p => p.type === type)?.value ?? "";
  return `${find("year")}-${find("month")}-${find("day")}`;
}
export default function AdminAppointmentsPage() {
  const [appointments, setAppointments] = useState<AppointmentRow[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<FilterState>({ search: "", status: "all", service: "all", scope: "all" });
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<AppointmentRow | null>(null);
  const [rescheduling, setRescheduling] = useState<AppointmentRow | null>(null);
  const [refreshKey, setRefreshKey] = useState(0);
  const [live, setLive] = useState(false);
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const r = await fetchAppointments();
    if (r.error) { setLoadError(r.error); return; }
    setLoadError(null);
    setAppointments(r.rows);
    setSelected(x => x ? r.rows.find(y => y.id === x.id) ?? x : null);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { setLoading(true); void load().finally(() => setLoading(false)); }, [load]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const off = subscribeToAppointments(() => {
      void load();
      setRefreshKey(x => x + 1);
      setLive(true);
      if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current);
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => setLive(false), 2000);
    });
    return () => { off(); if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current); };
  }, [load]);
  const filtered = appointments.filter(a => {
    const q = filters.search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return (!q || a.owner_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || a.id.toLowerCase().includes(q) || a.pets.some(p => p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)))
      && (filters.status === "all" || a.status === filters.status)
      && (filters.service === "all" || a.service_type === filters.service)
      && (filters.scope === "all" || a.scheduled_date === manilaDate());
  }).sort(compareAppointments);
  const maxPage = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(filtered.length / PAGE_SIZE) - 1);
  const safePage = Math.min(page, maxPage);
  const visible = filtered.slice(safePage * PAGE_SIZE, safePage * PAGE_SIZE + PAGE_SIZE);
  async function status(id: string, nextStatus: AppointmentStatus) {
    const r = await updateAppointmentStatus(id, nextStatus);
    if (r.error) return r.error.message;
    setAppointments(prev => prev.map(a => a.id === id ? { ...a, status: nextStatus } : a));
    setSelected(x => x && x.id === id ? { ...x, status: nextStatus } : x);
    setPage(0); void load();
    return null;
  }
  return <div>
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3"><h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-brand-pink">Appointments</h1>{live && <span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-600">â— Live update</span>}</div>
    <div className="mt-6"><AppointmentStats refreshKey={refreshKey}/></div>
    <div className="mt-6"><AppointmentFilters filters={filters} onChange={x => { setFilters(x); setPage(0); }}/></div>
    {loadError && <FeedbackDialog title="Appointments Could Not Load" message={loadError} onClose={() => setLoadError(null)} actionLabel="Retry Loading" onAction={() => { setLoadError(null); void load(); }}/>} 
    <div className="mt-4">{loading ? <p className="py-10 text-center text-zinc-400">Loading appointmentsâ€¦</p> : <AppointmentsTable rows={visible} onView={setSelected} onReschedule={setRescheduling}/>}</div>
    <div className="mt-4"><Pagination page={safePage} pageSize={PAGE_SIZE} totalItems={filtered.length} onPageChange={setPage}/></div>
    {selected && <AppointmentDetailModal appointment={selected} onClose={() => setSelected(null)} onUpdateStatus={status} onRefresh={load}/>} 
    {rescheduling && <AdminRescheduleModal appointment={rescheduling} onClose={() => setRescheduling(null)} onSaved={async () => { await load(); setRefreshKey(x => x + 1); }}/>} 
  </div>;
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";

type Confirmation = { date: string; title: string; detail: string; action: "open" | "close" | "remove" };

// Display blocked store closures as a focused dialog. Unrelated network and
// permission errors still use the existing page-level error notice.
function isClosureConflict(message: string): boolean {
  return /cannot close|active or upcoming appointment|appointment\(s\) already exist|appointments? would be affected|reschedule or cancel affected appointments/i.test(message);
}

export default function CalendarManagementPage() {
  const [allowed, setAllowed] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [dates, setDates] = useState<BookingClosedDate[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [conflict, setConflict] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState<Confirmation | null>(null);
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(() => {
    const [y, m] = manilaToday().split("-").map(Number);
    return new Date(y, m - 1, 1);
  });

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    const result = await fetchBookingClosedDates();
    if (result.error) setError(result.error);
    else { setDates(result.dates); setError(null); }
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    void (async () => {
      const { data: { user } } = await createClient().auth.getUser();
      if (!user) { if (alive) { setAllowed(false); setLoading(false); } return; }
      const { data } = await createClient().from("profiles").select("role").eq("id", user.id).maybeSingle();
      if (!alive) return;
      setAllowed(data?.role === "superadmin");
      if (data?.role === "superadmin") await refresh();
      else setLoading(false);
    })();
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [refresh]);

  const key = `${month.getFullYear()}-${String(month.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  const first = new Date(month.getFullYear(), month.getMonth(), 1).getDay();
  const total = new Date(month.getFullYear(), month.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate();
  const cells = Array.from({ length: Math.ceil((first + total) / 7) * 7 }, (_, i) => i - first + 1);
  const byDate = useMemo(() => new Map(dates.map(d => [d.date, d])), [dates]);
  const current = selected ? byDate.get(selected) : undefined;
  const isHoliday = current?.category === "regular_holiday" || current?.category === "special_non_working";
  const closed = current && !current.is_open_override;

  function reportFailure(message: string) {
    if (isClosureConflict(message)) { setConflict(message); setError(null); }
    else setError(message);
  }

  async function execute(action: Confirmation) {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true); setError(null); setConflict(null); setNotice(null);
    try {
      const failure = action.action === "remove"
        ? await deleteExceptionalClosure(action.date)
        : await setHolidayOpen(action.date, action.action === "open");
      if (failure) reportFailure(failure);
      else { setNotice(`${action.date}: Calendar updated.`); await refresh(); }
    } catch (cause) {
      reportFailure(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Unable to update calendar.");
    } finally {
      setConfirm(null); setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function add() {
    if (!selected || reason.trim().length < 2 || busy) return;
    setBusy(true); setError(null); setConflict(null); setNotice(null);
    try {
      const failure = await addExceptionalClosure(selected, reason);
      if (failure) reportFailure(failure);
      else { setNotice(`${selected}: Closed date added.`); setReason(""); await refresh(); }
    } catch (cause) {
      reportFailure(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Unable to create store closure.");
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  if (loading || allowed === null) return <p className="p-6 text-sm text-zinc-500">Loading calendarâ€¦</p>;
  if (!allowed) return <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-rose-50 p-5 text-rose-700">Calendar Management is for Superadmin accounts only.</p>;

  return <main className="mx-auto max-w-6xl space-y-5 pb-16">
    <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
      <div><h1 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-2xl font-bold text-brand-pink"><CalendarDays /> Calendar Management</h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600">Manage store day-offs, closures, and holiday opening overrides for every booking flow.</p>
      </div>
      <Link href="/admin/pet-services/grooming" className="rounded-full border border-pink-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink hover:bg-pink-50">Manage Groomers</Link>
    </header>
    {error && <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-rose-50 p-3 text-sm text-rose-700">{error}</p>}
    {notice && !error && <p role="status" className="rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 p-3 text-sm text-emerald-700">{notice}</p>}
    <div className="grid items-start gap-5 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_320px]">
      <section className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-4 sm:p-6">
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <button type="button" aria-label="Previous month" onClick={() => setMonth(new Date(month.getFullYear(), month.getMonth() - 1, 1))} className="rounded-full p-2 hover:bg-pink-50"><ChevronLeft size={20} /></button>
          <h2 className="text-lg font-bold">{month.toLocaleDateString("en-PH", { month: "long", year: "numeric" })}</h2>
          <button type="button" aria-label="Next month" onClick={() => setMonth(new Date(month.getFullYear(), month.getMonth() + 1, 1))} className="rounded-full p-2 hover:bg-pink-50"><ChevronRight size={20} /></button>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1.5 text-center">
          {["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"].map(d => <span key={d} className="py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-400">{d}</span>)}
          {cells.map((day, i) => {
            const date = day > 0 && day <= total ? `${key}-${String(day).padStart(2, "0")}` : "";
            const row = byDate.get(date);
            const unavailable = !!row && !row.is_open_override;
            return <button key={i} type="button" disabled={!date} onClick={() => { setSelected(date); setError(null); setConflict(null); setNotice(null); }} aria-pressed={selected === date}
              title={row ? `${unavailable ? "Closed" : "Open"}: ${row.name}` : undefined}
              className={`flex min-h-16 flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-xl border p-1 text-sm font-semibold ${unavailable ? "border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-700" : row?.is_open_override ? "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700" : selected === date ? "border-brand-pink bg-pink-50 text-brand-pink" : "border-transparent text-zinc-700 hover:bg-pink-50"} ${selected === date ? "ring-2 ring-brand-pink ring-offset-1" : ""}`}>
              {date ? day : ""}{row && <span className="mt-1 text-[9px] leading-none">{unavailable ? "Closed" : "Open"}</span>}
            </button>;
          })}
        </div>
        <p className="mt-4 text-xs text-zinc-500">Red: closed for booking Â· Green: holiday opened by Superadmin Â· Select any date to manage it.</p>
      </section>
      <aside className="space-y-3 rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-5">
        <h2 className="font-bold text-zinc-800">{selected ? `Date: ${selected}` : "Select a date"}</h2>
        {!selected ? <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">Choose a date on the calendar to manage availability.</p> : <>
          {current ? <div className={`rounded-xl border p-3 ${closed ? "border-rose-200 bg-rose-50" : "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50"}`}>
            <p className="text-sm font-bold">{closed ? "Closed" : "Open for booking"}</p><p className="mt-1 text-sm">{current.name}</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">{current.category === "exceptional_closure" ? "Custom shop closure" : "Official Philippine holiday"}</p>
          </div> : <p className="text-sm text-emerald-700">This date is open for bookings.</p>}
          {isHoliday ? <>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600">Holiday overrides are reversible. Holiday information is kept in the database.</p>
            <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setConfirm({ date: selected, title: closed ? "Open on this holiday?" : "Close on this holiday?", detail: closed ? "New appointments will be allowed on this official holiday." : "New appointments will be blocked for this holiday.", action: closed ? "open" : "close" })}
              className={`w-full rounded-full px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50 ${closed ? "bg-emerald-600" : "bg-brand-pink"}`}>{closed ? "Allow bookings on holiday" : "Close for holiday"}</button>
          </> : current?.category === "exceptional_closure" ?
            <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setConfirm({ date: selected, title: "Remove custom closure?", detail: "New bookings will be allowed on this date. Existing appointments will not change.", action: "remove" })}

import { fetchProducts, fetchAllBatches, computeStatus } from "@/lib/supabase/products";
import { fetchInventoryChangeLogs, type InventoryChangeLog } from "@/lib/supabase/inventory-change-logs";
import { sortRows, nextSortState, type SortDirection } from "@/lib/utils/sort";
import { batchHealth, sellableStock } from "@/lib/utils/inventory-expiration";
import type { Product, ProductBatch } from "@/lib/types/products";
import InventoryStats from "@/components/admin/inventory/InventoryStats";
import InventoryExpiryAlerts from "@/components/admin/inventory/InventoryExpiryAlerts";
import InventoryTabs from "@/components/admin/inventory/InventoryTabs";
import ProductsTable from "@/components/admin/inventory/ProductsTable";

import Pagination from "@/components/admin/Pagination";

const PAGE_SIZE = 10;
type Filter = "all" | "expired" | "expiring" | "low" | "unknown";
const logFilters = [
  {key:"all",label:"All changes"}, {key:"batch_received",label:"Received"},
  {key:"stock_decreased",label:"Stock decreased"}, {key:"stock_increased",label:"Stock increased"},
  {key:"expiration_changed",label:"Expiration"}, {key:"product_updated",label:"Product edits"},
] as const;

export default function InventoryPage() {
  const [products,setProducts] = useState<Product[]>([]);

  // Keep the internal 'stocks' value compatible with existing inventory tabs.
  const [tab,setTab] = useState<"products"|"stocks">("products");
  const [statusView,setStatusView] = useState<"active"|"discontinued">("active");
  const [search,setSearch] = useState("");
  const [filter,setFilter] = useState<Filter>("all");
  const [selected,setSelected] = useState<Product|null>(null);
  const [addProductOpen,setAddProductOpen] = useState(false);
  const [productsSortKey,setProductsSortKey] = useState<string|null>(null);
  const [productsSortDirection,setProductsSortDirection] = useState<SortDirection>(null);
  const [productsPage,setProductsPage] = useState(0);
  const [logs,setLogs] = useState<InventoryChangeLog[]>([]);
  const [logsError,setLogsError] = useState<string|null>(null);
  const [logsLoading,setLogsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [logsCount,setLogsCount] = useState(0);
  const [logsPage,setLogsPage] = useState(0);
  const [logAction,setLogAction] = useState<string>("all");
  const [logsVersion,setLogsVersion] = useState(0);
  const [showBatches,setShowBatches] = useState(false);
  const [batchSortKey,setBatchSortKey] = useState<string|null>(null);
  const [batchSortDirection,setBatchSortDirection] = useState<SortDirection>(null);
  const [batchPage,setBatchPage] = useState(0);

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);setError(null);
    try {
      const [p,b] = await Promise.all([fetchProducts(),fetchAllBatches()]);
      if (p.error || b.error) {setError([p.error,b.error].filter(Boolean).join("; "));return;}
      setProducts(p.products);setBatches(b.batches);
    } catch(e) {setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:"Inventory could not be loaded.");}
    finally {setLoading(false);}
  },[]);
  useEffect(()=>{void loadData();},[loadData]);
  useEffect(()=>{
    const refresh=()=>{if(document.visibilityState==="visible") {void loadData();setLogsVersion(v=>v+1);}};
    window.addEventListener("focus",refresh);
    return ()=>window.removeEventListener("focus",refresh);
  },[loadData]);
  useEffect(()=>{
    if(tab!=="stocks")return;
    let active=true;
    setLogsLoading(true);setLogsError(null);
    void fetchInventoryChangeLogs({page:logsPage,pageSize:PAGE_SIZE,search,action:logAction}).then(result=>{
      if(!active)return;
      if(result.error) {setLogsError(result.error);setLogs([]);setLogsCount(0);}
      else {setLogs(result.rows);setLogsCount(result.count);}
    }).catch(e=>{if(active){setLogsError(e instanceof Error?e.message:"Unable to load inventory history.");setLogs([]);setLogsCount(0);}})
      .finally(()=>{if(active)setLogsLoading(false);});
    return ()=>{active=false;};
  },[tab,logsPage,search,logAction,logsVersion]);

  const activeCount=products.filter(p=>p.status==="active").length;
  const discontinuedCount=products.length-activeCount;
  const enrichedProducts=useMemo(()=>products.filter(p=>p.status===statusView).map(p=>{
    const stock=sellableStock(p.id,batches);
    const health=batches.filter(b=>b.product_id===p.id).map(b=>batchHealth(b));
    const expiryRisk=health.includes("expired")?"Expired batch":health.includes("expiring")?"Expiring Soon":health.includes("unknown")?"Missing dates":"Clear";
    const statusLabel=computeStatus(stock,p.min_stock);
    return {...p,totalStock:stock,expiryRisk,statusLabel,priority:health.includes("expired")?0:statusLabel==="Out of Stock"?1:health.includes("expiring")?2:statusLabel==="Low Stock"?3:4};

       (filter==="low"&&p.statusLabel!=="In Stock")));

    });

      statusLabel:(()=>{const status=batchHealth(b);return status==="expired"?"Expired":status==="expiring"?"Expiring Soon":status==="healthy"?"Good":status==="depleted"?"Depleted":status==="unknown"?"No expiry recorded":"Adjustment";})(),
    }));
    return batchSortKey&&batchSortDirection?sortRows(rows,batchSortKey,batchSortDirection):rows.sort((a,b)=>b.received_date.localeCompare(a.received_date));
  },[batches,products,batchSortKey,batchSortDirection]);
  const batchPageSafe=Math.min(batchPage,Math.max(0,Math.ceil(allBatches.length/PAGE_SIZE)-1));

  function switchTab(next:"products"|"stocks") {setTab(next);setSearch("");setProductsPage(0);setLogsPage(0);}
  function switchFilter(next:Filter) {setFilter(next);setProductsPage(0);}
  return <main className="pb-12">
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3"><div>
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-brand-pink">Inventory</h1>

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { fetchPetsWithAccounts, fetchPetsWithoutAccounts } from "@/lib/supabase/appointments";
import { fetchCustomers } from "@/lib/supabase/users";
import type { Pet } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { Customer } from "@/lib/types/users";
import PetCard from "@/components/admin/pet-records/PetCard";
import PetFilters, { type PetFilterState } from "@/components/admin/pet-records/PetFilters";
import PetDetailModal from "@/components/admin/pet-records/PetDetailModal";

import OwnerDetailModal from "@/components/admin/pet-records/OwnerDetailModal";

type Tab = "registered" | "walk-in";
const PAGE_SIZE = 9;

export default function PetRecordsPage() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>("registered");
  const [registeredPets, setRegisteredPets] = useState<Pet[]>([]);
  const [walkInPets, setWalkInPets] = useState<Pet[]>([]);
  const [customers, setCustomers] = useState<Customer[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<PetFilterState>({ search: "", species: "all", ageSort: "none", breed: "" });
  const [ownerFilter, setOwnerFilter] = useState<string | "all">("all");
  const [pages, setPages] = useState<Record<Tab, number>>({ registered: 1, "walk-in": 1 });
  const [selectedPet, setSelectedPet] = useState<Pet | null>(null);
  const [selectedCustomer, setSelectedCustomer] = useState<Customer | null>(null);

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    const [regResult, walkResult, custResult] = await Promise.all([
      fetchPetsWithAccounts(), fetchPetsWithoutAccounts(), fetchCustomers(),
    ]);
    if (regResult.error) { setLoadError(regResult.error); return; }
    if (walkResult.error) { setLoadError(walkResult.error); return; }
    setLoadError(null);
    setRegisteredPets(regResult.pets);
    setWalkInPets(walkResult.pets);
    setCustomers(custResult.customers ?? []);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    setLoading(true);
    void loadData().finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [loadData]);

  const pets = tab === "registered" ? registeredPets : walkInPets;
  const customerById = (id: string) => customers.find((c) => c.id === id);

  function ownerNameFor(pet: Pet): string | null {
    if (tab === "registered") return pet.customer_id ? customerById(pet.customer_id)?.full_name ?? null : null;
    return pet.owner_name;
  }

  const filteredPets = (() => {
    const q = filters.search.trim().toLowerCase();
    let result = pets.filter((pet) => {
      const owner = ownerNameFor(pet);
      const matchesSearch = !q || pet.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (owner?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ?? false);
      const matchesSpecies = filters.species === "all" || pet.species === filters.species;
      const matchesBreed = !filters.breed.trim() || pet.breed.toLowerCase().includes(filters.breed.trim().toLowerCase());
      const matchesOwner = tab === "walk-in" || ownerFilter === "all" || pet.customer_id === ownerFilter;
      return matchesSearch && matchesSpecies && matchesBreed && matchesOwner;
    });
    if (filters.ageSort === "youngest") result = [...result].sort((a, b) => (a.age ?? 999) - (b.age ?? 999));
    if (filters.ageSort === "oldest") result = [...result].sort((a, b) => (b.age ?? -1) - (a.age ?? -1));
    return result;
  })();

  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filteredPets.length / PAGE_SIZE));
  const currentPage = Math.min(pages[tab], pageCount);
  const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE;
  const visiblePets = filteredPets.slice(startIndex, startIndex + PAGE_SIZE);

  function setPage(next: number) {
    setPages((previous) => ({ ...previous, [tab]: Math.max(1, Math.min(next, pageCount)) }));
  }
  function resetCurrentPage() {
    setPages((previous) => ({ ...previous, [tab]: 1 }));
  }
  function changeFilters(next: PetFilterState) {
    setFilters(next);
    resetCurrentPage();
  }
  function changeOwnerFilter(next: string | "all") {
    setOwnerFilter(next);
    resetCurrentPage();
  }
  function handlePetUpdated(updated: Pet) {
    const setter = tab === "registered" ? setRegisteredPets : setWalkInPets;
    setter((prev) => prev.map((p) => (p.id === updated.id ? updated : p)));
    setSelectedPet(updated);
  }
  function switchTab(next: Tab) {
    setTab(next);
    setOwnerFilter("all");
    setFilters((f) => ({ ...f, search: "" }));
  }

  const selectedPetOwner = selectedPet
    ? tab === "registered"
      ? { name: customerById(selectedPet.customer_id ?? "")?.full_name ?? null, contact: customerById(selectedPet.customer_id ?? "")?.phone_number ?? null, address: customerById(selectedPet.customer_id ?? "")?.address ?? null }
      : { name: selectedPet.owner_name, contact: selectedPet.owner_contact, address: null }
    : null;

  return (
    <div>
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-brand-pink">Pet&apos;s Record</h1>
      <div className="mt-4 flex w-fit rounded-full border border-pink-200 bg-white p-1">
        <button type="button" onClick={() => switchTab("registered")} className={`rounded-full px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold transition-colors ${tab === "registered" ? "bg-brand-pink text-white" : "text-zinc-600"}`}>
          Registered Owners <span className="ml-1 opacity-80">({registeredPets.length})</span>
        </button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => switchTab("walk-in")} className={`rounded-full px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold transition-colors ${tab === "walk-in" ? "bg-brand-pink text-white" : "text-zinc-600"}`}>
          Walk-in Only <span className="ml-1 opacity-80">({walkInPets.length})</span>
        </button>
      </div>
      {loadError && <p role="alert" className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-600">{loadError}</p>}
      <div className="mt-6 flex flex-col gap-6 lg:flex-row">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <PetFilters filters={filters} onChange={changeFilters} />
          {tab === "registered" && ownerFilter !== "all" && (
            <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-zinc-600">
              Showing pets for <strong>{customerById(ownerFilter)?.full_name}</strong>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => changeOwnerFilter("all")} className="text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink hover:underline">Clear</button>
            </div>
          )}
          {/* Larger cards need two columns alongside the owner sidebar. */}
          <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-1 content-start gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 2xl:grid-cols-3">
            {loading ? (
              <p className="col-span-full py-10 text-center text-zinc-400">Loading petsâ€¦</p>
            ) : filteredPets.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="col-span-full py-10 text-center text-zinc-400">
                {tab === "walk-in" ? "No walk-in-only pets match your filters." : "No pets match your search/filter."}
              </p>
            ) : visiblePets.map((pet) => (
              <PetCard key={pet.id} pet={pet} ownerName={ownerNameFor(pet)} onView={() => setSelectedPet(pet)} />
            ))}
          </div>
          {!loading && filteredPets.length > 0 && (
            <nav aria-label="Pet records pagination" className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white px-4 py-3">
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
                Showing <strong>{startIndex + 1}â€“{Math.min(startIndex + PAGE_SIZE, filteredPets.length)}</strong> of <strong>{filteredPets.length}</strong> pets
              </p>
              {pageCount > 1 && (
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setPage(currentPage - 1)} disabled={currentPage === 1} className="rounded-full border border-pink-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40">Previous</button>
                  {Array.from({ length: pageCount }, (_, index) => index + 1).filter((page) => page === 1 || page === pageCount || Math.abs(page - currentPage) <= 1).map((page, index, arr) => (
                    <span key={page} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      {index > 0 && page - arr[index - 1] > 1 && <span className="px-1 text-zinc-400" aria-hidden="true">â€¦</span>}
                      <button type="button" aria-label={`Page ${page}`} aria-current={currentPage === page ? "page" : undefined} onClick={() => setPage(page)} className={`min-h-8 min-w-8 rounded-full px-2 text-xs font-bold ${currentPage === page ? "bg-brand-pink text-white" : "border border-pink-200 text-brand-pink hover:bg-pink-50"}`}>{page}</button>
                    </span>
                  ))}
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setPage(currentPage + 1)} disabled={currentPage === pageCount} className="rounded-full border border-pink-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40">Next</button>

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { fetchKennels, addKennel, setKennelActive } from "@/lib/supabase/pet-services";
import { subscribeToServiceSessions, type BoardingSessionRow } from "@/lib/supabase/service-sessions";
import { checkoutBoardingPet, setBoardingPetPlannedPickup, fetchBoardingHistory, fetchBoardingOccupancy, type BoardingHistoryItem } from "@/lib/supabase/boarding-operations";
import type { Kennel, KennelSize } from "@/lib/types/pet-services";
import KennelStats from "@/components/admin/pet-services/KennelStats";
import BoardingFilters, { type BoardingFilterState } from "@/components/admin/pet-services/BoardingFilters";
import BoardingHistoryModal from "@/components/admin/pet-services/BoardingHistoryModal";
import OpsKennelCard from "@/components/admin/operations/OpsKennelCard";
import AddKennelModal from "@/components/admin/operations/AddKennelModal";
import SessionDetailsModal from "@/components/admin/pet-services/SessionDetailsModal";
import SessionCompletedModal from "@/components/admin/pet-services/SessionCompletedModal";
import FeedbackDialog from "@/components/admin/operations/FeedbackDialog";

type Pending = { kennel: Kennel;action: "disable" | "activate" };

export default function BoardingManagementPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [kennels, setKennels] = useState<Kennel[]>([]);
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<BoardingSessionRow[]>([]);
  const [historyRows, setHistoryRows] = useState<BoardingHistoryItem[]>([]);
  const [historyError, setHistoryError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<BoardingFilterState>({ search: "", status: "all" });
  const [history, setHistory] = useState(false);
  const [add, setAdd] = useState(false);
  const [viewing, setViewing] = useState<{ appointmentId: string;appointmentPetId: string } | null>(null);
  const [completingId, setCompletingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [completedName, setCompletedName] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<Pending | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [showInactive, setShowInactive] = useState(false);
  const [pickupTarget, setPickupTarget] = useState<BoardingSessionRow | null>(null);
  const [pickupValue, setPickupValue] = useState("");
  const [pickupBusy, setPickupBusy] = useState(false);
  const [pickupError, setPickupError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const [k, s] = await Promise.all([fetchKennels({ includeInactive: true }), fetchBoardingOccupancy()]);
    if (k.error || s.error) { setError(k.error ?? s.error ?? "Unable to load boarding data."); return; }
    setKennels(k.kennels);setSessions(s.sessions);setError(null);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { setLoading(true);void load().finally(() => setLoading(false)); }, [load]);
  useEffect(() => subscribeToServiceSessions(() => { void load(); }), [load]);
  const active = kennels.filter((k) => k.is_active !== false);
  const inactive = kennels.filter((k) => k.is_active === false);
  const count = (size: KennelSize) => active.filter((k) => k.size === size).length;
  const sessionFor = (kennelId: string) => sessions.filter((s) => s.kennelId === kennelId);
  const filtered = active.filter((kennel) => {
    const items = sessionFor(kennel.id);
    const query = filters.search.trim().toLowerCase();
    const searchMatch = !query || String(kennel.number).includes(query) || items.some((s) => s.petName.toLowerCase().includes(query) || s.ownerName.toLowerCase().includes(query));
    // 'booked' belongs to the reservation calendar, not physical occupancy.
    const statusMatch = filters.status === "all" || (filters.status === "occupied" ? items.length > 0 : items.length === 0);
    return searchMatch && statusMatch;
  });
  const nextNumber = (size: KennelSize) => {
    const list = kennels.filter((k) => k.size === size).map((k) => k.number);
    return list.length ? Math.max(...list) + 1 : 101;
  };

  async function addK(size: KennelSize, number: number, name: string) {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      // Forward the custom name when the installed addKennel helper supports it.
      // Older helpers accept only size/number and harmlessly ignore extra JS args.
      const saveWithName = addKennel as (kind: KennelSize, no: number, label: string) => ReturnType<typeof addKennel>;
      const { error: saveError } = await saveWithName(size, number, name);
      if (saveError) { setError(saveError.message); return; }
      setAdd(false);
      await load();
    } catch (cause) {
      setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Unable to add the kennel.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  // The updated AddKennelModal can reactivate a disabled physical kennel.
  // Route that request through the existing confirmation and capacity check.
  function requestKennelReactivation(id: string) {
    if (busy) return;
    const kennel = inactive.find((item) => item.id === id);
    if (!kennel) { setError("The selected disabled kennel could not be found. Refresh and try again."); return; }
    setAdd(false);
    setPending({ kennel, action: "activate" });
  }
  async function toggleKennel() {
    if (!pending || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);setError(null);
    try {
      const { error: saveError } = await setKennelActive(pending.kennel.id, pending.action === "activate");
      if (saveError) { setError(saveError.message); return; }
      setPending(null);await load();
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
  async function checkOut(id: string, name: string) {
    if (completingId) return;
    setCompletingId(id);setError(null);
    try {
      const result = await checkoutBoardingPet(id);
      if (result.error) setError(result.error);
      else { await load();setCompletedName(name); }
    } finally { setCompletingId(null); }
  }
  async function savePickup() {
    if (!pickupTarget || pickupBusy) return;
    const iso = new Date(`${pickupValue}:00+08:00`).toISOString();
    setPickupBusy(true);setPickupError(null);
    try {
      const r = await setBoardingPetPlannedPickup(pickupTarget.appointmentPetId, iso);
      if (r.error) { setPickupError(r.error); return; }
      setPickupTarget(null);await load();
    } catch (e) { setPickupError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unable to update pickup."); }
    finally { setPickupBusy(false); }
  }
  function openPickup(session: BoardingSessionRow) {
    setPickupTarget(session);setPickupError(null);
    const dt = session.pickUpAt ? new Date(session.pickUpAt) : null;
    const bits = dt ? new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", year:"numeric", month:"2-digit", day:"2-digit", hour:"2-digit", minute:"2-digit", hourCycle:"h23" }).formatToParts(dt) : [];
    const get = (name:string) => bits.find(b=>b.type===name)?.value??"00";
    setPickupValue(dt ? `${get("year")}-${get("month")}-${get("day")}T${get("hour")}:${get("minute")}` : "");
  }
  async function openHistory() {
    setHistory(true);setHistoryRows([]);setHistoryError(null);
    const result = await fetchBoardingHistory();
    setHistoryRows(result.history);setHistoryError(result.error);
  }

  return <div>
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
      <div><h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-brand-pink">Boarding Management</h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600">Active kennel capacity: <b>{count("small")} Small and {count("big")} Big</b>. Add kennels as the shop expands; booking availability follows the active roster. A shared Big kennel shows both checked-in pets.</p></div>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowInactive((v) => !v)} className="rounded-full border border-pink-200 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink">{showInactive ? "Hide" : "View"} Disabled Kennels ({inactive.length})</button>
    </div>
    {error && <FeedbackDialog title="Boarding Needs Attention" message={error} onClose={() => setError(null)} actionLabel="Retry Loading" onAction={() => { setError(null); void load(); }} />}
    <div className="mt-6"><KennelStats small={count("small")} big={count("big")} occupied={new Set(sessions.map((s) => s.kennelId)).size}/></div>
    <div className="mt-6"><BoardingFilters filters={filters} onChange={setFilters} onBack={() => router.push("/admin/pet-services")} onOpenHistory={() => { void openHistory(); }} historyCount={historyRows.length}/></div>
    {loading ? <p className="mt-10 text-center text-zinc-400">Loading boarding occupancyâ€¦</p> : <>
      {(["small", "big"] as KennelSize[]).map((size) => {
        const items = filtered.filter((k) => k.size === size);
        return <section key={size} className="mt-6">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2"><h2 className="font-bold uppercase text-zinc-800">{size === "big" ? "Big" : "Small"} Kennels ({count(size)} active)</h2>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setAdd(true)} className="rounded-full border border-brand-pink px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink disabled:opacity-40">Add Kennel</button></div>
          <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
            {items.map((k) => <OpsKennelCard key={k.id} kennel={k} sessions={sessionFor(k.id)}
              onView={(appointmentId, appointmentPetId) => setViewing({ appointmentId, appointmentPetId })}
              onRemove={() => setPending({ kennel: k, action: "disable" })}
              onComplete={(id, name) => { void checkOut(id, name); }} onPlanPickup={openPickup} completing={completingId}/>)}
            {items.length === 0 && <p className="col-span-full py-8 text-center text-sm text-zinc-500">No {size} kennels match the selected filter.</p>}
          </div>
        </section>;
      })}
      {showInactive && <section className="mt-8 rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-4"><h2 className="font-bold text-amber-900">Disabled Kennels</h2>
        <div className="mt-3 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">{inactive.map((k) => <div key={k.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white p-3">
          <b className="text-sm text-zinc-700">{k.size === "big" ? "Big" : "Small"} Kennel #{k.number}</b>
          <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setPending({ kennel: k, action: "activate" })} className="rounded-full border border-emerald-400 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 disabled:opacity-40">Reactivate</button>
        </div>)}{inactive.length === 0 && <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">No disabled kennels.</p>}</div>
      </section>}
    </>}
    {pickupTarget && <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[140] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 p-4">
      <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Plan individual pet pickup" className="w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl bg-white p-6 shadow-xl">
        <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-900">Plan Pickup â€” {pickupTarget.petName}</h3>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-zinc-600">Set an earlier pickup for this pet only. The shared kennel reservation and its total charge remain unchanged, and any companion pet keeps its stay.</p>
        <label className="mt-4 block text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-700">New planned pickup (Philippine time)
          <input type="datetime-local" value={pickupValue} onChange={e=>setPickupValue(e.target.value)} className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-pink-200 p-3"/>
        </label>
        {pickupError && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-700">{pickupError}</p>}

      onAdd={(size, number, name) => { void addK(size, number, name); }}
      onReactivate={requestKennelReactivation}
      saving={busy}

A kennel with upcoming bookings cannot be disabled." : "This kennel will become available for new reservations. The physical 6/2 capacity limit still applies."}</p>

          <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => { void toggleKennel(); }} className="rounded-full bg-brand-pink py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-40">{busy ? "Savingâ€¦" : "Confirm"}</button></div>
      </div>
    </div>}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { fetchGroomers, addGroomer, setGroomerStatus } from "@/lib/supabase/pet-services";
import { fetchGroomingSessions, subscribeToServiceSessions, type GroomingSessionRow } from "@/lib/supabase/service-sessions";
import { completeAppointmentPet, updateAppointmentStatus } from "@/lib/supabase/appointment-management";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import type { Groomer } from "@/lib/types/pet-services";
import SessionFilters, { type SessionFilterState } from "@/components/admin/pet-services/SessionFilters";
import HistoryModal from "@/components/admin/pet-services/HistoryModal";
import AddGroomerModal from "@/components/admin/pet-services/AddGroomerModal";
import SessionDetailsModal from "@/components/admin/pet-services/SessionDetailsModal";
import SessionCompletedModal from "@/components/admin/pet-services/SessionCompletedModal";
import GroomerAvailabilitySettings from "@/components/admin/pet-services/GroomerAvailabilitySettings";
import ActionConfirmModal from "@/components/admin/operations/ActionConfirmModal";
import FeedbackDialog from "@/components/admin/operations/FeedbackDialog";

export default function GroomingManagementPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [groomers, setGroomers] = useState<Groomer[]>([]);
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<GroomingSessionRow[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<SessionFilterState>({ search: "", status: "all", groomer: "all" });
  const [history, setHistory] = useState(false);
  const [add, setAdd] = useState(false);
  const [viewing, setViewing] = useState<GroomingSessionRow | null>(null);
  const [completingId, setCompletingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [completedName, setCompletedName] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [groomerTarget, setGroomerTarget] = useState<Groomer | null>(null);
  const [toggleBusy, setToggleBusy] = useState(false);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [groomerRefreshKey, setGroomerRefreshKey] = useState(0);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const [g, s] = await Promise.all([fetchGroomers(), fetchGroomingSessions()]);
    if (g.error || s.error) { setError(g.error ?? s.error ?? "Unable to load grooming data."); return; }
    // Preserve the previous protection against completed pets reappearing
    // while the parent appointment completion notification is pending.
    const ids = s.sessions.map(item => item.appointmentPetId);
    if (ids.length) {
      const { data: petRows, error: pe } = await createClient().from("appointment_pets")
        .select("id,status").in("id", ids);
      if (pe) { setError(pe.message); return; }
      const ongoing = new Set((petRows ?? []).filter(p => p.status !== "completed").map(p => p.id));
      setSessions(s.sessions.filter(item => ongoing.has(item.appointmentPetId)));
    } else setSessions([]);
    setGroomers(g.groomers);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { setLoading(true); void load().finally(() => setLoading(false)); }, [load]);
  useEffect(() => subscribeToServiceSessions(() => { void load(); }), [load]);

  const active = groomers.filter(g => g.status === "active");
  const visible = sessions.filter(s => (filters.groomer === "all" || s.groomerName === filters.groomer) &&
    (!filters.search || `${s.petName} ${s.ownerName}`.toLowerCase().includes(filters.search.toLowerCase())));

  async function addG(name: string) {
    const result = await addGroomer(name);
    if (result.error) return result.error.message;
    await load();
    setGroomerRefreshKey(k => k + 1);
    return null;
  }
  function requestGroomerStatus(id: string, currentStatus: "active" | "archived") {
    if (toggleBusy || groomerTarget) return;
    const person = groomers.find(g => g.id === id && g.status === currentStatus);
    if (!person) { setError("This groomer changed since the list loaded. Refresh and try again."); return; }
    setNotice(null);
    setGroomerTarget(person);
  }
  async function confirmGroomerStatus() {
    if (!groomerTarget || toggleBusy) return;
    const person = groomerTarget;
    const nextStatus = person.status === "active" ? "archived" : "active";
    setToggleBusy(true);
    try {
      const result = await setGroomerStatus(person.id, nextStatus);
      if (result.error) throw new Error(result.error.message);
      setGroomerTarget(null);
      await load();
      setGroomerRefreshKey(k => k + 1);
      setNotice(`${person.name} ${nextStatus === "active" ? "reactivated" : "archived"}.`);
    } catch (e) {
      setGroomerTarget(null);
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unable to update groomer status.");
    } finally { setToggleBusy(false); }
  }
  async function completePet(appointmentPetId: string, petName: string, appointmentId: string) {
    if (completingId) return;
    setCompletingId(appointmentPetId);
    try {
      const result = await completeAppointmentPet(appointmentPetId, "groomer");
      if (result.error) { setError(result.error); return; }
      const { data: pets, error: petError } = await createClient().from("appointment_pets")
        .select("id,status").eq("appointment_id", appointmentId);
      if (petError) { setError(`Pet status could not be verified: ${petError.message}`); return; }
      if (!(pets ?? []).some(p => p.id === appointmentPetId && p.status === "completed")) {
        setError("Pet completion was not saved. Refresh this appointment before retrying."); return;
      }
      let completionError: string | null = null;
      if ((pets ?? []).length && (pets ?? []).every(p => p.status === "completed")) {
        const updated = await updateAppointmentStatus(appointmentId, "completed");
        if (updated.error) completionError = `Pet completed, but the appointment needs attention: ${updated.error.message}`;
      }
      setCompletedName(petName);
      await load();
      if (completionError) setError(completionError);
    } catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unable to complete this grooming session."); }
    finally { setCompletingId(null); }
  }

  const archiving = groomerTarget?.status === "active";
  const targetHasSession = !!groomerTarget && sessions.some(s => s.groomerId === groomerTarget.id);

  return <div>
    <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-brand-pink">Grooming Management</h1>
    <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-zinc-500">Manage sessions, individual groomer reservations, package durations, and staff availability.</p>
    {notice && <p role="status" className="mt-3 text-sm font-medium text-emerald-700">{notice}</p>}
    <div className="mt-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-4"><p className="text-sm font-semibold">Active Sessions</p><p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold">{sessions.length}</p></div>
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-4"><p className="text-sm font-semibold">Available Right Now</p><p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold">{active.filter(g => !sessions.some(s => s.groomerId === g.id)).length}</p></div>
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-4"><p className="text-sm font-semibold">Active Groomers</p><p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold">{active.length}</p></div>
    </div>
    <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
      <SessionFilters filters={filters} onChange={setFilters} groomerNames={active.map(g => g.name)}
        onBack={() => router.push("/admin/pet-services")} onOpenHistory={() => setHistory(true)} historyCount={0} />
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setAdd(true)} className="rounded-full border-2 border-brand-pink px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink">Add Groomer</button>
    </div>
    {loading ? <p className="mt-10 text-center text-zinc-400">Loadingâ€¦</p> : <div className="mt-6 space-y-6">
      {active.map(g => {
        const gs = visible.filter(s => s.groomerId === g.id);
        return <section key={g.id}>
          <div className="flex justify-between gap-3"><div><h3 className="font-bold">{g.name} <span className="font-normal text-zinc-500">({gs.length}/1)</span></h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">{gs.length ? "In Progress" : "Available"}</p></div>
            <button type="button" disabled={toggleBusy} onClick={() => requestGroomerStatus(g.id, g.status)}
              className="rounded-full border border-red-400 px-3 py-1 text-xs text-red-500 disabled:opacity-50">Archive</button></div>
          {gs.length ? <div className="mt-3 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3">{gs.map(s => <div key={s.appointmentPetId} className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-4">
            <div className="flex justify-between"><strong>{s.petName}</strong><span className="rounded-full bg-violet-50 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] text-violet-700">In Progress</span></div>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">{s.breed}</p><p className="mt-2 text-xs text-zinc-400">Owner: {s.ownerName}</p>
            <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2"><button type="button" onClick={() => setViewing(s)} className="flex-1 rounded-full border border-brand-pink px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink">Details</button>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => void completePet(s.appointmentPetId, s.petName, s.appointmentId)} disabled={!!completingId}
                className="flex-1 rounded-full bg-brand-pink px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-40">{completingId === s.appointmentPetId ? "Savingâ€¦" : "Complete"}</button></div>
          </div>)}</div> : <div className="mt-3 rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-pink-200 p-5 text-sm text-zinc-400">No active pet session.</div>}
        </section>;
      })}
    </div>}
    <GroomerAvailabilitySettings refreshKey={groomerRefreshKey} />
    {history && <HistoryModal completedSessions={[]} onClose={() => setHistory(false)} />}
    {add && <AddGroomerModal groomers={groomers} onClose={() => setAdd(false)} onAdd={addG} onArchiveToggle={requestGroomerStatus} />}
    {viewing && <SessionDetailsModal appointmentId={viewing.appointmentId} appointmentPetId={viewing.appointmentPetId} onClose={() => setViewing(null)} />}
    {completedName && <SessionCompletedModal petName={completedName} onClose={() => setCompletedName(null)} />}
    {groomerTarget && <ActionConfirmModal
      title={`${archiving ? "Archive" : "Reactivate"} groomer?`}
      description={`${groomerTarget.name} will ${archiving ? "stop being available for new Grooming bookings" : "become available for new Grooming bookings"}. Existing appointment records are preserved.${archiving && targetHasSession ? " This groomer has an ongoing session; review that assignment before archiving." : ""}`}
      confirmLabel={archiving ? "Archive Groomer" : "Reactivate Groomer"}
      destructive={archiving} pending={toggleBusy} onCancel={() => setGroomerTarget(null)}
      onConfirm={confirmGroomerStatus} />}
    {error && <FeedbackDialog title="Grooming Needs Attention" message={error} onClose={() => setError(null)} actionLabel="Retry Loading" onAction={() => { setError(null); void load(); }} />}
  </div>;
}

function Stat({
  label,
  value,
  tone,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  tone: "pink" | "blue" | "green";
}) {
  const toneClass =
    tone === "pink"
      ? "bg-pink-50 text-brand-pink"
      : tone === "blue"
        ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-500"
        : "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600";

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
      <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${toneClass}`}>
        <PawIcon className="w-5 h-5" />
      </div>
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wide">{label}</p>
        <p className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800">{value}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { fetchProducts, addProduct, setProductStatus } from "@/lib/supabase/products";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import type { Product, ProductCategory } from "@/lib/types/products";
import ProductManageCard from "@/components/admin/operations/ProductManageCard";
import ProductFormModal from "@/components/admin/operations/ProductFormModal";
import ArchiveConfirmModal from "@/components/admin/operations/ArchiveConfirmModal";

const categories: { label: string; value: ProductCategory | "all" }[] = [
  { label: "All Items", value: "all" }, { label: "Food", value: "Food" },
  { label: "Treats", value: "Treats" }, { label: "Groom Product", value: "Grooming" },
  { label: "Accessories", value: "Accessories" }, { label: "Hygiene", value: "Hygiene" },
];

export default function PosManagementPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<ProductCategory | "all">("all");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [formModal, setFormModal] = useState<{ mode: "add" | "edit"; product?: Product } | null>(null);
  const [archiveTarget, setArchiveTarget] = useState<Product | null>(null);
  const [showArchived, setShowArchived] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const loadProducts = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    const result = await fetchProducts();
    if (result.error) { setError(result.error); return false; }
    setProducts(result.products);
    setError(null);
    return true;
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { void loadProducts().finally(() => setLoading(false)); }, [loadProducts]);

  const filtered = products.filter(p =>
    (showArchived ? p.status === "discontinued" : p.status === "active") &&
    (category === "all" || p.category === category) &&
    (!search.trim() || `${p.name} ${p.product_code}`.toLowerCase().includes(search.trim().toLowerCase()))
  );

  async function handleSave(data: {
    name: string; unit: string; package_size: string | null; price: number;
    min_stock: number; category: ProductCategory;
  }, id?: string): Promise<{ id: string; product_code: string }> {
    if (id) {
      const current = products.find(p => p.id === id);
      if (!current) throw new Error("This item is no longer in the loaded catalog. Refresh and try again.");
      const { data: updated, error: updateError } = await createClient().from("products")
        .update(data).eq("id", id).select("id");
      if (updateError) throw new Error(updateError.message);
      if (!updated?.length) throw new Error("The item was not updated. Check your database permissions.");
      setNotice(`Updated ${data.name}.`);
      return { id, product_code: current.product_code };
    }
    const result = await addProduct(data);
    if (result.error) throw new Error(result.error.message);
    if (!result.data) throw new Error("The new item could not be confirmed. Please refresh the catalog.");
    setNotice(`Added ${data.name}.`);
    return { id: result.data.id, product_code: result.data.product_code };
  }

  async function toggleArchive() {
    if (!archiveTarget || busy) return;
    setBusy(true); setError(null); setNotice(null);
    const target = archiveTarget;
    const newStatus = target.status === "active" ? "discontinued" : "active";
    try {
      const result = await setProductStatus(target.id, newStatus);
      if (result.error) throw new Error(result.error.message);
      setArchiveTarget(null);
      const refreshed = await loadProducts();
      if (refreshed) setNotice(`${target.name} ${newStatus === "active" ? "restored" : "archived"} successfully.`);
    } catch (err) { setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unable to change item status."); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  return <div className="pb-12">
    <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-brand-pink">POS Configuration</h1>
    <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500">Manage the items used by POS and Inventory.</p>
    <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
      <button type="button" onClick={() => router.push("/admin/pos")} aria-label="Back to POS" className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-pink-200 bg-white hover:border-brand-pink">â†</button>
      <input type="search" aria-label="Search items" placeholder="Search items by name or code" value={search} onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)} className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-full border border-pink-200 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-pink" />
      <button type="button" onClick={() => { setNotice(null); setFormModal({ mode: "add" }); }} className="rounded-full border-2 border-brand-pink px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink hover:bg-pink-50">Add Product</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowArchived(v => !v)} className={`rounded-full border-2 px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold ${showArchived ? "border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-800 text-white" : "border-zinc-300 text-zinc-600"}`}>{showArchived ? "Viewing Archive" : "Archive"}</button>
    </div>
    <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">{categories.map(c => <button type="button" key={c.value} onClick={() => setCategory(c.value)} className={`rounded-full border px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium ${category === c.value ? "border-brand-pink bg-brand-pink text-white" : "border-brand-pink bg-white text-zinc-700"}`}>{c.label}</button>)}</div>
    {error && <p role="alert" className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">{error}</p>}
    {notice && <p role="status" className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-emerald-800">{notice}</p>}
    <div className="mt-4 grid max-h-[60vh] grid-cols-2 gap-4 overflow-y-auto pr-1 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
      {loading ? <p className="col-span-full py-10 text-center text-zinc-500">Loading productsâ€¦</p> : filtered.length === 0 ? <p className="col-span-full py-10 text-center text-zinc-500">{showArchived ? "No archived products match these filters." : "No active products match these filters."}</p> : filtered.map(product => <ProductManageCard key={product.id} product={product} onEdit={() => { setNotice(null); setFormModal({ mode: "edit", product }); }} onArchiveToggle={() => setArchiveTarget(product)} />)}
    </div>
    {formModal && <ProductFormModal key={`${formModal.mode}-${formModal.product?.id ?? "new"}`} mode={formModal.mode} existing={formModal.product} onSave={handleSave} onClose={() => { setFormModal(null); void loadProducts(); }} />}
    {archiveTarget && <ArchiveConfirmModal itemName={archiveTarget.name} archived={archiveTarget.status === "discontinued"} onClose={() => { if (!busy) setArchiveTarget(null); }} onConfirm={toggleArchive} />}
  </div>;
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import type { Customer } from "@/lib/types/users";
import type { Pet, DraftPetSelection } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { Groomer, Kennel } from "@/lib/types/pet-services";
import type { Package, PetSize, Addon } from "@/lib/types/services";
import { emptyLeg, eligibleServicesFor, type BookingLeg } from "@/lib/types/booking-leg";
import { findDuplicatePetAddon } from "@/lib/booking/unique-pet-addons";
import { fetchGroomers, fetchKennels } from "@/lib/supabase/pet-services";
import { fetchPackagesFull, fetchPetSizes, fetchAddonsByCategory } from "@/lib/supabase/services";
import type { WalkInServiceChoice } from "@/components/admin/pos/walk-in/ServiceChoiceStep";
import CustomerVerifyStep from "@/components/admin/pos/walk-in/CustomerVerifyStep";
import PetInformationStep from "@/components/admin/pos/walk-in/PetInformationStep";
import WaiverStep from "@/components/admin/pos/walk-in/WaiverStep";
import BoardingDetailsAndSchedule from "@/components/shared/BoardingDetailsAndSchedule";
import AlaCarteSelectionStep from "@/components/admin/pos/walk-in/AlaCarteSelectionStep";
import CustomerServiceChoiceStep from "@/components/dashboard/booking/CustomerServiceChoiceStep";
import CustomerGroomingSelectionStep from "@/components/dashboard/booking/CustomerGroomingSelectionStep";
import CustomerGroomingScheduleStep from "@/components/dashboard/booking/CustomerGroomingScheduleStep";
import HolidayAwareGroomingSchedule from "@/components/admin/pos/walk-in/HolidayAwareGroomingSchedule";
import BookingProgress from "@/components/dashboard/booking/BookingProgress";
import AddAnotherServicePrompt from "@/components/dashboard/booking/AddAnotherServicePrompt";
import CurrentLegSidebar from "@/components/dashboard/booking/CurrentLegSidebar";
import WalkInMultiServiceSummary from "@/components/admin/pos/walk-in/WalkInMultiServiceSummary";
import "@/app/(dashboard)/account/appointments/booking-polish.css";
import "./pos-booking.css";

type Step = "verify" | "pet-info" | "service" | "waiver" | "selection" | "schedule" | "add-more" | "summary";

export default function WalkInPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>("verify");
  const [waiverBackStep, setWaiverBackStep] = useState<"service" | "add-more">("service");
  const [customer, setCustomer] = useState<Customer | null>(null);
  const [owner, setOwner] = useState({ name: "", contact: "", address: "" });
  const [pets, setPets] = useState<Pet[]>([]);
  const [currentLeg, setCurrentLeg] = useState<BookingLeg | null>(null);
  const [completedLegs, setCompletedLegs] = useState<BookingLeg[]>([]);
  const [groomers, setGroomers] = useState<Groomer[]>([]);
  const [kennels, setKennels] = useState<Kennel[]>([]);
  const [packagesByService, setPackagesByService] = useState<Record<string, Package[]>>({});
  const [sizesByService, setSizesByService] = useState<Record<string, PetSize[]>>({});
  const [addonsByService, setAddonsByService] = useState<Record<string, Addon[]>>({});
  const [lookupError, setLookupError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [duplicateWarning, setDuplicateWarning] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    Promise.all([
      fetchGroomers({ activeOnly: true }), fetchKennels(),
      fetchAddonsByCategory("Boarding Add-ons"),
      fetchAddonsByCategory("Ala Carte"),
    ]).then(([g, k, ba, ac]) => {
      if (!active) return;
      setGroomers(g.groomers); setKennels(k.kennels);
      setAddonsByService(prev => ({ ...prev, boarding: ba.addons, ala_carte: ac.addons }));
    }).catch(() => { if (active) setLookupError("Some booking options could not be loaded. Refresh before proceeding."); });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, []);

  const loadGrooming = useCallback(async (service: "dog_grooming" | "cat_grooming") => {
    try {
      const [pkg, sizes, addons] = await Promise.all([
        fetchPackagesFull(service), fetchPetSizes(service), fetchAddonsByCategory("Grooming Add-ons"),
      ]);
      setPackagesByService(prev => ({ ...prev, [service]: pkg.packages }));
      setSizesByService(prev => ({ ...prev, [service]: sizes.sizes }));
      setAddonsByService(prev => ({ ...prev, [service]: addons.addons }));
    } catch { setLookupError("Grooming prices could not be loaded. Refresh before proceeding."); }
  }, []);

  const loadForChoice = useCallback((choice: WalkInServiceChoice) => {
    if (choice === "grooming") void Promise.all([loadGrooming("dog_grooming"), loadGrooming("cat_grooming")]);
    else if (choice === "dog_grooming" || choice === "cat_grooming") void loadGrooming(choice);
  }, [loadGrooming]);

  const chosenIds = pets.map(p => p.id);
  const eligible = eligibleServicesFor(pets, chosenIds, completedLegs).filter(choice => {
    if (choice === "grooming") return !completedLegs.some(l => ["grooming", "dog_grooming", "cat_grooming"].includes(l.serviceChoice));
    return true;
  });
  const legPets = currentLeg ? pets.filter(p => currentLeg.petIds.includes(p.id)) : [];
  const grooming = currentLeg && ["grooming", "dog_grooming", "cat_grooming"].includes(currentLeg.serviceChoice);

  function chooseService(choice: WalkInServiceChoice) {
    const ids = pets.filter(p => choice === "dog_grooming" ? p.species === "Dog" : choice === "cat_grooming" ? p.species === "Cat" : true).map(p => p.id);
    if (!ids.length) return;
    setWaiverBackStep(step === "add-more" ? "add-more" : "service");
    setCurrentLeg(emptyLeg(choice, ids));
    loadForChoice(choice);
    setStep("waiver");
  }
  function updateSelections(selections: DraftPetSelection[]) {
    setCurrentLeg(prev => prev && { ...prev, petSelections: selections });
  }
  function confirmSchedule(selections?: DraftPetSelection[]) {
    if (!currentLeg) return;
    const confirmedLeg = Array.isArray(selections) ? { ...currentLeg, petSelections: selections } : currentLeg;
    const proposed = [...completedLegs.filter(l => l.id !== currentLeg.id), confirmedLeg];
    const duplicate = findDuplicatePetAddon(proposed, addonsByService);
    if (duplicate) { setDuplicateWarning(duplicate); setStep("selection"); return; }
    setCompletedLegs(proposed);
    setCurrentLeg(null);
    setStep("add-more");
  }
  function editLeg(id: string) {
    const found = completedLegs.find(l => l.id === id);
    if (!found) return;
    setCompletedLegs(prev => prev.filter(l => l.id !== id));
    setCurrentLeg(found); loadForChoice(found.serviceChoice); setStep("selection");
  }
  function backFromSelection() { setStep("waiver"); }

  // POS uses the same responsive layout as Customer Booking. The POS-only
  // identity verification and atomic walk-in checkout remain unchanged.
  const showPetSummary = (step === "selection" || step === "schedule") && legPets.length > 0;
  return <div className="ht-pos-booking ht-booking-v4 min-w-0 pb-8">
    <button type="button" onClick={() => router.push("/admin/pos")} className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-500 hover:text-brand-pink">â† Back to POS</button>
    <div className="mx-auto mt-5 w-full max-w-7xl min-w-0">
      <div className="ht-pos-intro mb-5 rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white px-4 py-4 sm:px-6">
        <h1 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-brand-pink">Walk-in Booking</h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500">Same multi-pet and multi-service booking process as customer appointments, with walk-in records.</p>
        {completedLegs.length > 0 && <p className="mt-2 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-700">Services ready: {completedLegs.length} Â· Pets: {pets.length}</p>}
      </div>
      <div className={`ht-booking-shell ${step === "verify" ? "ht-pos-verify" : ""}`}>
        {step !== "verify" && <div className="ht-booking-left">
          <BookingProgress step={step} hasCompletedServices={completedLegs.length > 0}
            combinedBoarding={step === "selection" && currentLeg?.serviceChoice === "boarding"} />
          {showPetSummary && <CurrentLegSidebar pets={legPets} onRemove={id => setCurrentLeg(prev =>
            prev && prev.petIds.length > 1 ? { ...prev,
              petIds: prev.petIds.filter(x => x !== id),
              petSelections: prev.petSelections.filter(s => s.pet.id !== id),
            } : prev)} />}
        </div>}
        <div className="ht-booking-main">
          <div className="ht-booking-panel">
      {lookupError && <p role="alert" className="mb-4 rounded-xl bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-700">{lookupError}</p>}
      {step === "verify" && <CustomerVerifyStep onSelectExisting={c => {
        setCustomer(c); setOwner({ name: c.full_name, contact: c.phone_number ?? "", address: c.address ?? "" }); setStep("pet-info");
      }} onNewCustomer={() => { setCustomer(null); setOwner({ name: "", contact: "", address: "" }); setStep("pet-info"); }} />}
      {step === "pet-info" && <PetInformationStep customer={customer} onBack={() => setStep("verify")} onNext={(selected, override) => {
        setPets(selected);
        if (override) setOwner({ name: override.name, contact: override.contact, address: override.address });
        setCompletedLegs([]); setCurrentLeg(null); setStep("service");
      }} />}
      {step === "service" && <CustomerServiceChoiceStep choice={null} petSpecies={pets.map(p => p.species)} onChange={chooseService}
        onBack={() => setStep(completedLegs.length ? "add-more" : "pet-info")} onNext={() => {}} />}
      {step === "waiver" && currentLeg && <WaiverStep serviceType={currentLeg.serviceChoice} onBack={() => { setCurrentLeg(null); setStep(waiverBackStep); }} onAgree={() => setStep("selection")} />}
      {step === "selection" && currentLeg?.serviceChoice === "boarding" && <div className="ht-pos-service-step"><BoardingDetailsAndSchedule
        pets={legPets} selections={currentLeg.petSelections} kennels={kennels}
        alreadyGroomedPetIds={completedLegs.filter(l => ["grooming", "dog_grooming", "cat_grooming"].includes(l.serviceChoice)).flatMap(l => l.petIds)}
        scheduledDate={currentLeg.scheduledDate} petBelongings={currentLeg.petBelongings}
        specialRequests={currentLeg.specialRequests} onChange={updateSelections}
        onBelongingsChange={v => setCurrentLeg(l => l && { ...l, petBelongings: v })}
        onRequestsChange={v => setCurrentLeg(l => l && { ...l, specialRequests: v })}
        onBack={backFromSelection} onConfirmed={confirmSchedule} /></div>}
      {step === "selection" && currentLeg?.serviceChoice === "ala_carte" && <AlaCarteSelectionStep pets={legPets} selections={currentLeg.petSelections}
        completedLegs={completedLegs} onChange={updateSelections} onBack={backFromSelection} onNext={() => setStep("schedule")} />}
      {step === "selection" && grooming && currentLeg && <div className="ht-pos-service-step"><CustomerGroomingSelectionStep serviceType={currentLeg.serviceChoice as "grooming" | "dog_grooming" | "cat_grooming"}
        pets={legPets} selections={currentLeg.petSelections} onChange={updateSelections} onBack={backFromSelection} onNext={() => setStep("schedule")} /></div>}
      {step === "schedule" && currentLeg && grooming && <div className="ht-booking-schedule"><HolidayAwareGroomingSchedule
        petSelections={currentLeg.petSelections} scheduledDate={currentLeg.scheduledDate} scheduledTime={currentLeg.scheduledTime}
