"use client";
// POS Issue #2: commit the entire checkout through one atomic Supabase RPC.
// Database is authoritative for stock, price and sales receipt.
import { useState, useMemo, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import { fetchProducts } from "@/lib/supabase/products";
import { checkoutPosSale } from "@/lib/supabase/pos-checkout";
import type { Product, ProductCategory } from "@/lib/types/products";
import PosCategoryTabs from "@/components/admin/pos/PosCategoryTabs";
import ProductPosCard from "@/components/admin/pos/ProductPosCard";
import CartPanel, { type CartLine } from "@/components/admin/pos/CartPanel";
import ProcessPaymentModal, { type LowStockWarning } from "@/components/admin/pos/ProcessPaymentModal";
import SaleCompleteModal, { type CompletedSale } from "@/components/admin/pos/SaleCompleteModal";

export default function PointOfSalePage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [allProducts, setAllProducts] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<ProductCategory | "all">("all");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [cart, setCart] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [paymentOpen, setPaymentOpen] = useState(false);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const processingRef = useRef(false);
  // Keep this ID stable during retries, including ambiguous network failures.
  const checkoutRequestId = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const [checkoutError, setCheckoutError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [completedSale, setCompletedSale] = useState<CompletedSale | null>(null);
  const [isSuperadmin, setIsSuperadmin] = useState(false);

  async function loadProducts() {
    setLoading(true);
    const { products, error } = await fetchProducts({ activeOnly: true });
    if (!error) setAllProducts(products);
    else setCheckoutError(`Unable to refresh inventory: ${error}`);
    setLoading(false);
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
      if (user) {
        const { data: profile } = await supabase.from("profiles")
          .select("role").eq("id", user.id).maybeSingle();
        setIsSuperadmin(profile?.role === "superadmin");
      }
      await loadProducts();
    }
    void load();
  }, []);

  const filteredProducts = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return allProducts.filter((p) =>
      (category === "all" || p.category === category) &&
      (!q || p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q))
    );
  }, [allProducts, category, search]);

  const cartLines: CartLine[] = Object.entries(cart)
    .filter(([, qty]) => qty > 0)
    .map(([id, qty]) => ({ product: allProducts.find((p) => p.id === id)!, qty }))
    .filter((line) => line.product);

  const amountDue = cartLines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.product.price * l.qty, 0);

  // A low-stock threshold is for staff decision-making, not a checkout ban.
  // Warn when the proposed sale would leave stock at/below min_stock,
  // even if the product currently has healthy stock.
  const lowStockWarnings: LowStockWarning[] = cartLines
    .filter(({ product, qty }) => {
      const available = Math.max(0, product.stock ?? 0);
      return available - qty <= product.min_stock;
    })
    .map(({ product, qty }) => ({
      productId: product.id,
      name: product.name,
      currentStock: Math.max(0, product.stock ?? 0),
      remainingStock: Math.max(0, (product.stock ?? 0) - qty),
      minStock: product.min_stock,
    }));

  function increment(id: string) {
    if (processingRef.current) return;
    const product = allProducts.find((p) => p.id === id);
    if (!product) return;
    setCart((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: Math.min(Math.max(0, product.stock ?? 0), (prev[id] ?? 0) + 1) }));
    checkoutRequestId.current = null;
  }
  function decrement(id: string) {
    if (processingRef.current) return;
    setCart((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: Math.max(0, (prev[id] ?? 0) - 1) }));
    checkoutRequestId.current = null;
  }
  function remove(id: string) {
    if (processingRef.current) return;
    setCart((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      delete next[id];
      return next;
    });
    checkoutRequestId.current = null;
  }
  function clearCart() {
    if (processingRef.current) return;
    setCart({});
    checkoutRequestId.current = null;
  }

  async function handleConfirmPayment(amountPaid: number, method: "Cash") {
    if (processingRef.current || cartLines.length === 0) return;
    // Prevent double submissions before React can rerender the button.
    processingRef.current = true;
    setProcessing(true);
    setCheckoutError(null);
    if (!checkoutRequestId.current) checkoutRequestId.current = crypto.randomUUID();

    try {
      const { sale, error } = await checkoutPosSale({
        requestId: checkoutRequestId.current,
        items: cartLines.map((l) => ({ productId: l.product.id, quantity: l.qty })),
        amountPaid,
        method,
      });
      if (error || !sale) {
        setCheckoutError(error ?? "Checkout failed. Please review Sales Reports before retrying.");
        return;
      }

      setCompletedSale({
        invoiceNumber: sale.invoiceNumber,
        method,
        total: sale.totalAmount,
        amountPaid: sale.amountPaid,
        change: sale.changeAmount,
        itemCount: sale.items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0),
        items: sale.items.map((item) => ({
          name: item.name, qty: item.quantity, unitPrice: item.unitPrice,
        })),
      });
      setPaymentOpen(false);
      setCart({});
      checkoutRequestId.current = null;
      await loadProducts();
    } catch (err) {
      setCheckoutError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Checkout connection failed. Check Sales Reports before retrying.");
    } finally {
      processingRef.current = false;
      setProcessing(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-6 h-full">
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-brand-pink">Point of Sales</h1>
          {isSuperadmin && (
            <button
              onClick={() => router.push("/admin/pos/configuration")}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 border-2 border-brand-pink text-brand-pink font-semibold text-sm px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-brand-pink hover:text-white transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
            >
              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" />
                <path d="M4 21V3h16v18H4ZM8 7h8M8 12h8M8 17h6" />
              </svg>
              Configuration
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {checkoutError && !paymentOpen && (
          <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-red-600 bg-red-50 rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5">{checkoutError}</p>
        )}

        {lowStockWarnings.length > 0 && !paymentOpen && (
          <div role="status" className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-amber-900">
            <strong>Low stock warning:</strong> This cart would leave {lowStockWarnings.length} product{lowStockWarnings.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} at or below the reorder level. The sale can still proceed after cashier confirmation.
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
          <div className="flex-1 relative">
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400">
              <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" /><path d="M21 21l-4-4" strokeLinecap="round" />
            </svg>
            <input type="text" placeholder="Search items" value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} className="w-full rounded-full border border-pink-200 bg-white pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-pink" />
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => router.push("/admin/pos/walk-in")} className="border-2 border-brand-pink text-brand-pink font-semibold text-sm px-6 py-2 rounded-full hover:bg-brand-pink hover:text-white transition-colors">
            Walk In
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-3">
          <PosCategoryTabs active={category} onChange={setCategory} />
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
          {loading ? (
            <p className="col-span-full text-center text-zinc-400 py-10">Loading products...</p>
          ) : filteredProducts.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="col-span-full text-center text-zinc-400 py-10">No items match your search.</p>
          ) : (
            filteredProducts.map((product) => (
              <ProductPosCard
                key={product.id}
                product={product}
                qty={cart[product.id] ?? 0}
                onIncrement={() => increment(product.id)}
                onDecrement={() => decrement(product.id)}
              />
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <CartPanel
        cart={cartLines}
        onIncrement={increment}
        onDecrement={decrement}
        onRemove={remove}
        onClear={clearCart}
        onProcessPayment={() => { setCheckoutError(null); setPaymentOpen(true); }}
      />

      {paymentOpen && (
        <ProcessPaymentModal amountDue={amountDue}
          processing={processing} error={checkoutError}
          lowStockWarnings={lowStockWarnings}
          onClose={() => { if (!processingRef.current) setPaymentOpen(false); }}
          onConfirm={handleConfirmPayment} />
      )}

      {completedSale && (
        <SaleCompleteModal sale={completedSale} onClose={() => setCompletedSale(null)} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\app\(admin)\admin\profile\page.tsx =====

"use client";
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { fetchOwnProfile, updateOwnProfile, uploadAvatar } from "@/lib/supabase/profile";
import { changeSuperadminUsername } from "@/lib/supabase/superadmin-username";
import { splitFullName } from "@/lib/types/profile";
import { validateEmail, validatePhoneNumber, validateUsername } from "@/lib/validation/staff";
import { ToastProvider, useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import ChangePasswordModal from "@/components/admin/profile/ChangePasswordModal";
import type { OwnProfile } from "@/lib/types/profile";

function ProfilePageInner() {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<OwnProfile | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [editMode, setEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [passwordModalOpen, setPasswordModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [uploadingAvatar, setUploadingAvatar] = useState(false);
  const [usernameOpen, setUsernameOpen] = useState(false);
  const [usernameDraft, setUsernameDraft] = useState("");
  const [usernameSaving, setUsernameSaving] = useState(false);
  const [usernameError, setUsernameError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    firstName: "", middleName: "", lastName: "",
    dateOfBirth: "", phoneNumber: "", email: "", address: "", recoveryEmail: "",
  });

  function loadIntoForm(p: OwnProfile) {
    const { first, middle, last } = splitFullName(p.full_name);
    setForm({
      firstName: first, middleName: middle, lastName: last,
      dateOfBirth: p.date_of_birth ?? "",
      phoneNumber: p.phone_number ?? "",
      email: p.email,
      address: p.address ?? "",
      recoveryEmail: p.recovery_email ?? "",
    });
  }

  async function load() {
    const { profile: updated, error: loadError } = await fetchOwnProfile();
    if (updated) { setProfile(updated); loadIntoForm(updated); }
    else if (loadError) showToast(loadError, "error");
    setLoading(false);
  }

  useEffect(() => { void load(); }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  function update(field: keyof typeof form, value: string) {
    setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  }

  function handleCancel() {
    if (profile) loadIntoForm(profile);
    setError(null);
    setEditMode(false);
  }

  async function handleSave() {
    setError(null);
    if (!form.firstName.trim() || !form.lastName.trim() || !form.phoneNumber.trim() || !form.email.trim()) {
      setError("First name, last name, phone number, and email are required.");
      return;
    }
    const phoneError = validatePhoneNumber(form.phoneNumber);
    if (phoneError) { setError(phoneError); return; }
    const emailError = validateEmail(form.email);
    if (emailError) { setError(emailError); return; }
    if (form.recoveryEmail) {
      const recoveryError = validateEmail(form.recoveryEmail);
      if (recoveryError) { setError(`Recovery email: ${recoveryError}`); return; }
    }

    setSaving(true);
    const fullName = [form.firstName, form.middleName, form.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
    try {
      const result = await updateOwnProfile({
        fullName,
        phoneNumber: form.phoneNumber,
        email: form.email,
        dateOfBirth: form.dateOfBirth || null,
        address: form.address,
        recoveryEmail: form.recoveryEmail,
      });
      if (result.error) { setError(result.error); return; }
      showToast(result.emailChangePending ? "Saved. Check your new email to confirm the change." : "Profile updated.");
      setEditMode(false);
      await load();
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : "Unable to update profile.");
    } finally { setSaving(false); }
  }

  function openUsernameEditor() {
    if (!profile || profile.role !== "superadmin") return;
    setUsernameDraft(profile.username ?? "");
    setUsernameError(null);
    setUsernameOpen(true);
  }

  async function saveUsername() {
    if (!profile || profile.role !== "superadmin" || usernameSaving) return;
    const cleaned = usernameDraft.trim();
    const invalid = validateUsername(cleaned);
    if (invalid || cleaned.length > 20) {
      setUsernameError(invalid ?? "Username must not exceed 20 characters.");
      return;
    }
    if (cleaned === profile.username) { setUsernameOpen(false); return; }
    setUsernameSaving(true);
    setUsernameError(null);
    try {
      const result = await changeSuperadminUsername(cleaned);
      if (result.error || !result.username) {
        setUsernameError(result.error ?? "Username update could not be confirmed.");
        return;
      }
      // The RPC updates profiles.username AND staff_profiles.username atomically.
      // Updating local state avoids resetting any unsaved, unrelated profile fields.
      setProfile((previous) => previous ? { ...previous, username: result.username } : previous);
      setUsernameOpen(false);
      showToast("Username changed. Use the new username at your next sign-in.");
    } catch (caught) {
      setUsernameError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : "Unable to change username.");
    } finally { setUsernameSaving(false); }
  }

  async function handleAvatarChange(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    setUploadingAvatar(true);
    const { error: avatarError, url } = await uploadAvatar(file);
    setUploadingAvatar(false);
    if (avatarError) { showToast(avatarError, "error"); return; }
    if (url && profile) setProfile({ ...profile, profile_picture_url: url });
    showToast("Profile photo updated.");
  }

  if (loading) return <p className="text-zinc-400">Loading profile...</p>;
  if (!profile) return <p className="text-red-500">Couldn't load your profile.</p>;

  const inputClass = (disabled: boolean) =>
    `mt-1.5 w-full rounded-xl border px-4 py-2.5 text-sm transition-shadow focus:outline-none ${
      disabled ? "border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 text-zinc-500" : "border-zinc-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-pink"
    }`;

  return (
    <div className="max-w-5xl">
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-brand-pink">Account Management</h1>
      <div className="mt-1 border-b-2 border-brand-pink/40" />
      <div className="mt-6 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 shadow-sm p-6 transition-shadow hover:shadow-md">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-start gap-5">
          <div className="relative shrink-0">
            <div className="w-24 h-24 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-brand-pink to-brand-pink-dark flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
              {profile.profile_picture_url ? (
                // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                <img src={profile.profile_picture_url} alt="Profile" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
              ) : (
                <svg width="44" height="44" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" opacity="0.85"><path d="M12 12a4 4 0 1 0 0-8 4 4 0 0 0 0 8zM4 21c0-4.5 3.5-7 8-7s8 2.5 8 7" /></svg>
              )}
            </div>
            <label className="absolute -bottom-2 -right-2 w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-white border-2 border-brand-pink flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer hover:bg-brand-tint transition-colors shadow-sm">
              {uploadingAvatar ? <span className="text-[9px] text-brand-pink">...</span> : (
                <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="text-brand-pink"><path d="M23 19a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H3a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4l2-3h6l2 3h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" /><circle cx="12" cy="13" r="4" /></svg>
              )}
              <input type="file" accept="image/*" className="hidden" onChange={handleAvatarChange} disabled={uploadingAvatar} />
            </label>
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-900">{profile.full_name || "Superadmin"}</h2>
                <span className="mt-1 inline-block text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-brand-tint text-brand-pink">{profile.role === "superadmin" ? "Super Admin" : profile.role === "admin" ? "Staff" : profile.role}</span>
              </div>
              {!editMode && <button onClick={() => setEditMode(true)} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 border-2 border-brand-pink text-brand-pink font-semibold text-sm px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-brand-pink hover:text-white transition-colors"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2"><path d="M12 20h9M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4L16.5 3.5z" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" /></svg>Edit Profile</button>}
            </div>
            <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-4 pt-4 border-t border-pink-50">
              <div><p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">Employee ID</p><p className="mt-0.5 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800">{profile.employee_id ?? "â€”"}</p></div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">Username</p>
                <p className="mt-0.5 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800 break-all">{profile.username ?? "â€”"}</p>
                {profile.role === "superadmin" && <button type="button" onClick={openUsernameEditor} className="mt-1 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink underline underline-offset-2">Change username</button>}
              </div>
              <div><p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">Status</p><p className="mt-0.5 text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-600 flex items-center gap-1.5"><span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" /> Active</p></div>
              <div><p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">Member Since</p><p className="mt-0.5 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800">{new Date(profile.created_at).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" })}</p></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 shadow-sm p-6 transition-shadow hover:shadow-md">
          <h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-brand-pink"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M12 12a4 4 0 1 0 0-8 4 4 0 0 0 0 8zM4 21c0-4.5 3.5-7 8-7s8 2.5 8 7" /></svg>Personal Information</h3>
          <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div><label className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-600">First Name</label><input disabled={!editMode} value={form.firstName} onChange={(e) => update("firstName", e.target.value)} className={inputClass(!editMode)} /></div>
            <div><label className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-600">Middle Name</label><input disabled={!editMode} value={form.middleName} onChange={(e) => update("middleName", e.target.value)} className={inputClass(!editMode)} /></div>
            <div><label className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-600">Last Name</label><input disabled={!editMode} value={form.lastName} onChange={(e) => update("lastName", e.target.value)} className={inputClass(!editMode)} /></div>
          </div>

import Link from "next/link";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import StaffAuditLogViewer from "@/components/admin/reports/StaffAuditLogViewer";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export default async function StaffAuditLogPage() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) redirect("/sign-in");
  const { data: profile } = await supabase.from("profiles").select("role").eq("id",user.id).maybeSingle();
  if (profile?.role !== "superadmin") redirect("/admin");
  return <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl space-y-5 pb-12">
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
      <div><p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">Report Management / Audit Logs</p>
        <h1 className="mt-1 text-2xl font-extrabold text-brand-pink">Staff Audit Logs</h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600">Recorded system changes by staff accounts and trusted server processes. SuperAdmin access only.</p>
      </div>
      <Link href="/admin/reports" className="rounded-full border border-pink-200 bg-white px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink hover:bg-pink-50">Back to Reports</Link>
    </div>
    <StaffAuditLogViewer />
  </div>;
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\app\(admin)\admin\reports\page.tsx =====

"use client";
// HappyTails Report Management: 3 clear reports.
// Service = appointments + charges; Inventory = stock; Sales = invoice cash ledger.
// Transaction Reports duplicate tab was merged into Service Reports.
import { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from "react";
import { Inter } from "next/font/google";
import { sortRows, nextSortState, type SortDirection } from "@/lib/utils/sort";

import type { ServiceReport } from "@/lib/data/service-reports-mock";
import type { InventoryReportRow } from "@/lib/data/inventory-reports-mock";
import type { SalesReportRow } from "@/lib/data/sales-reports-mock";
import { fetchServiceReports } from "@/lib/supabase/reports";
import { fetchInventoryReportRows } from "@/lib/supabase/inventory-reports";
import { fetchSalesReportRows } from "@/lib/supabase/sales";

import ReportsHeader from "@/components/admin/reports/ReportsHeader";
import ReportTabs, { type ReportTab } from "@/components/admin/reports/ReportTabs";
import ReportStats from "@/components/admin/reports/ReportStats";
import ReportFooter from "@/components/admin/reports/ReportFooter";
import ReportDetailModal from "@/components/admin/reports/ReportDetailModal";

import FilterToolbar, { type FilterState } from "@/components/admin/reports/FilterToolbar";
import ReportTable from "@/components/admin/reports/ReportTable";
import InventoryFilterToolbar, { type InventoryFilterState } from "@/components/admin/reports/InventoryFilterToolbar";
import InventoryReportTable from "@/components/admin/reports/InventoryReportTable";
import SalesFilterToolbar, { type SalesFilterState } from "@/components/admin/reports/SalesFilterToolbar";
import SalesReportTable from "@/components/admin/reports/SalesReportTable";

const inter = Inter({ subsets: ["latin"] });
const emptyServiceFilters: FilterState = {
  search: "", reportType: "All Types", source: "all", fromDate: "", toDate: "", status: "all",
};
const emptyInventoryFilters: InventoryFilterState = {
  search: "", category: "All Categories", expiration: "all", status: "all", unit: "All Units",
};
const emptySalesFilters: SalesFilterState = {
  search: "", fromDate: "", toDate: "", category: "All Categories",
};
const PAGE_SIZE_DEFAULT = 10;

export default function ReportManagementPage() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<ReportTab>("service");
  const [serviceReports, setServiceReports] = useState<ServiceReport[]>([]);
  const [inventoryReports, setInventoryReports] = useState<InventoryReportRow[]>([]);
  const [salesReports, setSalesReports] = useState<SalesReportRow[]>([]);
  const [reportsLoading, setReportsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [reportsError, setReportsError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [nowMs] = useState(() => Date.now());

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    async function load() {
      const [service, inventory, sales] = await Promise.all([
        fetchServiceReports(),
        fetchInventoryReportRows(),
        fetchSalesReportRows(),
      ]);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setServiceReports(service.rows);
      setInventoryReports(inventory.rows);
      setSalesReports(sales.rows);
      setReportsError(service.error ?? inventory.error ?? sales.error ?? null);
      setReportsLoading(false);
    }
    load().catch((error: unknown) => {
      if (mounted) {
        setReportsError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Couldn't load report data.");
        setReportsLoading(false);
      }
    });
    return () => { mounted = false; };
  }, []);

  // Service Reports: source is a first-class filter, not inferred from
  // whether a customer has a registered account.
  const [serviceFilters, setServiceFilters] = useState(emptyServiceFilters);
  const [servicePage, setServicePage] = useState(0);
  const [servicePageSize, setServicePageSize] = useState(PAGE_SIZE_DEFAULT);
  const [serviceSortKey, setServiceSortKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [serviceSortDir, setServiceSortDir] = useState<SortDirection>(null);
  const [selectedService, setSelectedService] = useState<ServiceReport | null>(null);

  const filteredService = useMemo(() => {
    const q = serviceFilters.search.trim().toLowerCase();
    const matched = serviceReports.filter((r) => {
      const matchesSearch = !q ||
        [r.id, r.pet, r.owner, r.service, r.appointmentId].some((v) => v.toLowerCase().includes(q));
      const matchesType = serviceFilters.reportType === "All Types" || r.category === serviceFilters.reportType;
      const matchesSource = serviceFilters.source === "all" || r.source === serviceFilters.source;
      const matchesStatus = serviceFilters.status === "all" || r.status === serviceFilters.status;
      const matchesFrom = !serviceFilters.fromDate || r.date >= serviceFilters.fromDate;
      const matchesTo = !serviceFilters.toDate || r.date <= serviceFilters.toDate;
      return matchesSearch && matchesType && matchesSource && matchesStatus && matchesFrom && matchesTo;
    });
    return sortRows(matched, serviceSortKey, serviceSortDir);
  }, [serviceFilters, serviceSortKey, serviceSortDir, serviceReports]);

  // Inventory Reports: preserve original filters, sorting, and pagination.
  const [inventoryFilters, setInventoryFilters] = useState(emptyInventoryFilters);
  const [inventoryPage, setInventoryPage] = useState(0);
  const [inventoryPageSize, setInventoryPageSize] = useState(PAGE_SIZE_DEFAULT);
  const [inventorySortKey, setInventorySortKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [inventorySortDir, setInventorySortDir] = useState<SortDirection>(null);

  const filteredInventory = useMemo(() => {
    const q = inventoryFilters.search.trim().toLowerCase();
    const matched = inventoryReports.filter((r) => {
      const matchesSearch = !q || r.itemName.toLowerCase().includes(q) || r.id.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchesCategory = inventoryFilters.category === "All Categories" || r.category === inventoryFilters.category;
      const matchesStatus = inventoryFilters.status === "all" || r.status === inventoryFilters.status;
      const matchesUnit = inventoryFilters.unit === "All Units" || r.unit === inventoryFilters.unit;
      const matchesExpiration = inventoryFilters.expiration === "all" ||
        (inventoryFilters.expiration === "no_expiration" && !r.expirationDate) ||
        (inventoryFilters.expiration === "expiring_soon" && !!r.expirationDate &&
          (new Date(r.expirationDate).getTime() - nowMs) / 86400000 <= 30);
      return matchesSearch && matchesCategory && matchesStatus && matchesUnit && matchesExpiration;
    });
    return sortRows(matched, inventorySortKey, inventorySortDir);
  }, [inventoryFilters, inventorySortKey, inventorySortDir, inventoryReports, nowMs]);

  // Sales Reports: one row per invoice. Category search matches any
  // item, but still shows the FULL invoice total/cash/change once.
  const [salesFilters, setSalesFilters] = useState(emptySalesFilters);
  const [salesPage, setSalesPage] = useState(0);
  const [salesPageSize, setSalesPageSize] = useState(PAGE_SIZE_DEFAULT);
  const [salesSortKey, setSalesSortKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [salesSortDir, setSalesSortDir] = useState<SortDirection>(null);

  const filteredSales = useMemo(() => {
    const q = salesFilters.search.trim().toLowerCase();
    const matched = salesReports.filter((r) => {
      const matchesSearch = !q || r.itemName.toLowerCase().includes(q) || r.invoiceNumber.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchesCategory = salesFilters.category === "All Categories" || r.items.some((i) => i.category === salesFilters.category);
      const matchesFrom = !salesFilters.fromDate || r.date >= salesFilters.fromDate;
      const matchesTo = !salesFilters.toDate || r.date <= salesFilters.toDate;
      return matchesSearch && matchesCategory && matchesFrom && matchesTo;
    });
    return sortRows(matched, salesSortKey, salesSortDir);
  }, [salesFilters, salesSortKey, salesSortDir, salesReports]);

  return (
    <div className={`${inter.className} -m-6 md:-m-8 p-6 md:p-8 min-h-full bg-[#F8F9FC]`}>
      <ReportsHeader />
      <div className="mt-6"><ReportTabs active={tab} onChange={setTab} /></div>

      {reportsError && (
        <div className="mt-5 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-600">
          Couldn&apos;t load report data: {reportsError}
        </div>
      )}
      {reportsLoading && <p className="mt-5 text-sm text-zinc-400">Loading real report dataâ€¦</p>}

      {tab === "service" && (
        <>
          <div className="mt-5"><FilterToolbar filters={serviceFilters} onApply={(f) => { setServiceFilters(f); setServicePage(0); }} onReset={() => { setServiceFilters(emptyServiceFilters); setServicePage(0); }} rows={filteredService} /></div>
          <div className="mt-5"><ReportStats reports={filteredService} /></div>
          <div className="mt-5"><ReportTable rows={filteredService.slice(servicePage * servicePageSize, servicePage * servicePageSize + servicePageSize)} onView={setSelectedService} sortKey={serviceSortKey} sortDirection={serviceSortDir} onSort={(key) => { const n = nextSortState(serviceSortKey, serviceSortDir, key); setServiceSortKey(n.key); setServiceSortDir(n.direction); }} /></div>
          <div className="mt-5"><ReportFooter page={servicePage} pageSize={servicePageSize} totalItems={filteredService.length} onPageChange={setServicePage} onPageSizeChange={(s) => { setServicePageSize(s); setServicePage(0); }} /></div>
        </>
      )}

      {tab === "inventory" && (
        <>
          <div className="mt-5"><InventoryFilterToolbar filters={inventoryFilters} onApply={(f) => { setInventoryFilters(f); setInventoryPage(0); }} onReset={() => { setInventoryFilters(emptyInventoryFilters); setInventoryPage(0); }} rows={filteredInventory} /></div>
          <div className="mt-5"><InventoryReportTable rows={filteredInventory.slice(inventoryPage * inventoryPageSize, inventoryPage * inventoryPageSize + inventoryPageSize)} sortKey={inventorySortKey} sortDirection={inventorySortDir} onSort={(key) => { const n = nextSortState(inventorySortKey, inventorySortDir, key); setInventorySortKey(n.key); setInventorySortDir(n.direction); }} /></div>
          <div className="mt-5"><ReportFooter page={inventoryPage} pageSize={inventoryPageSize} totalItems={filteredInventory.length} onPageChange={setInventoryPage} onPageSizeChange={(s) => { setInventoryPageSize(s); setInventoryPage(0); }} /></div>
        </>
      )}

      {tab === "sales" && (
        <>
          <div className="mt-5"><SalesFilterToolbar filters={salesFilters} onApply={(f) => { setSalesFilters(f); setSalesPage(0); }} onReset={() => { setSalesFilters(emptySalesFilters); setSalesPage(0); }} rows={filteredSales} /></div>
          <div className="mt-5"><SalesReportTable rows={filteredSales.slice(salesPage * salesPageSize, salesPage * salesPageSize + salesPageSize)} sortKey={salesSortKey} sortDirection={salesSortDir} onSort={(key) => { const n = nextSortState(salesSortKey, salesSortDir, key); setSalesSortKey(n.key); setSalesSortDir(n.direction); }} /></div>
          <div className="mt-5"><ReportFooter page={salesPage} pageSize={salesPageSize} totalItems={filteredSales.length} onPageChange={setSalesPage} onPageSizeChange={(s) => { setSalesPageSize(s); setSalesPage(0); }} /></div>
        </>
      )}
      {selectedService && <ReportDetailModal report={selectedService} onClose={() => setSelectedService(null)} />}
    </div>
  );
}

 const cleanSlug=(s:string)=>s.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/^-|-$/g,'');

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";

 const [tab,setTab]=useState<ServiceType>("dog_grooming"); const [search,setSearch]=useState("");
 const [packages,setPackages]=useState<Package[]>([]),[inclusions,setInclusions]=useState<PackageInclusion[]>([]),[pricing,setPricing]=useState<PackagePricing[]>([]),[sizes,setSizes]=useState<PetSize[]>([]),[addons,setAddons]=useState<Addon[]>([]),[addonPrices,setAddonPrices]=useState<AddonPrice[]>([]),[aLaCarteAddons,setALaCarteAddons]=useState<Addon[]>([]),[aLaCartePrices,setALaCartePrices]=useState<AddonPrice[]>([]);
 const [loading,setLoading]=useState(true),[busy,setBusy]=useState(false),[error,setError]=useState<string|null>(null),[notice,setNotice]=useState<string|null>(null);

 const loadData=useCallback(async()=>{setLoading(true);setError(null);try {const [pk,sz,ad,ala]=await Promise.all([fetchPackagesFull(tab),tab!=="boarding"?fetchPetSizes(tab):Promise.resolve({sizes:[] as PetSize[],error:null}),fetchAddonsByCategory(addonCategoryName),fetchAddonsByCategory("Ala Carte")]);setPackages(pk.packages);setInclusions(pk.inclusions);setPricing(pk.pricing);setSizes(sz.sizes);setAddons(ad.addons);setAddonPrices(ad.prices);setALaCarteAddons(ala.addons);setALaCartePrices(ala.prices);const message=[pk.error,sz.error,ad.error,ala.error].filter(Boolean).join("; ");if(message)setError(message);}catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:"Unable to load services");}finally{setLoading(false)}},[tab,addonCategoryName]);
 useEffect(()=>{void loadData()},[loadData]);
 useEffect(()=>{
   if(!confirmationTarget)return;
   function onKeyDown(event:KeyboardEvent){if(event.key==="Escape"&&!busy)setConfirmationTarget(null);}
   window.addEventListener("keydown",onKeyDown);
   return()=>window.removeEventListener("keydown",onKeyDown);
 },[confirmationTarget,busy]);
 function requestStatus(kind:ConfirmationTarget["kind"],id:string,name:string,isActive:boolean,action:ConfirmationTarget["action"]){
   if(busy||confirmationTarget)return;
   // Archiving and deactivating are valid only for active items; reactivation only for inactive ones.
   if(action==="reactivate" ? isActive : !isActive)return;
   setError(null);setNotice(null);

 }
 function togglePackage(pkg:Package){requestStatus("package",pkg.id,pkg.name,pkg.is_active,pkg.is_active?"deactivate":"reactivate")}
 function toggleSize(size:PetSize){requestStatus("size",size.id,size.label,size.is_active,size.is_active?"deactivate":"reactivate")}
 function toggleAddon(addon:Addon){requestStatus("addon",addon.id,addon.name,addon.is_active,addon.is_active?"deactivate":"reactivate")}
 function archivePackage(pkg:Package){requestStatus("package",pkg.id,pkg.name,pkg.is_active,"archive")}
 function archiveSize(size:PetSize){requestStatus("size",size.id,size.label,size.is_active,"archive")}
 function archiveAddon(addon:Addon){requestStatus("addon",addon.id,addon.name,addon.is_active,"archive")}
 async function confirmStatus(){
   if(!confirmationTarget||busy)return;
   const target=confirmationTarget;
   setBusy(true);setError(null);setNotice(null);
   try {
     const active=target.action==="reactivate";
     const result=target.kind==="package"?await togglePackageActive(target.id,active):target.kind==="size"?await toggleSizeActive(target.id,active):await toggleAddonActive(target.id,active);

   }catch(e){setError(`Couldn't ${target.action} ${target.name}: ${e instanceof Error?e.message:"Please check database permissions."}`)}
   finally{setBusy(false)}
 }
 async function addAddon(categoryName:string){setError(null);const {data,error:e}=await createClient().from("addon_categories").select("id").eq("name",categoryName).single();if(e||!data){setError(e?.message??`Missing category: ${categoryName}`);return;}setAddonModal({mode:"add",categoryId:data.id});}
 const filtered=packages.filter(p=>p.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.trim().toLowerCase()));
 return <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl pb-12">
   <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4"><div><h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-brand-pink">Service Management</h1><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500">Manage packages, rates, and optional pet services.</p><Link href="/admin/calendar-management" className="mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border-2 border-brand-pink bg-white px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink hover:bg-pink-50"><CalendarDays size={17}/> Calendar Management</Link></div><input aria-label="Search packages" placeholder="Search packagesâ€¦" value={search} onChange={e=>setSearch(e.target.value)} className="w-full max-w-xs rounded-full border border-pink-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm"/></div>

     <section className="mt-10"><div className="mb-3 flex justify-end"><button type="button" onClick={()=>void addAddon(addonCategoryName)} className="rounded-full border-2 border-brand-pink px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink">+ Add Add-on</button></div><AddOnsSection title={addonCategoryName} addons={addons} prices={addonPrices} onEdit={addon=>setAddonModal({mode:"edit",addon,categoryId:addon.category_id})} onToggleActive={toggleAddon} onArchive={archiveAddon}/></section>

   </>}
   {packageModal&&<PackageFormModal serviceType={tab} sizes={sizes} existing={packageModal.pkg} existingInclusions={packageModal.pkg?inclusions.filter(i=>i.package_id===packageModal.pkg!.id):undefined} existingPricing={packageModal.pkg?pricing.filter(p=>p.package_id===packageModal.pkg!.id):undefined} onClose={()=>setPackageModal(null)} onSaved={()=>{setPackageModal(null);void loadData()}}/>}

   {confirmationTarget&&<div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/55 p-4" onMouseDown={e=>{if(e.target===e.currentTarget&&!busy)setConfirmationTarget(null)}}>
     <div role="alertdialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="service-confirm-title" aria-describedby="service-confirm-description" className="w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-pink-100 bg-white shadow-2xl">
       <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 px-5 pt-5 sm:px-6 sm:pt-6">
         <span className={`flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl ${confirmationTarget.action==="reactivate"?"bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700":"bg-rose-50 text-rose-600"}`}>
           {confirmationTarget.action==="archive"?<Archive size={23}/>:confirmationTarget.action==="reactivate"?<RotateCcw size={23}/>:<PowerOff size={23}/>}

         <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={()=>setConfirmationTarget(null)} aria-label="Close confirmation" className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-zinc-500 hover:bg-pink-50 hover:text-brand-pink disabled:opacity-40"><X size={19}/></button>
       </div>
       <div className="px-5 pt-4 sm:px-6">
         <h2 id="service-confirm-title" className="text-xl font-extrabold text-zinc-800">{confirmationTarget.action==="archive"?"Archive":confirmationTarget.action==="reactivate"?"Reactivate":"Deactivate"} {confirmationTarget.kind==="package"?"Package":confirmationTarget.kind==="size"?"Pet Size":"Add-on"}?</h2>
         <p id="service-confirm-description" className="mt-2 break-words text-sm leading-6 text-zinc-600">
           {confirmationTarget.action==="reactivate"?"Are you sure you want to reactivate ":confirmationTarget.action==="archive"?"Are you sure you want to archive ":"Are you sure you want to deactivate "}
           <strong className="text-zinc-800">{confirmationTarget.name}</strong>?
           {confirmationTarget.action==="reactivate"?" It will become available for new bookings again.":" It will no longer be available for new bookings. Existing appointment and transaction history will be preserved."}
         </p>
         <div className="mt-4 flex gap-2 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2.5 text-xs leading-5 text-amber-800"><AlertTriangle size={17} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0"/><span>{confirmationTarget.action==="reactivate"?"Review package rates and availability before confirming. Existing bookings are not modified.":"You can reactivate the item later. Existing bookings will not be deleted."}</span></div>
         {error&&<p role="alert" className="mt-3 text-sm text-rose-600">{error}</p>}
       </div>
       <div className="mt-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 border-t border-pink-100 px-5 py-4 sm:px-6">
         <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={()=>setConfirmationTarget(null)} className="min-h-11 rounded-full border-2 border-pink-200 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-brand-pink hover:bg-pink-50 disabled:opacity-40">Cancel</button>
         <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={()=>void confirmStatus()} className="flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-brand-pink px-4 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-pink-dark disabled:opacity-40">{busy?"Processingâ€¦":confirmationTarget.action==="archive"?"Archive Item":confirmationTarget.action==="reactivate"?"Reactivate Item":"Deactivate Item"}</button>
       </div>
     </div>
   </div>}
 </div>

"use client";
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from "react";
import { fetchStaff, fetchCustomers } from "@/lib/supabase/users";
import { ToastProvider } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import SearchFilterBar from "@/components/admin/users/SearchFilterBar";
import StaffTable from "@/components/admin/users/StaffTable";
import CustomerTable from "@/components/admin/users/CustomerTable";
import AddStaffModal from "@/components/admin/users/AddStaffModal";
import StaffDetailModal from "@/components/admin/users/StaffDetailModal";
import CustomerDetailModal from "@/components/admin/users/CustomerDetailModal";
import ArchiveModal from "@/components/admin/users/ArchiveModal";
import Pagination from "@/components/admin/Pagination";
import type { StaffMember, Customer, AccountStatus } from "@/lib/types/users";

const PAGE_SIZE = 10;

function UserManagementInner() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"staff" | "customers">("staff");
  const [staff, setStaff] = useState<StaffMember[]>([]);
  const [customers, setCustomers] = useState<Customer[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<AccountStatus | "all">("all");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);

  const [addStaffOpen, setAddStaffOpen] = useState(false);
  const [archiveOpen, setArchiveOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedStaff, setSelectedStaff] = useState<StaffMember | null>(null);
  const [selectedCustomer, setSelectedCustomer] = useState<Customer | null>(null);

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const [staffResult, customerResult] = await Promise.all([fetchStaff(), fetchCustomers()]);
    setStaff(staffResult.staff);
    setCustomers(customerResult.customers);
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { loadData(); }, [loadData]);

  function matchesFilters(name: string, id: string, email: string | null, phone: string | null, status: AccountStatus) {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    const matchesSearch =
      !q || name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || id.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (email ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(q) || (phone ?? "").includes(q);
    const matchesStatus = statusFilter === "all" || status === statusFilter;
    return matchesSearch && matchesStatus && status !== "archived";
  }

  const visibleStaff = useMemo(
    () => staff.filter((s) => matchesFilters(`${s.first_name} ${s.last_name}`, s.employee_id, s.email, s.phone_number, s.status)),
    [staff, search, statusFilter]
  );
  const visibleCustomers = useMemo(
    () => customers.filter((c) => matchesFilters(c.full_name, c.customer_id, c.email, c.phone_number, c.status)),
    [customers, search, statusFilter]
  );

  const archivedStaff = staff.filter((s) => s.status === "archived");
  const archivedCustomers = customers.filter((c) => c.status === "archived");

  const currentList = tab === "staff" ? visibleStaff : visibleCustomers;
  const pagedList = currentList.slice(page * PAGE_SIZE, page * PAGE_SIZE + PAGE_SIZE);

  function changeTab(next: "staff" | "customers") {
    setTab(next);
    setPage(0);
    setSearch("");
    setStatusFilter("all");
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-3">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-brand-pink">User Account Management</h1>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {tab === "staff" && (
            <button onClick={() => setAddStaffOpen(true)} className="bg-brand-pink hover:bg-brand-pink-dark text-white font-semibold text-sm px-5 py-2 rounded-full transition-colors">
              Add Account
            </button>
          )}
          <button onClick={() => setArchiveOpen(true)} className="border-2 border-brand-pink text-brand-pink font-semibold text-sm px-5 py-2 rounded-full hover:bg-brand-pink hover:text-white transition-colors">
            Archive
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-5 inline-flex bg-white rounded-full border border-pink-100 p-1">
        <button onClick={() => changeTab("staff")} className={`px-6 py-2 rounded-full text-sm font-semibold transition-colors ${tab === "staff" ? "bg-brand-pink text-white" : "bg-white text-zinc-800"}`}>
          Staff Management
        </button>
        <button onClick={() => changeTab("customers")} className={`px-6 py-2 rounded-full text-sm font-semibold transition-colors ${tab === "customers" ? "bg-brand-pink text-white" : "bg-white text-zinc-800"}`}>
          User Management
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-5">
        <SearchFilterBar search={search} onSearchChange={(v) => { setSearch(v); setPage(0); }} status={statusFilter} onStatusChange={(v) => { setStatusFilter(v); setPage(0); }} />
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4">
        {loading ? (
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 overflow-hidden animate-pulse">
            <div className="h-10 bg-brand-pink/50" />
            {[...Array(4)].map((_, i) => <div key={i} className="h-12 bg-zinc-100 border-t border-pink-50" />)}
          </div>
        ) : tab === "staff" ? (
          <StaffTable staff={pagedList as StaffMember[]} onView={setSelectedStaff} />
        ) : (
          <CustomerTable customers={pagedList as Customer[]} onView={setSelectedCustomer} />
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4">
        <Pagination page={page} pageSize={PAGE_SIZE} totalItems={currentList.length} onPageChange={setPage} />
      </div>

      {addStaffOpen && <AddStaffModal onClose={() => setAddStaffOpen(false)} onCreated={loadData} />}
      {selectedStaff && <StaffDetailModal staff={selectedStaff} onClose={() => setSelectedStaff(null)} onChanged={loadData} />}
      {selectedCustomer && <CustomerDetailModal customer={selectedCustomer} onClose={() => setSelectedCustomer(null)} onChanged={loadData} />}
      {archiveOpen && (
        <ArchiveModal archivedStaff={archivedStaff} archivedCustomers={archivedCustomers} onClose={() => setArchiveOpen(false)} onChanged={loadData} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function UserManagementPage() {
  return (
    <ToastProvider>
      <UserManagementInner />
    </ToastProvider>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";
import { Camera, Check, ImagePlus, MapPin, Pencil, Trash2, UploadCloud, X } from "lucide-react";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import type { WebsiteBranch } from "@/lib/types/website-branches";

type Draft = Omit<WebsiteBranch, "id">;
const empty: Draft = { name: "", location: "", facebook_url: "", image_url: null, description: "", sort_order: 100, published: false };
const isFacebookUrl = (value: string) => {
  try {
    const url = new URL(value);
    return url.protocol === "https:" && /(^|\.)(facebook\.com|fb\.com)$/i.test(url.hostname) && url.pathname !== "/";
  } catch { return false; }
};

export default function BranchesManagementPage() {
  const [branches, setBranches] = useState<WebsiteBranch[]>([]);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<string | "new" | null>(null);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Draft>(empty);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<WebsiteBranch | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const fileInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const db = useMemo(() => createClient(), []);
  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    const { data, error: e } = await db.from("website_branches").select("*").order("sort_order").order("created_at");
    if (e) { setError(e.message); return; }
    setBranches((data ?? []) as WebsiteBranch[]);
  }, [db]);
  useEffect(() => { void refresh().finally(() => setLoading(false)); }, [refresh]);

  const openNew = () => {
    setDraft({ ...empty, sort_order: Math.max(0, ...branches.map(b => b.sort_order)) + 10 });
    setEditing("new"); setError(""); setNotice("");
  };
  const openEdit = (branch: WebsiteBranch) => {
    const { id: _id, ...rest } = branch; void _id;
    setDraft(rest); setEditing(branch.id); setError(""); setNotice("");
  };
  async function upload(file: File) {
    if (!file.type.match(/^image\/(jpeg|png|webp)$/) || file.size > 8 * 1024 * 1024) {
      setError("Choose a JPG, PNG, or WebP image no larger than 8 MB."); return;
    }
    if (busy) return;
    setUploading(true); setBusy(true); setError("");
    try {
      const ext = file.type === "image/png" ? "png" : file.type === "image/webp" ? "webp" : "jpg";
      const path = `website-branches/${crypto.randomUUID()}.${ext}`;
      const { error: uploadError } = await db.storage.from("site-images").upload(path, file, { contentType: file.type, upsert: false });
      if (uploadError) throw uploadError;
      setDraft(prev => ({ ...prev, image_url: db.storage.from("site-images").getPublicUrl(path).data.publicUrl }));
    } catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Image upload failed."); }
    finally { setUploading(false); setBusy(false); }
  }
  async function save() {
    if (busy || !editing) return;
    if (draft.name.trim().length < 2 || draft.location.trim().length < 2) { setError("Enter a branch name and location (at least 2 characters each)."); return; }
    if (!isFacebookUrl(draft.facebook_url.trim())) { setError("Enter an HTTPS URL for a specific Facebook page."); return; }
    setBusy(true); setError(""); setNotice("");
    try {
      const record = { ...draft, name: draft.name.trim(), location: draft.location.trim(), facebook_url: draft.facebook_url.trim(), description: draft.description.trim(), sort_order: Number.isFinite(draft.sort_order) ? draft.sort_order : 100, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() };
      const result = editing === "new" ? await db.from("website_branches").insert(record).select("id").single() : await db.from("website_branches").update(record).eq("id", editing).select("id").single();
      if (result.error) throw result.error;
      setEditing(null); setNotice("Branch saved successfully."); await refresh();
    } catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not save branch."); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
  async function remove() {
    if (!deleting || busy) return;
    setBusy(true); setError("");
    try {
      const { error: e } = await db.from("website_branches").delete().eq("id", deleting.id).select("id").single();
      if (e) throw e;
      setNotice("Branch deleted."); setDeleting(null); await refresh();
    } catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not delete branch."); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
  async function toggle(branch: WebsiteBranch) {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true); setError(""); setNotice("");
    try {
      const { error: e } = await db.from("website_branches").update({ published: !branch.published, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq("id", branch.id).select("id").single();
      if (e) throw e;
      setNotice(branch.published ? "Branch hidden." : "Branch published."); await refresh();
    } catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not change publication status."); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

'use client';
import { useEffect,useState } from 'react';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client';
import { textDefaults,type WebsiteService,type WebsitePackage,type WebsitePackageMedia } from '@/lib/website/catalog';

export default function ContentEditor(){
 const [text,setText]=useState<Record<string,string>>({...textDefaults});
 const [services,setServices]=useState<WebsiteService[]>([]);
 const [packages,setPackages]=useState<WebsitePackage[]>([]);
 const [media,setMedia]=useState<WebsitePackageMedia[]>([]);
 const [busy,setBusy]=useState(false),[error,setError]=useState(''),[status,setStatus]=useState('');
 const db=createClient();
 async function reload(){const [a,b,c,d]=await Promise.all([db.from('website_text').select('*'),db.from('website_services').select('*').order('sort_order'),db.from('packages').select('id,service_type,name,sort_order,is_active').order('sort_order'),db.from('website_package_media').select('*')]);
  const e=[a.error,b.error,c.error,d.error].find(Boolean);if(e){setError(e.message);return;}
  setText({...textDefaults,...Object.fromEntries((a.data??[]).map(x=>[x.key,x.value]))});setServices((b.data??[]) as WebsiteService[]);setPackages((c.data??[]) as WebsitePackage[]);setMedia((d.data??[]) as WebsitePackageMedia[]);
 }
 useEffect(()=>{void reload()},[]);
 async function run(fn:()=>Promise<void>){setBusy(true);setError('');setStatus('');try{await fn();setStatus('Changes saved.');await reload()}catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:'Operation failed')}finally{setBusy(false)}}
 async function saveText(key:string){const {error}=await db.from('website_text').upsert({key,value:text[key]??'',updated_at:new Date().toISOString()},{onConflict:'key'});if(error)throw error;}
 async function patchService(id:string,patch:Partial<WebsiteService>){const {error}=await db.from('website_services').update({...patch,updated_at:new Date().toISOString()}).eq('id',id);if(error)throw error;}
 async function patchMedia(id:string,patch:Partial<WebsitePackageMedia>){const {error}=await db.from('website_package_media').upsert({package_id:id,...patch,updated_at:new Date().toISOString()},{onConflict:'package_id'});if(error)throw error;}
 async function upload(file:File,kind:'services'|'packages',id:string){
  if(!file.type.startsWith('image/')||file.size>8*1024*1024)throw Error('Choose an image up to 8 MB.');
  const ext=file.name.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase()??'jpg';if(!['jpg','jpeg','png','webp'].includes(ext))throw Error('Use JPG, PNG, or WebP.');
  const path=`website-content/${kind}/${id}/${Date.now()}.${ext}`;
  const {error}=await db.storage.from('site-images').upload(path,file,{contentType:file.type,upsert:false});if(error)throw error;
  const url=db.storage.from('site-images').getPublicUrl(path).data.publicUrl;
  if(kind==='services')await patchService(id,{image_url:url});else await patchMedia(id,{image_url:url});
 }
 return <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl space-y-8 pb-16">
  <header><h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-brand-pink">Website Content & Images</h1><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500">Super Admin only. Published changes appear on the public website.</p></header>
  {error&&<p role="alert" className="rounded-lg bg-red-50 p-3 text-red-700">{error}</p>}{status&&<p role="status" className="rounded-lg bg-green-50 p-3 text-green-700">{status}</p>}
  <section className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 shadow-sm"><h2 className="mb-5 text-xl font-bold">Landing page text</h2><div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">{Object.keys(textDefaults).map(key=><div key={key}><label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-700" htmlFor={`text-${key}`}>{key.replaceAll('_',' ').replace(/\b\w/g,c=>c.toUpperCase())}</label><textarea id={`text-${key}`} rows={key.includes('description')?5:2} value={text[key]??''} onChange={e=>setText(old=>({...old,[key]:e.target.value}))} className="w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 p-3 text-sm"/><button disabled={busy} onClick={()=>void run(()=>saveText(key))} className="rounded-full bg-brand-pink px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50">Save text</button></div>)}</div></section>
  <section className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 shadow-sm"><h2 className="mb-4 text-xl font-bold">Service cards</h2><p className="mb-4 text-sm text-zinc-500">Create and archive services in Service Management. Edit their landing-page presentation here.</p><div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">{services.map(service=><ServiceEditor key={service.id} data={service} disabled={busy} onSave={p=>run(()=>patchService(service.id,p))} onUpload={f=>run(()=>upload(f,'services',service.id))}/>)}</div></section>
  <section className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 shadow-sm"><h2 className="mb-4 text-xl font-bold">Package images & descriptions</h2><p className="mb-4 text-sm text-zinc-500">Packages and pricing come from Service Management. Add a photo and optional marketing description here.</p><div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">{packages.map(pkg=>{const m=media.find(x=>x.package_id===pkg.id);return <PackageEditor key={pkg.id} name={`${pkg.name} â€” ${pkg.service_type}`} initial={m} disabled={busy} onSave={p=>run(()=>patchMedia(pkg.id,p))} onUpload={f=>run(()=>upload(f,'packages',pkg.id))}/>})}</div></section>
 </div>;
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import { defaultFAQs, FAQ_TEXT_KEY, isValidFAQJson, parseFAQs, type FAQItem } from "@/lib/website/faq";
import FAQSection from "@/components/landing/FAQSection";

const db = createClient();
const createId = () => typeof crypto !== "undefined" && "randomUUID" in crypto
  ? crypto.randomUUID() : `faq-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;

export default function FAQManagementPage() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<FAQItem[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const { data, error: failure } = await db.from("website_text").select("value").eq("key", FAQ_TEXT_KEY).maybeSingle();
    if (failure) { setError(`Could not load FAQs: ${failure.message}`); return; }
    if (data && !isValidFAQJson(data.value)) {
      setError("The stored FAQ content has an invalid format. No changes were loaded; correct it before saving.");
      return;
    }
    setItems(data ? parseFAQs(data.value) : defaultFAQs.map(item => ({ ...item })));
    setDirty(false);
    setError("");
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { void load().finally(() => setLoading(false)); }, [load]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!dirty) return;
    const handler = (event: BeforeUnloadEvent) => { event.preventDefault(); event.returnValue = ""; };
    window.addEventListener("beforeunload", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", handler);
  }, [dirty]);

  function change(next: FAQItem[]) { setItems(next); setDirty(true); setMessage(""); }
  function edit(id: string, patch: Partial<FAQItem>) { change(items.map(item => item.id === id ? { ...item, ...patch } : item)); }
  function move(index: number, direction: number) {
    const target = index + direction;
    if (target < 0 || target >= items.length) return;
    const next = [...items]; [next[index], next[target]] = [next[target], next[index]];
    change(next);
  }
  async function save() {
    if (busy || loading) return;
    if (items.length > 60) { setError("The FAQ section supports a maximum of 60 questions."); return; }
    if (items.some(item => !item.question.trim() || !item.answer.trim())) {
      setError("Every FAQ needs both a question and an answer. Remove incomplete entries or finish writing them."); return;
    }
    if (new Set(items.map(item => item.id)).size !== items.length) { setError("Duplicate FAQ identifiers found. Please reload and try again."); return; }
    setBusy(true); setError(""); setMessage("");
    try {
      const sanitized = items.map(item => ({
        id: item.id, question: item.question.trim(), answer: item.answer.trim(), published: item.published,
      }));
      const { data, error: failure } = await db.from("website_text")
        .upsert({ key: FAQ_TEXT_KEY, value: JSON.stringify(sanitized), updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }, { onConflict: "key" })
        .select("value").single();
      if (failure) throw new Error(failure.message);
      if (!data || !isValidFAQJson(data.value)) throw new Error("The database did not confirm the saved FAQ content.");
      setItems(parseFAQs(data.value)); setDirty(false);
      setMessage("FAQs saved. Published questions are visible on the website after refresh.");
    } catch (cause) { setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Unable to save FAQs."); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl space-y-6 pb-16">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div><h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-brand-pink sm:text-3xl">Frequently Asked Questions</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 max-w-2xl text-sm text-zinc-600">Manage customer questions shown on the public landing page. Reorder, publish, unpublish, or remove any question.</p></div>
        <Link href="/admin/website-management" className="rounded-full border border-pink-200 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink">Back to Website Management</Link>
      </div>
      {error && <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-700">{error}</p>}
      {message && <p role="status" className="rounded-xl border border-green-200 bg-green-50 p-3 text-sm text-green-700">{message}</p>}
      {loading ? <p className="py-10 text-sm text-zinc-500">Loading FAQsâ€¦</p> : <>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-4">
          <span className="text-sm text-zinc-600">{items.length} question{items.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} Â· {items.filter(item => item.published).length} published {dirty && <strong className="ml-2 text-amber-700">Unsaved changes</strong>}</span>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <button type="button" disabled={busy || items.length >= 60} onClick={() => change([...items, { id: createId(), question: "", answer: "", published: false }])} className="rounded-full border border-brand-pink px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink disabled:opacity-50">+ Add FAQ</button>
            <button type="button" disabled={busy || !dirty || !!error && !items.length} onClick={() => void save()} className="rounded-full bg-brand-pink px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50">{busy ? "Savingâ€¦" : "Save Changes"}</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="grid gap-4">{items.map((item, index) => <section key={item.id} className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm sm:p-5">
          <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500">Question {index + 1}</span>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700"><input type="checkbox" checked={item.published} disabled={busy} onChange={e => edit(item.id, { published: e.target.checked })} className="accent-pink-500" />Published</label>
              <button type="button" aria-label={`Move question ${index + 1} up`} disabled={busy || index === 0} onClick={() => move(index, -1)} className="rounded-lg border px-2.5 py-1 text-sm disabled:opacity-30">â†‘</button>
              <button type="button" aria-label={`Move question ${index + 1} down`} disabled={busy || index === items.length - 1} onClick={() => move(index, 1)} className="rounded-lg border px-2.5 py-1 text-sm disabled:opacity-30">â†“</button>
              <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => { if (window.confirm(`Remove this FAQ? Save Changes to publish the deletion.`)) change(items.filter(row => row.id !== item.id)); }} className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-red-600 disabled:opacity-40">Remove</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800">Question<input maxLength={250} disabled={busy} value={item.question} onChange={e => edit(item.id, { question: e.target.value })} placeholder="What would customers like to know?" className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-2.5 text-sm font-normal focus:border-brand-pink focus:outline-none" /></label>
          <label className="mt-3 block text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800">Answer<textarea maxLength={3000} disabled={busy} rows={3} value={item.answer} onChange={e => edit(item.id, { answer: e.target.value })} placeholder="Give a clear, helpful answerâ€¦" className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-2.5 text-sm font-normal focus:border-brand-pink focus:outline-none" /></label>
        </section>)}</div>
        <div className="flex justify-end"><button type="button" disabled={busy || !dirty} onClick={() => void save()} className="rounded-full bg-brand-pink px-6 py-3 font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-40">{busy ? "Savingâ€¦" : "Save All FAQ Changes"}</button></div>
        <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-pink-100"><FAQSection items={items} /></div>
      </>}
    </div>
  );
}
