"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import { type SiteSetting, type SiteSettingKey } from "@/lib/supabase/site-settings";
import EditableSection from "@/components/admin/operations/EditableSection";
import HeroSlidesManager from "@/components/admin/website/HeroSlidesManager";
import ServicesImagesManager from "@/components/admin/website/ServicesImagesManager";
import PricingImagesManager from "@/components/admin/website/PricingImagesManager";
import BeforeAfterImagesManager from "@/components/admin/website/BeforeAfterImagesManager";
import PetAvatarsManager from "@/components/admin/website/PetAvatarsManager";
import { fetchAllHeroSlides } from "@/lib/supabase/hero-slides";
import type { HeroSlide } from "@/lib/types/hero-slides";
import type { GalleryPhoto } from "@/lib/types/gallery";
import Navbar from "@/components/landing/Navbar";
import Hero from "@/components/landing/Hero";
import DynamicServices from "@/components/landing/DynamicServices";
import GroomingBanner from "@/components/landing/GroomingBanner";
import LandingTextSection from "@/components/landing/LandingTextSection";
import GroomingPricing from "@/components/landing/GroomingPricing";
import BoardingBanner from "@/components/landing/BoardingBanner";
import BoardingPricing from "@/components/landing/BoardingPricing";
import SpaBanner from "@/components/landing/SpaBanner";
import ProductsCarousel from "@/components/landing/ProductsCarousel";
import DynamicAbout from "@/components/landing/DynamicAbout";
import Gallery from "@/components/landing/Gallery";
import { PoliciesModalProvider } from "@/components/landing/PoliciesModalContext";
import PoliciesModal from "@/components/landing/PoliciesModal";
import FAQSection from "@/components/landing/FAQSection";
import { FAQ_TEXT_KEY, parseFAQs } from "@/lib/website/faq";
import type { Product } from "@/lib/types/products";
import { copy, type WebsiteService } from "@/lib/website/catalog";
import type { PublicPricingCatalog } from "@/lib/landing/public-pricing";
import type { Package, PackageInclusion, PackagePricing, PetSize } from "@/lib/types/services";

export default function WebsiteManagementPage() {
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<SiteSetting[]>([]);
  const [heroSlides, setHeroSlides] = useState<HeroSlide[]>([]);
  const [galleryPhotos, setGalleryPhotos] = useState<GalleryPhoto[]>([]);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [websiteServices, setWebsiteServices] = useState<WebsiteService[]>([]);
  const [websiteText, setWebsiteText] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [pricingCatalog, setPricingCatalog] = useState<PublicPricingCatalog>({
    packages: [], pricing: [], sizes: [], inclusions: [], loaded: false,
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [editMode, setEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [uploadTarget, setUploadTarget] = useState<SiteSettingKey | null>(null);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [manageHeroSlides, setManageHeroSlides] = useState(false);
  const [manageServicesImages, setManageServicesImages] = useState(false);
  const [managePricingImages, setManagePricingImages] = useState(false);
  const [manageBeforeAfter, setManageBeforeAfter] = useState(false);
  const [managePetAvatars, setManagePetAvatars] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  async function loadContent() {
    const supabase = createClient();
    const [settingsResult, productsResult, galleryResult, servicesResult, textResult] = await Promise.all([
      supabase.from("site_settings").select("*"),
      supabase.from("products").select("*").eq("status", "active").order("product_code"),
      supabase.from("gallery_photos").select("*").eq("active", true).order("sort_order", { ascending: true }).order("created_at", { ascending: false }),
      supabase.from("website_services").select("*").eq("published", true).order("sort_order", { ascending: true }),
      supabase.from("website_text").select("key,value"),
    ]);
    const { data: settingsData, error: settingsError } = settingsResult;
    const { data: productsData } = productsResult;
    const { data: galleryData } = galleryResult;
    if (!servicesResult.error) setWebsiteServices((servicesResult.data ?? []) as WebsiteService[]);
    if (!textResult.error) setWebsiteText(Object.fromEntries((textResult.data ?? []).map(row => [row.key, row.value])));
    // Fetch the exact active Service Management data used by public pricing cards.
    // Do not substitute hardcoded prices if any query fails.
    const [packageResult, rateResult, sizeResult, inclusionResult] = await Promise.all([
      supabase.from("packages").select("*").in("service_type", ["dog_grooming", "cat_grooming"]),
      supabase.from("package_pricing").select("*"),
      supabase.from("pet_sizes").select("*").in("service_type", ["dog_grooming", "cat_grooming"]),
      supabase.from("package_inclusions").select("*"),
    ]);
    const pricingFailure = packageResult.error ?? rateResult.error ?? sizeResult.error ?? inclusionResult.error;
    if (pricingFailure) {
      setPricingCatalog({ packages: [], pricing: [], sizes: [], inclusions: [], loaded: false });
    } else {
      setPricingCatalog({
        packages: (packageResult.data ?? []) as Package[],
        pricing: (rateResult.data ?? []) as PackagePricing[],
        sizes: (sizeResult.data ?? []) as PetSize[],
        inclusions: (inclusionResult.data ?? []) as PackageInclusion[],
        loaded: true,
      });
    }
    const failures = [
      pricingFailure ? `Unable to load live pricing: ${pricingFailure.message}` : null,
      settingsError ? `Unable to load website settings: ${settingsError.message}` : null,
      servicesResult.error ? `Unable to load published services: ${servicesResult.error.message}` : null,
      textResult.error ? `Unable to load website text: ${textResult.error.message}` : null,
    ].filter(Boolean);
    setError(failures.length ? failures.join(" | ") : null);
    if (!settingsError) setSettings((settingsData as SiteSetting[]) ?? []);
    setProducts((productsData as Product[]) ?? []);
    setGalleryPhotos((galleryData as GalleryPhoto[]) ?? []);
    const hero = await fetchAllHeroSlides();
    if (!hero.error) setHeroSlides(hero.slides.filter((s) => s.active));
  }

  useEffect(() => { void loadContent().finally(() => setLoading(false)); }, []);
  const get = (key: SiteSettingKey) => settings.find((s) => s.key === key);
  const serviceImageDefaults: Record<string, string | undefined> = {
    "pet-grooming": get("services_grooming_image")?.image_url ?? undefined,
    "pet-boarding": get("services_boarding_image")?.image_url ?? undefined,
    "pet-spa": get("services_spa_image")?.image_url ?? undefined,
  };
  const previewServices = websiteServices.map(service => ({
    ...service, image_url: service.image_url ?? serviceImageDefaults[service.slug] ?? null,
  }));
  function openUploadFor(key: SiteSettingKey) {
    setUploadTarget(key);
    window.setTimeout(() => fileInputRef.current?.click(), 0);
  }
  async function handleFileSelected(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    const key = uploadTarget;
    e.target.value = "";
    if (!file || !key) return;
    setUploading(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const dimensions = await new Promise<{ width: number; height: number }>((resolve, reject) => {
        const img = new window.Image();
        img.onload = () => { URL.revokeObjectURL(img.src); resolve({ width: img.naturalWidth, height: img.naturalHeight }); };
        img.onerror = () => { URL.revokeObjectURL(img.src); reject(new Error("The selected file is not a valid image.")); };
        img.src = URL.createObjectURL(file);
      });
      const ext = file.name.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() || "jpg";
      const path = `${key}-${Date.now()}.${ext}`;
      const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage.from("site-images").upload(path, file, { upsert: true, contentType: file.type });
      if (uploadError) throw uploadError;
      const newUrl = supabase.storage.from("site-images").getPublicUrl(path).data.publicUrl;
      const { error: updateError } = await supabase.from("site_settings").update({ image_url: newUrl, image_width: dimensions.width, image_height: dimensions.height, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq("key", key);
      if (updateError) throw updateError;
      setSettings((prev) => prev.map((s) => s.key === key ? { ...s, image_url: newUrl, image_width: dimensions.width, image_height: dimensions.height } : s));
    } catch (err) { setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Image upload failed."); }
    finally { setUploading(false); setUploadTarget(null); }
  }

  if (loading) return <p className="text-zinc-400">Loading live preview...</p>;
  return (
    <PoliciesModalProvider>
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <h1 className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-2xl font-bold text-brand-pink sm:text-3xl">Website Management</h1>
          <Link href="/admin/website-management/login" className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 border-brand-pink bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink hover:bg-brand-tint">Login Configuration</Link>
          <Link href="/admin/website-management/faqs" className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 border-brand-pink bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink hover:bg-brand-tint">Manage FAQs</Link>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setManagePetAvatars(true)} className="min-h-11 rounded-full border-2 border-brand-pink bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink hover:bg-brand-tint">Configure Pet Avatars</button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditMode((v) => !v)} className={`min-h-11 rounded-full border-2 px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold ${editMode ? "border-brand-pink bg-brand-pink text-white" : "border-brand-pink text-brand-pink"}`}>{editMode ? "Done Editing" : "Edit"}</button>
        </div>
        {error && <p role="alert" className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-red-50 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}
        {uploading && <p className="mt-4 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink">Uploading...</p>}
        <input ref={fileInputRef} type="file" accept="image/*" className="hidden" onChange={handleFileSelected} />
        <div className="mt-6 max-h-[75dvh] min-w-0 overflow-auto rounded-2xl border-2 border-zinc-800 shadow-xl sm:border-4">
          <EditableSection editMode={editMode} label="Logo" onEdit={() => openUploadFor("site_logo")}><Navbar logoUrl={get("site_logo")?.image_url} /></EditableSection>
          <EditableSection editMode={editMode} label="Hero Slides" onEdit={() => setManageHeroSlides(true)}><Hero slides={heroSlides} logoUrl={get("site_logo")?.image_url} /></EditableSection>
          <EditableSection editMode={editMode} label="Published Services" onEdit={() => setManageServicesImages(true)}><DynamicServices services={previewServices} heading={copy("services_heading", websiteText)} subheading={copy("services_subheading", websiteText)} /></EditableSection>
          <EditableSection editMode={editMode} label="Before & After Gallery" onEdit={() => setManageBeforeAfter(true)}><Gallery photos={galleryPhotos} heading={copy("gallery_heading", websiteText)} subheading={copy("gallery_subheading", websiteText)} /></EditableSection>
          <EditableSection editMode={editMode} label="Grooming Banner" onEdit={() => openUploadFor("grooming_banner_background")}><GroomingBanner description={copy("grooming_banner_description", websiteText)} backgroundUrl={get("grooming_banner_background")?.image_url} width={get("grooming_banner_background")?.image_width} height={get("grooming_banner_background")?.image_height} /></EditableSection>
          <EditableSection editMode={editMode} label="Grooming Pricing Photos" onEdit={() => setManagePricingImages(true)}><LandingTextSection heading={copy("grooming_heading", websiteText)} subheading={copy("grooming_subheading", websiteText)}><GroomingPricing catalog={pricingCatalog} basicImage={get("grooming_basic_image")?.image_url} diamondImage={get("grooming_diamond_image")?.image_url} premiumImage={get("grooming_premium_image")?.image_url} /></LandingTextSection></EditableSection>
          <EditableSection editMode={editMode} label="Boarding Banner" onEdit={() => openUploadFor("boarding_banner_background")}><BoardingBanner description={copy("boarding_banner_description", websiteText)} backgroundUrl={get("boarding_banner_background")?.image_url} width={get("boarding_banner_background")?.image_width} height={get("boarding_banner_background")?.image_height} /></EditableSection>
          <EditableSection editMode={editMode} label="Boarding Pricing Photos" onEdit={() => setManagePricingImages(true)}><LandingTextSection heading={copy("boarding_heading", websiteText)} subheading={copy("boarding_subheading", websiteText)}><BoardingPricing catalog={pricingCatalog} smallKennelImage={get("boarding_small_kennel_image")?.image_url} bigKennelImage={get("boarding_big_kennel_image")?.image_url} /></LandingTextSection></EditableSection>
          <EditableSection editMode={editMode} label="Spa Banner" onEdit={() => openUploadFor("spa_banner_background")}><SpaBanner description={copy("spa_banner_description", websiteText)} backgroundUrl={get("spa_banner_background")?.image_url} width={get("spa_banner_background")?.image_width} height={get("spa_banner_background")?.image_height} /></EditableSection>
          <LandingTextSection tone="pink" heading={copy("products_heading", websiteText)} subheading={copy("products_subheading", websiteText)}><ProductsCarousel products={products} /></LandingTextSection>
          <EditableSection editMode={editMode} label="About Us Background" onEdit={() => openUploadFor("about_us_background")}><DynamicAbout backgroundUrl={get("about_us_background")?.image_url} heading={copy("about_heading", websiteText)} description={copy("about_description", websiteText)} /></EditableSection>
          <EditableSection editMode={editMode} label="Frequently Asked Questions" onEdit={() => window.location.assign("/admin/website-management/faqs")}><FAQSection items={parseFAQs(websiteText[FAQ_TEXT_KEY])} /></EditableSection>
        </div>
        <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-zinc-400">This is the live site. Toggle "Edit" to reveal edit controls over each section.</p>
        {manageHeroSlides && <HeroSlidesManager onClose={async () => { setManageHeroSlides(false); await loadContent(); }} />}
        {manageServicesImages && <ServicesImagesManager settings={settings} onEdit={(key) => { setManageServicesImages(false); openUploadFor(key); }} onClose={() => setManageServicesImages(false)} />}
        {managePricingImages && <PricingImagesManager settings={settings} onEdit={(key) => { setManagePricingImages(false); openUploadFor(key); }} onClose={() => setManagePricingImages(false)} />}
        {manageBeforeAfter && <BeforeAfterImagesManager onClose={async () => { setManageBeforeAfter(false); await loadContent(); }} />}
        {managePetAvatars && <PetAvatarsManager settings={settings} onChanged={async () => { await loadContent(); }} onClose={() => setManagePetAvatars(false)} />}
        <PoliciesModal />
      </div>
    </PoliciesModalProvider>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import DashboardHeader from "@/components/admin/DashboardHeader";
import { fetchAppointments, type AppointmentRow } from "@/lib/supabase/appointment-management";
import { fetchProducts, fetchAllBatches } from "@/lib/supabase/products";
import { EXPIRY_WARNING_DAYS, expiryDaysLeft, philippinesToday } from "@/lib/utils/inventory-expiration";
import type { AppointmentStatus } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { Product, ProductBatch } from "@/lib/types/products";

type ServiceType = "grooming" | "boarding";
type DashboardEvent = {
  id: string;
  type: ServiceType;
  time: string;
  pet: string;
  owner: string;
  service: string;
  status: AppointmentStatus;
};

const dateKey = (date: Date) =>
  `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0")}`;

const timeLabel = (value: string | null) => {
  if (!value) return "Time not set";
  const match = value.match(/(?:T|\s)(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/) || value.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/);
  if (!match) return "Time not set";
  const hour = Number(match[1]);
  const minute = Number(match[2]);
  return `${String(hour % 12 || 12).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(minute).padStart(2, "0")} ${hour >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM"}`;
};

const serviceOf = (appointment: AppointmentRow): ServiceType =>
  appointment.service_type === "boarding" ? "boarding" : "grooming";

const serviceStyles: Record<ServiceType, { pill: string; label: string }> = {
  grooming: { pill: "bg-brand-tint text-brand-pink", label: "Grooming" },
  boarding: { pill: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700", label: "Boarding" },
};

const statusStyles: Record<AppointmentStatus, string> = {
  pending: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700",
  confirmed: "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700",
  checked_in: "bg-violet-50 text-violet-700",
  completed: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700",
  cancelled: "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500",
};

const statusLabel = (status: AppointmentStatus) =>
  status === "checked_in" ? "Checked In" : status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + status.slice(1);

const formatDate = (value: string) => {
  const date = new Date(`${value}T12:00:00+08:00`);
  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime())
    ? value
    : date.toLocaleDateString("en-PH", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" });
};

export default function AdminDashboardPage() {
  const [appointments, setAppointments] = useState<AppointmentRow[]>([]);
  const [products, setProducts] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [batches, setBatches] = useState<ProductBatch[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(() => {
    const [year, monthNumber] = philippinesToday().split("-").map(Number);
    return new Date(year, monthNumber - 1, 1);
  });
  const [selectedDay, setSelectedDay] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [statusModal, setStatusModal] = useState<AppointmentStatus | null>(null);
  const [inventoryToday, setInventoryToday] = useState(() => philippinesToday());

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const [appointmentResult, productResult, batchResult] = await Promise.all([
      fetchAppointments(),
      fetchProducts({ activeOnly: true }),
      fetchAllBatches(),
    ]);

    setAppointments(appointmentResult.rows);
    setProducts(productResult.products);
    setBatches(batchResult.batches);
    setInventoryToday(philippinesToday());
    setError(appointmentResult.error || productResult.error || batchResult.error || null);
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
    const refresh = window.setInterval(() => void load(), 30_000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(refresh);
  }, [load]);

  const activeAppointments = useMemo(
    () => appointments.filter(appointment => appointment.status !== "cancelled"),
    [appointments],
  );

  const todayAppointments = useMemo(
    () => activeAppointments.filter(appointment => appointment.scheduled_date === inventoryToday),
    [activeAppointments, inventoryToday],
  );

  const groomingToday = todayAppointments.filter(appointment => serviceOf(appointment) === "grooming").length;
  const boardingToday = todayAppointments.filter(appointment => serviceOf(appointment) === "boarding").length;

  const statusCounts = useMemo(() => ({
    pending: appointments.filter(appointment => appointment.status === "pending").length,
    confirmed: appointments.filter(appointment => appointment.status === "confirmed").length,
    checked_in: appointments.filter(appointment => appointment.status === "checked_in").length,
    completed: appointments.filter(appointment => appointment.status === "completed").length,
  }), [appointments]);

  const lowStock = useMemo(() => {
    const stockByProduct = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const batch of batches) {
      stockByProduct.set(batch.product_id, (stockByProduct.get(batch.product_id) || 0) + Number(batch.quantity || 0));
    }
    return products
      .map(product => ({
        id: product.id,
        name: product.name,
        remaining: stockByProduct.get(product.id) || 0,
        minimum: Number(product.min_stock || 0),
      }))
      .filter(product => product.remaining <= product.minimum)
      .sort((a, b) => a.remaining - b.remaining)
      .slice(0, 5);
  }, [products, batches]);

  // Keep the dashboard aligned with Inventory's existing expiration warning policy.
  // Only active, sellable batches with remaining stock are included.
  const nearExpiry = useMemo(() => {
    const productNames = new Map(products.map(product => [product.id, product.name]));
    return batches.flatMap(batch => {
      const productName = productNames.get(batch.product_id);
      if (!productName || batch.is_adjustment || Number(batch.quantity) <= 0) return [];
      const daysLeft = expiryDaysLeft(batch.expiration_date, inventoryToday);
      if (daysLeft === null || daysLeft < 0 || daysLeft > EXPIRY_WARNING_DAYS) return [];
      return [{
        id: batch.id,
        productName,
        batchNumber: batch.batch_number,
        expirationDate: batch.expiration_date as string,
        daysLeft,
        quantity: Number(batch.quantity),
      }];
    })
      .sort((a, b) => a.daysLeft - b.daysLeft || a.productName.localeCompare(b.productName))
      .slice(0, 5);
  }, [products, batches, inventoryToday]);

  const events = useMemo(() => {
    const byDate: Record<string, DashboardEvent[]> = {};
    for (const appointment of activeAppointments) {
      const type = serviceOf(appointment);
      const firstPet = appointment.pets[0];
      const event: DashboardEvent = {
        id: appointment.id,
        type,
        time: timeLabel(appointment.scheduled_time || appointment.drop_off_at || appointment.pick_up_at),
        pet: appointment.pets.map(pet => pet.name).filter(Boolean).join(", ") || appointment.owner_name,
        owner: appointment.owner_name,
        service: type === "boarding"
          ? (firstPet?.packagePricingLabel || "Boarding")
          : (firstPet?.packageName || "Grooming"),
        status: appointment.status,
      };
      (byDate[appointment.scheduled_date] ||= []).push(event);
    }
    Object.values(byDate).forEach(dayEvents => dayEvents.sort((a, b) => a.time.localeCompare(b.time)));
    return byDate;
  }, [activeAppointments]);

  const calendarCells = useMemo(() => {
    const firstDay = new Date(month.getFullYear(), month.getMonth(), 1).getDay();
    return Array.from({ length: 42 }, (_, index) => {
      const date = new Date(month.getFullYear(), month.getMonth(), index - firstDay + 1);
      return {
        key: dateKey(date),
        day: date.getDate(),
        muted: date.getMonth() !== month.getMonth(),
      };
    });
  }, [month]);

  const selectedEvents = selectedDay ? events[selectedDay] || [] : [];
  const selectedStatusAppointments = useMemo(() => {
    if (!statusModal) return [];
    return appointments
      .filter(appointment => appointment.status === statusModal)
      .sort((a, b) => a.scheduled_date.localeCompare(b.scheduled_date)
        || (a.scheduled_time || "").localeCompare(b.scheduled_time || ""));
  }, [appointments, statusModal]);

  const dateBadge = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-PH", {
    timeZone: "Asia/Manila",
    weekday: "long",
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: "numeric",
  }).format(new Date());

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="py-16 text-center text-sm text-zinc-400">Loading dashboardâ€¦</div>;
  }

  const statusCards: { status: Exclude<AppointmentStatus, "cancelled">; label: string; accent: string; marker: string }[] = [
    { status: "pending", label: "Pending", accent: "text-amber-700", marker: "bg-amber-400" },
    { status: "confirmed", label: "Confirmed", accent: "text-blue-700", marker: "bg-blue-500" },
    { status: "checked_in", label: "Checked In", accent: "text-violet-700", marker: "bg-violet-500" },
    { status: "completed", label: "Completed", accent: "text-emerald-700", marker: "bg-emerald-500" },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 pb-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <DashboardHeader />
        <div className="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-2 self-start rounded-full border border-pink-100 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 shadow-sm">
          <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-brand-pink" />
          {dateBadge}
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-red-100 bg-red-50 px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-red-600">
          Some dashboard data could not be loaded: {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Three primary metrics: avoid repeating the same service totals in separate cards. */}
      <section aria-label="Today's key metrics" className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
        <Link href="/admin/appointments" className="group flex min-h-[112px] items-center justify-between rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-5 text-left shadow-sm transition hover:border-pink-200 hover:shadow-md">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <span className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-brand-tint text-brand-pink">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" className="h-6 w-6"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="17" rx="2.5"/><path d="M8 2.5v4M16 2.5v4M3 9h18" strokeLinecap="round"/></svg>
            </span>
            <span><span className="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500">Today's Appointments</span><span className="mt-0.5 block text-3xl font-extrabold text-zinc-900">{todayAppointments.length}</span></span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-xl text-zinc-300 transition group-hover:translate-x-0.5 group-hover:text-brand-pink">â€º</span>
        </Link>

        <div className="flex min-h-[112px] items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
          <span className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-brand-tint text-brand-pink">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="currentColor" className="h-6 w-6"><circle cx="9" cy="9" r="4"/><circle cx="23" cy="9" r="4"/><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3.5"/><circle cx="26" cy="18" r="3.5"/><path d="M16 13c-5 0-8 4-8 8 0 4 3 6 8 6s8-2 8-6c0-4-3-8-8-8Z"/></svg>
          </span>
          <span><span className="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500">Grooming Today</span><span className="mt-0.5 block text-3xl font-extrabold text-zinc-900">{groomingToday}</span></span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex min-h-[112px] items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-sky-100 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
          <span className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-sky-50 text-xl font-bold text-sky-600">âŒ‚</span>
          <span><span className="block text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500">Boarding Today</span><span className="mt-0.5 block text-3xl font-extrabold text-zinc-900">{boardingToday}</span></span>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Appointment workflow summary is shown once, directly below the KPIs. */}
      <section aria-label="Appointment status summary" className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm sm:p-5">
        <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900">Appointment Status</h2>
            <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-500">Select a status to review its appointments.</p>
          </div>
          <Link href="/admin/appointments" className="text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink hover:underline">Manage Appointments</Link>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
          {statusCards.map(card => (
            <button key={card.status} type="button" onClick={() => setStatusModal(card.status)}
              className="group rounded-xl border border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50/80 p-4 text-left transition hover:border-pink-200 hover:bg-brand-tint/40">
              <span className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500">{card.label}</span>
                <span className={`h-2 w-2 rounded-full ${card.marker}`} />
              </span>
              <span className={`mt-2 block text-2xl font-extrabold ${card.accent}`}>{statusCounts[card.status]}</span>
              <span className="mt-1 block text-[10px] text-zinc-400 group-hover:text-brand-pink">View appointments â†’</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Main content: appointment calendar (8 columns) and inventory alerts (4 columns). */}
      <section aria-label="Appointment calendar and inventory alerts" className="grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-5 xl:grid-cols-12">
        <section className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm sm:p-5 xl:col-span-8">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900">Appointment Calendar</h2>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-500">Select any date to review its appointments.</p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-xl border border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50 p-1">
              <button type="button" aria-label="Previous month" onClick={() => { setMonth(current => new Date(current.getFullYear(), current.getMonth() - 1, 1)); setSelectedDay(null); }} className="h-8 w-8 rounded-lg text-lg text-zinc-500 hover:bg-white hover:text-brand-pink">â€¹</button>
              <span className="min-w-[132px] text-center text-xs font-bold text-zinc-700">{month.toLocaleDateString("en-PH", { month: "long", year: "numeric" })}</span>
              <button type="button" aria-label="Next month" onClick={() => { setMonth(current => new Date(current.getFullYear(), current.getMonth() + 1, 1)); setSelectedDay(null); }} className="h-8 w-8 rounded-lg text-lg text-zinc-500 hover:bg-white hover:text-brand-pink">â€º</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-7 border-b border-zinc-100 text-center">
            {["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"].map(day => <span key={day} className="pb-2 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-400">{day}</span>)}
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1 grid grid-cols-7 gap-1.5">
            {calendarCells.map(cell => {
              const dayEvents = events[cell.key] || [];
              const hasGrooming = dayEvents.some(event => event.type === "grooming");
              const hasBoarding = dayEvents.some(event => event.type === "boarding");
              const selected = selectedDay === cell.key;
              const isToday = cell.key === inventoryToday;
              return (
                <button key={cell.key} type="button" disabled={cell.muted} onClick={() => setSelectedDay(cell.key)}
                  aria-label={`${cell.key}${dayEvents.length ? `, ${dayEvents.length} appointments` : ", no appointments"}`}
                  className={`flex min-h-[54px] flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-xs transition sm:min-h-[66px] ${
                    cell.muted ? "cursor-default text-zinc-200" : selected ? "bg-brand-tint font-bold text-brand-pink ring-1 ring-pink-200" : "text-zinc-700 hover:bg-zinc-50"
                  } ${isToday && !selected ? "ring-1 ring-inset ring-pink-200" : ""}`}>
                  <span className={isToday && !selected ? "font-extrabold text-brand-pink" : ""}>{cell.day}</span>
                  {(hasGrooming || hasBoarding) && (
                    <span className="mt-1.5 flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                      {hasGrooming && <i className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-brand-pink" />}
                      {hasBoarding && <i className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-sky-400" />}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {dayEvents.length > 0 && <span className="mt-0.5 text-[9px] text-zinc-400">{dayEvents.length}</span>}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-x-5 gap-y-2 border-t border-zinc-100 pt-3 text-[10px] text-zinc-500">
            <span><i className="mr-1.5 inline-block h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-brand-pink" />Grooming</span>
            <span><i className="mr-1.5 inline-block h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-sky-400" />Boarding</span>
            <span><i className="mr-1.5 inline-block h-2 w-2 rounded-full ring-1 ring-pink-300" />Today</span>
          </div>

          {selectedDay && (
            <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-pink-100 bg-brand-tint/40 p-3 sm:p-4">
              <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div><h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-900">Appointments Â· {formatDate(selectedDay)}</h3><p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500">{selectedEvents.length} appointment{selectedEvents.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}</p></div>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setSelectedDay(null)} className="rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500 hover:bg-white">Close</button>
              </div>
              {selectedEvents.length ? (
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {selectedEvents.map(event => (
                    <div key={event.id} className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-lg bg-white px-3 py-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
                      <span className="w-20 shrink-0 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500">{event.time}</span>
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <p className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-zinc-800">{event.pet}</p>
                        <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-500">Customer: {event.owner} Â· {event.service}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
                        <span className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold ${serviceStyles[event.type].pill}`}>{serviceStyles[event.type].label}</span>
                        <span className={`rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold ${statusStyles[event.status]}`}>{statusLabel(event.status)}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                  <div className="flex justify-end pt-1"><Link href="/admin/appointments" className="text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink hover:underline">Open appointment management â†’</Link></div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p className="rounded-lg bg-white px-3 py-5 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500">No appointments scheduled for this date.</p>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </section>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 xl:col-span-4">
          <section className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm sm:p-5">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
              <div><h2 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900">Low Stock</h2><p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-500">Products at or below minimum stock.</p></div>
              <Link href="/admin/inventory" className="shrink-0 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink hover:underline">Inventory</Link>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
              {lowStock.length ? lowStock.map(product => (
                <div key={product.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-50/70 px-3 py-2.5">
                  <span className="min-w-0 truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700">{product.name}</span>
                  <span className="shrink-0 rounded-full bg-rose-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-rose-700">{product.remaining} left</span>
                </div>
              )) : <p className="rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500">No low-stock products.</p>}
            </div>
          </section>

          <section aria-label="Near-expiry inventory alert" className="rounded-2xl border border-amber-100 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm sm:p-5">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
              <div><h2 className="text-base font-bold text-zinc-900">Near Expiry</h2><p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-zinc-500">In-stock batches expiring within {EXPIRY_WARNING_DAYS} days.</p></div>
              <Link href="/admin/inventory" className="shrink-0 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink hover:underline">Inventory</Link>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
              {nearExpiry.length ? nearExpiry.map(batch => (
                <div key={batch.id} className="flex min-w-0 items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2.5">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="truncate text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-800" title={batch.productName}>{batch.productName}</p>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[10px] text-zinc-500">Batch {batch.batchNumber} Â· {batch.quantity} left</p>
                  </div>
                  <span className={`shrink-0 rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold ${batch.daysLeft === 0 ? "bg-rose-100 text-rose-700" : "bg-amber-100 text-amber-800"}`}>
                    {batch.daysLeft === 0 ? "Expires today" : `${batch.daysLeft} day${batch.daysLeft === 1 ? "" : "s"} left`}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )) : <p className="rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 px-3 py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500">No batches near expiry.</p>}
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
      </section>

      {/* Read-only status drill-down. Actual status changes remain in Appointment Management. */}
      {statusModal && (
        <div role="presentation" onClick={() => setStatusModal(null)} className="fixed inset-0 z-[90] flex items-center justify-center bg-zinc-950/45 p-4 backdrop-blur-[2px]">
          <section role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="dashboard-status-title" onClick={event => event.stopPropagation()} className="flex max-h-[85dvh] w-full max-w-2xl flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-zinc-100 px-5 py-4">
              <div><p className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-brand-pink">Appointment Overview</p><h2 id="dashboard-status-title" className="mt-0.5 text-lg font-extrabold text-zinc-900">{statusLabel(statusModal)} Appointments</h2><p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">{selectedStatusAppointments.length} record{selectedStatusAppointments.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}</p></div>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setStatusModal(null)} aria-label="Close appointment status dialog" className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-200">Ã—</button>
            </div>
            <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 space-y-2 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-5">
              {selectedStatusAppointments.length ? selectedStatusAppointments.map(appointment => {
                const service = serviceOf(appointment);
                const petNames = appointment.pets.map(pet => pet.name).filter(Boolean).join(", ") || appointment.owner_name;
                return (
                  <div key={appointment.id} className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-xl border border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50/70 p-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-400">{appointment.id.slice(0, 8)}</span><span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${serviceStyles[service].pill}`}>{serviceStyles[service].label}</span><span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500">{formatDate(appointment.scheduled_date)} Â· {timeLabel(appointment.scheduled_time || appointment.drop_off_at || appointment.pick_up_at)}</span></div>
                      <p className="mt-1 truncate text-sm font-bold text-zinc-800">{petNames}</p>
                      <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-zinc-500">Customer: {appointment.owner_name}</p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="shrink-0 rounded-full bg-white px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold text-zinc-600">View in management</span>
                  </div>
                );
              }) : <div className="py-12 text-center"><p className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-700">No {statusLabel(statusModal).toLowerCase()} appointments.</p><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-400">There are currently no records in this status.</p></div>}
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-zinc-100 px-5 py-4">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setStatusModal(null)} className="min-h-10 rounded-full border border-zinc-200 px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-50">Close</button>
              <Link href="/admin/appointments" onClick={() => setStatusModal(null)} className="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center rounded-full bg-brand-pink px-5 text-xs font-semibold text-white hover:bg-pink-600">Manage Appointments</Link>
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// Defense in depth: the admin layout enforces the same account policy as
// middleware even if the layout is rendered independently of a page redirect.
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import AdminShell from "@/components/admin/AdminShell";
import AccountStatusWatcher from "@/components/AccountStatusWatcher";
import ManagementStepConfirmation from "@/components/shared/ManagementStepConfirmation";

export default async function AdminLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: auth, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (authError || !auth.user) redirect("/sign-in");

  const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", auth.user.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (profileError || !profile) redirect("/sign-in?access=unverified");
  if (profile.role !== "superadmin" && profile.role !== "admin") {
    redirect("/account");
  }

  const { data: staffRow, error: staffError } = await supabase
    .from("staff_profiles")
    .select("id, status")
    .eq("id", auth.user.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (staffError || !staffRow) redirect("/sign-in?access=unverified");
  if (staffRow.status !== "active") redirect("/sign-in?deactivated=1");

  return (
    <>
      <AccountStatusWatcher userId={auth.user.id} table="staff_profiles" />
      <AdminShell role={profile.role}>
        <ManagementStepConfirmation>{children}</ManagementStepConfirmation>
      </AdminShell>
    </>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\app\(auth)\forgot-password\ForgotPasswordClient.tsx =====

"use client";

import { type CSSProperties, type FormEvent, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Check, CircleCheck, Eye, EyeOff, KeyRound, LockKeyhole, Mail, PawPrint, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";

type Step = "email" | "code" | "password";
type Props = { landscapeUrl: string; portraitUrl: string; customPortrait: boolean };
const RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS = 60;
const RECOVERY_CODE_LENGTH = 6;

function validatePassword(password: string) {
  return {
    length: password.length >= 8,
    uppercase: /[A-Z]/.test(password),
    lowercase: /[a-z]/.test(password),
    special: /[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(password),
  };
}

export default function ForgotPasswordClient({ landscapeUrl, portraitUrl, customPortrait }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const supabase = useMemo(() => createClient(), []);
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>("email");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirm, setShowConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [resendSeconds, setResendSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [passwordChanged, setPasswordChanged] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (resendSeconds <= 0) return;
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => setResendSeconds(s => Math.max(0, s - 1)), 1000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, [resendSeconds]);

  const passwordRules = validatePassword(password);
  const passwordValid = Object.values(passwordRules).every(Boolean);
  const passwordsMatch = password.length > 0 && password === confirmPassword;
  const backgroundVars = {
    "--ht-recovery-landscape": `url(${JSON.stringify(landscapeUrl)})`,
    "--ht-recovery-portrait": `url(${JSON.stringify(portraitUrl)})`,
  } as CSSProperties;

  function clearStatus() { setError(""); setMessage(""); }

  async function sendCode(event?: FormEvent) {
    event?.preventDefault();
    if (loading || (step === "code" && resendSeconds > 0)) return;
    clearStatus();
    const normalizedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!normalizedEmail) { setError("Please enter your email address."); return; }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const { error: resetError } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(normalizedEmail);
      if (resetError) { setError(resetError.message); return; }
      setEmail(normalizedEmail);
      setCode("");
      setResendSeconds(RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS);
      setMessage("If this email belongs to a HappyTails account, a 6-digit password reset code will arrive shortly. Check your inbox and spam folder.");
      setStep("code");
    } catch { setError("We couldn't send the code right now. Please try again."); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  }

  async function verifyCode(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (loading) return;
    clearStatus();
    const normalizedCode = code.replace(/\D/g, "");
    if (normalizedCode.length !== RECOVERY_CODE_LENGTH || !/^\d+$/.test(normalizedCode)) { setError("Enter the 6-digit password reset code from your email."); return; }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({ email, token: normalizedCode, type: "recovery" });
      if (verifyError) { setError(verifyError.message); return; }
      setMessage("Your reset code was verified. Set a new password for your HappyTails account.");
      setPassword(""); setConfirmPassword(""); setStep("password");
    } catch { setError("Verification failed. Please try again."); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  }

  async function updatePassword(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (loading) return;
    clearStatus();
    if (!passwordValid) { setError("Your new password does not meet all requirements."); return; }
    if (!passwordsMatch) { setError("Passwords do not match."); return; }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const { error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password });
      if (updateError) { setError(updateError.message); return; }
      await supabase.auth.signOut();
      setPassword(""); setConfirmPassword(""); setCode("");
      setPasswordChanged(true);
    } catch { setError("Unable to change your password right now. Please try again."); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  }

  const subtitles: Record<Step, string> = {
    email: "Enter the email address linked to your HappyTails account to request a password reset code.",
    code: "Enter the 6-digit password reset code sent to your email.",
    password: "Choose a new password and confirm it to finish resetting your account password.",
  };

  return (
    <div className={`ht-recovery-page${customPortrait ? " ht-recovery-custom-portrait" : ""}`} style={backgroundVars}>
      <div className="ht-recovery-portrait-top" aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="ht-recovery-placement">
        <div className="ht-recovery-portrait-middle" aria-hidden="true" />
        <section className="ht-recovery-card" aria-labelledby="ht-recovery-title">
          <header className="ht-recovery-heading">
            <PawPrint className="ht-recovery-paw" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" />
            <h1 id="ht-recovery-title">{step === "email" ? "Forgot Password?" : step === "code" ? "Verify Your Code" : "New Password"}</h1>
            <p>{subtitles[step]}</p>
          </header>
          <div className="ht-recovery-progress" aria-label={`Step ${step === "email" ? 1 : step === "code" ? 2 : 3} of 3`}>
            {(["email", "code", "password"] as const).map((s, index) => <span key={s} className={index <= (["email", "code", "password"] as const).indexOf(step) ? "active" : ""} />)}
          </div>

          {message && <p className="ht-recovery-notice" role="status"><CircleCheck size={19} aria-hidden="true" />{message}</p>}
          {error && <p className="ht-recovery-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}

          {step === "email" && <form onSubmit={sendCode} className="ht-recovery-form">
            <label className="ht-recovery-label" htmlFor="ht-reset-email">Email Address</label>
            <div className="ht-recovery-field"><Mail aria-hidden="true" /><input id="ht-reset-email" type="email" autoComplete="email" inputMode="email" placeholder="Enter your email address" required disabled={loading} value={email} onChange={e => setEmail(e.target.value)} /></div>
            <button className="ht-recovery-primary" type="submit" disabled={loading}>{loading ? "Sending code..." : "Send Verification Code"}<ArrowRight aria-hidden="true" size={22} /></button>
          </form>}

          {step === "code" && <form onSubmit={verifyCode} className="ht-recovery-form">
            <label className="ht-recovery-label" htmlFor="ht-reset-code">Verification Code</label>
            <div className="ht-recovery-field"><KeyRound aria-hidden="true" /><input className="ht-recovery-code" id="ht-reset-code" type="text" inputMode="numeric" autoComplete="one-time-code" maxLength={RECOVERY_CODE_LENGTH} placeholder="000000" required disabled={loading} value={code} onChange={e => setCode(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, RECOVERY_CODE_LENGTH))} /></div>
            <p className="ht-recovery-help">Check the inbox and spam folder for <strong>{email}</strong>. Use the latest code if you requested another one.</p>
            <button className="ht-recovery-primary" type="submit" disabled={loading || code.length !== RECOVERY_CODE_LENGTH}>{loading ? "Verifying..." : "Verify Code"}<ArrowRight aria-hidden="true" size={22} /></button>
            <div className="ht-recovery-actions"><button type="button" disabled={loading} onClick={() => { clearStatus(); setStep("email"); }}>Change email</button><button type="button" disabled={loading || resendSeconds > 0} onClick={() => void sendCode()}>{resendSeconds > 0 ? `Resend in ${resendSeconds}s` : "Resend reset code"}</button></div>
          </form>}

          {step === "password" && <form onSubmit={updatePassword} className="ht-recovery-form">
            <label className="ht-recovery-label" htmlFor="ht-new-password">New Password</label>
            <div className="ht-recovery-field"><LockKeyhole aria-hidden="true" /><input id="ht-new-password" type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"} autoComplete="new-password" placeholder="Enter new password" required disabled={loading} value={password} onChange={e => setPassword(e.target.value)} /><button type="button" className="ht-recovery-eye" onClick={() => setShowPassword(v => !v)} aria-label={showPassword ? "Hide new password" : "Show new password"}>{showPassword ? <EyeOff /> : <Eye />}</button></div>
            <label className="ht-recovery-label" htmlFor="ht-confirm-password">Confirm New Password</label>
            <div className="ht-recovery-field"><ShieldCheck aria-hidden="true" /><input id="ht-confirm-password" type={showConfirm ? "text" : "password"} autoComplete="new-password" placeholder="Confirm new password" required disabled={loading} value={confirmPassword} onChange={e => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)} /><button type="button" className="ht-recovery-eye" onClick={() => setShowConfirm(v => !v)} aria-label={showConfirm ? "Hide confirmation" : "Show confirmation"}>{showConfirm ? <EyeOff /> : <Eye />}</button></div>
            <div className="ht-recovery-requirements"><strong>Password requirements</strong>{Object.entries({ length: "At least 8 characters", uppercase: "One uppercase letter", lowercase: "One lowercase letter", special: "One special character" }).map(([key, label]) => <div key={key} className={passwordRules[key as keyof typeof passwordRules] ? "met" : ""}><Check size={15} aria-hidden="true" />{label}</div>)}</div>
            <button className="ht-recovery-primary" type="submit" disabled={loading || !passwordValid || !passwordsMatch}>{loading ? "Updating password..." : "Change Password"}<ArrowRight aria-hidden="true" size={22} /></button>
          </form>}

          <Link className="ht-recovery-back" href="/sign-in"><ArrowLeft size={18} aria-hidden="true" /> Back to Log In</Link>
        </section>
      </div>
      <div className="ht-recovery-portrait-bottom" aria-hidden="true" />

      {passwordChanged && <div className="ht-recovery-modal-backdrop" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="ht-reset-done-title"><div className="ht-recovery-modal"><CircleCheck size={56} className="ht-recovery-success-icon" aria-hidden="true"/><h2 id="ht-reset-done-title">Password Changed!</h2><p>Your password has been updated successfully. You can now sign in with your new password.</p><button className="ht-recovery-primary" type="button" onClick={() => router.replace("/sign-in")}>Continue to Log In <ArrowRight size={20} /></button></div></div>}
    </div>
  );
}

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import ForgotPasswordClient from "./ForgotPasswordClient";
import "./forgot-password.css";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
const DEFAULT_LANDSCAPE = "/images/happytails-login-landscape.webp";
const DEFAULT_PORTRAIT = "/images/happytails-login-portrait-top.webp";

function safeImageUrl(value: unknown, fallback: string): string {
  if (typeof value !== "string") return fallback;
  const url = value.trim();
  return ((url.startsWith("/") && !url.startsWith("//")) || url.startsWith("https://"))
    ? url : fallback;
}

export default async function ForgotPasswordPage() {
  let landscapeUrl = DEFAULT_LANDSCAPE;
  let portraitUrl = DEFAULT_PORTRAIT;
  let customPortrait = false;
  try {
    const supabase = await createClient();
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from("site_settings")
      .select("key, image_url")
      .in("key", ["login_background_desktop", "login_background_mobile"]);
    if (!error && data) {
      landscapeUrl = safeImageUrl(data.find(s => s.key === "login_background_desktop")?.image_url, DEFAULT_LANDSCAPE);
      portraitUrl = safeImageUrl(data.find(s => s.key === "login_background_mobile")?.image_url, DEFAULT_PORTRAIT);
      customPortrait = portraitUrl !== DEFAULT_PORTRAIT;
    }
  } catch {
    // Site-branding settings being unavailable must not block password recovery.
  }
  return <ForgotPasswordClient landscapeUrl={landscapeUrl} portraitUrl={portraitUrl} customPortrait={customPortrait} />;
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\app\(auth)\sign-in\page.tsx =====

import { Suspense } from "react";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import HappyTailsLogin from "@/components/auth/HappyTailsLogin";
import "./login.css";

// Branding is editable in Supabase; never freeze the image URLs at build time.
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const DEFAULT_LANDSCAPE = "/images/happytails-login-landscape.webp";
const DEFAULT_PORTRAIT = "/images/happytails-login-portrait-top.webp";

function safeImageUrl(value: unknown, fallback: string) {
  if (typeof value !== "string") return fallback;
  const url = value.trim();
  if ((url.startsWith("/") && !url.startsWith("//")) || url.startsWith("https://")) return url;
  return fallback;
}

export default async function SignInPage() {
  let landscapeUrl = DEFAULT_LANDSCAPE;
  let portraitUrl = DEFAULT_PORTRAIT;
  let customPortrait = false;

  try {
    // site_settings is also used by the public homepage. A failed settings
    // query must never block the login page: locally bundled art is the fallback.
    const supabase = await createClient();
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from("site_settings")
      .select("key, image_url")
      .in("key", ["login_background_desktop", "login_background_mobile"]);
    if (!error && data) {
      const desktop = data.find((setting) => setting.key === "login_background_desktop")?.image_url;
      const mobile = data.find((setting) => setting.key === "login_background_mobile")?.image_url;
      landscapeUrl = safeImageUrl(desktop, DEFAULT_LANDSCAPE);
      portraitUrl = safeImageUrl(mobile, DEFAULT_PORTRAIT);
      customPortrait = portraitUrl !== DEFAULT_PORTRAIT;
    }
  } catch { /* preserve access to sign-in during a settings/database outage */ }

  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <HappyTailsLogin
        landscapeUrl={landscapeUrl}
        portraitUrl={portraitUrl}
        customPortrait={customPortrait}
      />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import HappyTailsSignup from "./SignupClient";
import "../forgot-password/forgot-password.css";
import "./sign-up.css";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const DEFAULT_LANDSCAPE = "/images/happytails-login-landscape.webp";
const DEFAULT_PORTRAIT = "/images/happytails-login-portrait-top.webp";

function safeImageUrl(value: unknown, fallback: string) {
  if (typeof value !== "string") return fallback;
  const url = value.trim();
  return ((url.startsWith("/") && !url.startsWith("//")) || url.startsWith("https://")) ? url : fallback;
}

export default async function SignUpPage() {
  let landscapeUrl = DEFAULT_LANDSCAPE;
  let portraitUrl = DEFAULT_PORTRAIT;
  let customPortrait = false;
  try {
    const supabase = await createClient();
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from("site_settings")
      .select("key, image_url")
      .in("key", ["login_background_desktop", "login_background_mobile"]);
    if (!error && data) {
      landscapeUrl = safeImageUrl(data.find(s => s.key === "login_background_desktop")?.image_url, DEFAULT_LANDSCAPE);
      portraitUrl = safeImageUrl(data.find(s => s.key === "login_background_mobile")?.image_url, DEFAULT_PORTRAIT);
      customPortrait = portraitUrl !== DEFAULT_PORTRAIT;
    }
  } catch {
    // Branding must not prevent registration when site settings are unavailable.
  }
  return <HappyTailsSignup landscapeUrl={landscapeUrl} portraitUrl={portraitUrl} customPortrait={customPortrait} />;
}
