===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\app\(auth)\sign-up\SignupClient.tsx =====

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState, type CSSProperties, type FormEvent } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, CheckCircle2, Eye, EyeOff, LockKeyhole, Mail, PawPrint, Phone, UserRound, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import { hasValidCustomerPhone, normalizeCustomerPhone } from "@/lib/utils/customer-phone";
import "./signup-validation.css";
import { isUsernameTaken, validateUsernameFormat } from "@/lib/supabase/customer-auth";

type Props = { landscapeUrl: string; portraitUrl: string; customPortrait: boolean };
type Stage = "details" | "verify";
const CODE_LENGTH = 6;
const RESEND_SECONDS = 60;
const PENDING_EMAIL_KEY = "happytails-signup-pending-email";

const passwordChecks = (password: string) => ({
  length: password.length >= 8,
  upper: /[A-Z]/.test(password),
  lower: /[a-z]/.test(password),
  special: /[^A-Za-z0-9\s]/.test(password),
});

export default function HappyTailsSignup({ landscapeUrl, portraitUrl, customPortrait }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const supabase = useMemo(() => createClient(), []);
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<Stage>("details");
  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState("");
  const [username, setUsername] = useState("");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirmPassword, setShowConfirmPassword] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [cooldown, setCooldown] = useState(0);
  const [confirmedUserId, setConfirmedUserId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showLeaveConfirmation, setShowLeaveConfirmation] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Keep just the pending email to allow re-requesting an OTP after a refresh.
    // Do not persist the password or an authentication session in localStorage.
    try {
      const pending = sessionStorage.getItem(PENDING_EMAIL_KEY);
      if (pending && /^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(pending)) {
        setEmail(pending);
        setStage("verify");
      }
    } catch { /* storage is optional */ }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (cooldown <= 0) return;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setCooldown(value => Math.max(0, value - 1)), 1000);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [cooldown]);

  const checks = passwordChecks(password);
  const validPassword = Object.values(checks).every(Boolean);
  const phoneComplete = /^09\d{9}$/.test(phone);
  const confirmMismatch = confirmPassword.length > 0 && confirmPassword !== password;
  const passwordRequirements = [
    { key: "length", label: "At least 8 characters", passed: checks.length },
    { key: "upper", label: "One uppercase letter (Aâ€“Z)", passed: checks.upper },
    { key: "lower", label: "One lowercase letter (aâ€“z)", passed: checks.lower },
    { key: "special", label: "One special character (!, @, #, etc.)", passed: checks.special },
  ];

  function handlePhoneInput(value: string) {
    const digits = value.replace(/\D/g, "");
    // Convert pasted +639XXXXXXXXX / 639XXXXXXXXX to an 11-digit local number.
    const local = digits.startsWith("639") ? `0${digits.slice(2)}` : digits;
    setPhone(local.slice(0, 11));
  }
  const backgroundVars = {
    "--ht-recovery-landscape": `url(${JSON.stringify(landscapeUrl)})`,
    "--ht-recovery-portrait": `url(${JSON.stringify(portraitUrl)})`,
  } as CSSProperties;

  async function handleSignup(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (busy) return;
    setError(""); setMessage("");
    const normalizedName = fullName.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
    const normalizedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    const normalizedUsername = username.trim();
    const normalizedPhone = normalizeCustomerPhone(phone);
    if (normalizedName.length < 2 || normalizedName.length > 120) {
      setError("Enter your full name (2â€“120 characters)."); return;
    }
    const usernameError = validateUsernameFormat(normalizedUsername);
    if (usernameError) { setError(usernameError); return; }
    if (!hasValidCustomerPhone(normalizedPhone)) {
      setError("Enter a valid Philippine mobile number: 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX."); return;
    }
    if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(normalizedEmail) || normalizedEmail.length > 254) {
      setError("Enter a valid email address."); return;
    }
    if (!validPassword || password.length > 1024) {
      setError("Your password must satisfy all requirements shown below the Password field."); return;
    }
    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      setError("The passwords do not match."); return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      // This endpoint checks customer and staff usernames without exposing account emails.
      const availability = await isUsernameTaken(normalizedUsername);
      if (availability.error) { setError(availability.error); return; }
      if (availability.taken) { setError("That username is already taken. Choose another username."); return; }
      const { data, error: signupError } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
        email: normalizedEmail,
        password,
        options: {
          data: {
            full_name: normalizedName,
            username: normalizedUsername,
            phone_number: normalizedPhone,
            account_type: "customer",
          },
        },
      });
      if (signupError) { setError(signupError.message); return; }
      if (data.session) {
        // A returned session means email confirmation is disabled in Supabase.
        // Do not treat signup as verified; require the admin to enable it.
        await supabase.auth.signOut();
        setError("Email verification is not enabled for this project. Please contact HappyTails support.");
        return;
      }
      setEmail(normalizedEmail);
      setUsername(normalizedUsername);
      setPhone(normalizedPhone);
      setPassword(""); setConfirmPassword("");
      setCode("");
      setStage("verify");
      setCooldown(RESEND_SECONDS);
      setMessage("If this address can be registered, a 6-digit email verification code has been sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.");
      try { sessionStorage.setItem(PENDING_EMAIL_KEY, normalizedEmail); } catch { /* optional */ }
    } catch {
      setError("Registration is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.");
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  async function finishVerifiedAccount(userId: string) {
    // Verify the server-backed identity before writing any customer fields.
    const { data: auth, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
    if (authError || !auth.user || auth.user.id !== userId || auth.user.email?.toLowerCase() !== email) {
      setError("We could not verify your account session. Please contact support."); return;
    }
    const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase.from("profiles")
      .select("role").eq("id", userId).maybeSingle();
    if (profileError || !profile || profile.role === "admin" || profile.role === "superadmin") {
      setError("Your email is confirmed, but customer account setup could not be verified. Please contact support."); return;
    }
    const updates: { full_name?: string; phone_number?: string; username?: string } = {};
    // First verification uses signup metadata if the page was refreshed.
    const name = fullName.trim() || (typeof auth.user.user_metadata?.full_name === "string" ? auth.user.user_metadata.full_name : "");
    const mobile = normalizeCustomerPhone(phone || (typeof auth.user.user_metadata?.phone_number === "string" ? auth.user.user_metadata.phone_number : ""));
    const selectedUsername = username.trim() || (typeof auth.user.user_metadata?.username === "string" ? auth.user.user_metadata.username.trim() : "");
    if (name.length >= 2) updates.full_name = name;
    if (hasValidCustomerPhone(mobile)) updates.phone_number = mobile;
    if (!validateUsernameFormat(selectedUsername)) updates.username = selectedUsername;
    if (!updates.full_name || !updates.phone_number || !updates.username) {
      setError("Your email is verified, but required account details are missing. Contact HappyTails support."); return;
    }
    // The database's username uniqueness rule is authoritative, including
    // simultaneous signups after both pass the initial availability check.
    const { data: customer, error: customerError } = await supabase.from("customers")
      .update(updates).eq("id", userId).select("id,status,username").maybeSingle();
    if (customerError) {
      setError(customerError.code === "23505"
        ? "That username is now taken. Please contact HappyTails support to choose a new one."
        : "Email verified, but account details could not be saved. Please try again.");
      return;
    }
    if (!customer || customer.status !== "active" || customer.username?.toLowerCase() !== selectedUsername.toLowerCase()) {
      setError("Email verified, but your customer profile could not be completed. Contact support before signing in."); return;
    }
    // Verification signs the customer in temporarily. End that session and
    // follow the requested explicit login step.
    const { error: signoutError } = await supabase.auth.signOut();
    if (signoutError) {
      setError("Your account was verified, but sign-out did not finish. Please refresh and sign out before logging in again."); return;
    }
    try { sessionStorage.removeItem(PENDING_EMAIL_KEY); } catch { /* optional */ }
    router.replace("/sign-in?verified=1");
    router.refresh();
  }

  async function handleVerify(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (busy) return;
    setError(""); setMessage("");
    if (confirmedUserId) {
      setBusy(true);
      try { await finishVerifiedAccount(confirmedUserId); } finally { setBusy(false); }
      return;
    }
    if (!/^\d{6}$/.test(code)) { setError("Enter the 6-digit code from your verification email."); return; }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const { data, error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({
        email, token: code.trim(), type: "email",
      });
      if (verifyError || !data.user || !data.session) {
        setError(verifyError?.message || "This code is invalid or expired. Request a new code and try again.");
        return;
      }
      setConfirmedUserId(data.user.id);
      await finishVerifiedAccount(data.user.id);
    } catch {
      setError("Unable to verify this code right now. Please try again.");
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  async function handleResend() {
    if (busy || cooldown > 0) return;
    setBusy(true); setError(""); setMessage("");
    try {
      const { error: resendError } = await supabase.auth.resend({ type: "signup", email });
      if (resendError) { setError(resendError.message); return; }
      setCode("");
      setCooldown(RESEND_SECONDS);
      setMessage("If verification is still pending, another code has been requested. Use the latest email.");
    } catch { setError("Could not resend the code right now."); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }


  return (
    <div className={`ht-recovery-page ht-signup-page${customPortrait ? " ht-recovery-custom-portrait" : ""}`} style={backgroundVars}>
      <div className="ht-recovery-portrait-top" aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="ht-recovery-placement">
        <div className="ht-recovery-portrait-middle" aria-hidden="true" />
        <section className="ht-recovery-card ht-signup-card" aria-labelledby="ht-signup-title">
          <header className="ht-recovery-heading">
            <PawPrint className="ht-recovery-paw" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" />
            <h1 id="ht-signup-title">{stage === "details" ? "Create Account" : "Verify Your Email"}</h1>
            <p>{stage === "details" ? "Join the HappyTails family. Create your account using any valid email address." : `Enter the 6-digit verification code sent to ${email}.`}</p>
          </header>
          <div className="ht-recovery-progress" aria-label={`Step ${stage === "details" ? 1 : 2} of 2`}>
            <span className="active" /><span className={stage === "verify" ? "active" : ""} />
          </div>
          {message && <p className="ht-recovery-notice" role="status"><CheckCircle2 size={18} aria-hidden="true" />{message}</p>}
          {error && <p className="ht-recovery-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}

          {stage === "details" ? (
            <form className="ht-recovery-form ht-signup-form" onSubmit={handleSignup}>
              <label className="ht-recovery-label" htmlFor="ht-su-name">Full Name</label>
              <div className="ht-recovery-field"><UserRound aria-hidden="true" /><input id="ht-su-name" value={fullName} onChange={e => setFullName(e.target.value)} autoComplete="name" placeholder="Enter your full name" maxLength={120} disabled={busy} required /></div>
              <label className="ht-recovery-label" htmlFor="ht-su-username">Username</label>
              <div className="ht-recovery-field"><UserRound aria-hidden="true" /><input id="ht-su-username" value={username} onChange={e => setUsername(e.target.value)} autoComplete="username" autoCapitalize="none" spellCheck={false} placeholder="Choose a unique username" minLength={3} maxLength={20} disabled={busy} required /></div>
              <p className="ht-signup-password-hint">3â€“20 characters: letters, numbers, underscores, or periods. You can log in using this username or your email.</p>
              <label className="ht-recovery-label" htmlFor="ht-su-phone">Phone Number</label>
              <div className={`ht-recovery-field${phone.length > 0 && !phoneComplete ? " ht-signup-field-warning" : ""}`}><Phone aria-hidden="true" /><input id="ht-su-phone" value={phone} onChange={e => handlePhoneInput(e.target.value)} type="tel" autoComplete="tel" inputMode="numeric" pattern="09[0-9]{9}" placeholder="09XXXXXXXXX" maxLength={11} aria-describedby="ht-su-phone-help" aria-invalid={phone.length > 0 && !phoneComplete} disabled={busy} required /></div>
              <p id="ht-su-phone-help" className={`ht-signup-inline-help${phone.length > 0 && !phoneComplete ? " ht-signup-inline-error" : ""}`} role={phone.length > 0 && !phoneComplete ? "status" : undefined}>{phone.length === 0 ? "Enter 11 digits starting with 09. You may paste a +63 number." : phoneComplete ? "âœ“ Valid 11-digit Philippine mobile number" : `Enter 11 digits beginning with 09 (${phone.length}/11 digits).`}</p>
              <label className="ht-recovery-label" htmlFor="ht-su-email">Email Address</label>
              <div className="ht-recovery-field"><Mail aria-hidden="true" /><input id="ht-su-email" value={email} onChange={e => setEmail(e.target.value)} type="email" autoComplete="email" autoCapitalize="none" placeholder="Gmail, Yahoo, iCloud, Outlook, etc." maxLength={254} disabled={busy} required /></div>
              <label className="ht-recovery-label" htmlFor="ht-su-password">Password</label>
              <div className={`ht-recovery-field${password.length > 0 && !validPassword ? " ht-signup-field-warning" : ""}`}><LockKeyhole aria-hidden="true" /><input id="ht-su-password" value={password} onChange={e => setPassword(e.target.value)} type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"} autoComplete="new-password" placeholder="Create a password" aria-describedby="ht-su-password-rules" aria-invalid={password.length > 0 && !validPassword} disabled={busy} required /><button type="button" className="ht-recovery-eye" onClick={() => setShowPassword(v => !v)} aria-label={showPassword ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}>{showPassword ? <EyeOff /> : <Eye />}</button></div>
              <div id="ht-su-password-rules" className="ht-signup-password-rules" aria-label="Password requirements">
                <strong>Password requirements</strong>
                <ul>{passwordRequirements.map(rule => <li key={rule.key} className={rule.passed ? "ht-signup-rule-met" : ""}><span aria-hidden="true">{rule.passed ? "âœ“" : "â—‹"}</span>{rule.label}</li>)}</ul>
              </div>
              <label className="ht-recovery-label" htmlFor="ht-su-confirm">Confirm Password</label>
              <div className={`ht-recovery-field${confirmMismatch ? " ht-signup-field-warning" : ""}`}><ShieldCheck aria-hidden="true" /><input id="ht-su-confirm" value={confirmPassword} onChange={e => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)} type={showConfirmPassword ? "text" : "password"} autoComplete="new-password" placeholder="Confirm your password" aria-invalid={confirmMismatch} aria-describedby="ht-su-confirm-help" disabled={busy} required /><button type="button" className="ht-recovery-eye" onClick={() => setShowConfirmPassword(v => !v)} aria-label={showConfirmPassword ? "Hide confirmation" : "Show confirmation"}>{showConfirmPassword ? <EyeOff /> : <Eye />}</button></div>
              <p id="ht-su-confirm-help" className={`ht-signup-inline-help${confirmMismatch ? " ht-signup-inline-error" : ""}`} role={confirmMismatch ? "alert" : "status"}>{confirmPassword.length === 0 ? "Re-enter the same password to confirm." : confirmMismatch ? "âœ• Passwords do not match." : "âœ“ Passwords match."}</p>
              <button className="ht-recovery-primary" type="submit" disabled={busy}>{busy ? "Creating account..." : "Create Account"}<ArrowRight aria-hidden="true" size={20} /></button>
            </form>
          ) : (
            <form className="ht-recovery-form" onSubmit={handleVerify}>
              <label className="ht-recovery-label" htmlFor="ht-su-code">Email Verification Code</label>
              <div className="ht-recovery-field"><Mail aria-hidden="true" /><input className="ht-recovery-code" id="ht-su-code" value={code} onChange={e => setCode(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, CODE_LENGTH))} type="text" inputMode="numeric" autoComplete="one-time-code" maxLength={CODE_LENGTH} placeholder="000000" disabled={busy || !!confirmedUserId} required={!confirmedUserId} /></div>
              <p className="ht-recovery-help">Check your inbox and spam folder. The code is for email confirmation, not password recovery.</p>
              <p className="ht-signup-verification-warning" role="note">Your email and username are reserved for this pending registration. Complete verification using this email. Leaving or restarting with another email will not automatically release your username.</p>
              <button className="ht-recovery-primary" type="submit" disabled={busy || (!confirmedUserId && code.length !== CODE_LENGTH)}>{busy ? "Verifying..." : confirmedUserId ? "Complete Account Setup" : "Verify Email"}<ArrowRight aria-hidden="true" size={20} /></button>
              <div className="ht-recovery-actions"><span className="ht-signup-locked-label">Registration details locked</span><button type="button" disabled={busy || cooldown > 0 || !!confirmedUserId} onClick={() => void handleResend()}>{cooldown > 0 ? `Resend in ${cooldown}s` : "Resend code"}</button></div>
            </form>
          )}
          <Link className="ht-recovery-back" href="/sign-in" onClick={event => { if (stage === "verify") { event.preventDefault(); setShowLeaveConfirmation(true); } }}><ArrowLeft size={18} aria-hidden="true" /> Back to Log In</Link>
        </section>
      </div>
      {showLeaveConfirmation && stage === "verify" && (
        <div className="ht-signup-leave-overlay" role="presentation">
          <section className="ht-signup-leave-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="ht-signup-leave-title" aria-describedby="ht-signup-leave-description">
            <h2 id="ht-signup-leave-title">Leave email verification?</h2>
            <p id="ht-signup-leave-description">Your registration is not complete. Your username may remain reserved by the pending account even if you leave. You can return to Sign Up in this browser session to resend your code.</p>
            <div className="ht-signup-leave-actions">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowLeaveConfirmation(false)}>Continue Verification</button>
              <Link href="/sign-in">Leave to Log In</Link>
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="ht-recovery-portrait-bottom" aria-hidden="true" />
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\app\(dashboard)\account\appointments\history\page.tsx =====

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import { fetchAppointmentsByCustomer, subscribeToAppointments, type AppointmentRow } from "@/lib/supabase/appointment-management";
import type { AppointmentStatus, AppointmentServiceType } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import CustomerAppointmentDetailModal from "@/components/dashboard/CustomerAppointmentDetailModal";

const PAGE_SIZE = 10;

const STATUS_STYLES: Record<AppointmentStatus, string> = {
  pending: "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700",
  confirmed: "bg-sky-100 text-sky-700",
  checked_in: "bg-purple-100 text-purple-700",
  completed: "bg-green-100 text-green-700",
  cancelled: "bg-red-100 text-red-600",
};

const STATUS_LABELS: Record<AppointmentStatus, string> = {
  pending: "Pending", confirmed: "Confirmed", checked_in: "Checked In",
  completed: "Completed", cancelled: "Cancelled",
};

const SERVICE_LABELS: Record<AppointmentServiceType, string> = {
  dog_grooming: "Dog Grooming", cat_grooming: "Cat Grooming",
  boarding: "Boarding", ala_carte: "Ala Carte",
};

type FilterTab = "all" | "upcoming" | "completed" | "cancelled";

function displayDate(dateStr: string): string {
  return new Date(dateStr + "T00:00:00").toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" });
}

export default function AppointmentHistoryPage() {
  const [appointments, setAppointments] = useState<AppointmentRow[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [userId, setUserId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<FilterTab>("all");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [viewingId, setViewingId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const loadAppointments = useCallback(async (id: string) => {
    const { rows } = await fetchAppointmentsByCustomer(id);
    const sorted = [...rows].sort(
      (a, b) => new Date(b.created_at).getTime() - new Date(a.created_at).getTime()
    );
    setAppointments(sorted);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    async function init() {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
      if (!user) { setLoading(false); return; }
      setUserId(user.id);
      await loadAppointments(user.id);
      setLoading(false);
    }
    void init();
  }, [loadAppointments]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!userId) return;
    const unsubscribe = subscribeToAppointments(() => { void loadAppointments(userId); });
    return unsubscribe;
  }, [userId, loadAppointments]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (filter === "all") return appointments;
    if (filter === "upcoming") return appointments.filter((a) => a.status === "pending" || a.status === "confirmed" || a.status === "checked_in");
    if (filter === "completed") return appointments.filter((a) => a.status === "completed");
    return appointments.filter((a) => a.status === "cancelled");
  }, [appointments, filter]);

  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / PAGE_SIZE));
  const currentPage = Math.min(page, pageCount);
  const visible = filtered.slice((currentPage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE, currentPage * PAGE_SIZE);

  const tabs: { key: FilterTab; label: string }[] = [
    { key: "all", label: "All" },
    { key: "upcoming", label: "Upcoming" },
    { key: "completed", label: "Completed" },
    { key: "cancelled", label: "Cancelled" },
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold text-zinc-800">Appointments</h1>
      <div className="mt-4 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto">
        {tabs.map((tab) => (
          <button
            key={tab.key}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setFilter(tab.key); setPage(1); }}
            aria-pressed={filter === tab.key}
            className={`shrink-0 rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-semibold transition-colors ${
              filter === tab.key ? "bg-brand-pink text-white" : "border border-brand-pink text-brand-pink hover:bg-brand-tint"
            }`}
          >
            {tab.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <p className="mt-6 text-sm text-zinc-400">Loading your appointmentsâ€¦</p>
      ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="mt-6 rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-brand-tint px-6 py-10 text-center">
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">
            {filter === "all" ? "You don't have any appointments yet." : `No ${filter} appointments.`}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="mt-6 flex flex-col gap-3">
            {visible.map((appt) => (
              <div key={appt.id} className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <div>
                    <p className="font-semibold text-zinc-800">{SERVICE_LABELS[appt.service_type]}</p>
                    <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">
                      {displayDate(appt.scheduled_date)}
                      {appt.scheduled_time ? ` Â· ${appt.scheduled_time}` : ""}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <span className={`shrink-0 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold ${STATUS_STYLES[appt.status]}`}>
                    {STATUS_LABELS[appt.status]}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {appt.pets.map((pet) => (
                    <span key={pet.id} className="rounded-full bg-brand-tint px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-600">
                      {pet.name}
                      {pet.packageName ? ` Â· ${pet.packageName}` : ""}
                      {pet.kennelLabel ? ` Â· ${pet.kennelLabel}` : ""}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-pink-50 pt-3">
                  <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
                    {appt.pets.length} {appt.pets.length === 1 ? "pet" : "pets"}
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <span className="font-bold text-brand-pink">â‚±{appt.total_amount.toFixed(2)}</span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setViewingId(appt.id)}
                      className="rounded-full border-2 border-brand-pink px-4 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink transition-colors hover:bg-brand-pink hover:text-white"
                    >
                      View
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {pageCount > 1 && (
            <nav aria-label="Appointments pages" className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white px-4 py-3">
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
                Showing {(currentPage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE + 1}â€“{Math.min(currentPage * PAGE_SIZE, filtered.length)} of {filtered.length} appointments
              </p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                <button type="button" disabled={currentPage === 1} onClick={() => setPage(currentPage - 1)}
                  className="rounded-full border border-pink-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink hover:bg-pink-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40">
                  Previous
                </button>
                {Array.from({ length: pageCount }, (_, index) => index + 1).map((number) => (
                  <button key={number} type="button" onClick={() => setPage(number)} aria-label={`Page ${number}`} aria-current={currentPage === number ? "page" : undefined}
                    className={`min-w-8 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold ${currentPage === number ? "bg-brand-pink text-white" : "border border-pink-200 text-brand-pink hover:bg-pink-50"}`}>
                    {number}
                  </button>
                ))}
                <button type="button" disabled={currentPage === pageCount} onClick={() => setPage(currentPage + 1)}
                  className="rounded-full border border-pink-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink hover:bg-pink-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40">
                  Next
                </button>
              </div>
            </nav>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      {viewingId && <CustomerAppointmentDetailModal appointmentId={viewingId} onClose={() => setViewingId(null)} onCancelled={() => { if (userId) void loadAppointments(userId); }} />}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
// Booking workflow: existing data sources, pricing, multiple-pet and multi-service logic preserved.
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import { fetchPetsByCustomer } from "@/lib/supabase/appointments";
import { fetchGroomers, fetchKennels } from "@/lib/supabase/pet-services";
import { fetchPackagesFull, fetchPetSizes, fetchAddonsByCategory } from "@/lib/supabase/services";
import type { Pet, DraftPetSelection } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { Customer } from "@/lib/types/users";
import Link from "next/link";
import { hasValidCustomerPhone } from "@/lib/utils/customer-phone";
import type { Groomer, Kennel } from "@/lib/types/pet-services";
import type { Package, PetSize, Addon } from "@/lib/types/services";
import { emptyLeg, eligibleServicesFor, autoQueuedGroomingLegs, type BookingLeg } from "@/lib/types/booking-leg";
import { findDuplicatePetAddon } from "@/lib/booking/unique-pet-addons";
import type { WalkInServiceChoice } from "@/components/admin/pos/walk-in/ServiceChoiceStep";
import CustomerServiceChoiceStep from "@/components/dashboard/booking/CustomerServiceChoiceStep";
import BookingPetInformationStep from "@/components/dashboard/booking/BookingPetInformationStep";
import CustomerGroomingSelectionStep from "@/components/dashboard/booking/CustomerGroomingSelectionStep";
import BoardingDetailsAndSchedule from "@/components/shared/BoardingDetailsAndSchedule";
import AlaCarteSelectionStep from "@/components/admin/pos/walk-in/AlaCarteSelectionStep";
import CustomerGroomingScheduleStep from "@/components/dashboard/booking/CustomerGroomingScheduleStep";
import AddAnotherServicePrompt from "@/components/dashboard/booking/AddAnotherServicePrompt";
import MultiServiceSummaryStep from "@/components/dashboard/booking/MultiServiceSummaryStep";
import CurrentLegSidebar from "@/components/dashboard/booking/CurrentLegSidebar";
import OnlineCapacityGroomingSchedule from "@/components/dashboard/booking/OnlineCapacityGroomingSchedule";
import CustomerWaiverStep from "@/components/dashboard/booking/CustomerWaiverStep";
import BookingProgress, { type BookingPhase } from "@/components/dashboard/booking/BookingProgress";

type Step = BookingPhase;
export default function BookAppointmentPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [customer, setCustomer] = useState<Customer | null>(null);
  const [pets, setPets] = useState<Pet[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>("pet-info");
  const [waiverBackStep, setWaiverBackStep] = useState<"service" | "add-more">("service");
  const [selectedPetIds, setSelectedPetIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [queuedLegs, setQueuedLegs] = useState<BookingLeg[]>([]);
  const [completedLegs, setCompletedLegs] = useState<BookingLeg[]>([]);
  const [currentLeg, setCurrentLeg] = useState<BookingLeg | null>(null);
  const [groomers, setGroomers] = useState<Groomer[]>([]);
  const [kennels, setKennels] = useState<Kennel[]>([]);
  const [boardingAddons, setBoardingAddons] = useState<Addon[]>([]);
  const [packagesByService, setPackagesByService] = useState<Record<string, Package[]>>({});
  const [sizesByService, setSizesByService] = useState<Record<string, PetSize[]>>({});
  const [addonsByService, setAddonsByService] = useState<Record<string, Addon[]>>({});
  const [duplicateWarning, setDuplicateWarning] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
      if (!user) { router.push("/sign-in"); return; }
      const { data: customerRow } = await supabase.from("customers").select("*").eq("id", user.id).single();
      if (!customerRow) { router.push("/sign-in"); return; }
      setCustomer(customerRow);
      const { pets: petRows } = await fetchPetsByCustomer(user.id);
      setPets(petRows);
      const [groomerResult, kennelResult, boardingAddonResult, alaCarteResult] = await Promise.all([
        fetchGroomers({ activeOnly: true }), fetchKennels(), fetchAddonsByCategory("Boarding Add-ons"), fetchAddonsByCategory("Ala Carte"),
      ]);
      setGroomers(groomerResult.groomers);
      setKennels(kennelResult.kennels);
      setBoardingAddons(boardingAddonResult.addons);
      setAddonsByService(prev => ({ ...prev, ala_carte: alaCarteResult.addons }));
      setLoading(false);
    }
    void load();
  }, [router]);

  const loadGroomingLookups = useCallback(async (serviceType: "dog_grooming" | "cat_grooming") => {
    if (packagesByService[serviceType]) return;
    const [pkgResult, sizeResult, addonResult] = await Promise.all([
      fetchPackagesFull(serviceType), fetchPetSizes(serviceType), fetchAddonsByCategory("Grooming Add-ons"),
    ]);
    setPackagesByService((prev) => ({ ...prev, [serviceType]: pkgResult.packages }));
    setSizesByService((prev) => ({ ...prev, [serviceType]: sizeResult.sizes }));
    setAddonsByService((prev) => ({ ...prev, [serviceType]: addonResult.addons }));
  }, [packagesByService]);

  const loadLookupsForChoice = useCallback((choice: WalkInServiceChoice) => {
    if (choice === "grooming") void Promise.all([loadGroomingLookups("dog_grooming"), loadGroomingLookups("cat_grooming")]);
    else if (choice === "dog_grooming" || choice === "cat_grooming") void loadGroomingLookups(choice);
  }, [loadGroomingLookups]);

  useEffect(() => { setAddonsByService((prev) => ({ ...prev, boarding: boardingAddons })); }, [boardingAddons]);

  const selectedPets = pets.filter((p) => selectedPetIds.includes(p.id));
  const selectedSpecies = selectedPets.map((p) => p.species);
  const uniqueSelectedSpecies = Array.from(new Set(selectedSpecies));

  function startNextLeg(queue: BookingLeg[]) {
    if (queue.length > 0) {
      const [next, ...rest] = queue;
      setQueuedLegs(rest); setCurrentLeg(next); loadLookupsForChoice(next.serviceChoice); setWaiverBackStep("service"); setStep("waiver");
    } else setStep("service");
  }
  function handlePetInfoNext() {
    if (uniqueSelectedSpecies.length === 2) startNextLeg(autoQueuedGroomingLegs(selectedPets));
    else setStep("service");
  }
  function handleServiceChosen(choice: WalkInServiceChoice) {
    const eligiblePetIds = selectedPets.filter((p) => {
      if (choice === "dog_grooming") return p.species === "Dog";
      if (choice === "cat_grooming") return p.species === "Cat";
      return true;
    }).map((p) => p.id);
    const leg = emptyLeg(choice, eligiblePetIds);
    setWaiverBackStep(step === "add-more" ? "add-more" : "service");
    setCurrentLeg(leg); loadLookupsForChoice(choice); setStep("waiver");
  }
  function handleWaiverDeclined() { setCurrentLeg(null); setStep(waiverBackStep); }
  function handleLegSelectionChange(selections: DraftPetSelection[]) {
    setCurrentLeg((leg) => leg ? { ...leg, petSelections: selections } : leg);
  }
  function handleRemovePetFromLeg(petId: string) {
    if (!currentLeg || currentLeg.petIds.length <= 1) return;
    setCurrentLeg({ ...currentLeg, petIds: currentLeg.petIds.filter((id) => id !== petId),
      petSelections: currentLeg.petSelections.filter((sel) => sel.pet.id !== petId) });
  }
  function handleLegScheduleConfirmed(confirmedSelections?: DraftPetSelection[]) {
    if (!currentLeg) return;
    const selections = Array.isArray(confirmedSelections) ? confirmedSelections : currentLeg.petSelections;
    if (!selections.length || selections.some((selection) => !selection?.pet?.id)) {
      setStep("selection");
      return;
    }
    const updated = { ...currentLeg, petSelections: selections };
    const proposed = [...completedLegs.filter(l => l.id !== currentLeg.id), updated];
    const duplicate = findDuplicatePetAddon(proposed, addonsByService);
    if (duplicate) { setDuplicateWarning(duplicate); setStep("selection"); return; }
    setCompletedLegs(proposed); setCurrentLeg(null);
    if (queuedLegs.length > 0) startNextLeg(queuedLegs);
    else setStep("add-more");
  }
  function handleEditLeg(legId: string) {
    const leg = completedLegs.find((l) => l.id === legId);
    if (!leg) return;
    setCompletedLegs((prev) => prev.filter((l) => l.id !== legId));
    setCurrentLeg(leg); loadLookupsForChoice(leg.serviceChoice); setStep("selection");
  }
  const hasGroomingLeg = completedLegs.some((leg) =>
    leg.serviceChoice === "grooming" || leg.serviceChoice === "dog_grooming" || leg.serviceChoice === "cat_grooming"
  );
  const eligibleForMore = eligibleServicesFor(pets, selectedPetIds, completedLegs)
    .filter((choice) => !hasGroomingLeg || !["grooming", "dog_grooming", "cat_grooming"].includes(choice));
  if (loading || !customer) return <p className="py-10 text-center text-sm text-zinc-400 sm:py-16">Loadingâ€¦</p>;
  if (!hasValidCustomerPhone(customer.phone_number)) return (
    <section className="mx-auto max-w-xl rounded-3xl border border-rose-200 bg-white p-7 text-center shadow-sm">
      <span className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-rose-50 text-rose-600">!</span>
      <h1 className="mt-4 text-xl font-bold text-zinc-800">Phone number required</h1>
      <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-zinc-600">Please add a valid mobile number to My Account before booking an appointment. HappyTails staff use it to contact you about your pet and appointment.</p>
      <Link href="/account/profile" className="mt-5 inline-flex rounded-full bg-brand-pink px-6 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white">Complete My Account</Link>
    </section>
  );
  const legPets = currentLeg ? pets.filter((p) => currentLeg.petIds.includes(p.id)) : [];
  const isGrooming = currentLeg?.serviceChoice === "grooming" || currentLeg?.serviceChoice === "dog_grooming" || currentLeg?.serviceChoice === "cat_grooming";
  const showSidebar = (step === "selection" || step === "schedule") && legPets.length > 0;

  return <div className="ht-booking-shell">
    <div className="ht-booking-left"><BookingProgress step={step} hasCompletedServices={completedLegs.length > 0} combinedBoarding={step === "selection" && currentLeg?.serviceChoice === "boarding"} />
    {showSidebar && <CurrentLegSidebar pets={legPets} onRemove={handleRemovePetFromLeg} />}</div>
    <div className="ht-booking-main">
      <div className="ht-booking-panel">
        {step === "pet-info" && <div className="ht-booking-pets"><BookingPetInformationStep customer={customer} pets={pets} onPetsChange={setPets}
          selectedIds={selectedPetIds} onSelectionChange={setSelectedPetIds}
          onBack={() => router.push("/account")} onNext={handlePetInfoNext} /></div>}
        {step === "service" && <div className="ht-booking-services"><CustomerServiceChoiceStep choice={currentLeg?.serviceChoice ?? null}
          onChange={handleServiceChosen} onBack={() => setStep("pet-info")}
          onNext={() => setStep("waiver")} petSpecies={selectedSpecies} /></div>}
        {step === "waiver" && currentLeg && <CustomerWaiverStep serviceType={currentLeg.serviceChoice} onBack={handleWaiverDeclined} onAgree={() => setStep("selection")} />}
        {step === "selection" && currentLeg?.serviceChoice === "boarding" && <BoardingDetailsAndSchedule
          pets={legPets} selections={currentLeg.petSelections} kennels={kennels}
          alreadyGroomedPetIds={completedLegs.filter((leg) => ["dog_grooming", "cat_grooming", "grooming"].includes(leg.serviceChoice)).flatMap((leg) => leg.petIds)}
          onChange={handleLegSelectionChange} scheduledDate={currentLeg.scheduledDate}
          petBelongings={currentLeg.petBelongings} specialRequests={currentLeg.specialRequests}
          onBelongingsChange={(items) => setCurrentLeg((leg) => leg && { ...leg, petBelongings: items })}
          onRequestsChange={(text) => setCurrentLeg((leg) => leg && { ...leg, specialRequests: text })}
          onBack={() => setStep("waiver")} onConfirmed={(items) => handleLegScheduleConfirmed(items)} />}
        {step === "selection" && currentLeg?.serviceChoice === "ala_carte" && <AlaCarteSelectionStep
          pets={legPets} selections={currentLeg.petSelections} completedLegs={completedLegs} onChange={handleLegSelectionChange}
          onBack={() => setStep("waiver")} onNext={() => setStep("schedule")} />}
        {step === "selection" && isGrooming && currentLeg && <CustomerGroomingSelectionStep
          serviceType={currentLeg.serviceChoice as "grooming" | "dog_grooming" | "cat_grooming"}
          pets={legPets} selections={currentLeg.petSelections} onChange={handleLegSelectionChange}
          onBack={() => setStep("waiver")}
          onNext={() => setStep("schedule")} />}
        {step === "schedule" && currentLeg && isGrooming && <div className="ht-booking-schedule"><OnlineCapacityGroomingSchedule
          petSelections={currentLeg.petSelections} scheduledDate={currentLeg.scheduledDate}
          scheduledTime={currentLeg.scheduledTime} specialRequests={currentLeg.specialRequests}
          onDateChange={(date) => setCurrentLeg((l) => l && { ...l, scheduledDate: date })}
          onTimeChange={(time) => setCurrentLeg((l) => l && { ...l, scheduledTime: time })}
          onRequestsChange={(text) => setCurrentLeg((l) => l && { ...l, specialRequests: text })}
          onSelectionsChange={handleLegSelectionChange}
          onBack={() => setStep("selection")} onConfirmed={(items) => handleLegScheduleConfirmed(items)} /></div>}

          customer={customer} ownerContact={customer.phone_number ?? ""} petSelections={currentLeg.petSelections}
          groomers={groomers} completedLegs={completedLegs} scheduledDate={currentLeg.scheduledDate}
          scheduledTime={currentLeg.scheduledTime} specialRequests={currentLeg.specialRequests}
          onDateChange={(date) => setCurrentLeg((l) => l && { ...l, scheduledDate: date })}
          onTimeChange={(time) => setCurrentLeg((l) => l && { ...l, scheduledTime: time })}
          onRequestsChange={(text) => setCurrentLeg((l) => l && { ...l, specialRequests: text })}
          onSelectionsChange={handleLegSelectionChange}
          onBack={() => setStep("selection")} onConfirmed={() => handleLegScheduleConfirmed()} /></div>}
        {step === "add-more" && <AddAnotherServicePrompt eligibleServices={eligibleForMore}
          onAddService={handleServiceChosen} onDone={() => setStep("summary")} onBack={() => { const last = completedLegs[completedLegs.length - 1]; if (last) handleEditLeg(last.id); else setStep("service"); }} />}

          packagesByService={packagesByService} sizesByService={sizesByService}

function relativeTime(iso: string) {

 if(m<1)return "Just now";if(m<60)return `${m}m ago`;if(m<1440)return `${Math.round(m/60)}h ago`;
 return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString("en-PH",{month:"short",day:"numeric",year:"numeric"});
}

 useEffect(()=>{if(!userId)return;return subscribeToNotifications(userId,()=>{void load(userId)})},[userId,load]);
 const unread=items.filter(x=>!x.read).length,pageCount=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(items.length/PAGE_SIZE)),currentPage=Math.min(page,pageCount);

  const {error:err}=await markNotificationRead(n.id);

export default function PetDetailPage() {

    void (async()=>{
      try {
        const {data:{user}, error: authError}=await createClient().auth.getUser();
        if(authError)throw authError;
        if(!user)return;
        const {pets,error: fetchError}=await fetchPetsByCustomer(user.id);
        if(fetchError)throw new Error(fetchError);
        if(!active)return;
        const row=(pets.find(p=>p.id===params.petId)??null) as PetWithWeight|null;
        setPet(row);
        if(row)state.setForm({...blankCustomerPet,vaccination_status:row.vaccination_status ?? blankCustomerPet.vaccination_status,name:row.name,species:row.species,breed:row.breed,weight:row.weight_kg==null?"":String(row.weight_kg),sex:row.sex??"",age:petAgeLabel(row)??""});
      } catch(e) {
        if(active)setMessage(e instanceof Error?e.message:"Unable to load pet details.");
      } finally {if(active)setLoading(false);}
    })();
    return()=>{active=false};
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  },[params.petId]);

  async function save(e:FormEvent){
    e.preventDefault();
    if(!pet||saving||archiving||state.loadingGuide||!state.validate())return;

    const {form,size}=state;
    const keepLegacySize=!form.weight.trim()&&form.species===pet.species;
    try {
      const changes = {
        name:form.name.trim(),species:form.species,breed:form.breed.trim(),
        vaccination_status: form.vaccination_status,
        size_label:size?.label??(keepLegacySize?pet.size_label:"Unclassified"),
        pet_size_id:size?.id??(keepLegacySize?pet.pet_size_id??null:null),
        weight_kg:form.weight.trim()?Number(form.weight):null,
        sex:form.sex||null,...normalizePetAge(form.age)!,
      };
      const {data,error}=await editCustomerPet(pet.id,changes);
      if(error)throw new Error(error.message);
      const saved=Array.isArray(data)?data[0]:null;
      if(!saved)throw new Error("The database did not confirm the update. Please try again.");
      setPet({ ...(saved as PetWithWeight), photo_url: (saved as PetWithWeight).photo_url ?? pet.photo_url });

    } catch(e){setMessage(e instanceof Error?e.message:"Unable to save pet changes.");}
    finally{setSaving(false);}
  }

function NewPetForm({ customerId, onClose, onSaved }: { customerId: string; onClose: () => void; onSaved: () => void }) {
  const state = useCustomerPetForm();
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  async function submit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (saving || !state.validate()) return;
    setSaving(true); setError("");
    try {
      const { form, size } = state;
      const normalizedAge = normalizePetAge(form.age);
      if (!normalizedAge) throw new Error("Enter a valid age such as 3 weeks, 6 months or 2 years.");
      const { error: saveError } = await insertCustomerPet({ customer_id: customerId, name: form.name.trim(), species: form.species,
        breed: form.breed.trim(), size_label: size?.label ?? "Unclassified", weight_kg: form.weight.trim() ? Number(form.weight) : null, pet_size_id: size?.id ?? null,
        ...normalizedAge, sex: form.sex || null, vaccination_status: form.vaccination_status });
      if (saveError) throw new Error(saveError.message);
      state.setForm(blankCustomerPet);
      onSaved();
    } catch (caught) { setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : "Unable to add pet."); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  }
  return <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[90] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-4" onMouseDown={e => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget && !saving) onClose(); }}>
    <form noValidate onSubmit={submit} role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="add-pet-title" className="max-h-[90vh] w-full max-w-lg overflow-y-auto rounded-3xl bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl">
      <div className="mb-5 flex items-center justify-between"><h2 id="add-pet-title" className="text-xl font-bold">Add New Pet</h2><button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close">âœ•</button></div>
      <CustomerPetFields state={state}/>
      {error && <p role="alert" className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}
      <div className="mt-6 flex justify-end gap-3"><button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={onClose} className="rounded-xl border px-5 py-3 text-sm">Cancel</button><button type="submit" disabled={saving || (!!state.form.weight.trim() ? false : state.loadingGuide || !!state.guideError)} className="rounded-xl bg-brand-pink px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50">{saving ? "Savingâ€¦" : "Add Pet"}</button></div>
    </form>
  </div>;
}

export default function MyAccountPage() {

  const [form, setForm] = useState({ full_name: "", phone_number: "", address: "" });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    (async () => {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
      if (!user) { if (active) setLoading(false); return; }
      const { data } = await supabase.from("customers").select("*").eq("id", user.id).single();
      if (!active) return;
      if (data) {
        setCustomer(data as Customer);
        setForm({ full_name: data.full_name ?? "", phone_number: data.phone_number ?? "", address: data.address ?? "" });
      }
      setLoading(false);
    })();
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, []);
  async function saveProfile(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!customer || saving) return;
    const phone = normalizeCustomerPhone(form.phone_number);
    if (!hasValidCustomerPhone(phone)) {
      setMessage("Enter a valid Philippine mobile number (09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX).");
      return;
    }
    if (!form.full_name.trim()) { setMessage("Full name is required."); return; }
    setSaving(true); setMessage("");

      .update({ full_name: form.full_name.trim(), phone_number: phone, address: form.address.trim() || null })
      .eq("id", customer.id).select("*").single();

      setCustomer(data as Customer);
      setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, phone_number: phone }));
      setMessage("Account information updated successfully.");
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("happytails:contact-updated"));

    setSaving(false);

  const missingPhone = !hasValidCustomerPhone(customer.phone_number);
  return <div className="space-y-6">
    <div><h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-zinc-800 md:text-3xl">My Account</h1><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500">Manage the contact information connected to your Happy Tails account.</p></div>

        <div className="mt-4 text-center"><h2 className="font-bold text-zinc-800">{customer.full_name}</h2><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">{customer.email ?? "No email on file"}</p><span className="mt-3 inline-flex rounded-full bg-pink-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink">Client ID: {customer.customer_id}</span></div>

function localDateKey(date = new Date()) {
  const y = date.getFullYear();
  const m = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const d = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
}

function formatDate(dateStr: string) {
  return new Date(`${dateStr}T00:00:00`).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    weekday: "long",
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function formatTime(time: string | null) {
  if (!time) return "Time to be confirmed";

  const [hours, minutes] = time.split(":").map(Number);
  const date = new Date();
  date.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);

  return date.toLocaleTimeString("en-US", {
    hour: "numeric",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

function serviceLabel(type: AppointmentRow["service_type"]) {
  return {
    dog_grooming: "Dog Grooming",

    boarding: "Boarding",

}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\app\(dashboard)\layout.tsx =====

// Defense in depth: customer pages require a verified, active customer row.
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import DashboardNavbar from "@/components/dashboard/DashboardNavbar";
import AccountStatusWatcher from "@/components/AccountStatusWatcher";

export default async function DashboardLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: auth, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (authError || !auth.user) redirect("/sign-in");

  const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", auth.user.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (profileError || !profile) redirect("/sign-in?access=unverified");
  if (profile.role === "admin" || profile.role === "superadmin") redirect("/admin");

  const { data: customer, error: customerError } = await supabase
    .from("customers")
    .select("*")
    .eq("id", auth.user.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (customerError || !customer) redirect("/sign-in?access=unverified");
  if (customer.status !== "active") redirect("/sign-in?deactivated=1");

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen overflow-x-hidden bg-brand-tint">
      <AccountStatusWatcher userId={auth.user.id} table="customers" />
      <DashboardNavbar customer={customer} />
      <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-3 py-3 sm:px-4 sm:py-5 md:px-6 md:py-6">
        {children}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\app\api\admin\appointment-reschedule\route.ts =====

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import nodemailer from "nodemailer";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { buildRescheduleEmail, type RescheduleEmailDetails } from "@/lib/email/happytails-reschedule-email";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

type Delivery = "sent" | "failed" | "not_configured" | "no_customer" | "no_email";

async function notifyCustomer(customerId: string | null, details: RescheduleEmailDetails): Promise<Delivery> {
  if (!customerId) return "no_customer";
  if (!process.env.GMAIL_SMTP_USER || !process.env.GMAIL_SMTP_APP_PASSWORD) return "not_configured";
  try {
    const admin = createAdminClient();
    const { data, error } = await admin.auth.admin.getUserById(customerId);
    if (error || !data.user?.email) return "no_email";
    const recipient = data.user.email;
    const mail = buildRescheduleEmail(details);
    const transporter = nodemailer.createTransport({
      host: "smtp.gmail.com", port: 465, secure: true,
      auth: { user: process.env.GMAIL_SMTP_USER, pass: process.env.GMAIL_SMTP_APP_PASSWORD },
      connectionTimeout: 10000, greetingTimeout: 10000, socketTimeout: 15000,
    });
    const result = await transporter.sendMail({
      from: { name: process.env.HAPPYTAILS_EMAIL_FROM_NAME || "HappyTails Pet Grooming CafÃ©", address: process.env.GMAIL_SMTP_USER },
      to: recipient, subject: mail.subject, text: mail.text, html: mail.html,
    });
    return result.accepted.some((email) =>
  (typeof email === "string" ? email : email.address)
    .toLowerCase() === recipient.toLowerCase()
) ? "sent" : "failed";
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("HappyTails reschedule notification failed", error);
    return "failed";
  }
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const db = await createClient();
    const { data: { user }, error: userError } = await db.auth.getUser();
    if (userError || !user) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Sign in required." }, { status: 401 });
    const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await db.from("profiles").select("role").eq("id", user.id).single();
    if (profileError || !["admin", "superadmin"].includes(String(profile?.role))) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Staff access required." }, { status: 403 });
    }
    const input: unknown = await request.json();
    if (!input || typeof input !== "object") return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request." }, { status: 400 });
    const { appointmentId, date, time, reason } = input as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (typeof appointmentId !== "string" || !/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(appointmentId)
      || typeof date !== "string" || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date)
      || typeof time !== "string" || !/^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$/.test(time)
      || typeof reason !== "string" || reason.trim().length < 5 || reason.trim().length > 500) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Enter a valid appointment, date, time, and rescheduling reason (5â€“500 characters)." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // The staff-only RPC performs availability validation, saves the reason,
    // and returns the *actual* old schedule in one transaction.
    const { data: old, error: mutationError } = await db.rpc("happytails_reschedule_staff_appointment", {
      p_appointment_id: appointmentId, p_date: date, p_time: time, p_reason: reason.trim(),
    });
    if (mutationError) return NextResponse.json({ error: mutationError.message }, { status: 409 });

    // Never report an email as sent until Gmail accepts it. A notification
    // failure cannot roll back the successfully committed schedule change.
    const { data: appointment, error: lookupError } = await db.from("appointments")
      .select("id,customer_id,owner_name,service_type,scheduled_date,scheduled_time,drop_off_at,pick_up_at,appointment_pets(pets(name))")
      .eq("id", appointmentId).single();
    if (lookupError || !appointment) {
      console.error("Reschedule saved but updated appointment lookup failed", lookupError);
      return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, delivery: "failed" });
    }
    const previous = (old && typeof old === "object" && !Array.isArray(old) ? old : {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const petNames = (appointment.appointment_pets ?? []).flatMap(item => {
      const pet = Array.isArray(item.pets) ? item.pets[0] : item.pets;
      return pet?.name ? [pet.name] : [];
    });
    const details: RescheduleEmailDetails = {
      id: appointment.id, ownerName: appointment.owner_name,
      serviceType: appointment.service_type, petNames,
      reason: reason.trim(),
      oldDate: typeof previous.previous_date === "string" ? previous.previous_date : null,
      oldTime: typeof previous.previous_time === "string" ? previous.previous_time : null,
      oldDropOff: typeof previous.previous_drop_off_at === "string" ? previous.previous_drop_off_at : null,
      oldPickUp: typeof previous.previous_pick_up_at === "string" ? previous.previous_pick_up_at : null,
      newDate: appointment.scheduled_date, newTime: appointment.scheduled_time,
      newDropOff: appointment.drop_off_at, newPickUp: appointment.pick_up_at,
    };
    const delivery = await notifyCustomer(appointment.customer_id, details);
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, delivery });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Appointment rescheduling request failed", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unable to process rescheduling." }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import nodemailer from "nodemailer";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import {
  buildAppointmentEmail,
  type AppointmentEmailData,
  type EmailAction,
} from "@/lib/email/happytails-appointment-email";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

type Action = EmailAction;

const allowed: Record<Action, string[]> = {
  confirmed: ["pending"],
  completed: ["checked_in"],
  cancelled: ["pending", "confirmed"],
};

async function emailCustomer(appointment: AppointmentEmailData & { customer_id: string | null }, action: Action, reason: string | undefined) {
  if (!process.env.GMAIL_SMTP_USER || !process.env.GMAIL_SMTP_APP_PASSWORD) {
    console.warn("HappyTails appointment email skipped: GMAIL_SMTP_USER or GMAIL_SMTP_APP_PASSWORD is missing");
    return "not_configured";
  }

  if (!appointment.id) return "missing_appointment";

  const admin = createAdminClient();
  const customerId = appointment.customer_id;
  if (!customerId) return "no_customer";

  const { data, error } = await admin.auth.admin.getUserById(customerId);
  const recipientEmail = data.user?.email;
  if (error || !recipientEmail) return "no_email";

  // The logo is a remote image referenced by URL in the HTML, not an email attachment.
  // Configure HAPPYTAILS_EMAIL_LOGO_URL with the public HTTPS URL of /images/logo.png.
  const { subject, html, text } = buildAppointmentEmail({ appointment, action, reason });
  const transporter = nodemailer.createTransport({
    host: "smtp.gmail.com",
    port: 465,
    secure: true,
    auth: {
      user: process.env.GMAIL_SMTP_USER,
      pass: process.env.GMAIL_SMTP_APP_PASSWORD,
    },
    connectionTimeout: 10000,
    greetingTimeout: 10000,
    socketTimeout: 15000,
  });

  const info = await transporter.sendMail({
    from: {
      name: process.env.HAPPYTAILS_EMAIL_FROM_NAME || "HappyTails Pet Grooming CafÃ©",
      address: process.env.GMAIL_SMTP_USER,
    },
    to: recipientEmail,
    subject,
    html,
    text,
  });

  return info.accepted.includes(recipientEmail) ? "sent" : "failed";
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const auth = await createClient();
    const {
      data: { user },
      error: authError,
    } = await auth.auth.getUser();

    if (authError || !user) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Sign in required" }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await auth
      .from("profiles")
      .select("role")
      .eq("id", user.id)
      .single();

    if (profileError || !["admin", "superadmin"].includes(String(profile?.role))) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Staff access required" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const input: unknown = await request.json();
    if (!input || typeof input !== "object") {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const { appointmentId, status, reason } = input as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (
      typeof appointmentId !== "string" ||
      !/^[a-f\d-]{36}$/i.test(appointmentId) ||
      typeof status !== "string" ||
      !["confirmed", "completed", "cancelled"].includes(status)
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid appointment or status" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const action = status as Action;
    if (
      action === "cancelled" &&
      (typeof reason !== "string" || reason.trim().length < 5 || reason.trim().length > 500)
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Enter a cancellation reason between 5 and 500 characters" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const { data: current, error: lookupError } = await auth
      .from("appointments")
      .select("id,status")
      .eq("id", appointmentId)
      .single();

    if (lookupError || !current) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: lookupError?.message ?? "Appointment not found" }, { status: 404 });
    }

    if (!allowed[action].includes(current.status)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `Cannot ${action} an appointment in ${current.status} status` },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    if (action === "cancelled") {
      const { error } = await auth.rpc("happytails_staff_cancel_appointment", {
        p_appointment_id: appointmentId,
        p_reason: (reason as string).trim(),
      });
      if (error) return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 409 });
    } else {
      const { data, error } = await auth
        .from("appointments")
        .update({ status: action })
        .eq("id", appointmentId)
        .eq("status", current.status)
        .select("id")
        .maybeSingle();

      if (error) return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });
      if (!data) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "Appointment was already changed by another user" },
          { status: 409 }
        );
      }
    }

    let delivery = "failed";
    try {
      const { data: appointment, error } = await auth
        .from("appointments")
        .select(
          "id,customer_id,owner_name,service_type,scheduled_date,scheduled_time,drop_off_at,pick_up_at,appointment_pets(pets(name),packages(name))"
        )
        .eq("id", appointmentId)
        .single();

      if (error) throw error;
      if (!appointment) throw new Error("Appointment details were not found");

      // Supabase's relationship inference can return joined pets/packages as arrays.
      // Normalize those joins before passing them to the email template.
      const emailAppointment: AppointmentEmailData & { customer_id: string | null } = {
        ...appointment,
        appointment_pets: (appointment.appointment_pets ?? []).map((row) => ({
          pets: Array.isArray(row.pets) ? (row.pets[0] ?? null) : (row.pets ?? null),
          packages: Array.isArray(row.packages) ? (row.packages[0] ?? null) : (row.packages ?? null),
        })),
      };
      delivery = await emailCustomer(
        emailAppointment,
        action,
        typeof reason === "string" ? reason.trim() : undefined
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("HappyTails appointment email delivery failed", error);
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, delivery });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Appointment status request failed", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unable to process appointment" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// POST /api/admin/create-staff
// Only active Superadmin may create staff identities. Staff use a username
// and password; a private, random Auth email is generated for Supabase's
// email/password identity provider. It is NOT a deliverable mailbox.
// Never write a newly created staff identity to public.customers.
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { validatePassword, validatePhoneNumber, validateUsername } from "@/lib/validation/staff";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

type StaffRequest = {
  firstName?: unknown;
  middleName?: unknown;
  lastName?: unknown;
  username?: unknown;
  password?: unknown;
  confirmPassword?: unknown;
  phoneNumber?: unknown;
  jobTitle?: unknown;
};

function badRequest(error: string, status = 400) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error }, { status, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
}

const asText = (value: unknown): string => typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: auth, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  const actor = auth.user;
  if (authError || !actor) return badRequest("Not signed in.", 401);

  const [{ data: actorProfile, error: profileError }, { data: actorStaff, error: staffError }] = await Promise.all([
    supabase.from("profiles").select("role").eq("id", actor.id).maybeSingle(),
    supabase.from("staff_profiles").select("status").eq("id", actor.id).maybeSingle(),
  ]);
  if (profileError || staffError || !actorProfile || !actorStaff ||
      actorProfile.role !== "superadmin" || actorStaff.status !== "active") {
    return badRequest("Only an active Superadmin may create staff accounts.", 403);
  }

  let body: StaffRequest;
  try {
    if (!request.headers.get("content-type")?.includes("application/json")) return badRequest("Expected JSON request.");
    // Avoid accepting oversized provisioning requests.
    const raw = await request.text();
    if (raw.length > 8192) return badRequest("Request is too large.", 413);
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== "object" || Array.isArray(parsed)) return badRequest("Invalid account details.");
    body = parsed as StaffRequest;
  } catch {
    return badRequest("Invalid JSON request.");
  }

  const firstName = asText(body.firstName);
  const middleName = asText(body.middleName);
  const lastName = asText(body.lastName);
  const username = asText(body.username);
  const password = typeof body.password === "string" ? body.password : "";
  const confirmPassword = typeof body.confirmPassword === "string" ? body.confirmPassword : "";
  const phoneNumber = asText(body.phoneNumber);
  const jobTitle = asText(body.jobTitle) || "Staff";

  if (!firstName || !lastName || !username || !password) {
    return badRequest("First name, last name, username, and password are required.");
  }
  if ([firstName, middleName, lastName].some(value => value.length > 80) || jobTitle.length > 100) {
    return badRequest("One or more name or job title fields are too long.");
  }
  if (username.length > 20) return badRequest("Username must not exceed 20 characters.");
  const usernameError = validateUsername(username);
  if (usernameError) return badRequest(usernameError);
  if (password !== confirmPassword) return badRequest("Passwords do not match.");
  if (password.length > 1024) return badRequest("Password is too long.");
  const passwordError = validatePassword(password);
  if (passwordError) return badRequest(passwordError);
  if (phoneNumber) {
    const phoneError = validatePhoneNumber(phoneNumber);
    if (phoneError) return badRequest(phoneError);
  }

  const adminClient = createAdminClient();
  const escaped = username.replace(/[\\%_]/g, "\\$&");
  const { data: possibleStaff, error: lookupError } = await adminClient
    .from("staff_profiles").select("username").ilike("username", escaped).limit(20);
  if (lookupError) return badRequest("Could not validate the staff username.", 503);
  if ((possibleStaff ?? []).some(row => row.username?.toLowerCase() === username.toLowerCase())) {
    return badRequest("That username is already taken.", 409);
  }

  const { data: usernameTaken, error: customerLookupError } = await adminClient
    .rpc("is_username_taken", { check_username: username });
  if (customerLookupError) return badRequest("Could not check username availability.", 503);
  if (usernameTaken) return badRequest("That username is already taken.", 409);

  const { data: adminRole, error: roleLookupError } = await adminClient
    .from("roles").select("id").eq("name", "admin").maybeSingle();
  if (roleLookupError || !adminRole) return badRequest("Staff role is not configured in Supabase.", 503);

  // A UUID-based address avoids collisions with any real customer email.
  // No emails are sent by admin.createUser; staff log in by username.
  const internalAuthEmail = `staff-${randomUUID().replace(/-/g, "")}@staff.happytails.invalid`;
  const { data: created, error: createError } = await adminClient.auth.admin.createUser({
    email: internalAuthEmail,
    password,
    email_confirm: true,
    user_metadata: {
      full_name: `${firstName} ${lastName}`,
      account_type: "staff",
    },
  });
  if (createError || !created.user) {
    console.error("Staff Auth provisioning failed", createError?.name ?? "missing_user");
    return badRequest(createError?.message ?? "Unable to create staff authentication.", 500);
  }

  const staffUserId = created.user.id;
  // A failed setup must not leave a half-created user. This rollback only
  // deletes the NEW, unfinished Auth identity, not any existing account.
  async function failProvisioning(reason: string) {
    const { error: rollbackError } = await adminClient.auth.admin.deleteUser(staffUserId);
    if (rollbackError) {
      console.error("Staff provisioning rollback failed", { staffUserId, error: rollbackError.message });
      return badRequest("Staff setup failed and automatic cleanup could not complete. Contact your database administrator before retrying.", 500);
    }
    return badRequest(`${reason} No staff account was created.`, 500);
  }

  // Profiles is populated by the existing Supabase Auth trigger. Never
  // create a SECOND profile or insert into the customers table here.
  const { data: profile, error: profileUpdateError } = await adminClient
    .from("profiles")
    .update({ role: "admin", role_id: adminRole.id })
    .eq("id", staffUserId)
    .select("id, role")
    .maybeSingle();
  if (profileUpdateError || !profile || profile.role !== "admin") {
    console.error("Staff role assignment failed", profileUpdateError?.code ?? "missing_profile");
    return failProvisioning("Could not assign the staff role.");
  }

  const { data: staffProfile, error: insertError } = await adminClient
    .from("staff_profiles")
    .insert({
      id: staffUserId,
      first_name: firstName,
      middle_name: middleName || null,
      last_name: lastName,
      username,
      // Never expose the random Supabase Auth identifier as a contact email.
      email: null,
      phone_number: phoneNumber || null,
      job_title: jobTitle,
      role_id: adminRole.id,
      status: "active",
    })
    .select()
    .single();
  if (insertError || !staffProfile) {
    console.error("Staff profile insertion failed", insertError?.code ?? "missing_profile");
    return failProvisioning(`Could not create staff profile${insertError ? `: ${insertError.message}` : "."}`);
  }

  // On some installations, the auth.users INSERT trigger automatically
  // creates a public.customers row for EVERY Auth user. Remove only the
  // shadow row attached to this brand-new staff identity. Check the actual
  // database outcome; a successful DELETE without affected rows is not
  // enough to establish that the account is staff-only.
  const { error: shadowDeleteError } = await adminClient
    .from("customers").delete().eq("id", staffUserId);
  if (shadowDeleteError) {
    console.error("Staff customer-shadow removal failed", shadowDeleteError.code);
    return failProvisioning("Could not remove the auto-generated customer profile.");
  }
  const { data: customerShadow, error: shadowCheckError } = await adminClient
    .from("customers").select("id").eq("id", staffUserId).maybeSingle();
  if (shadowCheckError || customerShadow) {
    console.error("Staff customer-shadow verification failed", shadowCheckError?.code ?? "customer_row_still_exists");
    return failProvisioning("Staff-only account verification failed.");
  }

  const { error: auditError } = await adminClient.from("audit_logs").insert({
    actor_id: actor.id,
    actor_role: actorProfile.role,
    action: "staff.created",
    target_type: "staff",
    target_id: staffUserId,
    details: { username, jobTitle, emailRequired: false },
  });
  if (auditError) console.error("Staff creation audit insert failed", auditError.code);

  return NextResponse.json({ staff: staffProfile }, {
    status: 201,
    headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" },
  });
}
