// POST /api/admin/reset-staff-password/[id]
// Superadmin-only. Issues a temporary password directly to the superadmin.
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { randomInt } from "node:crypto";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";

function generateTempPassword() {
  const chars = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnpqrstuvwxyz23456789!@#$";
  return Array.from({ length: 12 }, () => chars[randomInt(chars.length)]).join("");
}

export async function POST(request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: auth, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  const actor = auth.user;
  if (authError || !actor) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not signed in." }, { status: 401 });

  const [{ data: actorProfile, error: profileError }, { data: staffRow, error: staffError }] = await Promise.all([
    supabase.from("profiles").select("role").eq("id", actor.id).maybeSingle(),
    supabase.from("staff_profiles").select("status").eq("id", actor.id).maybeSingle(),
  ]);
  if (profileError || staffError || !actorProfile || !staffRow) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Account access could not be verified." }, { status: 403 });
  }
  if (actorProfile.role !== "superadmin" || staffRow.status !== "active") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Only an active superadmin can reset staff passwords." }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const adminClient = createAdminClient();
  const tempPassword = generateTempPassword();
  const { error } = await adminClient.auth.admin.updateUserById(id, { password: tempPassword });
  if (error) return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });

  await adminClient.from("audit_logs").insert({
    actor_id: actor.id,
    actor_role: actorProfile.role,
    action: "staff.password_reset",
    target_type: "staff",
    target_id: id,
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ tempPassword });
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\app\api\auth\check-username\route.ts =====

// Issue #6: the signup username availability check stays functional,
// but callers can no longer invoke is_username_taken directly in Supabase.
// This limited endpoint NEVER returns an email or a user identifier.
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { consumeAuthQuota, isSameOriginJsonPost, readSmallJson } from "@/lib/auth/username-security";
import { validateUsername as validateStaffUsername } from "@/lib/validation/staff";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

function respond(body: Record<string, unknown>, status = 200) {
  return NextResponse.json(body, { status, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } });
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  if (!isSameOriginJsonPost(request)) return respond({ error: "Invalid request." }, 403);
  const body = await readSmallJson(request);
  if (!body || typeof body.username !== "string") return respond({ error: "Invalid username." }, 400);
  const username = body.username.trim();
  if (username.length > 20 || username.includes("@") || validateStaffUsername(username)) {
    return respond({ error: "Invalid username." }, 400);
  }
  try {
    const admin = createAdminClient();
    const quota = await consumeAuthQuota(admin, request, "availability");
    if (quota.unavailable) return respond({ error: "Username availability is temporarily unavailable." }, 503);
    if (!quota.allowed) return respond({ error: "Too many checks. Please try again in 15 minutes." }, 429);
    const { data, error } = await admin.rpc("is_username_taken", { check_username: username });
    if (error || typeof data !== "boolean") {
      console.error("Issue #6 username availability RPC failure", error?.code ?? "invalid result");
      return respond({ error: "Username availability is temporarily unavailable." }, 503);
    }
    return respond({ taken: data });
  } catch {
    return respond({ error: "Username availability is temporarily unavailable." }, 503);
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export async function GET() {

  } catch (error) { checks.supabase_admin = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error); }
  const ready = Object.values(checks).every((v) => v === "configured" || v === "reachable");

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\app\api\auth\forgot-password\request\route.ts =====

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS, OTP_EXPIRY_MINUTES, createOtp, expiresAt, getAdminClient, findUserByEmail, hashValue, normalizeEmail, publicPasswordResetError, sendPasswordResetOtp } from "@/lib/auth/password-reset";
export const runtime = "nodejs";
export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const email = normalizeEmail(typeof body.email === "string" ? body.email : "");
    if (!email || !/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(email)) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Enter a valid email address." }, { status: 400 });
    const supabase = getAdminClient();
    const now = new Date();
    const { data: recent, error: recentError } = await supabase.from("password_reset_otps").select("created_at").eq("email", email).is("verified_at", null).order("created_at", { ascending: false }).limit(1).maybeSingle();
    if (recentError) throw new Error(`PASSWORD_RESET_TABLE_CHECK_FAILED:${recentError.message}`);
    if (recent?.created_at) {
      const secondsSinceRequest = (Date.now() - new Date(recent.created_at).getTime()) / 1000;
      if (secondsSinceRequest < RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS) return NextResponse.json({ error: `Please wait ${Math.ceil(RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS - secondsSinceRequest)} seconds before requesting another code.` }, { status: 429 });
    }
    const user = await findUserByEmail(supabase, email);
    if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, message: "If that email is registered, a verification code has been sent." });
    const otp = createOtp();
    const { error: deleteError } = await supabase.from("password_reset_otps").delete().eq("email", email).is("verified_at", null);
    if (deleteError) throw new Error(`PASSWORD_RESET_DELETE_FAILED:${deleteError.message}`);
    const { error: insertError } = await supabase.from("password_reset_otps").insert({ email, user_id: user.id, otp_hash: hashValue(otp), expires_at: expiresAt(OTP_EXPIRY_MINUTES), attempts: 0, created_at: now.toISOString() });
    if (insertError) throw new Error(`PASSWORD_RESET_INSERT_FAILED:${insertError.message}`);
    try { await sendPasswordResetOtp(email, otp); }
    catch (emailError) { await supabase.from("password_reset_otps").delete().eq("email", email).eq("otp_hash", hashValue(otp)); throw emailError; }
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, message: "A verification code has been sent to your email." });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Password reset request failed", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: publicPasswordResetError(error) }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";
import { getAdminClient, hashValue, isValidPassword } from "@/lib/auth/password-reset";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

const COOKIE_NAME = "happy_tails_password_reset";

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const password = typeof body.password === "string" ? body.password : "";

    if (!isValidPassword(password)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Password must be at least 8 characters and include uppercase, lowercase, and a special character." },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const cookieStore = await cookies();
    const resetToken = cookieStore.get(COOKIE_NAME)?.value;
    if (!resetToken) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Your verification has expired. Request a new code." }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const supabase = getAdminClient();
    const { data: record, error } = await supabase
      .from("password_reset_otps")
      .select("id,user_id,reset_token_hash,reset_token_expires_at,verified_at,used_at")
      .eq("reset_token_hash", hashValue(resetToken))
      .not("verified_at", "is", null)
      .is("used_at", null)
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (error || !record || new Date(record.reset_token_expires_at).getTime() <= Date.now()) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Your verification has expired. Request a new code." }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const { error: updatePasswordError } = await supabase.auth.admin.updateUserById(record.user_id, { password });
    if (updatePasswordError) throw updatePasswordError;

    await supabase
      .from("password_reset_otps")
      .update({ used_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq("id", record.id)
      .is("used_at", null);

    const response = NextResponse.json({ ok: true, message: "Your password has been changed successfully." });
    response.cookies.set(COOKIE_NAME, "", {
      httpOnly: true,
      sameSite: "lax",
      secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
      path: "/",
      maxAge: 0,
    });
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Password reset failed", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "We could not change your password. Please request a new verification code." }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\app\api\auth\forgot-password\verify\route.ts =====

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import {
  MAX_OTP_ATTEMPTS,
  RESET_TOKEN_EXPIRY_MINUTES,
  createResetToken,
  expiresAt,
  getAdminClient,
  hashValue,
  normalizeEmail,
} from "@/lib/auth/password-reset";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

const COOKIE_NAME = "happy_tails_password_reset";

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const email = normalizeEmail(typeof body.email === "string" ? body.email : "");
    const code = typeof body.code === "string" ? body.code.replace(/\s/g, "") : "";

    if (!email || !/^\d{6}$/.test(code)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Enter the 6-digit verification code from your email." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const supabase = getAdminClient();
    const { data: record, error } = await supabase
      .from("password_reset_otps")
      .select("id,email,user_id,otp_hash,expires_at,attempts,verified_at")
      .eq("email", email)
      .is("verified_at", null)
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (error || !record) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "That code is invalid or has expired. Request a new code and try again." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    if (new Date(record.expires_at).getTime() <= Date.now() || record.attempts >= MAX_OTP_ATTEMPTS) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "That code is invalid or has expired. Request a new code and try again." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const expectedHash = hashValue(code);
    if (expectedHash !== record.otp_hash) {
      await supabase
        .from("password_reset_otps")
        .update({ attempts: record.attempts + 1 })
        .eq("id", record.id);

      return NextResponse.json({ error: "That code is invalid or has expired. Request a new code and try again." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const resetToken = createResetToken();
    const { error: updateError } = await supabase
      .from("password_reset_otps")
      .update({
        verified_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        reset_token_hash: hashValue(resetToken),
        reset_token_expires_at: expiresAt(RESET_TOKEN_EXPIRY_MINUTES),
      })
      .eq("id", record.id)
      .is("verified_at", null);

    if (updateError) throw updateError;

    const response = NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
    response.cookies.set(COOKIE_NAME, resetToken, {
      httpOnly: true,
      sameSite: "lax",
      secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
      path: "/",
      maxAge: RESET_TOKEN_EXPIRY_MINUTES * 60,
    });
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Password reset verification failed", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "We could not verify that code. Please request a new one." }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// Issue #6: customer + staff username/email login without email disclosure.
// The resolved email, password and Supabase service role key NEVER appear
// in the response. This endpoint issues the same SSR auth cookies that
// the existing @supabase/ssr browser client understands.
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { consumeAuthQuota, isSameOriginJsonPost, readSmallJson } from "@/lib/auth/username-security";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const BAD_LOGIN = "Invalid username/email or password.";
function reply(error: string, status: number) {
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error }, {
    status,
    headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" },
  });
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  if (!isSameOriginJsonPost(request)) return reply("Invalid request.", 403);
  const body = await readSmallJson(request);
  if (!body) return reply("Invalid request.", 400);
  const identifier = typeof body.identifier === "string" ? body.identifier.trim() : "";
  const password = typeof body.password === "string" ? body.password : "";
  if (identifier.length < 3 || identifier.length > 254 || !password || password.length > 1024) {
    return reply(BAD_LOGIN, 401);
  }
  const isEmail = identifier.includes("@");
  if (!isEmail && !/^[A-Za-z0-9_.]{3,20}$/.test(identifier)) return reply(BAD_LOGIN, 401);

  try {
    const admin = createAdminClient();
    const quota = await consumeAuthQuota(admin, request, "login");
    if (quota.unavailable) return reply("Sign-in service is temporarily unavailable.", 503);
    if (!quota.allowed) return reply("Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.", 429);

    let email: string | null = isEmail ? identifier : null;
    if (!isEmail) {
      // Resolve both customer and STAFF usernames privately. The legacy
      // email_for_username RPC is customer-oriented; it does not reliably
      // cover staff_profiles usernames. Never send any resolved email to
      // the browser. Always verify the password with Supabase Auth below.
      // Escape LIKE wildcards (especially underscores, valid in usernames)
      // and still compare exact normalized usernames after the query.
      const escapedUsername = identifier.replace(/[\\%_]/g, "\\$&");
      const [customerLookup, staffLookup] = await Promise.all([
        admin.rpc("email_for_username", { lookup_username: identifier }),
        admin.from("staff_profiles")
          .select("id, username")
          .ilike("username", escapedUsername)
          .limit(20),
      ]);

      if (customerLookup.error || staffLookup.error) {
        console.error("Issue #6 username lookup unavailable", {
          customer: customerLookup.error?.code ?? null,
          staff: staffLookup.error?.code ?? null,
        });
        return reply("Sign-in service is temporarily unavailable.", 503);
      }

      const customerEmail = typeof customerLookup.data === "string" &&
        customerLookup.data.includes("@") ? customerLookup.data : null;
      const exactStaffMatches = (staffLookup.data ?? []).filter(
        (row) => typeof row.username === "string" &&
          row.username.toLowerCase() === identifier.toLowerCase(),
      );
      if (exactStaffMatches.length > 1) {
        // A database missing a case-insensitive unique index may contain
        // duplicate staff usernames. Never choose an arbitrary account.
        return reply(BAD_LOGIN, 401);
      }

      if (exactStaffMatches.length === 1) {
        // staff_profiles.email can legitimately be NULL: staff creation
        // originally stored the email in auth.users only. Read it by the
        // matched, server-side staff UUID, NOT from client input.
        const staffAuth = await admin.auth.admin.getUserById(exactStaffMatches[0].id);
        if (staffAuth.error) {
          console.error("Issue #6 staff auth lookup failed", staffAuth.error.name);
          return reply("Sign-in service is temporarily unavailable.", 503);
        }
        const staffEmail = staffAuth.data.user?.email ?? null;
        if (!staffEmail) return reply(BAD_LOGIN, 401);

        // If the same username belongs to different customer and staff
        // accounts, reject it instead of selecting the wrong identity.
        // Both can still use their email addresses to sign in.
        if (customerEmail && customerEmail.toLowerCase() !== staffEmail.toLowerCase()) {
          return reply(BAD_LOGIN, 401);
        }
        email = staffEmail;
      } else {
        email = customerEmail;
      }
    }

    // Perform a password check even for unknown usernames to minimize
    // response-timing differences. This fake address cannot be registered.
    const authEmail = email ?? `${createHash("sha256").update(identifier.toLowerCase()).digest("hex").slice(0, 24)}@invalid.happytails.invalid`;

    const successfulResponse = NextResponse.json({ ok: true, redirectTo: "/account" }, {
      headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" },
    });
    const supabase = createServerClient(
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
      {
        cookies: {
          getAll: () => request.cookies.getAll(),
          // Update the incoming request's cookie state as well as the
          // pending successful response. Supabase SSR may read cookies again
          // later in this *same request* after signInWithPassword(); leaving
          // request.cookies unchanged makes authenticated queries look anon.
          // These cookies reach the browser only if we return success.
          setAll(cookiesToSet) {
            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) => {
              request.cookies.set(name, value);
              successfulResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);
            });
          },
        },
      },
    );
    const { data: login, error: loginError } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
      email: authEmail,
      password,
    });
    if (loginError || !login.user || !email) return reply(BAD_LOGIN, 401);

    // Authentication has already succeeded, so server-only service_role
    // may check this verified user's exact ID. This avoids an RLS/SSR-cookie
    // race during login without weakening role or active-status policy.
    // NEVER accept a role, status, or account ID from the request body.
    const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await admin
      .from("profiles").select("role").eq("id", login.user.id).maybeSingle();
    if (profileError || !profile || typeof profile.role !== "string") {
      console.error("Issue #6 login: verified user has unreadable/missing role profile", profileError?.code ?? "not_found");
      return reply("Account access could not be verified. Please contact support.", 403);
    }
    const isStaff = profile.role === "admin" || profile.role === "superadmin";
    // Supabase's typed query parser requires literal select strings. A
    // conditional select such as isStaff ? "status" : "status, username"
    // produces a ParserError instead of a typed row at build time.
    // Query the role's authoritative table explicitly (Issue #5 policy).
    const accountResult = isStaff
      ? await admin.from("staff_profiles")
          .select("status")
          .eq("id", login.user.id)
          .maybeSingle()
      : await admin.from("customers")
          .select("status, username")
          .eq("id", login.user.id)
          .maybeSingle();
    const { data: account, error: statusError } = accountResult;
    if (statusError || !account) {
      console.error("Issue #6 login: verified user's account status row missing/unreadable", {
        role: profile.role,
        code: statusError?.code ?? "not_found",
      });
      return reply("Account access could not be verified. Please contact support.", 403);
    }
    if (account.status !== "active") {
      return reply("This account is inactive or archived. Please contact support.", 403);
    }

    // Preserve Issue #1: on the first confirmed email login, restore a
    // customer's null username from that user's verified Auth metadata.
    // A conditional update never overwrites an existing username.
    if (!isStaff && "username" in account && !account.username) {
      const pending = login.user.user_metadata?.username;
      if (typeof pending === "string" && /^[A-Za-z0-9_.]{3,20}$/.test(pending.trim())) {
        const { error: syncError } = await admin.from("customers")
          .update({ username: pending.trim() })
          .eq("id", login.user.id)
          .is("username", null);
        if (syncError) {
          console.error("Issue #6: username recovery failed", syncError.code ?? "update failed");
          return reply("Account setup could not be completed. Please contact support.", 503);
        }
      }
    }

    // The response body contains only a role-dependent route. No email,
    // tokens, or indication of whether an unknown username exists.
    if (isStaff) {
      // Construct the identical success response with the correct route,
      // preserving the exact auth cookies set by the SSR client.
      const response = NextResponse.json({ ok: true, redirectTo: "/admin" }, {
        headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" },
      });
      successfulResponse.cookies.getAll().forEach((cookie) => response.cookies.set(cookie));
      return response;
    }
    return successfulResponse;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Issue #6 sign-in endpoint failure", error instanceof Error ? error.name : "unknown");
    return reply("Sign-in service is temporarily unavailable.", 503);
  }
}

/**
 * Authenticated users may set only their own username (SEC-001).
 * Issue #5: require an ACTIVE customer row even when using service_role.
 * Supports Supabase SSR cookies or a verified Supabase bearer token.
 */
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { createClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const cookieChanges: Array<(response: NextResponse) => void> = [];

  function respond(payload: Record<string, unknown>, status = 200) {
    const response = NextResponse.json(payload, {
      status,
      headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" },
    });
    for (const apply of cookieChanges) apply(response);
    return response;
  }

  const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  const publicKey =
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY ??
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY;

  if (!supabaseUrl || !publicKey) {
    console.error("set-username: Supabase public configuration is missing");
    return respond({ error: "Server configuration error" }, 500);
  }

  try {
    const authorization = request.headers.get("authorization");
    let authenticatedUserId: string | undefined;

    if (authorization !== null) {
      const bearer = /^Bearer\s+(\S+)$/i.exec(authorization);
      if (!bearer) return respond({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);

      const publicClient = createClient(supabaseUrl, publicKey, {
        auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
      });
      const { data, error } = await publicClient.auth.getUser(bearer[1]);
      if (error || !data.user) return respond({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
      authenticatedUserId = data.user.id;
    } else {
      const cookieClient = createServerClient(supabaseUrl, publicKey, {
        cookies: {
          getAll() {
            return request.cookies.getAll();
          },
          setAll(cookiesToSet) {
            cookieChanges.push((response) => {
              for (const { name, value, options } of cookiesToSet) {
                response.cookies.set(name, value, options);
              }
            });
          },
        },
      });
      const { data, error } = await cookieClient.auth.getUser();
      if (error || !data.user) return respond({ error: "Unauthorized" }, 401);
      authenticatedUserId = data.user.id;

      // Browser cookie auth must be same-origin to prevent CSRF.
      const origin = request.headers.get("origin");
      if (!origin || origin !== new URL(request.url).origin) {
        return respond({ error: "Forbidden origin" }, 403);
      }
    }

    const contentLength = Number(request.headers.get("content-length") ?? 0);
    if (contentLength > 2048) return respond({ error: "Request body too large" }, 413);

    const text = await request.text();
    if (text.length > 2048) return respond({ error: "Request body too large" }, 413);

    let body: unknown;
    try {
      body = JSON.parse(text);
    } catch {
      return respond({ error: "Invalid JSON" }, 400);
    }

    if (!body || typeof body !== "object" || Array.isArray(body)) {
      return respond({ error: "Invalid request body" }, 400);
    }
    const input = body as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (input.userId !== undefined && input.userId !== authenticatedUserId) {
      return respond({ error: "Cannot edit another user's username" }, 403);
    }

    if (typeof input.username !== "string") {
      return respond({ error: "A username is required" }, 400);
    }

    const username = input.username.trim();
    if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{3,30}$/.test(username)) {
      return respond(
        { error: "Username must be 3â€“30 characters and contain only letters, numbers, underscores, periods or hyphens" },
        400
      );
    }

    const serviceRoleKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
    if (!serviceRoleKey) {
      console.error("set-username: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is missing");
      return respond({ error: "Server configuration error" }, 500);
    }

    const admin = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceRoleKey, {
      auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
    });

    // Unlike a regular browser query, service_role bypasses RLS. Check the
    // authenticated customer's status explicitly BEFORE privileged mutation.
    const { data: customer, error: accountError } = await admin
      .from("customers")
      .select("id, status")
      .eq("id", authenticatedUserId)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (accountError || !customer) {
      return respond({ error: "Customer account could not be verified" }, 403);
    }
    if (customer.status !== "active") {
      return respond({ error: "Customer account is not active" }, 403);
    }

    const { data: updated, error: updateError } = await admin
      .from("customers")
      .update({ username })
      .eq("id", authenticatedUserId)
      .eq("status", "active")
      .select("id")
      .maybeSingle();

    if (updateError) {
      if (updateError.code === "23505") {
        return respond({ error: "Username is already taken" }, 409);
      }
      console.error("set-username: database update failed", updateError.code);
      return respond({ error: "Unable to update username" }, 500);
    }

    if (!updated) return respond({ error: "Customer account is no longer active" }, 403);
    return respond({ success: true, userId: authenticatedUserId, username });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("set-username: unexpected error", error);
    return respond({ error: "Unable to update username" }, 500);
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import nodemailer from "nodemailer";
import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { boardingReminderEmail } from "@/lib/email/happytails-boarding-reminder";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const maxDuration = 60;

type Related<T> = T | T[] | null;
type Appointment = { id: string; owner_name: string; customer_id: string | null; scheduled_date: string; pick_up_at: string | null; status: string; service_type: string };
type Pet = { name: string };
type Row = { id: string; status: string; actual_checkout_at: string | null; planned_pet_pickup_at: string | null; appointments: Related<Appointment>; pets: Related<Pet> };
const first = <T,>(value: Related<T>): T | null => Array.isArray(value) ? (value[0] ?? null) : value;
const manilaDate = (date: Date): string => {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit" }).formatToParts(date);
  const get = (type: string) => parts.find(x => x.type === type)?.value ?? "";
  return `${get("year")}-${get("month")}-${get("day")}`;
};
const nextDay = (date: string) => {
  const d = new Date(`${date}T00:00:00Z`);
  d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 1);
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
};

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  if (!process.env.CRON_SECRET || request.headers.get("authorization") !== `Bearer ${process.env.CRON_SECRET}`) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (!process.env.GMAIL_SMTP_USER || !process.env.GMAIL_SMTP_APP_PASSWORD) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Google SMTP is not configured" }, { status: 503 });
  }
  const admin = createAdminClient();
  const tomorrow = nextDay(manilaDate(new Date()));
  const mailer = nodemailer.createTransport({
    host: "smtp.gmail.com", port: 465, secure: true,
    auth: { user: process.env.GMAIL_SMTP_USER, pass: process.env.GMAIL_SMTP_APP_PASSWORD },
    connectionTimeout: 10000, greetingTimeout: 10000, socketTimeout: 15000,
  });
  let sent = 0, skipped = 0, failed = 0, checked = 0;
  try {
    // Pagination avoids Supabase's default 1000-row cap. Filter on the effective
    // per-pet pickup date after the query: it may override the parent booking.
    for (let offset = 0; ; offset += 500) {
      const { data, error } = await admin.from("appointment_pets")
        .select("id,status,actual_checkout_at,planned_pet_pickup_at,appointments!inner(id,owner_name,customer_id,scheduled_date,pick_up_at,status,service_type),pets(name)")
        .eq("appointments.service_type", "boarding")
        .eq("appointments.status", "checked_in")
        .neq("status", "completed")
        .is("actual_checkout_at", null)
        .order("id", { ascending: true })
        .range(offset, offset + 499);
      if (error) throw error;
      const rows = (data ?? []) as unknown as Row[];
      for (const row of rows) {
        checked++;
        const booking = first(row.appointments);
        const pet = first(row.pets);
        const pickup = row.planned_pet_pickup_at || booking?.pick_up_at;
        if (!booking || !pickup || !pet || !booking.customer_id || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(pickup)) || manilaDate(new Date(pickup)) !== tomorrow) {
          skipped++; continue;
        }
        // The database primary key ensures simultaneous runs cannot claim the same
        // pet and exact pickup timestamp twice. A failed send remains visible for review.
        const { error: claimError } = await admin.from("boarding_pickup_email_reminders")
          .insert({ appointment_pet_id: row.id, pickup_at: pickup, status: "claimed" });
        if (claimError) {
          if (claimError.code === "23505") { skipped++; continue; }
          throw claimError;
        }
        try {
          const { data: account, error: accountError } = await admin.auth.admin.getUserById(booking.customer_id);
          if (accountError || !account.user?.email) {
            await admin.from("boarding_pickup_email_reminders").update({ status: "no_email", error_message: "Registered customer email unavailable" }).eq("appointment_pet_id", row.id).eq("pickup_at", pickup);
            skipped++; continue;
          }
          const message = boardingReminderEmail({ appointmentId: booking.id, customerName: booking.owner_name, petName: pet.name, pickupAt: pickup, scheduledDate: booking.scheduled_date });
          const result = await mailer.sendMail({
            from: { name: process.env.HAPPYTAILS_EMAIL_FROM_NAME || "HappyTails Pet Grooming CafÃ©", address: process.env.GMAIL_SMTP_USER },
            to: account.user.email, ...message,
          });
          if (!result.accepted.includes(account.user.email)) throw new Error("SMTP did not accept the recipient");
          const { error: logError } = await admin.from("boarding_pickup_email_reminders")
            .update({ status: "sent", sent_at: new Date().toISOString(), error_message: null })
            .eq("appointment_pet_id", row.id).eq("pickup_at", pickup);
          if (logError) console.error("Reminder delivered, but recording delivery failed", logError);
          sent++;
        } catch (e) {
          failed++;
          const errorMessage = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unknown email failure";
          await admin.from("boarding_pickup_email_reminders")
            .update({ status: "failed", error_message: errorMessage.slice(0, 500) })
            .eq("appointment_pet_id", row.id).eq("pickup_at", pickup);
          console.error("Boarding pickup reminder failed", row.id, errorMessage);
        }
      }
      if (rows.length < 500) break;
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, pickupDate: tomorrow, checked, sent, skipped, failed });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Boarding pickup reminders failed", e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unable to complete reminders", checked, sent, failed }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/server";
import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
const BUCKET = "pet-profile-photos";
const MAX_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
const uuid = /^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[1-8][a-f0-9]{3}-[89ab][a-f0-9]{3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$/i;

function isJpeg(buffer: Uint8Array) { return buffer.length > 4 && buffer[0] === 0xff && buffer[1] === 0xd8 && buffer[2] === 0xff; }
function fail(error: string, status: number) { return NextResponse.json({ error }, { status }); }

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const petId = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get("petId") || "";
    if (!uuid.test(petId)) return fail("Invalid pet identifier.", 400);
    const auth = await createClient();
    const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await auth.auth.getUser();
    if (authError || !user) return fail("Sign in to change a pet photo.", 401);
    const admin = createAdminClient();
    const { data: pet, error: petError } = await admin.from("pets").select("id,customer_id,photo_url").eq("id", petId).maybeSingle();
    if (petError) return fail("Could not verify the pet record.", 500);
    if (!pet) return fail("Pet not found.", 404);
    if (pet.customer_id !== user.id) {
      const { data: roleRow, error: roleError } = await admin.from("profiles").select("role").eq("id", user.id).maybeSingle();
      if (roleError || !["admin", "superadmin"].includes(roleRow?.role ?? "")) return fail("You cannot edit this pet's photo.", 403);
    }
    const data = await request.formData();
    const file = data.get("photo");
    if (!(file instanceof File)) return fail("Choose a photo.", 400);
    if (file.type !== "image/jpeg" || file.size < 100 || file.size > MAX_BYTES) return fail("The cropped photo must be a JPEG under 2 MB.", 400);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer());
    if (!isJpeg(bytes)) return fail("The image file is invalid.", 400);
    const path = `${petId}/${randomUUID()}.jpg`;
    const { error: uploadError } = await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).upload(path, bytes, { contentType: "image/jpeg", upsert: false, cacheControl: "3600" });
    if (uploadError) return fail(`Unable to upload photo: ${uploadError.message}`, 500);
    const { data: publicLink } = admin.storage.from(BUCKET).getPublicUrl(path);
    const url = publicLink.publicUrl;
    const { data: updated, error: updateError } = await admin.from("pets").update({ photo_url: url }).eq("id", petId).select("photo_url").single();
    if (updateError || !updated) {
      await admin.storage.from(BUCKET).remove([path]);
      return fail("Unable to save the new profile picture. Check the database migration.", 500);
    }
    // Only remove files that clearly belong to this pet inside this bucket.
    const oldUrl = String(pet.photo_url ?? "");
    const needle = `/storage/v1/object/public/${BUCKET}/${petId}/`;
    if (oldUrl.includes(needle)) {
      const oldPath = oldUrl.split(needle)[1]?.split("?")[0];
      if (oldPath && /^[a-f0-9-]{36}\.jpg$/i.test(oldPath)) {
        void admin.storage.from(BUCKET).remove([`${petId}/${oldPath}`]);
      }
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ url });
  } catch {
    return fail("Could not upload this pet photo. Please try again.", 500);
  }
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\app\auth\callback\route.ts =====

import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

// Exact paths only: never redirect to user-supplied `next` URLs.
export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const callbackUrl = new URL(request.url);
  const code = callbackUrl.searchParams.get("code");
  const redirect = (path: string) => NextResponse.redirect(new URL(path, request.url));
  if (!code || callbackUrl.searchParams.has("error")) {
    return redirect("/sign-in?google_error=oauth");
  }

  // Capture Supabase's PKCE cookies on the same response that exchanges the
  // authorization code. These cookies must survive the final redirect.
  let response = redirect("/sign-in?google_error=oauth");
  const supabase = createServerClient(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll: () => request.cookies.getAll(),
        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) => {
            request.cookies.set(name, value);
            response.cookies.set(name, value, options);
          });
        },
      },
    },
  );

  const setRedirect = (path: string) => {
    const next = redirect(path);
    response.cookies.getAll().forEach(({ name, value, ...options }) =>
      next.cookies.set(name, value, options));
    next.headers.set("Cache-Control", "no-store");
    response = next;
  };

  try {
    const { error: exchangeError } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);
    if (exchangeError) return response;

    const { data: auth, error: userError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
    if (userError || !auth.user) return response;

    // Use server-side DB reads to match the password login's role and active
    // status policy. Do not trust email, name, or role fields from Google.
    const admin = createAdminClient();
    const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await admin
      .from("profiles").select("role").eq("id", auth.user.id).maybeSingle();
    if (profileError || !profile || typeof profile.role !== "string") {
      await supabase.auth.signOut();
      setRedirect("/sign-in?google_error=setup");
      return response;
    }
    const isStaff = profile.role === "admin" || profile.role === "superadmin";
    const table = isStaff ? "staff_profiles" : "customers";
    const { data: account, error: accountError } = await admin.from(table)
      .select("status").eq("id", auth.user.id).maybeSingle();
    if (accountError || !account) {
      await supabase.auth.signOut();
      setRedirect("/sign-in?google_error=setup");
      return response;
    }
    if (account.status !== "active") {
      await supabase.auth.signOut();
      setRedirect("/sign-in?deactivated=1");
      return response;
    }
    setRedirect(isStaff ? "/admin" : "/account");
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Google OAuth callback failed", error instanceof Error ? error.name : "unknown");
    await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => undefined);
    setRedirect("/sign-in?google_error=oauth");
    return response;
  }
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";

type ConfirmationState = "checking" | "confirmed" | "pending" | "error";

/** Supabase processes its ConfirmationURL first and then redirects here.
 * We verify the resulting Auth user state instead of treating a redirect as proof.
 */
export default function EmailChangePage() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<ConfirmationState>("checking");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("Checking your email confirmationâ€¦");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    const supabase = createClient();

    const inspect = async () => {
      const search = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const fragment = new URLSearchParams(window.location.hash.slice(1));
      const errorMessage = search.get("error_description") || fragment.get("error_description");
      if (errorMessage || search.has("error") || fragment.has("error")) {
        if (active) {
          setState("error");
          setMessage(errorMessage || "The confirmation link has expired or is invalid. Request a new email change from Account Management.");
        }
        return;
      }

      try {
        // Supabase's browser client recovers the session returned in the
        // confirmation URL where applicable; getUser then retrieves the
        // authoritative, latest email from Supabase Auth.
        const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
        if (!active) return;
        if (error || !user) {
          setState("pending");
          setMessage("Your link was opened, but we cannot verify the updated email in this browser. Sign in again and check Account Management. If secure email change is enabled, approve the links sent to both email addresses.");
          return;
        }
        setEmail(user.email || "");
        const pendingEmail = user.new_email;
        if (pendingEmail && pendingEmail.toLowerCase() !== (user.email || "").toLowerCase()) {
          setState("pending");
          setMessage(`Email change still pending for ${pendingEmail}. If Secure Email Change is enabled, confirm the emails sent to both your old and new addresses.`);
          return;
        }
        // No pending email doesn't prove this link just made a change. A
        // signed-in user may have landed here without any confirmation.
        setState("confirmed");
        setMessage("Your currently verified account email is shown below. Check that it matches the new address you requested.");
      } catch {
        if (active) {
          setState("error");
          setMessage("Unable to check your account at this time. Please sign in and verify the email shown in Account Management.");
        }
      }
    };
    void inspect();
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, []);

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#FDF1F7] px-4 py-14 text-[#14283e]">
      <section className="mx-auto max-w-lg rounded-2xl border border-pink-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm sm:p-9">
        <p className="text-sm font-bold text-[#F53D93]">HappyTails Pet Grooming CafÃ©</p>
        <h1 className="mt-3 text-2xl font-bold">Email Address Confirmation</h1>
        <p role="status" className={`mt-5 rounded-xl p-4 text-sm leading-6 ${state === "error" ? "bg-red-50 text-red-700" : state === "confirmed" ? "bg-green-50 text-green-800" : "bg-pink-50 text-[#14283e]"}`}>
          {message}
        </p>
        {email && <p className="mt-4 break-all text-sm"><strong>Current account email:</strong> {email}</p>}
        <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
          <Link href="/admin/profile" className="rounded-full bg-[#F53D93] px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white">Account Management</Link>
          <Link href="/sign-in" className="rounded-full border border-pink-200 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold">Sign in</Link>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

// Serves the existing, official 480Ã—480 HappyTails logo as a search/favicon icon.
// The source image remains public/images/logo.png; no duplicate image assets.
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { join } from "node:path";

export const size = { width: 480, height: 480 };
export const contentType = "image/png";

export default async function Icon(): Promise<Response> {
  const logo = await readFile(join(process.cwd(), "public", "images", "logo.png"));
  return new Response(new Uint8Array(logo), {
    headers: { "Content-Type": contentType },
  });
}

import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { IS_PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT, SITE_URL } from "@/lib/seo";
import "./globals.css";

// Load the existing typefaces in the browser rather than through next/font/google.
// Some Google Fonts responses use extensionless URLs that Next.js 16 Turbopack
// cannot resolve during the production build.
// Retain the same CSS variable names consumed by globals.css/Tailwind.
const fontVariables = {
  "--font-heading": '"Fredoka"',
  "--font-body": '"Nunito"',
} as React.CSSProperties;

const siteName = "Happy Tails Pet Grooming Cafe";
const siteDescription =
  "Discover dog and cat grooming, pet boarding, spa services, and pet products at Happy Tails Pet Grooming Cafe. Explore our services and book online.";

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  metadataBase: new URL(SITE_URL),
  applicationName: siteName,
  title: {
    default: "Happy Tails Pet Grooming Cafe | Grooming & Pet Boarding",
    template: `%s | ${siteName}`,
  },
  description: siteDescription,
  alternates: { canonical: "/" },
  openGraph: {
    type: "website",
    locale: "en_PH",
    siteName,
    title: "Happy Tails Pet Grooming Cafe | Grooming & Pet Boarding",
    description: siteDescription,
    url: "/",
    images: [{ url: "/images/hero-bg.png", alt: siteName }],
  },
  twitter: {
    card: "summary_large_image",
    title: "Happy Tails Pet Grooming Cafe | Grooming & Pet Boarding",
    description: siteDescription,
    images: ["/images/hero-bg.png"],
  },
  robots: IS_PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT
    ? { index: false, follow: false }
    : {
        index: true,
        follow: true,
        googleBot: {
          index: true,
          follow: true,
          "max-image-preview": "large",
        },
      },
  ...(process.env.GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION
    ? { verification: { google: process.env.GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION } }
    : {}),
};

export default function RootLayout({
  children,
}: Readonly<{
  children: React.ReactNode;
}>) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" className="h-full antialiased" style={fontVariables}>
      <head>
        <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
        <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossOrigin="anonymous" />
        <link
          rel="stylesheet"
          href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fredoka:wght@500;600;700&family=Nunito:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap"
        />
      </head>
      {/* suppressHydrationWarning here specifically: browser extensions
          like Grammarly inject attributes (data-gr-ext-installed, etc.)
          into <body> after the page loads, which React then flags as a
          hydration mismatch even though nothing in this app caused it.
          This only suppresses warnings on this one element â€” it won't
          hide a real mismatch anywhere else in the tree. */}
      <body className="min-h-full flex flex-col font-body" suppressHydrationWarning>{children}</body>
    </html>
  );
}

// Show the latest published text and service prices on every new page request.
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export default async function Home() {
  const db = await createClient();
  const [settingsResult, heroResult, productsResult, galleryPhotos, serviceResult, textResult, branchResult, packageResult, sizeResult] = await Promise.all([
    db.from('site_settings').select('*'),
    db.from('hero_slides').select('*').eq('active', true).order('sort_order', { ascending: true }),
    db.from('products').select('*').eq('status', 'active').order('product_code'),
    fetchActiveGalleryPhotos(),
    db.from('website_services').select('*').eq('published', true).order('sort_order', { ascending: true }),
    db.from('website_text').select('key,value'),
    db.from('website_branches').select('*').eq('published', true).order('sort_order', { ascending: true }).order('created_at', { ascending: true }),
    db.from('packages').select('id,service_type,name,sort_order,is_active')
      .in('service_type', ['dog_grooming', 'cat_grooming', 'boarding']).eq('is_active', true).order('sort_order'),
    db.from('pet_sizes').select('id,service_type,label,weight_range,sort_order,is_active')
      .in('service_type', ['dog_grooming', 'cat_grooming']).order('sort_order'),
  ]);
  const packages = (packageResult.data ?? []) as Package[];
  const packageIds = packages.map(pkg => pkg.id);
  const [pricingResult, inclusionResult] = packageResult.error || !packageIds.length
    ? [null, null]
    : await Promise.all([
      db.from('package_pricing').select('id,package_id,size_id,size_label,size_detail,price,is_per_night,nights').in('package_id', packageIds),
      db.from('package_inclusions').select('id,package_id,label,sort_order').in('package_id', packageIds).order('sort_order'),
    ]);
  if (packageResult.error || sizeResult.error || pricingResult?.error || inclusionResult?.error) {
    console.error('[HappyTails public pricing] Could not load active service rates:',
      packageResult.error?.message ?? sizeResult.error?.message ?? pricingResult?.error?.message ?? inclusionResult?.error?.message);
  }
  if (textResult.error) console.error('[HappyTails website text] Failed to read published content:', textResult.error.message);
  const pricingCatalog: PublicPricingCatalog = {
    packages, pricing: (pricingResult?.data ?? []) as PackagePricing[],
    sizes: (sizeResult.data ?? []) as PetSize[], inclusions: (inclusionResult?.data ?? []) as PackageInclusion[],
    loaded: !packageResult.error && !sizeResult.error &&
      (packageIds.length === 0 || (!pricingResult?.error && !inclusionResult?.error)),
  };
  const settings = (settingsResult.data ?? []) as SiteSetting[];
  const get = (key: string) => settings.find(s => s.key === key);
  const text = Object.fromEntries((textResult.data ?? []).map(item => [item.key, item.value])) as Record<string, string>;
  const services = (serviceResult.data ?? []) as WebsiteService[];
  const branches = (branchResult.data ?? []) as WebsiteBranch[];
  const imageDefaults: Record<string, string | undefined> = {
    'pet-grooming': get('services_grooming_image')?.image_url ?? undefined,
    'pet-boarding': get('services_boarding_image')?.image_url ?? undefined,
    'pet-spa': get('services_spa_image')?.image_url ?? undefined,
  };
  const shownServices = services.map(s => ({ ...s, image_url: s.image_url ?? imageDefaults[s.slug] ?? null }));
  return (
    <PoliciesModalProvider>
      <Navbar logoUrl={get('site_logo')?.image_url} />
      <main>
        <Hero slides={(heroResult.data ?? []) as HeroSlide[]} logoUrl={get('site_logo')?.image_url} />
        <HomepageSeo />
        {shownServices.length > 0 && <DynamicServices services={shownServices} heading={copy('services_heading', text)} subheading={copy('services_subheading', text)} />}
        <Gallery photos={galleryPhotos} heading={copy('gallery_heading', text)} subheading={copy('gallery_subheading', text)} />
        <GroomingBanner description={copy('grooming_banner_description', text)} backgroundUrl={get('grooming_banner_background')?.image_url} width={get('grooming_banner_background')?.image_width} height={get('grooming_banner_background')?.image_height} />
        <LandingTextSection heading={copy('grooming_heading', text)} subheading={copy('grooming_subheading', text)}><GroomingPricing catalog={pricingCatalog} basicImage={get('grooming_basic_image')?.image_url} diamondImage={get('grooming_diamond_image')?.image_url} premiumImage={get('grooming_premium_image')?.image_url} /></LandingTextSection>
        <BoardingBanner description={copy('boarding_banner_description', text)} backgroundUrl={get('boarding_banner_background')?.image_url} width={get('boarding_banner_background')?.image_width} height={get('boarding_banner_background')?.image_height} />
        <LandingTextSection heading={copy('boarding_heading', text)} subheading={copy('boarding_subheading', text)}><BoardingPricing catalog={pricingCatalog} smallKennelImage={get('boarding_small_kennel_image')?.image_url} bigKennelImage={get('boarding_big_kennel_image')?.image_url} /></LandingTextSection>
        <SpaBanner description={copy('spa_banner_description', text)} backgroundUrl={get('spa_banner_background')?.image_url} width={get('spa_banner_background')?.image_width} height={get('spa_banner_background')?.image_height} />
        <SpaBenefits />
        <LandingTextSection tone="pink" heading={copy('products_heading', text)} subheading={copy('products_subheading', text)}><ProductsCarousel products={(productsResult.data ?? []) as Product[]} /></LandingTextSection>
        <BranchesCarousel branches={branches} />
        <DynamicAbout backgroundUrl={get('about_us_background')?.image_url} heading={copy('about_heading', text)} description={copy('about_description', text)} />
        <FAQSection items={parseFAQs(text[FAQ_TEXT_KEY])} />
      </main>
      <Footer />
      <PoliciesModal />
    </PoliciesModalProvider>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\app\robots.ts =====

import type { MetadataRoute } from "next";
import { IS_PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT, SITE_URL } from "@/lib/seo";

export default function robots(): MetadataRoute.Robots {
  if (IS_PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT) {
    return { rules: { userAgent: "*", disallow: "/" } };
  }

  return {
    rules: {
      userAgent: "*",
      allow: "/",
      disallow: [
        "/admin",
        "/account",
        "/api",
        "/auth",
        "/sign-in",
        "/sign-up",
        "/forgot-password",
        "/verify-email",
      ],
    },
    sitemap: `${SITE_URL}/sitemap.xml`,
  };
}

}
function phNow() {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23" }).formatToParts(new Date());
  const read = (key: string) => parts.find(p => p.type === key)?.value ?? "00";
  return { date: `${read("year")}-${read("month")}-${read("day")}`, time: `${read("hour")}:${read("minute")}` };
}
function localTime(timestamp: string) {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23" }).format(new Date(timestamp));
}
function formatSchedule(date: string, time: string) {
  return new Date(`${date}T${time}:00+08:00`).toLocaleString("en-PH", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" });
}
export default function AdminRescheduleModal({ appointment, onClose, onSaved }: {
  appointment: AppointmentRow;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSaved: () => Promise<void> | void;

    ? localTime(appointment.drop_off_at)
    : appointment.scheduled_time?.slice(0, 5) ?? "09:00";

  const [slotsError, setSlotsError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [time, setTime] = useState(previousTime);
  const [now, setNow] = useState(phNow);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [delivery, setDelivery] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {

  }, []);

    };

  }, [saving, onClose]);

      const blocked: Record<string, string> = {};

          blocked[item.day] = item.capacity === 0 ? "No groomers available" : "Fully booked";
        }
      }

      setBlockedDates(blocked);
    }).then(undefined, () => {

});
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [grooming, month, appointment.scheduled_date]);

        if (!active) return;

        const availability: Record<string, number> = {};
        for (const item of (data ?? []) as { slot_time: string; remaining: number }[]) {
          availability[item.slot_time.slice(0, 5)] = Math.max(0, Number(item.remaining) || 0);

        setSlotAvailability(availability);

  }

  if (active) {

  }

    && date >= now.date && (date > now.date || time > now.time)
    && time >= "09:00" && time <= maxTime
    && calendarReady && !closure && !blockedDates[date] && availableStart && !slotsLoading && !slotsError
    && (date !== appointment.scheduled_date || time !== previousTime)
    && reason.trim().length >= 5 && reason.trim().length <= 500;
  async function submit() {
    if (!valid || saving) return;

      const closed = await closures.verifyOpen(date);
      if (closed) throw new Error(closed);

        method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ appointmentId: appointment.id, date, time, reason: reason.trim() }),
      });
      const payload: { error?: string; delivery?: string } = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.error ?? "Unable to reschedule the appointment.");

      try { await onSaved(); } catch { /* Saved successfully; realtime refresh can retry. */ }
    } catch (cause) {
      setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Unable to reschedule the appointment.");
    } finally { setSaving(false); }

          <p>{delivery === "sent" ? "The customer notification email was sent." : delivery === "no_customer" ? "No registered customer account is linked to this booking. "use client";
// Search + Filter panel, cleaned up from the original version, which
// had three real problems: no indication filters were active once the
// panel closed, no way to clear them except resetting each dropdown by
// hand, and the panel had no backdrop or click-outside handling so it
// could be left open while interacting with the page behind it. Fixed:
// active filters now show as removable chips right under the search
// row, a "Clear all" appears only when something's actually filtered,
// and the panel closes on an outside click like a normal dropdown.
import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import type { AppointmentStatus, AppointmentServiceType } from "@/lib/types/appointments";

export type FilterState = {
  search: string;
  status: AppointmentStatus | "all";
  service: AppointmentServiceType | "all";
  scope: "today" | "all";
};

const statusOptions: AppointmentStatus[] = ["pending", "confirmed", "checked_in", "completed", "cancelled"];
const serviceOptions: { value: AppointmentServiceType; label: string }[] = [
  { value: "dog_grooming", label: "Dog Grooming" },
  { value: "cat_grooming", label: "Cat Grooming" },
  { value: "boarding", label: "Boarding" },
  { value: "ala_carte", label: "Ala Carte" },
];

const emptyFilters: Pick<FilterState, "status" | "service"> = { status: "all", service: "all" };

export default function AppointmentFilters({
  filters,
  onChange,
}: {
  filters: FilterState;
  onChange: (next: FilterState) => void;
}) {
  const [panelOpen, setPanelOpen] = useState(false);
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!panelOpen) return;
    function handleClickOutside(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (panelRef.current && !panelRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setPanelOpen(false);
    }
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
  }, [panelOpen]);

  const activeCount = (filters.status !== "all" ? 1 : 0) + (filters.service !== "all" ? 1 : 0);

  function clearAll() {
    onChange({ ...filters, ...emptyFilters });
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className="flex-1 relative">
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-zinc-400">
            <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7" />
            <path d="M21 21l-4-4" strokeLinecap="round" />
          </svg>
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search by pet, owner, or appointment ID"
            value={filters.search}
            onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...filters, search: e.target.value })}
            className="w-full rounded-full border border-pink-200 bg-white pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-pink"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex rounded-full border border-pink-200 bg-white p-1 shrink-0">
          <button
            onClick={() => onChange({ ...filters, scope: "today" })}
            className={`px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${filters.scope === "today" ? "bg-brand-pink text-white" : "text-zinc-600 hover:text-brand-pink"}`}
          >
            Today
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => onChange({ ...filters, scope: "all" })}
            className={`px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition-colors ${filters.scope === "all" ? "bg-brand-pink text-white" : "text-zinc-600 hover:text-brand-pink"}`}
          >
            All History
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="relative shrink-0" ref={panelRef}>
          <button
            onClick={() => setPanelOpen((v) => !v)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
              activeCount > 0 ? "border-brand-pink bg-brand-tint text-brand-pink" : "border-pink-200 bg-white text-zinc-700 hover:border-brand-pink"
            }`}
          >
            Filter
            {activeCount > 0 && (
              <span className="bg-brand-pink text-white text-[10px] font-bold w-4 h-4 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">{activeCount}</span>
            )}
            <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" className={`transition-transform ${panelOpen ? "rotate-180" : ""}`}>
              <path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
            </svg>
          </button>

          {panelOpen && (
            <div className="absolute right-0 top-full mt-2 w-72 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-pink-100 p-5 z-20">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-brand-pink text-sm tracking-wide">FILTER</h3>
                <button onClick={() => setPanelOpen(false)} aria-label="Close filter panel" className="text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600">
                  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5">
                    <path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" strokeLinecap="round" />
                  </svg>
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-4">
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500">STATUS</label>
                <select
                  value={filters.status}
                  onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...filters, status: e.target.value as FilterState["status"] })}
                  className="mt-1.5 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-700 text-sm px-3 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-pink"
                >
                  <option value="all">All Statuses</option>
                  {statusOptions.map((s) => <option key={s} value={s}>{s.replace("_", " ")}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-4">
                <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500">SERVICE</label>
                <select
                  value={filters.service}
                  onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...filters, service: e.target.value as FilterState["service"] })}
                  className="mt-1.5 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-700 text-sm px-3 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-pink"
                >
                  <option value="all">All Services</option>
                  {serviceOptions.map((s) => <option key={s.value} value={s.value}>{s.label}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>

              {activeCount > 0 && (
                <button onClick={clearAll} className="mt-4 w-full text-center text-xs font-semibold text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 py-1.5">
                  Clear all filters
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {activeCount > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {filters.status !== "all" && (
            <FilterChip label={`Status: ${filters.status.replace("_", " ")}`} onRemove={() => onChange({ ...filters, status: "all" })} />
          )}
          {filters.service !== "all" && (
            <FilterChip
              label={`Service: ${serviceOptions.find((s) => s.value === filters.service)?.label}`}
              onRemove={() => onChange({ ...filters, service: "all" })}
            />
          )}
          <button onClick={clearAll} className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-400 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors">
            Clear all
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function FilterChip({ label, onRemove }: { label: string; onRemove: () => void }) {
  return (
    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-brand-tint text-brand-pink text-xs font-semibold pl-3 pr-2 py-1.5 rounded-full capitalize">
      {label}
      <button onClick={onRemove} aria-label={`Remove ${label} filter`} className="hover:text-brand-pink-dark">
        <svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" strokeLinecap="round" /></svg>
      </button>
    </span>
  );
}

"use client";
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import StatCard from "@/components/admin/StatCard";
import { fetchTodaysAppointmentCount, fetchTodaysTransactionTotal } from "@/lib/supabase/appointment-management";
import { fetchAllPets } from "@/lib/supabase/appointments";

// Refetches on every `refreshKey` change â€” the parent bumps this key
// whenever the realtime subscription fires, so these numbers stay live
// too, not just the table.
export default function AppointmentStats({ refreshKey }: { refreshKey: number }) {
  const [todaysCount, setTodaysCount] = useState(0);
  const [totalPets, setTotalPets] = useState(0);
  const [todaysTotal, setTodaysTotal] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchTodaysAppointmentCount().then((r) => setTodaysCount(r.count));
    fetchAllPets().then((r) => setTotalPets(r.pets.length));
    fetchTodaysTransactionTotal().then((r) => setTodaysTotal(r.total));
  }, [refreshKey]);

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
      <StatCard
        value={String(todaysCount)}
        label="Today's Appointment"
        icon={
          <svg width="36" height="36" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#F53D93" strokeWidth="1.8">
            <rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="16" rx="2" />
            <path d="M3 9h18M8 3v4M16 3v4" strokeLinecap="round" />
          </svg>
        }
      />
      <StatCard
        value={String(totalPets)}
        label="Total Pets Registered"
        icon={
          <svg width="36" height="36" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#84cc16" strokeWidth="1.8">
            <path d="M8 9a2 2 0 1 0 0-4 2 2 0 0 0 0 4zM16 9a2 2 0 1 0 0-4 2 2 0 0 0 0 4zM5 13a2 2 0 1 0 0-4 2 2 0 0 0 0 4zM19 13a2 2 0 1 0 0-4 2 2 0 0 0 0 4zM12 21c-3 0-6-1.5-6-4.5S9 13 12 13s6 .5 6 3.5S15 21 12 21z" />
          </svg>
        }
      />
      <StatCard
        value={`â‚±${todaysTotal.toLocaleString()}`}
        label="Total Transaction Today"
        icon={
          <svg width="36" height="36" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#F59E0B" strokeWidth="1.8">
            <path d="M12 2v20M17 6H9.5a2.5 2.5 0 0 0 0 5h5a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0 5H6" strokeLinecap="round" />
          </svg>
        }
      />

}

import type { Kennel } from "@/lib/types/pet-services";
import { kennelDisplayName } from "@/lib/types/pet-services";
import { checkInAppointment, fetchAvailableKennels, fetchGroomingSessions } from "@/lib/supabase/service-sessions";

type GroomerOption = { id: string; name: string };
type AvailabilityRow = { appointment_pet_id: string; groomer_id: string; groomer_name: string };

export default function CheckInAssignmentModal({ appointment, onClose, onSuccess }: {
  appointment: AppointmentRow; onClose: () => void; onSuccess: () => void;
}) {
  const boarding = appointment.service_type === "boarding";
  const [kennels, setKennels] = useState<Kennel[]>([]);
  const [reserved, setReserved] = useState<Record<string,string>>({});
  const [available, setAvailable] = useState<Record<string, GroomerOption[]>>({});
  const [busyGroomers, setBusyGroomers] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<Record<string, string>>(() => Object.fromEntries(
    appointment.pets.filter(p => !boarding && !!p.groomerId).map(p => [p.appointmentPetId, p.groomerId as string])
  ));
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true); setError(null);
    if (boarding) {
      const db = createClient();
      const [availableRows, bookedRows, activeRows] = await Promise.all([
        fetchAvailableKennels(),
        db.from("appointment_pets").select("id,kennel_id").eq("appointment_id", appointment.id),
        db.from("kennels").select("*").eq("is_active", true).order("number"),
      ]);
      if (availableRows.error || bookedRows.error || activeRows.error) {
        setError(availableRows.error ?? bookedRows.error?.message ?? activeRows.error?.message ?? "Unable to load kennels.");
        setKennels([]);
      } else {
        const map = Object.fromEntries((bookedRows.data ?? []).filter(r => !!r.kennel_id).map(r => [r.id, r.kennel_id as string]));
        setReserved(map);
        setChosen(prev => ({ ...prev, ...map }));
        setKennels(((activeRows.data ?? []) as Kennel[]).filter(k => !!Object.values(map).includes(k.id) || availableRows.kennels.some(a => a.id === k.id)));
      }
    } else {
      const [{ data, error: failure }, active] = await Promise.all([
        createClient().rpc("happytails_checkin_groomer_options", { p_appointment_id: appointment.id }),
        fetchGroomingSessions(),
      ]);
      setBusyGroomers(new Set(active.sessions.filter(s => s.appointmentId !== appointment.id).map(s => s.groomerId)));
      if (failure || active.error) {
        setAvailable({}); setError(`Could not verify groomer availability: ${failure?.message ?? active.error}`);
      } else {
        const next: Record<string, GroomerOption[]> = {};
        for (const row of (data ?? []) as AvailabilityRow[]) {
          (next[row.appointment_pet_id] ??= []).push({ id: row.groomer_id, name: row.groomer_name });
        }
        setAvailable(next);
      }
    }
    setLoading(false);
  }, [appointment.id, boarding]);
  useEffect(() => { void load(); }, [load]);
  const hasDuplicateGroomer = !boarding && new Set(Object.values(chosen).filter(Boolean)).size !== Object.values(chosen).filter(Boolean).length;
  const complete = appointment.pets.length > 0 && appointment.pets.every(p => {
    const selected = chosen[p.appointmentPetId];
    return Boolean(selected && (boarding
      ? kennels.some(k => k.id === selected && k.is_active !== false && (!p.requestedKennelSize || k.size === p.requestedKennelSize)) && (!reserved[p.appointmentPetId] || reserved[p.appointmentPetId] === selected)
      : (available[p.appointmentPetId] ?? []).some(g => g.id === selected)));
  }) && !hasDuplicateGroomer;
  const reservedCount = useMemo(() => appointment.pets.filter(p => !boarding && !!p.groomerId).length, [appointment.pets, boarding]);
  async function save() {
    if (loading || saving || !complete) { setError("Review the available assignment for every pet before checking in."); return; }
    setSaving(true); setError(null);
    try {
      if (boarding) {
        const result = await checkInAppointment(appointment.id, appointment.pets.map(p => ({
          appointmentPetId: p.appointmentPetId, resourceId: chosen[p.appointmentPetId], resourceType: "kennel" as const,
        })));
        if (result.error) { setError(result.error); return; }
      } else {
        const { error: failure } = await createClient().rpc("happytails_checkin_grooming_v2", {
          p_appointment_id: appointment.id,
          p_assignments: appointment.pets.map(p => ({ appointment_pet_id: p.appointmentPetId, groomer_id: chosen[p.appointmentPetId] })),
        });
        if (failure) { setError(`${failure.message} Refresh availability and review the assignment.`); await load(); return; }
      }
      onSuccess();
    } catch (cause) { setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Unable to complete check-in."); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  }
  return <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[120] flex items-center justify-center overflow-y-auto bg-black/60 p-3 sm:p-5" onClick={() => { if (!saving) onClose(); }}>
    <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={boarding ? "Assign kennels" : "Confirm booked groomers"}
      onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()} className="flex max-h-[calc(100dvh-1.5rem)] w-full max-w-lg flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-brand-tint shadow-2xl">
      <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-brand-pink px-5 py-4 text-white">
        <div><h3 className="font-bold">{boarding ? "Assign Kennels" : "Confirm Groomer Assignments"}</h3>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-white/85">{boarding ? "Existing booked kennels are preselected; no new selection is needed." : `${reservedCount} booked groomer${reservedCount === 1 ? "" : "s"} preselected. Only eligible groomers are listed.`}</p></div>
        <button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close" className="text-2xl">Ã—</button>
      </div>
      <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5">
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-600">
          <span>{boarding ? `Active kennels: ${kennels.length} Â· Confirm existing reservations` : `${appointment.scheduled_date} Â· ${appointment.scheduled_time?.slice(0,5) ?? "No time"}`}</span>
          <button type="button" disabled={loading || saving} onClick={() => void load()} className="font-semibold text-brand-pink disabled:opacity-50">Refresh availability</button>
        </div>
        {loading ? <p className="py-8 text-center text-zinc-400">Checking reservationsâ€¦</p> :
          <div className="space-y-3">{appointment.pets.map(p => {
            const current = chosen[p.appointmentPetId] ?? "";
            const bookedGroomerSelected = !boarding && p.groomerId === current && !!current;
            const options = boarding
              ? kennels.filter(k => (!p.requestedKennelSize || k.size === p.requestedKennelSize) && (reserved[p.appointmentPetId] ? k.id === reserved[p.appointmentPetId] : true))
                  .map(k => ({ id: k.id, name: `${kennelDisplayName(k)} Â· ${k.size === "small" ? "Small" : "Big"} #${k.number}` }))
              : (available[p.appointmentPetId] ?? []);
            const usable = options.filter(o => boarding || o.id === current || !Object.entries(chosen).some(([petId,id]) => petId !== p.appointmentPetId && id === o.id));
            const bookedGroomerBusy = !boarding && !!p.groomerId && busyGroomers.has(p.groomerId);
            const reservationMissing = !boarding && !!p.groomerId && !options.some(o => o.id === p.groomerId);
            return <div key={p.appointmentPetId} className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-4">
              <div className="mb-2 flex items-start justify-between gap-2"><div><strong>{p.name}</strong><p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">{p.breed} Â· {p.size_label}</p></div>
                {bookedGroomerSelected && !reservationMissing && <span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-700">Booked groomer</span>}</div>
              {bookedGroomerBusy && <p role="status" className="mb-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-amber-800">Reminder: {p.groomerName ?? "The booked groomer"} is currently in a grooming session. Choose an available groomer or check in later.</p>}
              {boarding && reserved[p.appointmentPetId] && <p className="mb-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-800">Reserved kennel confirmed automatically. No reassignment needed.</p>}
              <select disabled={boarding && !!reserved[p.appointmentPetId]} value={usable.some(g => g.id === current) ? current : ""} onChange={e => setChosen(prev => ({ ...prev, [p.appointmentPetId]: e.target.value }))} className="w-full rounded-xl border border-pink-200 px-3 py-3 text-sm">
                <option value="">Select {boarding ? "active kennel" : "available groomer"}</option>
                {usable.map(option => <option key={option.id} value={option.id}>{option.name}</option>)}
              </select>
              {reservationMissing && !bookedGroomerBusy && <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-amber-700">The booked groomer is unavailable. Select an available replacement.</p>}
              {!boarding && !options.length && <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-amber-700">No groomer is available for this pet.</p>}
              {boarding && !p.requestedKennelSize && <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-red-600">This booking has no recorded kennel size.</p>}
            </div>;
          })}</div>}
        {hasDuplicateGroomer && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 text-xs text-red-700">A groomer cannot be assigned to two pets at the same time.</p>}
        {error && <p role="alert" className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-red-50 p-3 text-xs text-red-700">{error}</p>}
        <div className="mt-5 flex gap-3"><button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={onClose} className="flex-1 rounded-full border border-zinc-300 py-3">Cancel</button>
          <button type="button" disabled={saving || loading || !complete} onClick={() => void save()} className="flex-1 rounded-full bg-brand-pink py-3 font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-40">{saving ? "Checkingâ€¦" : "Check In & Start"}</button></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>;
}
