"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import type { AppointmentRow, AppointmentPetDetail } from "@/lib/supabase/appointment-management";
import { previewGroomingVerification, saveGroomingVerification, type VerificationPreview } from "@/lib/supabase/grooming-verification";

export default function OnlineGroomingVerification({ appointment, pet, onSaved }: {
  appointment: AppointmentRow;
  pet: AppointmentPetDetail;
  onSaved: () => Promise<void> | void;
}) {
  const [weight, setWeight] = useState("");
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<VerificationPreview | null>(null);
  const [approved, setApproved] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [booked, setBooked] = useState<{ packageId: string; pricingId: string } | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    void createClient().from("appointment_pets").select("package_id,package_pricing_id")
      .eq("id",pet.appointmentPetId).single().then(({data})=>{
        if (active && data?.package_id && data?.package_pricing_id) setBooked({packageId:data.package_id,pricingId:data.package_pricing_id});
      });
    return ()=>{active=false};
  }, [pet.appointmentPetId]);
  const serviceType = appointment.service_type;
  if (appointment.is_walk_in || (serviceType !== "dog_grooming" && serviceType !== "cat_grooming")) return null;
  if (appointment.status === "completed" || appointment.status === "cancelled" || appointment.status === "checked_in") return null;

  async function calculate() {
    if (serviceType !== "dog_grooming" && serviceType !== "cat_grooming") return;
    if (!booked) {setError("The saved package details could not be loaded.");return;}
    setBusy(true); setError(null); setPreview(null); setApproved(false);
    const result = await previewGroomingVerification({
      serviceType, packageId: booked.packageId, oldPricingId: booked.pricingId,
      oldLineAmount: pet.lineAmount, weightKg: Number(weight),
    });
    setPreview(result.preview); setError(result.error); setBusy(false);
  }
  async function confirm() {
    if (!preview || !approved) return;
    setBusy(true); setError(null);
    const result = await saveGroomingVerification({
      appointmentPetId: pet.appointmentPetId, weightKg: preview.weightKg,
      customerApproved: approved, expectedPreviousLineAmount: preview.previousLineAmount,
    });
    if (result.error) { setError(result.error); setBusy(false); return; }
    setSuccess(true); setPreview(null); setBusy(false);
    await onSaved();
  }
  const delta = preview ? preview.newLineAmount - preview.previousLineAmount : 0;
  return <div className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-pink-200 bg-white p-4">
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2"><h5 className="text-sm font-bold text-brand-pink">Verify Weight & Final Price</h5><span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500">Online grooming only</span></div>
    <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-600">Weigh {pet.name} at the shop. The stored appointment quote is not final until the customer approves the verified price.</p>
    <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-zinc-500">Registered size: <strong>{pet.size_label || "Unclassified"}</strong> Â· Booked rate: <strong>{pet.packagePricingLabel || "â€”"}</strong> Â· Quoted: <strong>â‚±{pet.lineAmount.toLocaleString()}</strong></p>
    <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2">
      <label className="flex-1 min-w-[135px] text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700">Measured weight (KG){serviceType === "cat_grooming" ? " Â· Whole numbers only" : ""}
        <input type="number" step={serviceType === "cat_grooming" ? "1" : "0.01"} min={serviceType === "cat_grooming" ? "1" : "0.01"} max="200" value={weight} onChange={e=>{setWeight(e.target.value);setPreview(null);setApproved(false);setError(null);setSuccess(false);}} placeholder={serviceType === "cat_grooming" ? "e.g. 4 or 6" : "e.g. 12.50"} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-pink-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:border-brand-pink focus:outline-none" />
      </label>
      <button type="button" onClick={calculate} disabled={busy || !weight.trim() || !booked} className="rounded-full border border-brand-pink px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-brand-pink disabled:opacity-40">Calculate Price</button>
    </div>
    {preview && <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 rounded-xl bg-pink-50 p-3 text-sm">
      <div className="flex justify-between"><span>Verified size</span><strong>{preview.sizeLabel}</strong></div>
      <div className="flex justify-between"><span>Original quote</span><strong>â‚±{preview.previousLineAmount.toLocaleString()}</strong></div>
      <div className="flex justify-between"><span>Revised price (including existing extras)</span><strong>â‚±{preview.newLineAmount.toLocaleString()}</strong></div>
      <div className="flex justify-between border-t border-pink-200 pt-2"><span>Difference</span><strong>{delta >= 0 ? "+" : "âˆ’"}â‚±{Math.abs(delta).toLocaleString()}</strong></div>
      <label className="flex items-start gap-2 pt-2 text-xs text-zinc-700"><input type="checkbox" checked={approved} onChange={e=>setApproved(e.target.checked)} className="mt-0.5 accent-pink-500" /><span>I have explained the revised final price and received the customer's approval.</span></label>
      <button type="button" disabled={!approved || busy} onClick={confirm} className="w-full rounded-full bg-brand-pink py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white disabled:opacity-40">{busy ? "Savingâ€¦" : "Confirm Verified Weight & Price"}</button>
    </div>}
    {error && <p role="alert" className="mt-2 rounded-lg bg-red-50 p-2 text-xs text-red-700">{error}</p>}
    {success && <p role="status" className="mt-2 rounded-lg bg-green-50 p-2 text-xs text-green-700">Verified price saved. Appointment details will refresh.</p>}
  </div>;
}

// Add Product â€” Inventory version. Image upload deliberately removed:

import { useState } from "react";
import { addProduct } from "@/lib/supabase/products";
import type { ProductCategory } from "@/lib/types/products";

const categories: ProductCategory[] = ["Food", "Treats", "Grooming", "Accessories", "Hygiene"];

export default function AddProductModal({ onClose, onAdded }: { onClose: () => void; onAdded: () => void }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [unit, setUnit] = useState("");
  const [packageSize, setPackageSize] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<ProductCategory>("Food");
  const [price, setPrice] = useState("");
  const [minStock, setMinStock] = useState("");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function handleSubmit() {
    if (!name.trim() || !unit.trim() || !price) {
      setError("Name, unit, and price are required.");
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    setError(null);

    const { error: err } = await addProduct({
      name: name.trim(),
      category,
      unit: unit.trim(),
      package_size: packageSize.trim() || null,
      price: parseFloat(price) || 0,
      min_stock: parseInt(minStock) || 0,
    });

    setSaving(false);
    if (err) { setError(err.message); return; }
    onAdded();
  }

  return (

            </select>

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\admin\inventory\InventoryBatchMovementHistory.tsx =====

"use client";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";

type ExpirationChange = { id:string; batch_id:string; previous_expiration:string|null; new_expiration:string; reason:string; created_at:string };
type Movement = {
  id: string;
  batch_id: string;
  quantity_removed: number;
  reason: string;
  quantity_before: number;
  quantity_after: number;
  created_at: string;
};

export default function InventoryBatchMovementHistory({ productId, batchNames }: {
  productId: string; batchNames: Map<string,string>;
}) {
  const [opened,setOpened] = useState(false);
  const [rows,setRows] = useState<Movement[]>([]);
  const [changes,setChanges] = useState<ExpirationChange[]>([]);
  const [loading,setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error,setError] = useState<string|null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if(!opened)return;
    let alive = true;
    const load = async () => {
      setLoading(true);setError(null);
      const db = createClient();
      const [removals, expiry] = await Promise.all([
        db.from("inventory_batch_movements").select("id,batch_id,quantity_removed,reason,quantity_before,quantity_after,created_at")
          .eq("product_id",productId).order("created_at",{ascending:false}).limit(30),
        batchNames.size ? db.from("inventory_batch_expiry_audit").select("id,batch_id,previous_expiration,new_expiration,reason,created_at")
          .in("batch_id",Array.from(batchNames.keys())).order("created_at",{ascending:false}).limit(30) : Promise.resolve({data:[] as ExpirationChange[],error:null}),
      ]);
      if (!alive)return;
      setRows((removals.data??[]) as Movement[]);setChanges((expiry.data??[]) as ExpirationChange[]);setError(removals.error?.message??expiry.error?.message??null);setLoading(false);
    };
    void load();
    return ()=>{alive=false;};
  },[productId,opened]);
  return <section className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-pink-100 bg-zinc-50/70 p-3">
    <button type="button" aria-expanded={opened} onClick={()=>setOpened(v=>!v)} className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 text-left text-xs font-bold text-brand-pink">
      <span>Batch change audit trail</span><span>{opened?"Hide":"Show recent changes"}</span>
    </button>
    {opened && <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
      {loading?<p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">Loading audit historyâ€¦</p>:error?<p role="alert" className="text-xs text-rose-700">Unable to load audit history: {error}. Apply the Inventory migration if not yet installed.</p>:rows.length===0 && changes.length===0?<p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">No audited changes yet. Earlier legacy adjustments are preserved in the batch list.</p>:

"use client";
import type { Product, ProductBatch } from "@/lib/types/products";
import { batchHealth, expiryDaysLeft } from "@/lib/utils/inventory-expiration";

export default function InventoryExpiryAlerts({ products, batches, onViewBatch }: {
  products: Product[]; batches: ProductBatch[]; onViewBatch: () => void;
}) {
  const nameById = new Map(products.map(p => [p.id, p.name]));
  const active = new Set(products.filter(p => p.status === "active").map(p => p.id));
  const priority = batches.filter(b => active.has(b.product_id) && ["expired", "expiring"].includes(batchHealth(b)))
    .sort((a,b) => (batchHealth(a) === "expired" ? 0 : 1) - (batchHealth(b) === "expired" ? 0 : 1) || (a.expiration_date ?? "").localeCompare(b.expiration_date ?? ""));
  if (!priority.length) return null;
  return <section className="mt-5 rounded-2xl border border-rose-200 bg-white p-4 sm:p-5" aria-label="Inventory expiration alerts">
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2"><div><h2 className="font-bold text-rose-800">Expiration alerts Â· {priority.length} batch{priority.length === 1 ? "" : "es"}</h2><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-600">Expired inventory is excluded from sellable stock. Check affected batches before sale.</p></div>
      <button type="button" onClick={onViewBatch} className="rounded-full border border-rose-300 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-50">Review Batches</button>
    </div>
    <div className="mt-3 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">{priority.slice(0,6).map(b => {
      const expired = batchHealth(b) === "expired";
      const days = expiryDaysLeft(b.expiration_date);
      return <div key={b.id} className={`rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5 ${expired ? "border-rose-200 bg-rose-50" : "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50"}`}>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-1"><span className="truncate text-xs font-bold text-zinc-800">{nameById.get(b.product_id) ?? "Product"}</span><span className={`text-[11px] font-bold ${expired ? "text-rose-700" : "text-amber-800"}`}>{expired ? "Expired" : days === 0 ? "Expires today" : `${days} days left`}</span></div>
        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-600">{b.batch_number} Â· {b.quantity} units Â· {b.expiration_date}</p>
      </div>;
    })}</div>
    {priority.length > 6 && <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-rose-700">+{priority.length - 6} additional batches require attention.</p>}
  </section>;
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\admin\inventory\InventoryStats.tsx =====

import type { Product, ProductBatch } from "@/lib/types/products";
import { computeStatus } from "@/lib/supabase/products";
import { batchHealth, sellableStock } from "@/lib/utils/inventory-expiration";

export default function InventoryStats({ products, batches }: { products: Product[]; batches: ProductBatch[] }) {
  const active = products.filter(p => p.status === "active");
  const stock = active.map(p => computeStatus(sellableStock(p.id, batches), p.min_stock));
  const activeIds = new Set(active.map(p => p.id));
  const real = batches.filter(b => !b.is_adjustment && b.quantity > 0 && activeIds.has(b.product_id));
  const expired = real.filter(b => batchHealth(b) === "expired");
  const soon = real.filter(b => batchHealth(b) === "expiring");
  const unknown = real.filter(b => batchHealth(b) === "unknown");
  const cards = [
    { label: "Active Products", value: active.length, sub: "Product catalog", color: "text-zinc-800" },
    { label: "Out of Stock", value: stock.filter(s => s === "Out of Stock").length, sub: "Sellable units only", color: "text-rose-700" },
    { label: "Low Stock", value: stock.filter(s => s === "Low Stock").length, sub: "Sellable units only", color: "text-amber-700" },
    { label: "Expired Batches", value: expired.length, sub: `${expired.reduce((n,b) => n + b.quantity,0)} units to isolate`, color: "text-rose-700" },
    { label: "Expiring in 30 Days", value: soon.length, sub: `${soon.reduce((n,b) => n + b.quantity,0)} units at risk`, color: "text-amber-700" },
    { label: "Missing Expiry", value: unknown.length, sub: "Review dates on file", color: "text-zinc-700" },
  ];
  return <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6">
    {cards.map(card => <div key={card.label} className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white px-4 py-4 shadow-sm">
      <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600">{card.label}</p>
      <p className={`mt-2 text-2xl font-extrabold ${card.color}`}>{card.value}</p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-zinc-500">{card.sub}</p>
    </div>)}
  </div>;
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\admin\inventory\ProductDetailModal.tsx =====

"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import type { Product, ProductBatch, ProductCategory } from "@/lib/types/products";
import { updateProduct, addBatch, adjustInventoryBatch, setInventoryBatchExpiration, setProductStatus, computeStatus } from "@/lib/supabase/products";
import { batchHealth, batchHealthLabel, expiryDaysLeft, sellableStock, physicalStock, philippinesToday } from "@/lib/utils/inventory-expiration";
import InventoryBatchMovementHistory from "./InventoryBatchMovementHistory";

type Mode = "view" | "edit" | "addBatch" | "adjust" | "confirmAdjust" | "editExpiry" | "confirmDiscontinue" | "confirmReactivate";
const categories: ProductCategory[] = ["Food","Treats","Grooming","Accessories","Hygiene"];
const reasons = ["Expired Removal","Damaged","Lost/Miscount","Return to Supplier","Other"];
export default function ProductDetailModal({ product, batches, onClose, onChanged }: {
  product: Product; batches: ProductBatch[]; onClose: () => void; onChanged: () => void;
}) {
  const [mode,setMode] = useState<Mode>("view");
  const [saving,setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error,setError] = useState<string|null>(null);
  const [editName,setEditName] = useState(product.name);
  const [editUnit,setEditUnit] = useState(product.unit);
  const [editCategory,setEditCategory] = useState<ProductCategory>(product.category);
  const [editMinStock,setEditMinStock] = useState(String(product.min_stock));
  const [batchQty,setBatchQty] = useState("");
  const [batchExpiry,setBatchExpiry] = useState("");
  const [adjustBatch,setAdjustBatch] = useState("");
  const [adjustQty,setAdjustQty] = useState("");
  const [adjustReason,setAdjustReason] = useState(reasons[0]);
  const [customReason,setCustomReason] = useState("");
  const [expiryBatch,setExpiryBatch] = useState("");
  const [expiryDate,setExpiryDate] = useState("");
  const [expiryReason,setExpiryReason] = useState("");
  const productBatches = batches.filter(b => b.product_id === product.id)
    .sort((a,b) => (a.expiration_date ?? "9999").localeCompare(b.expiration_date ?? "9999") || b.received_date.localeCompare(a.received_date));
  const stock = sellableStock(product.id,batches);
  const physical = physicalStock(product.id,batches);
  const expired = productBatches.filter(b => batchHealth(b) === "expired");
  const expiring = productBatches.filter(b => batchHealth(b) === "expiring");
  const status = computeStatus(stock,product.min_stock);
  const availableToAdjust = productBatches.filter(b => !b.is_adjustment && b.quantity > 0);
  const chosen = availableToAdjust.find(b => b.id === adjustBatch);
  const field = "mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-zinc-300 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-pink";
  function switchMode(next: Mode) {setError(null);setMode(next);}
  async function saveEdit() {
    const min = Number(editMinStock);
    if (!editName.trim() || !editUnit.trim() || !Number.isSafeInteger(min) || min < 0) {setError("Enter a product name, unit, and valid minimum stock.");return;}
    setSaving(true);setError(null);
    try {const result = await updateProduct(product.id,{name:editName.trim(),unit:editUnit.trim(),category:editCategory,min_stock:min});
      if(result.error){setError(result.error.message);return;} onChanged();switchMode("view");
    } catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:"Unable to update product.");} finally {setSaving(false);}
  }
  async function saveBatch() {
    const qty = Number(batchQty);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(qty) || qty < 1) {setError("Enter a positive whole-number batch quantity.");return;}
    if (batchExpiry && batchExpiry < philippinesToday()) {setError("Expired stock cannot be received as sellable inventory.");return;}
    setSaving(true);setError(null);
    try {const result = await addBatch({product_id:product.id,quantity:qty,expiration_date:batchExpiry||null});
      if(result.error){setError(result.error.message);return;}setBatchQty("");setBatchExpiry("");onChanged();switchMode("view");
    } catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:"Unable to receive batch.");} finally {setSaving(false);}
  }
  async function removeStock() {
    const qty = Number(adjustQty);
    const reason = adjustReason === "Other" ? customReason.trim() : adjustReason;
    if (!chosen || !Number.isSafeInteger(qty) || qty < 1 || qty > chosen.quantity) {setError("Choose a batch and a quantity not exceeding its remaining units.");return;}
    if (reason.length < 3) {setError("Describe the reason for stock removal.");return;}
    setSaving(true);setError(null);
    try {const result = await adjustInventoryBatch(chosen.id,qty,reason);
      if(result.error){setError(result.error.message);return;}setAdjustQty("");setAdjustBatch("");onChanged();switchMode("view");
    } catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:"Could not remove stock.");} finally {setSaving(false);}
  }
  async function saveExpiry() {
    if (!expiryBatch || !expiryDate || expiryReason.trim().length < 3) {setError("Enter a date and a correction reason (at least three characters).");return;}
    setSaving(true);setError(null);
    try {const result = await setInventoryBatchExpiration(expiryBatch,expiryDate,expiryReason);
      if(result.error){setError(result.error.message);return;}onChanged();switchMode("view");
    } catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:"Could not update batch expiration.");}finally{setSaving(false);}
  }
  async function changeStatus(status: "active"|"discontinued") {
    setSaving(true);setError(null);
    try {const result=await setProductStatus(product.id,status);
      if(result.error){setError(result.error.message);return;}onChanged();onClose();
    } catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:"Unable to change status.");} finally{setSaving(false);}
  }
  return <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[80] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 px-3 py-5 sm:px-4" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={`${product.name} inventory details`} onClick={() => {if(!saving)onClose();}}>
    <div className="max-h-[94vh] w-full max-w-3xl overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-white shadow-2xl" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-brand-pink px-5 py-4 text-white sm:px-6"><div><h2 className="text-lg font-bold">{mode === "view"?"Product Information":mode === "edit"?"Edit Product":mode === "addBatch"?"Receive Stock Batch":mode === "adjust"?"Remove Stock from Batch":mode === "confirmAdjust"?"Confirm Stock Removal":mode === "editExpiry"?"Correct Batch Expiration":mode === "confirmDiscontinue"?"Discontinue Product":"Reactivate Product"}</h2><p className="text-xs text-white/80">{product.product_code} Â· {product.name}</p></div>
        <button type="button" onClick={()=>{if(!saving){if(mode === "view")onClose();else switchMode("view");}}} aria-label="Close modal" className="rounded-full p-1.5 hover:bg-white/20">âœ•</button></div>
      <div className="max-h-[calc(94vh-90px)] overflow-y-auto p-5 sm:p-6">
        {error && <p role="alert" className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-3 text-sm text-rose-700">{error}</p>}
        {mode === "view" && <>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3"><div><h3 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-zinc-900">{product.name}</h3><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500">{product.category} Â· {product.unit}{product.package_size?` Â· ${product.package_size}`:""}</p></div>
            <span className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold ${status === "In Stock"?"bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800":status === "Low Stock"?"bg-amber-100 text-amber-800":"bg-rose-100 text-rose-800"}`}>{status}</span></div>
          <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4">
            {[{title:"Sellable Stock",val:stock},{title:"Physical Stock",val:physical},{title:"Min Stock",val:product.min_stock},{title:"Unit Price",val:`â‚±${Number(product.price).toLocaleString()}`}].map(x => <div key={x.title} className="rounded-xl bg-pink-50 p-3"><p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-600">{x.title}</p><p className="mt-1 text-xl font-extrabold text-zinc-800">{x.val}</p></div>)}
          </div>
          {(expired.length>0 || expiring.length>0) && <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-3 text-xs text-rose-800"><strong>Expiration attention:</strong> {expired.length>0&&`${expired.length} expired batch(es), ${expired.reduce((n,b)=>n+b.quantity,0)} unsellable units. `}{expiring.length>0&&`${expiring.length} batch(es) expire within 30 days.`}</div>}
          <div className="mt-5 flex items-center justify-between"><h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-brand-pink">Batch Information ({productBatches.length})</h3><span className="text-xs text-zinc-500">Individual expiry &amp; quantity</span></div>

"Not recorded"}</strong>{health==="expiring"&&days!==null ? ` Â· ${days===0?"Today":`${days} days left`}`:""}</p></div><div className="text-right"><p className="text-lg font-extrabold tabular-nums">{b.quantity} <span className="text-xs font-normal">units</span></p><span className="inline-block rounded-full bg-white/80 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold">{batchHealthLabel(health)}</span></div></div>{!b.is_adjustment && <button type="button" onClick={()=>{setExpiryBatch(b.id);setExpiryDate(b.expiration_date??"");setExpiryReason("");switchMode("editExpiry");}} className="mt-2 rounded-full border border-zinc-300 bg-white px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-zinc-700 hover:border-brand-pink">{b.expiration_date?"Correct expiration date":"Record missing expiration"}</button>}</div>;

import type { Product, ProductBatch } from "@/lib/types/products";
import { computeStatus } from "@/lib/supabase/products";
import { batchHealth, sellableStock, physicalStock } from "@/lib/utils/inventory-expiration";
import SortableHeader, { type SortDirection } from "@/components/admin/reports/SortableHeader";
const cols = [
  { key: "product_code", label: "Product ID" }, { key: "name", label: "Product Name" },
  { key: "category", label: "Category" }, { key: "totalStock", label: "Sellable" },
  { key: "min_stock", label: "Min Stock" }, { key: "statusLabel", label: "Stock Status" },
  { key: "expiryRisk", label: "Expiration" },
];
export default function ProductsTable({ products, batches, onView, sortKey, sortDirection, onSort }: {
  products: Product[]; batches: ProductBatch[]; onView: (p: Product) => void;
  sortKey: string | null; sortDirection: SortDirection; onSort: (key: string) => void;
}) {
  return <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white"><table className="w-full min-w-[900px] text-sm">
    <thead><tr className="bg-brand-pink text-white">{cols.map(c => <SortableHeader key={c.key} label={c.label} sortKey={c.key} activeSortKey={sortKey} direction={sortDirection} onSort={onSort} variant="light" />)}<th className="px-3 py-3 text-left">Action</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>{products.length === 0 ? <tr><td colSpan={8} className="py-10 text-center text-zinc-400">No products found.</td></tr> : products.map(p => {
      const stock = sellableStock(p.id, batches);
      const status = computeStatus(stock,p.min_stock);
      const related = batches.filter(b => b.product_id === p.id);
      const hasExpired = related.some(b => batchHealth(b) === "expired");
      const hasSoon = related.some(b => batchHealth(b) === "expiring");
      const atRisk = hasExpired ? "Expired batch" : hasSoon ? "Expiring Soon" : related.some(b => batchHealth(b) === "unknown") ? "Missing dates" : "Clear";
      return <tr key={p.id} className={`border-t border-pink-50 ${hasExpired ? "bg-rose-50/50" : "hover:bg-pink-50/50"}`}>
        <td className="px-3 py-3 text-zinc-600">{p.product_code}</td>
        <td className="px-3 py-3 font-semibold text-zinc-800">{p.name}<span className="block text-[11px] font-normal text-zinc-400">{p.unit}{p.package_size?` Â· ${p.package_size}`:""}</span></td>
        <td className="px-3 py-3 text-zinc-600">{p.category}</td>
        <td className="px-3 py-3 font-semibold tabular-nums">{stock}<span className="block text-[11px] font-normal text-zinc-500">{physicalStock(p.id,batches)} physical</span></td>
        <td className="px-3 py-3 tabular-nums">{p.min_stock}</td>
        <td className="px-3 py-3"><span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold ${status === "In Stock"?"bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700":status === "Low Stock"?"bg-amber-100 text-amber-800":"bg-rose-100 text-rose-700"}`}>{status}</span></td>
        <td className="px-3 py-3"><span className={`rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold ${hasExpired?"bg-rose-100 text-rose-700":hasSoon?"bg-amber-100 text-amber-800":"bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-600"}`}>{atRisk}</span></td>

"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

type Props = {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  pending?: boolean;
  destructive?: boolean;
  onCancel: () => void;
  onConfirm: () => void | Promise<void>;
};

/** In-app confirmation dialog, independent of browser-native confirm(). */
export default function ActionConfirmModal({ title, description, confirmLabel = "Confirm", pending = false, destructive = false, onCancel, onConfirm }: Props) {
  useEffect(() => {
    function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key === "Escape" && !pending) onCancel();
    }
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [onCancel, pending]);

  return (
    <div role="presentation" className="fixed inset-0 z-[300] flex items-center justify-center overflow-y-auto bg-black/60 p-4" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); if (e.target === e.currentTarget && !pending) onCancel(); }}>
      <div role="alertdialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="action-confirm-title" aria-describedby="action-confirm-description" className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-3xl bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl">
        <h2 id="action-confirm-title" className="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-800">{title}</h2>
        <p id="action-confirm-description" className="mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-zinc-600">{description}</p>
        <div className="mt-6 flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 sm:flex-row">
          <button type="button" autoFocus disabled={pending} onClick={onCancel} className="min-h-11 flex-1 rounded-full border-2 border-zinc-200 px-4 py-2 font-semibold text-zinc-600 disabled:opacity-50">Cancel</button>
          <button type="button" disabled={pending} onClick={() => void onConfirm()} className={`min-h-11 flex-1 rounded-full px-4 py-2 font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50 ${destructive ? "bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700" : "bg-brand-pink hover:opacity-90"}`}>{pending ? "Please waitâ€¦" : confirmLabel}</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Wraps a real section of the live site with an "Edit" button overlay,
// shown only when the parent page's global edit mode is on. Clicking it
// opens the upload modal scoped to that section's site_settings key.
//
// REAL BUG FIXED: this renders the actual live Navbar/Hero/banner
// components â€” not a mockup â€” which means their real links and buttons
// (nav items, the "Login" button) were genuinely clickable inside the
// admin preview. Clicking any of them navigated the whole admin app
// away to the public site or /sign-in, kicking the superadmin out of
// the dashboard. `pointer-events-none` on the content wrapper makes
// everything underneath purely visual â€” pixel-identical, but clicks
// never reach the real <a>/<button> elements inside it. The Edit
// button itself explicitly re-enables pointer-events so it still
// works, since it sits inside the otherwise-disabled zone.
export default function EditableSection({
  editMode,
  label,
  onEdit,
  children,
}: {
  editMode: boolean;
  label: string;
  onEdit: () => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <div className="pointer-events-none" aria-hidden="true">
        {children}
      </div>
      {editMode && (
        <button
          onClick={onEdit}
          className="pointer-events-auto absolute top-4 right-4 z-10 bg-white text-brand-pink border-2 border-brand-pink font-semibold text-sm px-5 py-2 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:bg-brand-pink hover:text-white transition-colors"

"use client";

import { useEffect, useId, useRef } from "react";
import { AlertCircle, AlertTriangle, Info, X } from "lucide-react";

type Tone = "error" | "warning" | "info";

type Props = {
  title: string;
  message: string;
  tone?: Tone;
  onClose: () => void;
  actionLabel?: string;
  onAction?: () => void;
  actionPending?: boolean;
};

/** Important, actionable feedback only. Leave routine form hints inline. */
export default function FeedbackDialog({
  title, message, tone = "error", onClose,
  actionLabel = "Understood", onAction, actionPending = false,
}: Props) {
  const titleId = useId();
  const descriptionId = useId();
  const closeRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    closeRef.current?.focus();
    function onKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && !actionPending) { e.stopPropagation(); onClose(); }
    }
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [onClose, actionPending]);

  const Icon = tone === "warning" ? AlertTriangle : tone === "info" ? Info : AlertCircle;
  const color = tone === "warning" ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700" : tone === "info" ? "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700" : "bg-rose-50 text-rose-600";

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[400] flex items-center justify-center overflow-y-auto bg-black/65 p-3 sm:p-5"
      role="presentation" onMouseDown={e => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget && !actionPending) onClose(); }}>
      <section role="alertdialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby={titleId} aria-describedby={descriptionId}
        className="w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl bg-white p-5 shadow-2xl sm:p-7">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <span className={`flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl ${color}`}>
            <Icon size={24} aria-hidden="true" />
          </span>
          <button type="button" disabled={actionPending} onClick={onClose} aria-label="Dismiss message"

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\admin\operations\ProductFormModal.tsx =====

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { uploadProductImage, setProductImage } from "@/lib/supabase/products";
import type { Product, ProductCategory } from "@/lib/types/products";

const categories: ProductCategory[] = ["Food", "Treats", "Grooming", "Accessories", "Hygiene"];
type FormValues = { name: string; unit: string; package_size: string | null; price: number; min_stock: number; category: ProductCategory };

export default function ProductFormModal({ mode, existing, onClose, onSave }: {
  mode: "add" | "edit";
  existing?: Product;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSave: (product: FormValues, id?: string) => Promise<{ id: string; product_code: string } | null>;
}) {
  const [name, setName] = useState(existing?.name ?? "");
  const [unit, setUnit] = useState(existing?.unit ?? "");
  const [packageSize, setPackageSize] = useState(existing?.package_size ?? "");
  const [price, setPrice] = useState(existing ? String(existing.price) : "");
  const [minStock, setMinStock] = useState(existing ? String(existing.min_stock) : "0");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<ProductCategory>(existing?.category ?? "Food");
  const [imageFile, setImageFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState<string | null>(existing?.image_url ?? null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => { if (previewUrl?.startsWith("blob:")) URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl); };
  }, [previewUrl]);
  function selectImage(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (!file.type.startsWith("image/")) { setError("Please select an image file."); return; }
    if (file.size > 8 * 1024 * 1024) { setError("Images must be 8 MB or smaller."); return; }
    setImageFile(file);
    setPreviewUrl(URL.createObjectURL(file));
    setError(null);
  }
  async function submit(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (saving) return;
    const priceNumber = Number(price), stockNumber = Number(minStock);
    if (!name.trim() || !unit.trim() || !price.trim() || !minStock.trim()) { setError("Item name, unit, price, and minimum stock are required."); return; }
    if (!Number.isFinite(priceNumber) || priceNumber < 0) { setError("Enter a valid non-negative price."); return; }
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(stockNumber) || stockNumber < 0) { setError("Minimum stock must be a non-negative whole number."); return; }
    setSaving(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const result = await onSave({ name: name.trim(), unit: unit.trim(), package_size: packageSize.trim() || null, price: priceNumber, min_stock: stockNumber, category }, existing?.id);
      if (!result) throw new Error("The product could not be saved. Please retry.");
      if (imageFile) {
        const upload = await uploadProductImage(imageFile, result.product_code);
        if (upload.error || !upload.url) throw new Error(`Item saved, but image upload failed: ${upload.error ?? "no URL returned"}`);
        const linked = await setProductImage(result.id, upload.url);
        if (linked.error) throw new Error(`Item saved, but image could not be linked: ${linked.error.message}`);
      }
      onClose();
    } catch (err) { setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unable to save item."); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  }
  const field = "mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-2.5 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-pink";
  return <div role="presentation" className="fixed inset-0 z-[110] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/55 p-4" onMouseDown={e => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget && !saving) onClose(); }}>
    <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={mode === "add" ? "Add product" : "Edit product"} className="max-h-[92vh] w-full max-w-md overflow-y-auto rounded-3xl bg-white shadow-2xl">
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-10 flex items-center justify-between bg-brand-pink px-6 py-4 text-white"><h2 className="font-bold">{mode === "add" ? "Add Product" : "Edit Product"}</h2><button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close" className="rounded-full px-2 py-1 hover:bg-white/20">âœ•</button></div>
      <form onSubmit={e => { void submit(e); }} className="space-y-4 px-6 py-5">
        <div><span className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-700">Product Image</span><label className="mt-1 flex h-32 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-pink-200 bg-pink-50">
          {previewUrl ? <>{/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}<img src={previewUrl} alt="Selected product preview" className="h-full w-full object-contain p-2" /></> : <span className="text-sm text-zinc-500">Choose an image</span>}
          <input type="file" accept="image/*" disabled={saving} onChange={selectImage} className="sr-only" />
        </label></div>
        <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-700">Item Name<input required value={name} onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)} className={field} /></label>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"><label className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-700">Unit<input required value={unit} onChange={e => setUnit(e.target.value)} placeholder="Piece, Kilo" className={field} /></label><label className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-700">Package Size<input value={packageSize} onChange={e => setPackageSize(e.target.value)} placeholder="80g" className={field} /></label></div>
        <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-700">Category<select value={category} onChange={e => setCategory(e.target.value as ProductCategory)} className={field}>{categories.map(c => <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}</select></label>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"><label className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-700">Price (â‚±)<input required type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value={price} onChange={e => setPrice(e.target.value)} className={field} /></label><label className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-700">Min Stock<input required type="number" min="0" step="1" value={minStock} onChange={e => setMinStock(e.target.value)} className={field} /></label></div>
        {error && <p role="alert" className="rounded-lg bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-700">{error}</p>}
        <div className="flex gap-3 pt-2"><button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={onClose} className="flex-1 rounded-full border-2 border-zinc-300 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-600">Cancel</button><button type="submit" disabled={saving} className="flex-1 rounded-full bg-brand-pink py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50">{saving ? "Savingâ€¦" : mode === "add" ? "Add" : "Save Changes"}</button></div>
      </form>
    </div>
  </div>;
}

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import type { Customer } from "@/lib/types/users";
import type { Pet } from "@/lib/types/appointments";

export default function OwnerPanel({
  customers,
  pets,
  onSelectOwner,
  onShowAll,
}: {
  customers: Customer[];
  pets: Pet[];
  onSelectOwner: (customer: Customer) => void;
  onShowAll: () => void;
}) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");

  const petCount = (customerId: string) => pets.filter((p) => p.customer_id === customerId).length;

  const filteredCustomers = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();

      .filter((c) => !q || c.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(q))

  return (

  const fields = useCustomerPetForm({
    ...blankCustomerPet,
    vaccination_status: initial.vaccination_status ?? blankCustomerPet.vaccination_status,
    name: pet.name, species: pet.species, breed: pet.breed,
    weight: initial.weight_kg == null ? "" : String(initial.weight_kg),
    age: petAgeLabel(pet) ?? "", sex: pet.sex ?? "",
  });
  const [displayPet, setDisplayPet] = useState<PetWithWeight>(initial);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [photoEditing, setPhotoEditing] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!editing) return;
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => { if (event.key === "Escape" && !saving) cancel(); };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [editing, saving]);

  function cancel() {
    fields.setForm({
      ...blankCustomerPet,
      vaccination_status: displayPet.vaccination_status ?? blankCustomerPet.vaccination_status,
      name: displayPet.name, species: displayPet.species, breed: displayPet.breed,
      weight: displayPet.weight_kg == null ? "" : String(displayPet.weight_kg),
      age: petAgeLabel(displayPet) ?? "", sex: displayPet.sex ?? "",
    });
    fields.setErrors({});
    setError(null);
    setEditing(false);
  }

  async function save() {
    if (saving || !fields.validate()) return;
    const { form, size } = fields;
    // A legacy record without a recorded weight must not lose its existing size
    // just because staff corrected its name, breed, age, or sex.
    const keepLegacySize = !form.weight.trim() && form.species === displayPet.species;
    const changes = {
      name: form.name.trim(), breed: form.breed.trim(), species: form.species,
      vaccination_status: form.vaccination_status,
      ...normalizePetAge(form.age)!,
      sex: form.sex || null,
      weight_kg: form.weight.trim() ? Number(form.weight) : null,
      size_label: size?.label ?? (keepLegacySize ? displayPet.size_label : "Unclassified"),
      pet_size_id: size?.id ?? (keepLegacySize ? displayPet.pet_size_id ?? null : null),
    };
    setSaving(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const { data, error: saveError } = await createClient().from("pets")
        .update(changes).eq("id", displayPet.id).select("*").single();
      if (saveError) throw new Error(saveError.message);
      if (!data) throw new Error("The pet update was not confirmed. Check permissions and retry.");
      const updated = data as PetWithWeight;
      setDisplayPet(updated);
      onUpdated(updated);
      setEditing(false);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unable to save this pet profile.");
    } finally { setSaving(false); }
  }

  function updatePhoto(url: string) {
    const updated = { ...displayPet, photo_url: url };
    setDisplayPet(updated);
    onUpdated(updated);
  }

  return <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[90] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 px-3 py-4" onMouseDown={e => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget && !saving && !photoEditing) onClose(); }}>
    <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={`${displayPet.name} profile and service history`}
      className="max-h-[92vh] w-full max-w-4xl overflow-y-auto rounded-3xl bg-white shadow-xl">
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-10 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-pink-100 bg-white px-5 py-4 sm:px-7">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <PetAvatar pet={displayPet} size="md" />
          <div><h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-900">{displayPet.name}</h3><p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">{displayPet.breed} Â· {displayPet.sex ?? "â€”"}</p></div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close pet profile" className="rounded-full p-2 text-zinc-500 hover:bg-pink-50 hover:text-brand-pink">âœ•</button>
      </div>
      <div className="px-5 py-5 sm:px-7">
        <div className="mb-5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 p-4">
          <PetAvatar pet={displayPet} size="lg" />
          <div className="flex-1"><h4 className="font-semibold text-zinc-800">Profile picture</h4><p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">Use a real photo so staff can identify this pet quickly.</p></div>
          <button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={()=>setPhotoEditing(true)} className="rounded-full border border-brand-pink px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink">{displayPet.photo_url ? "Change Photo" : "Add Photo"}</button>
        </div>
        <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">
          <section className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-pink-50/30 p-4">
            <h4 className="mb-3 font-bold text-zinc-800">Pet Information</h4>
            {editing ? <div className="space-y-4">
              <CustomerPetFields state={fields}/>
              {!fields.form.weight.trim() && <p className="text-xs text-amber-800">No weight entered. The current estimated size is retained when species is unchanged. Enter a weight to recalculate the size using the active Service Management size guide.</p>}
              {error && <p role="alert" className="rounded-lg bg-red-50 p-2 text-sm text-red-700">{error}</p>}
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={cancel} className="flex-1 rounded-full border border-zinc-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold">Cancel</button>
                <button type="button" disabled={saving || fields.loadingGuide} onClick={() => void save()} className="flex-1 rounded-full bg-brand-pink px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50">{saving ? "Savingâ€¦" : "Save"}</button>
              </div>
            </div> : <div className="space-y-2">
              <Row label="Species" value={displayPet.species}/><Row label="Breed" value={displayPet.breed}/>
              <Row label="Estimated Size" value={displayPet.size_label}/>
              <Row label="Weight" value={displayPet.weight_kg == null ? "Not recorded" : `${displayPet.weight_kg} kg`}/>
              <Row label="Age" value={petAgeLabel(displayPet)}/><Row label="Sex" value={displayPet.sex}/>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditing(true)} className="mt-3 w-full rounded-full border-2 border-brand-pink py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink hover:bg-pink-50">Edit Pet Info</button>
            </div>}
          </section>
          <section className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 p-4"><h4 className="mb-3 font-bold text-zinc-800">Owner Information</h4>
            <div className="space-y-2"><Row label="Owner Name" value={ownerName}/><Row label="Contact Number" value={ownerContact}/><Row label="Address" value={ownerAddress}/></div>
          </section>
        </div>
        <PetServiceHistory petId={displayPet.id}/>
      </div>
    </div>
    {photoEditing && <PetPhotoEditor petId={displayPet.id} petName={displayPet.name} onSaved={updatePhoto} onClose={()=>setPhotoEditing(false)}/>}
  </div>;
}

  onClose: () => void;
  onAdd: (name: string) => Promise<string | null>;

                  <button
                    onClick={() => onUpdateStage(session.id, "checked_in")}
                    className="flex-1 border-2 border-green-500 text-green-600 font-semibold text-sm py-2 rounded-full hover:bg-green-500 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                  >
                    Check In Now
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}

              {session.stage === "checked_in" && (
                <div className="flex gap-3">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => onUpdateStage(session.id, "cancelled")}
                    className="flex-1 border-2 border-zinc-300 text-zinc-400 font-semibold text-sm py-2 rounded-full hover:border-red-400 hover:text-red-500 transition-colors"
                  >
                    Cancel Session
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setShowPayment(true)}
                    className="flex-1 border-2 border-brand-pink text-brand-pink font-semibold text-sm py-2 rounded-full hover:bg-brand-pink hover:text-white transition-colors"
                  >
                    Check Out
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}

              {session.stage === "checked_out" && (
                <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-green-600 font-semibold text-sm">
                  <span aria-hidden>ðŸŽ‰</span> This boarding has been completed!!
                </p>
              )}

              {session.stage === "cancelled" && (
                <p className="text-zinc-400 text-sm">This session was cancelled.</p>
              )}
            </Section>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\admin\pet-services\BoardingProgressTimeline.tsx =====

import type { BoardingStage } from "@/lib/data/boarding-kennels-mock";

const steps: { key: BoardingStage; label: string }[] = [
  { key: "booked", label: "Booked" },
  { key: "checked_in", label: "Check in" },
  { key: "checked_out", label: "Check out" },
];

export default function BoardingProgressTimeline({ stage }: { stage: BoardingStage }) {
  const currentIndex = steps.findIndex((s) => s.key === stage);

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center">
      {steps.map((step, i) => {
        const isDone = i <= currentIndex;
        const isLast = i === steps.length - 1;
        return (
          <div key={step.key} className="flex items-center flex-1 last:flex-none">
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
              <div
                className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center border-2 ${
                  isDone ? "bg-brand-pink border-brand-pink text-white" : "border-brand-pink-light text-brand-pink-light"
                }`}
              >
                {isDone ? (
                  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3">
                    <path d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
                  </svg>
                ) : (
                  <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-current" />
                )}
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 whitespace-nowrap">{step.label}</span>
            </div>
            {!isLast && (
              <div className={`flex-1 h-0.5 mx-1 ${i < currentIndex ? "bg-brand-pink" : "bg-brand-pink-light"}`} />
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\admin\pet-services\GroomerAvailabilitySettings.tsx =====

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import { fetchPackagesFull, fetchAddonsByCategory } from "@/lib/supabase/services";
import { fetchGroomers } from "@/lib/supabase/pet-services";
import ActionConfirmModal from "@/components/admin/operations/ActionConfirmModal";
import FeedbackDialog from "@/components/admin/operations/FeedbackDialog";

type Duration = { package_id: string; duration_minutes: number; verified: boolean };
type AlaDuration = { addon_id: string; duration_minutes: number; verified: boolean };
type ServiceDuration = { id: string; name: string; service: string; duration: number; verified: boolean; kind: "package" | "ala_carte" };
type Groomer = { id: string; name: string };
type DayOff = { id: string; groomer_id: string; off_date: string; start_time: string; end_time: string; reason: string | null };

export default function GroomerAvailabilitySettings({ refreshKey = 0 }: { refreshKey?: number }) {
  const [services, setServices] = useState<ServiceDuration[]>([]);
  const [groomers, setGroomers] = useState<Groomer[]>([]);
  const [timeOff, setTimeOff] = useState<DayOff[]>([]);
  const [groomer, setGroomer] = useState("");
  const [date, setDate] = useState("");
  const [from, setFrom] = useState("09:00");
  const [to, setTo] = useState("18:00");
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState<DayOff | null>(null);

  const reload = useCallback(async () => {
    const db = createClient();
    const [dogs, cats, ala, durations, alaDurations, g, off] = await Promise.all([
      fetchPackagesFull("dog_grooming"),
      fetchPackagesFull("cat_grooming"),
      fetchAddonsByCategory("Ala Carte"),
      db.from("grooming_package_durations").select("package_id,duration_minutes,verified"),
      db.from("ala_carte_service_durations").select("addon_id,duration_minutes,verified"),
      fetchGroomers({ activeOnly: true }),
      db.from("groomer_time_off").select("id,groomer_id,off_date,start_time,end_time,reason")
        .gte("off_date", new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila" })).order("off_date"),
    ]);
    const problem = dogs.error ?? cats.error ?? ala.error ?? durations.error?.message ??
      alaDurations.error?.message ?? g.error ?? off.error?.message;
    if (problem) throw new Error(problem);
    const packageDurations = new Map(((durations.data ?? []) as Duration[]).map(d => [d.package_id, d]));
    const itemDurations = new Map(((alaDurations.data ?? []) as AlaDuration[]).map(d => [d.addon_id, d]));
    const grooming: ServiceDuration[] = [
      ...dogs.packages.filter(p => p.is_active).map(p => ({ ...p, service: "Dog" })),
      ...cats.packages.filter(p => p.is_active).map(p => ({ ...p, service: "Cat" })),
    ].map(p => ({ id: p.id, name: p.name, service: p.service, kind: "package" as const,
      duration: packageDurations.get(p.id)?.duration_minutes ?? 30,
      verified: packageDurations.get(p.id)?.verified ?? false }));
    const aLaCarte: ServiceDuration[] = ala.addons.filter(a => a.is_active).map(a => ({
      id: a.id, name: a.name, service: "Ã€ La Carte", kind: "ala_carte" as const,
      duration: itemDurations.get(a.id)?.duration_minutes ?? 30,
      verified: itemDurations.get(a.id)?.verified ?? false,
    }));
    setServices([...grooming, ...aLaCarte]);
    setGroomers(g.groomers);
    setTimeOff((off.data ?? []) as DayOff[]);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void reload().catch(e => setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not load groomer settings"));
  }, [reload, refreshKey]);

  async function saveDuration(row: ServiceDuration) {
    if (busy) return;
    if (!Number.isInteger(row.duration) || row.duration < 30 || row.duration > 480 || row.duration % 30 !== 0) {
      setError("Service duration must be between 30 and 480 minutes, in increments of 30."); return;
    }
    setBusy(true); setError(null); setNotice(null);
    try {
      const db = createClient();
      const { error: failure } = row.kind === "ala_carte"
        ? await db.from("ala_carte_service_durations").upsert({ addon_id: row.id, duration_minutes: row.duration,
            verified: true, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }, { onConflict: "addon_id" })
        : await db.from("grooming_package_durations").upsert({ package_id: row.id, duration_minutes: row.duration,
            verified: true, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }, { onConflict: "package_id" });
      if (failure) throw new Error(failure.message);
      await reload();
      setNotice(`${row.service} ${row.name}: ${row.duration}-minute duration verified.`);
    } catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unable to save service duration."); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  async function addTimeOff() {
    if (busy) return;
    if (!groomer || !date || from >= to) {
      setError("Choose a groomer, date, and valid unavailability period before saving."); return;
    }
    setBusy(true); setError(null); setNotice(null);
    try {
      const { error: failure } = await createClient().from("groomer_time_off")
        .insert({ groomer_id: groomer, off_date: date, start_time: from, end_time: to, reason: reason.trim() || null });
      if (failure) throw new Error(failure.message);
      await reload(); setReason(""); setNotice("Groomer time off saved.");
    } catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unable to save time off."); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  async function confirmRemoveTimeOff() {
    if (!removing || busy) return;
    const id = removing.id;
    setBusy(true); setError(null); setNotice(null);
    try {
      const { error: failure } = await createClient().from("groomer_time_off").delete().eq("id", id);
      if (failure) throw new Error(failure.message);
      setRemoving(null); await reload();
      setNotice("Groomer unavailability removed. Booking capacity has been updated.");
    } catch (e) { setRemoving(null); setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unable to remove time off."); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  return <section className="mt-10 space-y-6 rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
    <div><h2 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-brand-pink">Groomer Availability & Service Durations</h2>
      <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600">Verify Grooming package and Ã€ La Carte item durations. These durations are used to prevent overlapping groomer reservations.</p></div>
    {notice && <p role="status" className="text-sm font-medium text-emerald-700">{notice}</p>}
    <div><h3 className="font-bold text-zinc-800">Service duration (minutes)</h3>
      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">Each Ã€ La Carte item has its own duration. Multiple items for the same pet use their combined duration.</p>
      <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">{services.map(row => <div key={`${row.kind}-${row.id}`} className="rounded-xl border border-pink-100 p-3">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2"><strong className="min-w-0 text-sm">{row.service}: {row.name}</strong>
          <span className={`shrink-0 text-[11px] ${row.verified ? "text-emerald-700" : "text-amber-700"}`}>{row.verified ? "Verified" : "Review required"}</span></div>
        <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><input type="number" min="30" max="480" step="30" value={row.duration}
          onChange={e => setServices(current => current.map(item => item.id === row.id && item.kind === row.kind ? { ...item, duration: Number(e.target.value), verified: false } : item))}
          aria-label={`Duration in minutes for ${row.service} ${row.name}`} className="w-28 rounded-lg border border-pink-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm" />
          <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void saveDuration(row)} className="rounded-full bg-brand-pink px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-40">Verify & Save</button></div>
      </div>)}</div>
      {!services.length && <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-zinc-500">No active Grooming packages or Ã€ La Carte items were found.</p>}
    </div>
    <div className="border-t border-pink-100 pt-5"><h3 className="font-bold text-zinc-800">Groomer time off / breaks</h3>
      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-600">Unavailability prevents overlapping bookings. Removing a restriction requires confirmation.</p>
      <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <label className="text-xs font-semibold">Groomer<select value={groomer} onChange={e => setGroomer(e.target.value)} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-pink-200 p-2 text-sm"><option value="">Select groomer</option>{groomers.map(g => <option key={g.id} value={g.id}>{g.name}</option>)}</select></label>
        <label className="text-xs font-semibold">Date<input type="date" value={date} onChange={e => setDate(e.target.value)} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-pink-200 p-2 text-sm" /></label>
        <label className="text-xs font-semibold">Start<input type="time" value={from} onChange={e => setFrom(e.target.value)} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-pink-200 p-2 text-sm" /></label>
        <label className="text-xs font-semibold">End<input type="time" value={to} onChange={e => setTo(e.target.value)} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-pink-200 p-2 text-sm" /></label>
      </div>
      <input value={reason} onChange={e => setReason(e.target.value)} maxLength={200} placeholder="Optional reason (leave, break, trainingâ€¦)" className="mt-3 w-full rounded-lg border border-pink-200 p-2 text-sm" />
      <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void addTimeOff()} className="mt-3 rounded-full border border-brand-pink px-5 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink disabled:opacity-40">Save Unavailability</button>
      {!!timeOff.length && <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">{timeOff.map(row => <div key={row.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg bg-pink-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs">
        <span className="min-w-0 break-words">{groomers.find(g => g.id === row.groomer_id)?.name ?? "Groomer"} Â· {row.off_date} Â· {row.start_time.slice(0, 5)}â€“{row.end_time.slice(0, 5)} {row.reason ? `Â· ${row.reason}` : ""}</span>
        <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setRemoving(row)} className="shrink-0 font-bold text-red-600 disabled:opacity-50">Remove</button>
      </div>)}</div>}
    </div>
    {removing && <ActionConfirmModal title="Remove groomer unavailability?"
      description={`Removing the ${removing.off_date}, ${removing.start_time.slice(0, 5)}â€“${removing.end_time.slice(0, 5)} restriction can expose new booking slots. Existing appointments will not be deleted.`}
      confirmLabel="Remove Restriction" destructive pending={busy} onCancel={() => setRemoving(null)} onConfirm={confirmRemoveTimeOff} />}
    {error && <FeedbackDialog title="Groomer Settings Need Attention" message={error} onClose={() => setError(null)} />}
  </section>;
}

// Shows every active groomer, independent of session count â€” the old
// GroomerGroup only ever rendered for groomers that already had active
// sessions grouped by name, so with zero real sessions (no appointments

import type { Groomer } from "@/lib/types/pet-services";

export default function GroomerRoster({
  groomers,
  onArchiveToggle,
}: {
  groomers: Groomer[];
  onArchiveToggle: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  if (groomers.length === 0) {
    return <p className="mt-10 text-center text-zinc-400">No groomers yet. Add one to get started.</p>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="mt-6 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
      {groomers.map((g) => (
        <div key={g.id} className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-pink-100 p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <p className="font-semibold text-zinc-800">{g.name}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">0 active sessions</p>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => onArchiveToggle(g.id)}
            className="text-xs font-semibold border border-red-400 text-red-500 px-3 py-1 rounded-full hover:bg-red-500 hover:text-white transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            Archive
          </button>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
// History modal: groomers with their completed-session counts, expandable
// to show which pets they were for.
import { useState } from "react";
import type { GroomingSession } from "@/lib/data/grooming-sessions-mock";

export default function HistoryModal({
  completedSessions,
  onClose,
}: {
  completedSessions: GroomingSession[];
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const byGroomer = completedSessions.reduce<Record<string, GroomingSession[]>>((acc, s) => {
    (acc[s.groomerName] ??= []).push(s);
    return acc;
  }, {});

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 px-4" onClick={onClose}>
      <div
        className="w-full max-w-sm bg-white rounded-3xl overflow-hidden max-h-[80vh] overflow-y-auto"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className="bg-brand-pink px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0">
          <h3 className="text-white font-bold">Session History</h3>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-white hover:opacity-80" aria-label="Close">
            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5">
              <path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" strokeLinecap="round" />
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="p-5">
          {Object.keys(byGroomer).length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-zinc-400 text-center py-8">No completed sessions yet today.</p>
          ) : (
            Object.entries(byGroomer).map(([groomer, sessions]) => (
              <div key={groomer} className="mb-3">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setExpanded(expanded === groomer ? null : groomer)}
                  className="w-full flex items-center justify-between bg-brand-tint rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-left"
                >
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800">{groomer}</span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink">
                    {sessions.length} completed
                  </span>
                </button>
                {expanded === groomer && (
                  <ul className="mt-2 ml-2 space-y-1.5">
                    {sessions.map((s) => (
                      <li key={s.id} className="text-sm text-zinc-600 flex justify-between border-b border-pink-50 py-1.5">
                        <span>{s.petName} ({s.ownerName})</span>
                        <span className="text-zinc-400">{s.timeSlot}</span>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                )}
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\admin\pet-services\KennelStats.tsx =====

/**
 * Kennel dashboard summary.
 *
 * Boarding Management can supply aggregate physical occupancy counts, while
 * older callers can still supply per-kennel session snapshots. Supporting both
 * shapes keeps the statistics component compatible with earlier screens.
 */
type KennelStatSession = {
  stage: "booked" | "checked_in" | "checked_out" | "cancelled";
};

type KennelStatItem = {
  session: KennelStatSession | null;
};

type KennelStatsProps =
  | { kennels: KennelStatItem[] }
  | { small: number; big: number; occupied: number };

export default function KennelStats(props: KennelStatsProps) {
  let total: number;
  let inProgress: number;
  let scheduled: number;
  let available: number;

  if ("kennels" in props) {
    // Backward-compatible input: one item per physical kennel.
    total = props.kennels.length;
    inProgress = props.kennels.filter((k) => k.session?.stage === "checked_in").length;
    scheduled = props.kennels.filter((k) => k.session?.stage === "booked").length;
    available = props.kennels.filter((k) => !k.session).length;
  } else {
    // Current Boarding Management passes physical capacity and the count of
    // unique occupied kennel IDs, not the number of checked-in pets. This
    // correctly counts two pets sharing one kennel as one occupied kennel.
    total = props.small + props.big;
    inProgress = props.occupied;
    scheduled = 0; // Future reservations are not physical occupancy.
    available = Math.max(0, total - inProgress);
  }

  const cards = [
    { label: "Total Kennels", value: total, dot: null, extra: "ðŸ " },
    { label: "In progress", value: inProgress, dot: "bg-red-500" },
    { label: "Scheduled", value: scheduled, dot: "bg-yellow-400" },
    { label: "Available Kennels", value: available, dot: "bg-green-500" },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:grid-cols-4">
      {cards.map((card) => (
        <div key={card.label} className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white px-5 py-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-700">{card.label}</span>
            {card.dot ? (
              <span className={`h-3 w-3 rounded-full ${card.dot}`} />
            ) : (
              <span aria-hidden>{card.extra}</span>
            )}
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-zinc-900">{card.value}</p>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\admin\pet-services\ProgressTimeline.tsx =====

import type { SessionStage } from "@/lib/data/grooming-sessions-mock";

const steps: { key: SessionStage; label: string }[] = [
  { key: "scheduled", label: "Scheduled" },
  { key: "in_progress", label: "In Progress" },
  { key: "completed", label: "Completed" },
];

export default function ProgressTimeline({ stage }: { stage: SessionStage }) {
  const currentIndex = steps.findIndex((s) => s.key === stage);

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center">
      {steps.map((step, i) => {
        const isDone = i <= currentIndex;
        const isLast = i === steps.length - 1;
        return (
          <div key={step.key} className="flex items-center flex-1 last:flex-none">
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
              <div
                className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center border-2 ${
                  isDone ? "bg-brand-pink border-brand-pink text-white" : "border-brand-pink-light text-brand-pink-light"
                }`}
              >
                {isDone ? (
                  <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3">
                    <path d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
                  </svg>
                ) : (
                  <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-current" />
                )}
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-zinc-500 whitespace-nowrap">{step.label}</span>
            </div>
            {!isLast && (
              <div className={`flex-1 h-0.5 mx-1 ${i < currentIndex ? "bg-brand-pink" : "bg-brand-pink-light"}`} />
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
// Session detail modal. Actions change depending on stage:
//   scheduled    -> Cancel Session | Start Session
//   in_progress  -> Cancel Session | Mark as Completed (-> payment step)
//   [payment]    -> Cancel | Confirm Payment (-> completes the session)
//   completed    -> celebratory message, no actions
import { useState } from "react";
import type { GroomingSession, SessionStage } from "@/lib/data/grooming-sessions-mock";
import ProgressTimeline from "./ProgressTimeline";

function Section({ title, icon, children }: { title: string; icon: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="mt-5">
      <h4 className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-bold text-brand-pink">
        <span aria-hidden>{icon}</span> {title}
      </h4>
      <div className="mt-2">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Row({ label, value }: { label: string; value: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex justify-between text-sm py-1">
      <span className="text-zinc-500">{label}</span>
      <span className="text-zinc-800 font-medium text-right">{value || "â€”"}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

function Pill({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <span className="inline-block bg-brand-tint text-brand-pink text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-1 rounded-full mr-2 mb-2">
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

const stageBadge: Record<SessionStage, string> = {
  scheduled: "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700",
  in_progress: "bg-red-100 text-red-600",
  completed: "bg-green-100 text-green-700",
  cancelled: "bg-zinc-200 text-zinc-500",
};
const stageLabel: Record<SessionStage, string> = {
  scheduled: "Scheduled",
  in_progress: "Progress",
  completed: "Completed",
  cancelled: "Cancelled",
};

export default function SessionDetailModal({
  session,
  onClose,
  onUpdateStage,
}: {
  session: GroomingSession;
  onClose: () => void;
  onUpdateStage: (id: string, stage: SessionStage, startedAt?: string) => void;
}) {
  const [showPayment, setShowPayment] = useState(false);
  const addOnsTotal = session.addOns.reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.price, 0);
  const total = session.servicePrice + addOnsTotal;

  function handleStart() {
    const now = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" });
    onUpdateStage(session.id, "in_progress", now);
  }

  function handleConfirmPayment() {
    onUpdateStage(session.id, "completed");
    setShowPayment(false);
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 px-4" onClick={onClose}>
      <div
        className="w-full max-w-md bg-white rounded-3xl overflow-hidden max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className="bg-brand-pink px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0">
          <h3 className="text-white font-bold">
            {showPayment ? "Confirm Payment" : "Session Details"}
          </h3>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-white hover:opacity-80" aria-label="Close">
            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5">
              <path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" strokeLinecap="round" />
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>

        {showPayment ? (
          // --- Payment confirmation step ---
          <div className="px-6 py-6">
            <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500 text-center">Session Quotation</p>
            <div className="mt-4 bg-brand-tint rounded-2xl p-4">
              <Row label="Pet" value={`${session.petName} (${session.ownerName})`} />
              <Row label="Service" value={session.services.join(" â€” ")} />
              <Row label="Price" value={`â‚±${session.servicePrice.toLocaleString()}`} />
              <Row label="Add Ons" value={`â‚±${addOnsTotal.toLocaleString()}`} />
              <div className="flex justify-between text-base py-2 border-t border-pink-200 mt-1 pt-2">
                <span className="font-bold text-brand-pink">Total Due</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-brand-pink">â‚±{total.toLocaleString()}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-6 flex gap-3">
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowPayment(false)}
                className="flex-1 border-2 border-zinc-300 text-zinc-500 font-semibold text-sm py-2.5 rounded-full hover:border-zinc-400 transition-colors"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleConfirmPayment}
                className="flex-1 bg-green-500 hover:bg-green-600 text-white font-semibold text-sm py-2.5 rounded-full transition-colors"
              >
                Confirm Payment
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="px-6 pb-6">
            <Section title="Progress Timeline" icon="ðŸ“ˆ">
              <ProgressTimeline stage={session.stage} />
            </Section>

            <Section title="Sessions Information" icon="ðŸ“‹">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center py-1">
                <span className="text-sm text-zinc-500">Status</span>
                <span className={`text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-1 rounded-full ${stageBadge[session.stage]}`}>
                  {stageLabel[session.stage]}
                </span>
              </div>
              <Row label="Owner Name" value={session.ownerName} />
              <Row label="Contact No." value={session.ownerContact} />
              <Row label="Address" value={session.ownerAddress} />
              <Row label="Pet Name" value={session.petName} />
