===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\admin\pos\walk-in\AlaCarteSelectionStep.tsx =====

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import { fetchAddonsByCategory } from "@/lib/supabase/services";
import { normalizeAddonName, chosenAddonNamesByPet } from "@/lib/booking/unique-pet-addons";
import type { BookingLeg } from "@/lib/types/booking-leg";
import type { Addon, AddonPrice } from "@/lib/types/services";
import type { Pet, DraftPetSelection } from "@/lib/types/appointments";

function normalizedSize(value: string) {
  return value.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
}
function priceForPet(rows: AddonPrice[], addonId: string, petSize: string): number | null {
  const relevant = rows.filter(row => row.addon_id === addonId);
  const size = normalizedSize(petSize);
  const exact = relevant.find(row => normalizedSize(row.size_label) === size);
  const large = /^(large|extralarge|2xextralarge|xl|2xl|xxl)$/.test(size);
  const preferred = large
    ? relevant.find(row => ["large", "largesize"].includes(normalizedSize(row.size_label)))
    : relevant.find(row => ["smallmedium", "small", "medium"].includes(normalizedSize(row.size_label)));
  const universal = relevant.find(row => ["all", "allsize", "allsizes", "standard", "fixed"].includes(normalizedSize(row.size_label)));
  const value = Number((exact ?? preferred ?? universal)?.price);
  return (exact || preferred || universal) && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 ? value : null;
}

export default function AlaCarteSelectionStep({ pets, selections, completedLegs = [], onChange, onBack, onNext }: {
  pets: Pet[];
  selections: DraftPetSelection[];
  completedLegs?: BookingLeg[];
  onChange: (selections: DraftPetSelection[]) => void;
  onBack: () => void;
  onNext: () => void;
}) {
  const [addons, setAddons] = useState<Addon[]>([]);
  const [prices, setPrices] = useState<AddonPrice[]>([]);
  const [serviceAddons, setServiceAddons] = useState<Record<string, Addon[]>>({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setLoadError(null);
    try {
      const [ala, grooming, boarding] = await Promise.all([
        fetchAddonsByCategory("Ala Carte"), fetchAddonsByCategory("Grooming Add-ons"), fetchAddonsByCategory("Boarding Add-ons"),
      ]);
      const failure = ala.error || grooming.error || boarding.error;
      if (failure) throw new Error(failure);
      setAddons(ala.addons.filter(a => a.is_active));
      setPrices(ala.prices);
      setServiceAddons({ ala_carte: ala.addons, dog_grooming: grooming.addons, cat_grooming: grooming.addons,
        grooming: grooming.addons, boarding: boarding.addons });
    } catch (error) {
      setLoadError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unable to load Ã€ La Carte prices.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { void loadData(); }, [loadData]);

  const takenByPet = useMemo(() => chosenAddonNamesByPet(completedLegs, serviceAddons), [completedLegs, serviceAddons]);
  const selectionFor = (pet: Pet) => selections.find(s => s.pet.id === pet.id);
  const isTaken = (pet: Pet, addon: Addon) => takenByPet[pet.id]?.has(normalizeAddonName(addon.name)) ?? false;

  function toggleAddon(pet: Pet, addonId: string) {
    const addon = addons.find(item => item.id === addonId);
    if (!addon) return;
    if (isTaken(pet, addon)) {
      setNotice(`${addon.name} is unavailable for ${pet.name} because it is already selected in another service.`);
      return;
    }
    setNotice(null);
    const existing = selectionFor(pet);
    const base: DraftPetSelection = existing ?? { pet, packageId: null, packagePricingId: null, sizeId: null, kennelId: null, groomerId: null, addonIds: [], lineAmount: 0 };
    const addonIds = base.addonIds.includes(addonId) ? base.addonIds.filter(id => id !== addonId) : [...base.addonIds, addonId];
    const amounts = addonIds.map(id => priceForPet(prices, id, pet.size_label));
    if (amounts.some(amount => amount === null)) return;
    const lineAmount = amounts.reduce<number>((total, amount) => total + (amount ?? 0), 0);
    onChange([...selections.filter(s => s.pet.id !== pet.id), { ...base, addonIds, lineAmount }]);
  }
  const ready = pets.length > 0 && pets.every(pet => {
    const selected = selectionFor(pet);
    return !!selected?.addonIds.length && selected.addonIds.every(id => {
      const addon = addons.find(row => row.id === id);
      return !!addon && !isTaken(pet, addon) && priceForPet(prices, id, pet.size_label) !== null;
    });
  });

  if (loading) return <p className="py-16 text-center text-zinc-400">Loading add-onsâ€¦</p>;
  return <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl">
    <h2 className="text-center text-2xl font-bold text-brand-pink">Ã€ La Carte</h2>
    <p className="mt-1 text-center text-sm text-zinc-500">Choose individual services for each pet. Services already selected for that pet cannot be charged twice.</p>
    {loadError && <p role="alert" className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-700">{loadError}. Please retry.</p>}
    {!loadError && addons.length === 0 && <p className="mt-10 text-center text-zinc-400">No Ã€ La Carte items available right now.</p>}
    {!loadError && pets.map(pet => {
      const selected = selectionFor(pet);
      return <div key={pet.id} className="mt-6">
        <p className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-800">{pet.name} <span className="font-normal text-zinc-400">({pet.size_label})</span></p>
        <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">{addons.map(addon => {
          const price = priceForPet(prices, addon.id, pet.size_label);
          const taken = isTaken(pet, addon);
          const active = !taken && (selected?.addonIds.includes(addon.id) ?? false);
          const unavailable = taken || price === null;
          return <button type="button" key={addon.id} disabled={unavailable} aria-disabled={unavailable}
            title={taken ? `Already selected for ${pet.name} in Grooming or Boarding` : price === null ? "Price unavailable for this size" : undefined}
            onClick={() => toggleAddon(pet, addon.id)}
            className={`rounded-xl border-2 px-3 py-2.5 text-left text-xs ${unavailable ? "cursor-not-allowed border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500" : active ? "border-brand-pink bg-brand-pink text-white" : "border-pink-100 text-zinc-700 hover:border-pink-200"}`}>
            <span className="block font-semibold">{addon.name}</span>
            <span className={`mt-1 block ${active ? "text-white/80" : "text-zinc-500"}`}>{taken ? "Unavailable Â· already selected for this pet" : price === null ? "Price unavailable for this size" : `â‚±${price.toLocaleString("en-PH")}`}</span>
            {addon.price_note && <span className="mt-1 block italic opacity-75">{addon.price_note}</span>}
          </button>;
        })}</div>
        {selected && selected.addonIds.length > 0 && <p className="mt-2 text-right text-sm font-bold text-brand-pink">Subtotal: â‚±{selected.lineAmount.toLocaleString("en-PH")}</p>}
      </div>;
    })}
    <div className="mt-8 flex gap-3">
      <button type="button" onClick={onBack} className="flex-1 rounded-full border-2 border-zinc-300 py-2.5 font-semibold text-zinc-500">Back</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={onNext} disabled={!ready || !!loadError} className="flex-1 rounded-full bg-brand-pink py-2.5 font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-40">Next</button>
    </div>
    {notice && <div role="alertdialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Service unavailable" className="fixed inset-0 z-[200] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/55 p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-3xl bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl"><h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-amber-800">Service Unavailable</h3><p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-zinc-700">{notice}</p>
        <button type="button" autoFocus onClick={() => setNotice(null)} className="mt-5 w-full rounded-full bg-brand-pink px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-white">OK</button></div>
    </div>}
  </div>;
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { fetchPackagesFull, fetchAddonsByCategory } from "@/lib/supabase/services";
import { blockingReason, hasFreeBathDry, isBathDry, boardingBathDryPrice } from "@/lib/booking/boarding-promotions";
import { MIN_EXTENDED_BOARDING_NIGHTS, MAX_BOARDING_NIGHTS, extendedBoardingNightError,
  isExtendedBoardingRate, parseExtendedBoardingNights } from "@/lib/booking/boarding-duration";
import type { Package, PackagePricing, Addon, AddonPrice } from "@/lib/types/services";
import type { Pet, DraftPetSelection } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import { validShareGroup, shareError, shareGroups, withSharedKennelPrices, type ShareSelection } from "@/lib/booking/boarding-share";
import FeedbackDialog from "@/components/admin/operations/FeedbackDialog";

type KennelSize = "small" | "big";
function petTier(pet: Pet): "small" | "medium" | "large" | null {
  const size = (pet.size_label ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (size === "small") return "small";
  if (size === "medium") return "medium";
  if (/large|^(?:[2-9]xl|x{1,5}l)$/.test(size)) return "large";
  return null;
}
function fixedNights(rate: PackagePricing): number | null {
  if (isExtendedBoardingRate(rate)) return null;
  if (rate.nights != null && Number.isSafeInteger(rate.nights) && rate.nights > 0) return rate.nights;
  const match = `${rate.size_detail ?? ""} ${rate.size_label}`.match(/(\d+)\s*nights?/i);
  return match ? Number(match[1]) : null;
}

export default function BoardingSelectionStep({ pets, selections, onChange, scheduledDate: _scheduledDate, onBack,
  onNext, alreadyGroomedPetIds = [], combined = false, onPrepared }: {
  pets: Pet[];
  selections: DraftPetSelection[];
  onChange: (items: DraftPetSelection[]) => void;
  scheduledDate: string | null;
  onBack: () => void;
  onNext: () => void;
  alreadyGroomedPetIds?: string[];
  combined?: boolean;
  onPrepared?: (pricing: PackagePricing[], valid: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const [packages, setPackages] = useState<Package[]>([]);
  const [pricing, setPricing] = useState<PackagePricing[]>([]);
  const [addons, setAddons] = useState<Addon[]>([]);
  const [addonPrices, setAddonPrices] = useState<AddonPrice[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [shareTargets, setShareTargets] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [shareNotice, setShareNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [blocker, setBlocker] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [custom, setCustom] = useState<Record<string, string>>(() => Object.fromEntries(
    selections.filter(s => s.boardingNights != null).map(s => [s.pet.id, String(s.boardingNights)])
  ));
  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const [result, extra] = await Promise.all([fetchPackagesFull("boarding"), fetchAddonsByCategory("Boarding Add-ons")]);
      if (result.error || extra.error) throw new Error(result.error || extra.error || "Unable to load boarding services");
      setPackages(result.packages.filter((p) => p.is_active));
      setPricing(result.pricing);
      setAddons(extra.addons.filter((p) => p.is_active));
      setAddonPrices(extra.prices);
    } catch (err) { setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not load boarding pricing"); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { void load(); }, [load]);
  const forPet = (pet: Pet) => selections.find((s) => s.pet.id === pet.id);
  const rateFor = (s?: DraftPetSelection) => pricing.find((r) => r.id === s?.packagePricingId);
  const nightsFor = (s?: DraftPetSelection) => s?.boardingNights ?? (rateFor(s) ? fixedNights(rateFor(s)!) : null);
  function addonPrice(id: string, pet: Pet) {
    const addon = addons.find((a) => a.id === id);
    return addon && isBathDry(addon.name) ? boardingBathDryPrice(pet.size_label)
      : addonPrices.find((p) => p.addon_id === id)?.price ?? 0;
  }
  function recalculate(s: DraftPetSelection): DraftPetSelection {
    const rate = rateFor(s);
    const nights = nightsFor(s);
    if (rate && isExtendedBoardingRate(rate) && parseExtendedBoardingNights(nights) === null) return { ...s, lineAmount: 0 };
    const usable = s.addonIds.filter((id) => {
      const addon = addons.find((a) => a.id === id);
      return addon && !blockingReason(addon.name, nights, alreadyGroomedPetIds.includes(s.pet.id));
    });
    const base = rate ? rate.price * (isExtendedBoardingRate(rate) ? nights ?? 0 : 1) : 0;
    return { ...s, addonIds: usable, lineAmount: base + usable.reduce((n, id) => n + addonPrice(id, s.pet), 0) };
  }
  function update(pet: Pet, patch: Partial<DraftPetSelection>) {
    const original: DraftPetSelection = forPet(pet) ?? { pet, packageId: null, packagePricingId: null,
      sizeId: null, kennelId: null, groomerId: null, addonIds: [], lineAmount: 0 };
    const changed = (patch.boardingKennelSize !== undefined && patch.boardingKennelSize !== original.boardingKennelSize) ||
      (patch.packagePricingId !== undefined && patch.packagePricingId !== original.packagePricingId) ||
      ("boardingNights" in patch && patch.boardingNights !== original.boardingNights);
    const next = recalculate({ ...original, ...patch, ...(changed ? {
      boardingScheduledDate: null, boardingDropOffAt: null, boardingPickUpAt: null, kennelId: null,
    } : {}) });
    let all = [...selections.filter((s) => s.pet.id !== pet.id), next] as ShareSelection[];
    const previousGroup = (original as ShareSelection).boardingShareGroupId;
    // Changing a shared pet's kennel/package/duration dissolves the old group;
    // editing add-ons keeps the group and recalculates the single base charge.
    if (changed && previousGroup) {
      all = all.map(s => s.boardingShareGroupId === previousGroup
        ? { ...s, boardingShareGroupId: null } : s);
      setShareNotice("The shared kennel was removed because its package or duration changed. You can create the group again below.");
    }
    onChange(withSharedKennelPrices(all.map(recalculate), pricing));
  }
  function chooseSize(pet: Pet, size: KennelSize) {
    if (size === "small" && !["small", "medium"].includes(petTier(pet) ?? "")) return;
    const pkg = packages.find((p) => p.name.toLowerCase().includes(size === "small" ? "small" : "big"));
    update(pet, { boardingKennelSize: size, packageId: pkg?.id ?? null, packagePricingId: null,
      boardingNights: null, addonIds: [] });
  }
  function chooseRate(pet: Pet, rate: PackagePricing) {
    const nights = isExtendedBoardingRate(rate) ? parseExtendedBoardingNights(custom[pet.id]) : fixedNights(rate);
    update(pet, { packageId: rate.package_id, packagePricingId: rate.id, boardingNights: nights });
  }
  function changeNights(pet: Pet, value: string) {
    setCustom((prev) => ({ ...prev, [pet.id]: value }));
    update(pet, { boardingNights: parseExtendedBoardingNights(value) });
  }
  function toggle(pet: Pet, id: string) {
    const s = forPet(pet); if (!s) return;
    const rate = rateFor(s);
    if (rate && isExtendedBoardingRate(rate) && parseExtendedBoardingNights(s.boardingNights) === null) return;
    update(pet, { addonIds: s.addonIds.includes(id) ? s.addonIds.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...s.addonIds, id] });
  }
  function createGroup() {
    const group = selections.filter(s => shareTargets.includes(s.pet.id)) as ShareSelection[];
    if (!validShareGroup(group)) {
      setBlocker("A shared Big kennel allows 2 Small pets, Small + Medium, Medium + Medium, or 3 Small pets. Select the same Big-kennel package and duration for every pet in the group.");
      return;
    }
    if (group.some(s => (s as ShareSelection).boardingShareGroupId)) {
      setBlocker("A selected pet already shares a kennel. Select Separate pets for that group before choosing a new arrangement.");
      return;
    }
    const groupId = `share:${group.map(s => s.pet.id).sort().join(":")}`;
    const next = (selections as ShareSelection[]).map(s => shareTargets.includes(s.pet.id)
      ? { ...s, boardingShareGroupId: groupId } : s);
    onChange(withSharedKennelPrices(next.map(recalculate), pricing));
    setShareTargets([]);
    setShareNotice("Shared Big kennel selected. One kennel base rate will be charged for this group; per-pet add-ons remain separate.");
  }
  function removeGroup(groupId: string) {
    const next = (selections as ShareSelection[]).map(s => s.boardingShareGroupId === groupId
      ? { ...s, boardingShareGroupId: null } : s);
    onChange(next.map(recalculate));
    setShareNotice("Sharing removed; each pet has its own kennel base charge again.");
  }
  const selectedGroups = shareGroups(selections as ShareSelection[]);
  const currentShareError = shareError(selections as ShareSelection[]);
  const valid = !error && !currentShareError && pets.length > 0 && pets.every((pet) => {
    const s = forPet(pet), rate = rateFor(s), nights = nightsFor(s);
    return !!s && !!petTier(pet) && !!s.boardingKennelSize &&
      !(s.boardingKennelSize === "small" && !["small", "medium"].includes(petTier(pet) ?? "")) &&
      !!rate && rate.package_id === s.packageId &&
      typeof nights === "number" && Number.isSafeInteger(nights) && nights > 0 && nights <= MAX_BOARDING_NIGHTS &&
      (!isExtendedBoardingRate(rate) || parseExtendedBoardingNights(nights) !== null);
  });
  useEffect(() => { onPrepared?.(pricing, valid && !loading); }, [onPrepared, pricing, valid, loading]);
  if (loading) return <p className="py-10 text-center text-zinc-500">Loading boarding packagesâ€¦</p>;
  return <section className="mx-auto max-w-3xl">
    <h2 className="text-center text-xl font-bold text-brand-pink">Pet Hotel / Boarding</h2>
    <p className="mt-2 text-center text-sm text-zinc-600">Step 1 of 2 â€” choose the kennel and duration for each pet. Next, check availability for the <strong>entire stay</strong> in the Dates step.</p>
    <p className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-pink-50 p-4 text-xs leading-5 text-zinc-700">Each Small kennel accepts one Small <b>or Medium</b> pet. Sharing one Big kennel is available for 2 Small, Small + Medium, Medium + Medium, or three Small pets. All other pets use separate kennels. Live capacity is verified using active kennels for the entire stay. Free Bath & Dry begins at four nights.</p>
    {pets.map((pet) => {

      const rates = size ? packages.filter((p) => p.name.toLowerCase().includes(size === "small" ? "small" : "big"))
        .flatMap((p) => pricing.filter((r) => r.package_id === p.id)).sort((a, b) => (fixedNights(a) ?? 999) - (fixedNights(b) ?? 999)) : [];
      const rate = rateFor(s), nights = nightsFor(s), extended = !!rate && isExtendedBoardingRate(rate);

"use client";
// First screen of the walk-in flow: confirm whether this is an existing
// customer (search real customers table) or someone new (no account,
// just a name/contact/address for this booking). Doesn't create
// anything yet â€” just decides which path Pet Information takes later.
import { useState } from "react";
import { searchCustomers } from "@/lib/supabase/appointments";
import type { Customer } from "@/lib/types/users";

export default function CustomerVerifyStep({
  onSelectExisting,
  onNewCustomer,
}: {
  onSelectExisting: (customer: Customer) => void;
  onNewCustomer: () => void;
}) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [results, setResults] = useState<Customer[]>([]);
  const [searching, setSearching] = useState(false);
  const [searched, setSearched] = useState(false);

  async function handleSearch(value: string) {
    setQuery(value);
    if (!value.trim()) { setResults([]); setSearched(false); return; }
    setSearching(true);
    const { customers, error } = await searchCustomers(value);
    setSearching(false);
    setSearched(true);
    if (!error) setResults(customers as Customer[]);
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-lg mx-auto">
      <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-brand-pink text-center">Verify Customer</h2>
      <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500 text-center">Search for an existing account, or start a new booking.</p>

export type NewPetEntry = { name: string; species: "Dog" | "Cat"; breed: string; sizeKg: string; age: string; sex: "Male" | "Female" | "" };
const emptyPet = (): NewPetEntry => ({ name: "", species: "Dog", breed: "", sizeKg: "", age: "", sex: "" });
const phoneError = (value: string) => !value ? "Contact number is required." : !/^\d+$/.test(value) ? "Use numbers only for the contact number." : value.length !== 11 ? "Enter exactly 11 digits (09XXXXXXXXX)." : !/^09\d{9}$/.test(value) ? "Mobile number must start with 09." : null;
function petError(pet: NewPetEntry, index: number): string | null {
  const label = `Pet ${index + 1}`;
  if (!pet.name.trim()) return `${label}: Enter the pet's name.`;
  if (!pet.breed.trim()) return `${label}: Enter or select a breed.`;
  if (!pet.sizeKg.trim()) return `${label}: Enter the pet's weight in kilograms.`;
  const weight = Number(pet.sizeKg);
  if (!Number.isFinite(weight) || weight <= 0 || weight > 200) return `${label}: Weight must be greater than 0 and no more than 200 kg.`;
  if (normalizePetAge(pet.age) === null) return `${label}: Enter an age such as 3 weeks, 6 months, or 2 years, or leave it blank.`;
  return null;
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\admin\pos\walk-in\PetInformationStep.tsx =====

"use client";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import BookingPetInformationStep from "@/components/dashboard/booking/BookingPetInformationStep";
import { addPet, fetchPetsByCustomer, weightKgToSizeTier } from "@/lib/supabase/appointments";
import { normalizePetAge } from "@/lib/utils/pet-age";
import type { Pet } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { Customer } from "@/lib/types/users";
import NewCustomerPetForm, { type NewPetEntry } from "./NewCustomerPetForm";

export default function PetInformationStep({ customer, onBack, onNext }: {
  customer: Customer | null; onBack: () => void;
  onNext: (pets: Pet[], ownerOverride?: { name: string; contact: string; address: string }) => void;
}) {
  const [pets, setPets] = useState<Pet[]>([]);
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(Boolean(customer));
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const loadPets = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!customer) return;
    setLoading(true);setError(null);
    try {
      const result = await fetchPetsByCustomer(customer.id);
      if (result.error) {setError(result.error);return;}
      setPets(result.pets);
      setSelectedIds(ids=>ids.filter(id=>result.pets.some(p=>p.id===id)));
    } catch (caught) { setError(caught instanceof Error?caught.message:"Unable to load this customer's pets."); }
    finally {setLoading(false);}
  },[customer]);
  useEffect(()=>{if(customer)void loadPets();},[customer,loadPets]);
  async function handleNewCustomerSubmit(owner: {name:string;contact:string;address:string}, entries:NewPetEntry[]) {
    if(saving)return;
    setSaving(true);setError(null);
    const savedPets:Pet[]=[];
    try {
      for(const entry of entries){
        const weight=Number(entry.sizeKg);
        const age=normalizePetAge(entry.age);
        if(!age)throw new Error(`Invalid age for ${entry.name}.`);
        const {data,error:petError}=await addPet({
          customer_id:null,name:entry.name,species:entry.species,breed:entry.breed,
          size_label:weightKgToSizeTier(weight),owner_name:owner.name,owner_contact:owner.contact,
          ...age,sex:entry.sex||null,
        });
        if(petError||!data){setError(`Saved ${savedPets.length} of ${entries.length} pets, then failed: ${petError?.message??"No pet record returned"}`);return;}
        savedPets.push(data as Pet);
      }
      onNext(savedPets,owner);
    }catch(e){setError(e instanceof Error?e.message:"Unable to register the new pets.");}
    finally{setSaving(false);}
  }
  if(!customer)return <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl">{error&&<p role="alert" className="mb-4 rounded-xl bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700">{error}</p>}{saving&&<p role="status" className="mb-3 text-center text-sm text-zinc-500">Saving pet recordsâ€¦</p>}<NewCustomerPetForm onBack={onBack} onNext={handleNewCustomerSubmit}/></div>;
  if(loading)return <p role="status" className="py-16 text-center text-sm text-zinc-500">Loading registered petsâ€¦</p>;
  return <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-4xl">{error&&<div role="alert" className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-red-100 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700"><span>{error}</span><button type="button" onClick={()=>void loadPets()} className="font-semibold underline">Retry</button></div>}
    <BookingPetInformationStep customer={customer} pets={pets} onPetsChange={setPets} selectedIds={selectedIds} onSelectionChange={setSelectedIds} onBack={onBack} onNext={()=>{const chosen=pets.filter(p=>selectedIds.includes(p.id));if(chosen.length)onNext(chosen);}}/>
  </div>;
}

import type { WalkInDraft } from "@/lib/types/walk-in-draft";
import { toAppointmentServiceType } from "@/lib/types/walk-in-draft";
import type { Package, PetSize, Addon } from "@/lib/types/services";
import type { Groomer, Kennel } from "@/lib/types/pet-services";

function formatDate(dateStr: string | null): string {
  if (!dateStr) return "â€”";
  return new Date(dateStr + "T00:00:00").toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" });
}
function formatDateTime(iso: string | null): string {
  if (!iso) return "â€”";
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" });
}
function formatTime12h(time: string | null): string {
  if (!time) return "â€”";
  const [h, m] = time.split(":").map(Number);
  return `${h % 12 || 12}:${String(m).padStart(2, "0")} ${h >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM"}`;
}

export default function SummaryStep({
  draft, packages, sizes, addons, groomers, onBack, onDone,
}: {
  draft: WalkInDraft;
  packages: Package[];
  sizes: PetSize[];
  addons: Addon[];
  groomers: Groomer[];
  kennels: Kennel[];
  onBack: () => void;
  onDone: () => void;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const submitLock = useRef(false);

  const isBoarding = draft.serviceChoice === "boarding";
  const totalAmount = draft.petSelections.reduce((sum, sel) => sum + sel.lineAmount, 0);

  function buildAppointment(
    service_type: "dog_grooming" | "cat_grooming" | "boarding" | "ala_carte",
    petSelections: typeof draft.petSelections,
  ): CreateAppointmentInput {
    return {
      service_type,
      is_walk_in: true,
      customer_id: draft.customer?.id ?? null,
      owner_name: draft.ownerName,
      owner_contact: draft.ownerContact,
      owner_address: draft.ownerAddress || null,
      scheduled_date: draft.scheduledDate ?? "",
      scheduled_time: isBoarding ? null : draft.scheduledTime,
      drop_off_at: isBoarding ? draft.dropOffAt : null,
      pick_up_at: isBoarding ? draft.pickUpAt : null,
      special_requests: draft.specialRequests || null,
      petSelections,
    };
  }

  async function handleComplete() {
    if (submitLock.current || saved) return;
    if (!draft.serviceChoice || !draft.scheduledDate || draft.petSelections.length === 0) return;
    submitLock.current = true;
    setSaving(true);
    setError(null);

    const writes: CreateAppointmentInput[] = [];
    if (
      draft.serviceChoice === "grooming" ||
      draft.serviceChoice === "dog_grooming" ||
      draft.serviceChoice === "cat_grooming"
    ) {
      // Mixed Dog/Cat grooming keeps two species-specific appointments,
      // but both commit together in the same database transaction.
      const dogSelections = draft.petSelections.filter((s) => s.pet.species === "Dog");
      const catSelections = draft.petSelections.filter((s) => s.pet.species === "Cat");
      if (dogSelections.length) writes.push(buildAppointment("dog_grooming", dogSelections));
      if (catSelections.length) writes.push(buildAppointment("cat_grooming", catSelections));
    } else {
      writes.push(buildAppointment(toAppointmentServiceType(draft.serviceChoice), draft.petSelections));
    }

    try {
      const { error: err } = await createAppointmentsAtomic(writes);
      if (err) {
        setError(`The appointment was not completed: ${err}`);
        submitLock.current = false;
        return;
      }
      setSaved(true);
      // Keep the lock on success to avoid duplicate submissions.
    } catch (unexpected) {
      setError(unexpected instanceof Error ? unexpected.message : "Unexpected booking error. Check existing appointments before trying again.");
      submitLock.current = false;
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  if (saved) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-md py-16 text-center">
        <div className="mx-auto flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-emerald-100">

        </div>
        <h2 className="mt-4 text-xl font-bold text-zinc-800">Booking Complete</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500">Both pets have been included in the booking.</p>
        <button onClick={() => router.push("/admin/pos")} className="mt-6 w-full rounded-full bg-brand-pink py-2.5 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-brand-pink-dark">Back to POS</button>
      </div>
    );
  }

      <h2 className="text-center text-2xl font-bold text-brand-pink">{isBoarding ? "Check your Appointment" : "Confirm Transaction"}</h2>
      <p className="mt-1 text-center text-sm text-zinc-500">Review your order before completing the booking.</p>

      <div className="mt-5 rounded-2xl border-2 border-pink-100 p-5">

          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-brand-pink">Owner Information</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600">Name: {draft.ownerName || "â€”"}</p>
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">Contact No: {draft.ownerContact || "â€”"}</p>
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">Address: {draft.ownerAddress || "â€”"}</p>
        </div>

        {draft.petSelections.map((sel) => {
          const pkg = packages.find((p) => p.id === sel.packageId);
          const size = sizes.find((s) => s.id === sel.sizeId);
          const groomer = groomers.find((g) => g.id === sel.groomerId);
          const petAddons = sel.addonIds.map((id) => addons.find((a) => a.id === id)?.name).filter(Boolean);
          return (
            <div key={sel.pet.id} className="border-b border-dashed border-pink-200 py-3 last:border-b-0">
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-brand-pink">Pet Information</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600">Name: {sel.pet.name}</p>
              <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">Breed: {sel.pet.breed}</p>
              <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">Species: {sel.pet.species}</p>
              <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">Size: {sel.pet.size_label}</p>
              <p className="mt-2 text-xs font-bold text-brand-pink">Services</p>
              {isBoarding ? (
                <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">Kennel Size: {sel.boardingKennelSize === "small" ? "Small" : sel.boardingKennelSize === "big" ? "Big" : "â€”"}</p>
              ) : (

"use client";

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { createAppointmentsAtomic, type CreateAppointmentInput } from "@/lib/supabase/appointments";
import { checkBookingClosedDate } from "@/lib/supabase/booking-closures";
import { isGrooming, verifyGroomingLegPlans, type ScheduledGroomingSelection } from "@/lib/supabase/grooming-booking";
import type { Customer } from "@/lib/types/users";
import type { BookingLeg } from "@/lib/types/booking-leg";
import type { AppointmentServiceType, DraftPetSelection } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { Package, PetSize, Addon } from "@/lib/types/services";
import type { Groomer } from "@/lib/types/pet-services";

type Props = {
  customer: Customer | null;
  owner: { name: string; contact: string; address: string };
  legs: BookingLeg[];
  packagesByService: Record<string, Package[]>;
  sizesByService: Record<string, PetSize[]>;
  addonsByService: Record<string, Addon[]>;
  groomers: Groomer[];
  onBack: () => void;
  onEditLeg: (id: string) => void;
  onDone: () => void;
};
const labels: Record<string, string> = { grooming: "Grooming", dog_grooming: "Dog Grooming", cat_grooming: "Cat Grooming", boarding: "Boarding", ala_carte: "Ã€ La Carte" };
const prettyTime = (time?: string | null) => {
  if (!time || !/^\d{2}:\d{2}/.test(time)) return "â€”";
  const [h, m] = time.split(":").map(Number);
  return `${h % 12 || 12}:${String(m).padStart(2, "0")} ${h >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM"}`;
};

export default function WalkInMultiServiceSummary({
  customer, owner, legs, packagesByService, sizesByService, addonsByService, groomers,
  onBack, onEditLeg, onDone,
}: Props) {
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [approved, setApproved] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const lock = useRef(false);
  const hasGrooming = legs.some(l => isGrooming(l.serviceChoice));
  const total = legs.reduce((sum, leg) => sum + leg.petSelections.reduce((n, s) => n + Number(s.lineAmount || 0), 0), 0);

  function makeInput(leg: BookingLeg, service: AppointmentServiceType, pets: DraftPetSelection[], start: string | null): CreateAppointmentInput {
    return {
      service_type: service, is_walk_in: true, customer_id: customer?.id ?? null,
      owner_name: owner.name, owner_contact: owner.contact, owner_address: owner.address || null,
      scheduled_date: leg.scheduledDate ?? "", scheduled_time: start,
      drop_off_at: null, pick_up_at: null,
      special_requests: leg.specialRequests || null, petSelections: pets,
    };
  }

  async function save() {
    if (lock.current || saving || saved || (hasGrooming && !approved)) return;
    setError(null);
    if (!owner.name.trim() || !owner.contact.trim() || !legs.length) {
      setError("Owner information and services are required."); return;
    }
    const writes: CreateAppointmentInput[] = [];
    for (const leg of legs) {
      if (!leg.petSelections.length) { setError(`Select pets for ${labels[leg.serviceChoice]}.`); return; }
      if (leg.petSelections.some(s => !Number.isFinite(Number(s.lineAmount)) || Number(s.lineAmount) < 0)) {
        setError("An amount is invalid. Edit the affected service."); return;
      }
      if (leg.serviceChoice === "boarding") {
        for (const s of leg.petSelections) {
          if (!s.boardingScheduledDate || !s.boardingDropOffAt || !s.boardingPickUpAt) {
            setError(`Complete boarding dates for ${s.pet.name}.`); return;
          }
          writes.push({ ...makeInput(leg, "boarding", [s], null),
            scheduled_date: s.boardingScheduledDate, drop_off_at: s.boardingDropOffAt, pick_up_at: s.boardingPickUpAt });
        }
      } else if (isGrooming(leg.serviceChoice)) {
        if (!leg.scheduledDate || !leg.scheduledTime) { setError("Select a grooming date and time."); return; }
        for (const s of leg.petSelections as ScheduledGroomingSelection[]) {
          if (!s.groomerId || !s.groomingScheduledTime || !s.packagePricingId) {
            setError(`Groomer reservation missing for ${s.pet.name}. Edit the schedule.`); return;
          }
          writes.push(makeInput(leg, s.pet.species === "Cat" ? "cat_grooming" : "dog_grooming", [s], s.groomingScheduledTime));
        }
      } else {
        if (!leg.scheduledDate) { setError("Select an Ã€ La Carte date."); return; }
        for (const selection of leg.petSelections) {
          const s = selection as DraftPetSelection & { alaCarteScheduledTime?: string | null };
          if (!s.addonIds?.length || Number(s.lineAmount) <= 0 || !s.groomerId || !s.alaCarteScheduledTime) {
            setError(`Choose Ã€ La Carte items, start time, and groomer for ${s.pet.name}.`); return;
          }
          // One appointment per pet: the groomer may return for another pet
          // after finishing this one, but never at overlapping times.
          writes.push(makeInput(leg, "ala_carte", [s], s.alaCarteScheduledTime));
        }
      }
    }
    lock.current = true; setSaving(true);
    try {
      for (const day of new Set(writes.map(w => w.scheduled_date))) {
        const closed = await checkBookingClosedDate(day);
        if (closed.error || closed.closed) {
          setError(closed.error || `${day} is closed (${closed.name || "Holiday / closure"}).`);
          lock.current = false; return;
        }
      }
      const problem = await verifyGroomingLegPlans(legs);
      if (problem) { setError(problem); lock.current = false; return; }
      const result = await createAppointmentsAtomic(writes);
      if (result.error) { setError(`Walk-in booking could not be saved: ${result.error}`); lock.current = false; return; }
      if (result.appointments.length !== writes.length) {
        throw new Error("Unconfirmed appointment result. Check the appointment table before retrying.");
      }
      setSaved(true);
    } catch (cause) {
      setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Unconfirmed booking result. Check the appointment table before retrying.");
    } finally { setSaving(false); }
  }

  if (saved) return <section className="mx-auto max-w-xl py-10 text-center">
    <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-700">Walk-in Booking Complete</h2>
    <p className="mt-2 text-zinc-600">All appointments were recorded together. Each pet has an individual groomer reservation and start time.</p>
    <p className="mt-3 font-semibold text-brand-pink">Total recorded: â‚±{total.toLocaleString()}</p>
    <button type="button" onClick={onDone} className="mt-5 rounded-full bg-brand-pink px-6 py-3 font-semibold text-white">Return to POS</button>
  </section>;

  return <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl">
    <h2 className="text-center text-2xl font-extrabold text-brand-pink">Walk-in Booking Summary</h2>
    <p className="mt-1 text-center text-sm text-zinc-500">Review each pet, groomer, appointment time and total before saving.</p>
    <div className="mt-5 space-y-4">{legs.map(leg => <section key={leg.id} className="rounded-2xl border-2 border-pink-100 bg-white p-5">
      <div className="flex justify-between gap-3"><h3 className="font-bold text-brand-pink">{labels[leg.serviceChoice]}</h3>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => onEditLeg(leg.id)} className="text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink underline">Edit</button></div>
      {leg.petSelections.map(s => {
        const service = leg.serviceChoice === "grooming" ? (s.pet.species === "Cat" ? "cat_grooming" : "dog_grooming") : leg.serviceChoice;
        const pkg = packagesByService[service]?.find(p => p.id === s.packageId);

export default function CartPanel({ cart, onIncrement, onDecrement, onRemove, onClear, onProcessPayment }: {

  onIncrement: (id: string) => void;

"use client";
// Cash-only POS. Payment is submitted once; keep the modal open if the
// database rejects the sale, so staff can safely correct/retry the payment.
import { useState } from "react";

export type LowStockWarning = {
  productId: string;
  name: string;
  currentStock: number;
  remainingStock: number;
  minStock: number;
};

export default function ProcessPaymentModal({
  amountDue, onClose, onConfirm, processing, error, lowStockWarnings,
}: {
  amountDue: number;
  onClose: () => void;
  onConfirm: (amountPaid: number, method: "Cash") => Promise<void>;
  processing: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  lowStockWarnings: LowStockWarning[];
}) {
  const [amountPaid, setAmountPaid] = useState("");
  const [acknowledgedLowStock, setAcknowledgedLowStock] = useState(false);
  const method = "Cash" as const;

  const paidNumber = amountPaid.trim() === "" ? NaN : Number(amountPaid);
  const validPaid = Number.isFinite(paidNumber) && paidNumber >= 0 &&
    paidNumber <= 100000000 && Math.round(paidNumber * 100) / 100 === paidNumber;
  const change = validPaid ? paidNumber - amountDue : 0;
  // The cashier decides whether to proceed when stock reaches the
  // reorder threshold. Available stock is still enforced by the DB.
  const canConfirm = validPaid && paidNumber >= amountDue && amountDue > 0 &&
    !processing && (lowStockWarnings.length === 0 || acknowledgedLowStock);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 px-4"
      onClick={() => { if (!processing) onClose(); }}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm bg-white rounded-3xl overflow-hidden" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="bg-brand-pink px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 className="text-white font-bold">Process Payment</h3>
          <button onClick={onClose} disabled={processing} className="text-white hover:opacity-80 disabled:opacity-40" aria-label="Close">
            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5">
              <path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" strokeLinecap="round" />
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="px-6 py-6">
          <div className="bg-brand-tint rounded-xl px-4 py-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">Amount Due (estimate; verified at checkout)</p>
            <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-brand-pink">â‚±{amountDue.toFixed(2)}</p>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-5">
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink">Payment Method</p>
            <p className="mt-2 inline-block px-5 py-1.5 rounded-full text-sm font-semibold bg-brand-pink text-white">Cash</p>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4">
            <label htmlFor="pos-cash-paid" className="text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink">Amount Paid (â‚±)</label>
            <input id="pos-cash-paid" type="number" min={0} step="0.01" autoFocus
              disabled={processing} value={amountPaid} onChange={(e) => setAmountPaid(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="0.00"
              className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-2.5 text-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-pink" />
          </div>

          {amountPaid !== "" && validPaid && (
            <div className={`mt-4 flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg px-4 py-3 font-semibold ${change >= 0 ? "bg-green-100 text-green-700" : "bg-red-100 text-red-600"}`}>
              <span>{change >= 0 ? "Estimated change" : "Short by"}</span>
              <span>â‚±{Math.abs(change).toFixed(2)}</span>
            </div>
          )}
          {amountPaid !== "" && !validPaid && (
            <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-red-600">Enter a valid amount with at most two decimal places.</p>
          )}
          {lowStockWarnings.length > 0 && (
            <section aria-label="Low stock warning" className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-3 text-amber-900">
              <p className="text-sm font-bold">Low stock warning â€” staff decision</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs">The sale is allowed, but it will leave these products at or below their reorder levels:</p>
              <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1 text-xs">
                {lowStockWarnings.map((item) => (
                  <li key={item.productId}>
                    <strong>{item.name}</strong>: {item.currentStock} available â†’ {item.remainingStock} after sale (reorder level: {item.minStock})
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
              <label className="mt-3 flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-2 text-xs font-semibold">
                <input type="checkbox" checked={acknowledgedLowStock} disabled={processing}
                  onChange={(e) => setAcknowledgedLowStock(e.target.checked)}
                  className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 accent-amber-700" />
                <span>I acknowledge the low stock and approve this sale.</span>
              </label>
              <p className="mt-2 text-[11px]">You can sell the last available unit. A quantity greater than actual available stock is still rejected.</p>
            </section>
          )}
          {error && (
            <p role="alert" className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">
              {error}
              <span className="mt-1 block text-xs">If the connection failed after payment, check Sales Reports before starting a new cart.</span>
            </p>
          )}

          <div className="mt-6 flex gap-3">
            <button onClick={onClose} disabled={processing}
              className="flex-1 border-2 border-zinc-300 text-zinc-500 font-semibold text-sm py-2.5 rounded-full hover:border-zinc-400 disabled:opacity-40 transition-colors">Cancel</button>
            <button onClick={() => { if (canConfirm) void onConfirm(paidNumber, method); }}
              disabled={!canConfirm}
              className="flex-1 border-2 border-brand-pink text-brand-pink font-semibold text-sm py-2.5 rounded-full disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:bg-brand-pink hover:text-white transition-colors">
              {processing ? "Processingâ€¦" : "Confirm Payment"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// One shared image container for product photos, used everywhere a
// product image appears (POS sales cards, POS configuration cards, the
// add/edit form preview). Every container is the exact same size no
// matter what â€” object-contain means each photo fits fully inside it
// instead of getting cropped to fill a square, so a tall bottle and a
// wide bag of kibble both just look like themselves at a consistent
// size, not stretched or chopped to match the container.
export default function ProductImage({
  src,
  alt,
  className = "",
}: {
  src: string | null;
  alt: string;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className={`w-full aspect-square bg-brand-tint rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden ${className}`}>
      {src ? (

import type { Product } from "@/lib/types/products";
import ProductImage from "./ProductImage";

export default function ProductPosCard({
  product,
  qty,
  onIncrement,
  onDecrement,
}: {
  product: Product;
  qty: number;
  onIncrement: () => void;
  onDecrement: () => void;
}) {
  const stock = Math.max(0, product.stock ?? 0);
  const outOfStock = stock <= 0;
  // Low stock is an advisory threshold, NOT a ban on selling stock.
  const lowStock = !outOfStock && stock <= product.min_stock;
  const maxReached = qty >= stock;

  return (
    <div className={`relative rounded-xl border-2 p-3 flex flex-col items-center text-center transition ${
      outOfStock ? "border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50" : lowStock ? "border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/40" : "border-pink-100 bg-white"
    }`}>
      {outOfStock && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 z-10 flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-white/65">
          <span className="rounded-full bg-red-100 px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold text-red-600 shadow-sm">OUT OF STOCK</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className={outOfStock ? "opacity-45 grayscale" : ""}>
        <ProductImage src={product.image_url} alt={product.name} />
      </div>
      <p className={`mt-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase truncate w-full ${outOfStock ? "text-zinc-400" : "text-zinc-800"}`} title={product.name}>
        {product.name}
      </p>
      <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">{product.package_size ?? product.unit}</p>
      <p className={`text-sm font-bold ${outOfStock ? "text-zinc-400" : "text-brand-pink"}`}>â‚±{product.price}</p>

      {outOfStock ? (
        <p className="mt-2 text-[10px] font-semibold text-red-500">Out of stock â€” unavailable for sale</p>
      ) : (
        <>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-zinc-500">{stock} available</p>
          {lowStock && (
            <p role="status" className="mt-1 rounded-md bg-amber-100 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-amber-800">
              Low stock (reorder level: {product.min_stock}) â€” still sellable
            </p>
          )}
          <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={onDecrement} disabled={qty === 0}
              aria-label={`Remove one ${product.name}`}
              className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-brand-pink text-white flex items-center justify-center disabled:opacity-30 hover:bg-brand-pink-dark transition-colors">âˆ’</button>
            {qty > 0 && <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-700 w-4 text-center">{qty}</span>}
            <button onClick={onIncrement} disabled={maxReached}
              aria-label={maxReached ? `Maximum available quantity reached for ${product.name}` : `Add one ${product.name}`}
              className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-brand-pink text-white flex items-center justify-center disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:bg-brand-pink-dark transition-colors">+</button>
          </div>
          {maxReached && <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-amber-700">Maximum available quantity selected</p>}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
// Return/Exchange modal. Two stages:
//   1. Type a receipt # and click Find
//   2. If found, adjust return quantities per line item (capped at
//      maxReturnable), pick a reason, and Confirm Refund.
import { useState } from "react";
import { transactions, type Transaction } from "@/lib/data/pos-transactions-mock";

const reasons = ["Defective", "Wrong Item", "Changed Mind", "Other"];

export default function ReturnExchangeModal({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
  const [receiptInput, setReceiptInput] = useState("");
  const [found, setFound] = useState<Transaction | null>(null);
  const [notFound, setNotFound] = useState(false);
  const [returnQtys, setReturnQtys] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [reason, setReason] = useState(reasons[0]);
  const [confirmed, setConfirmed] = useState(false);

  function handleFind() {
    const match = transactions.find(
      (t) => t.id.toLowerCase() === receiptInput.trim().toLowerCase()
    );
    if (match) {
      setFound(match);
      setNotFound(false);
      setReturnQtys(Object.fromEntries(match.lineItems.map((li) => [li.productId, 0])));
    } else {
      setFound(null);
      setNotFound(true);
    }
  }

  const refundSubtotal = found
    ? found.lineItems.reduce((sum, li) => sum + li.unitPrice * (returnQtys[li.productId] ?? 0), 0)
    : 0;
  const refundTotal = refundSubtotal;
  const hasAnyReturn = Object.values(returnQtys).some((q) => q > 0);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 px-4" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-white rounded-3xl overflow-hidden max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="bg-brand-pink px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0">
          <h3 className="text-white font-bold">Return / Exchange</h3>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-white hover:opacity-80" aria-label="Close">
            <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5">
              <path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" strokeLinecap="round" />
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="px-6 py-5">
          {confirmed ? (
            <div className="text-center py-8">
              <p className="text-4xl">âœ…</p>
              <p className="mt-3 font-bold text-green-600">Refund confirmed!</p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500">â‚±{refundTotal.toFixed(2)} refunded for {reason.toLowerCase()}.</p>
              <button
                onClick={onClose}
                className="mt-6 bg-brand-pink hover:bg-brand-pink-dark text-white font-semibold text-sm px-8 py-2.5 rounded-full transition-colors"
              >
                Done
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              {!found && (
                <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500 mb-3">Today's transactions â€” enter a receipt number below.</p>
              )}

              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Receipt #"
                  value={receiptInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setReceiptInput(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && handleFind()}
                  className="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-2.5 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-pink"
                />
                <button
                  onClick={handleFind}
                  className="bg-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-200 font-semibold text-sm px-5 rounded-lg transition-colors"
                >
                  Find
                </button>
              </div>

              {notFound && (
                <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-red-500">No transaction found with that receipt number.</p>
              )}

                <>
                  <div className="mt-4 bg-brand-tint rounded-xl px-4 py-3">

                          onChange={(e) => {

                            setReturnQtys((prev) => ({ ...prev, [li.productId]: val }));
                          }}
                          className="w-16 rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-2 py-1.5 text-sm text-center focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-pink"

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\admin\profile\ChangePasswordModal.tsx =====

"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { validatePassword } from "@/lib/validation/staff";
import { changeOwnPassword } from "@/lib/supabase/profile";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";

export default function ChangePasswordModal({ onClose, onChanged }: { onClose: () => void; onChanged: () => void }) {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState("");
  const [next, setNext] = useState("");
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  async function handleSubmit() {
    setError(null);
    if (!current.trim()) { setError("Enter your current password."); return; }
    if (next !== confirm) { setError("New passwords do not match."); return; }
    const pwError = validatePassword(next);
    if (pwError) { setError(pwError); return; }

    setSaving(true);
    const result = await changeOwnPassword(current, next);
    setSaving(false);

    if (result.error) { setError(result.error); return; }
    showToast("Password changed successfully.");
    onChanged();
    onClose();
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 px-4" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm bg-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="bg-brand-pink px-6 py-4">
          <h3 className="text-white font-bold">Change Password</h3>
        </div>
        <div className="p-6 space-y-3">
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600">Current Password</label>
            <input type="password" value={current} onChange={(e) => setCurrent(e.target.value)} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-pink" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600">New Password</label>
            <input type="password" value={next} onChange={(e) => setNext(e.target.value)} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-pink" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600">Confirm New Password</label>
            <input type="password" value={confirm} onChange={(e) => setConfirm(e.target.value)} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-pink" />
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">At least 8 characters, with uppercase, lowercase, a number, and a special character.</p>

          {error && <p className="text-sm text-red-600 bg-red-50 rounded-lg px-3 py-2">{error}</p>}

          <div className="flex gap-3 pt-2">
            <button onClick={onClose} className="flex-1 border-2 border-zinc-300 text-zinc-500 font-semibold text-sm py-2 rounded-full hover:border-zinc-400 transition-colors">Cancel</button>
            <button onClick={handleSubmit} disabled={saving} className="flex-1 bg-brand-pink hover:bg-brand-pink-dark disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-semibold text-sm py-2 rounded-full transition-colors">
              {saving ? "Saving..." : "Change Password"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\admin\reports\ExportMenu.tsx =====

"use client";
// Was duplicated inline (and UI-only â€” buttons just closed the menu)
// in every one of the four report FilterToolbar variants. Pulled into
// one component wired to lib/utils/report-export.ts so all four tabs
// actually export real files instead of four copies of a dead dropdown.
import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import { exportReportCSV, exportReportExcel, exportReportPDF, printReport, type ExportColumn } from "@/lib/utils/report-export";

export default function ExportMenu<T>({
  title,
  columns,
  rows,
  filename,
}: {
  title: string;
  columns: ExportColumn<T>[];
  rows: T[];
  filename: string;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const menuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    function handleClickOutside(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
    }
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
  }, [open]);

  async function handleSelect(format: "PDF" | "Excel" | "CSV" | "Print") {
    setOpen(false);
    if (rows.length === 0) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const opts = { title, columns, rows, filename };
      if (format === "PDF") await exportReportPDF(opts);
      else if (format === "Excel") await exportReportExcel(opts);
      else if (format === "CSV") exportReportCSV(opts);
      else await printReport(opts);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="relative ml-auto" ref={menuRef}>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
        disabled={busy}
        className="flex items-center gap-1.5 border border-[#E8E8E8] text-zinc-600 font-medium text-sm px-4 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-zinc-50 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
      >
        {busy ? "Exportingâ€¦" : "Export"}
        <svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" /></svg>
      </button>
      {open && rows.length === 0 && (
        <div className="absolute right-0 top-full mt-1.5 w-44 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg border border-[#E8E8E8] px-4 py-3 z-20">
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">No rows to export.</p>
        </div>
      )}
      {open && rows.length > 0 && (
        <div className="absolute right-0 top-full mt-1.5 w-36 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-lg border border-[#E8E8E8] py-1.5 z-20">
          {(["PDF", "Excel", "CSV", "Print"] as const).map((opt) => (
            <button
              type="button"
              key={opt}
              onClick={() => handleSelect(opt)}
              className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-600 hover:bg-[#F8F9FC] transition-colors"
            >
              {opt}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
export default function ReportFooter({
  page,
  pageSize,
  totalItems,
  onPageChange,
  onPageSizeChange,
}: {
  page: number;
  pageSize: number;
  totalItems: number;
  onPageChange: (page: number) => void;
  onPageSizeChange: (size: number) => void;
}) {
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalItems / pageSize));
  const start = totalItems === 0 ? 0 : page * pageSize + 1;
  const end = Math.min(totalItems, (page + 1) * pageSize);

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-3">
      <select
        value={pageSize}
        onChange={(e) => onPageSizeChange(Number(e.target.value))}
        className="rounded-lg border border-[#E8E8E8] bg-white px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-zinc-600 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF5F9E]/40"
      >
        {[10, 25, 50].map((n) => <option key={n} value={n}>{n} rows</option>)}
      </select>

      <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">
        Showing {start}â€“{end} of {totalItems} items
      </p>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <button
          onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.max(0, page - 1))}
          disabled={page === 0}
          className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full border border-[#E8E8E8] flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-500 disabled:opacity-40 hover:border-[#FF5F9E] transition-colors"
        >
          â€¹
        </button>
        {Array.from({ length: pageCount }, (_, i) => (
          <button
            key={i}
            onClick={() => onPageChange(i)}
            className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
              page === i ? "bg-[#FF5F9E] text-white" : "text-zinc-500 hover:bg-[#F8F9FC]"
            }`}
          >
            {i + 1}
          </button>
        ))}
        <button
          onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.min(pageCount - 1, page + 1))}
          disabled={page >= pageCount - 1}
          className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full border border-[#E8E8E8] flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-500 disabled:opacity-40 hover:border-[#FF5F9E] transition-colors"
        >
          â€º
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function ReportsHeader() {
  const [now, setNow] = useState<Date | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setNow(new Date());
    const interval = setInterval(() => setNow(new Date()), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-zinc-900" style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-body)" }}>
          Report Management
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500">View and manage all reports in one place.</p>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
        <button
          aria-label="Notifications"
          className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-white border border-[#E8E8E8] flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-500 hover:border-[#FF5F9E] transition-colors"
        >
          <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
            <path d="M18 8a6 6 0 1 0-12 0c0 7-3 9-3 9h18s-3-2-3-9" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
            <path d="M13.7 21a2 2 0 0 1-3.4 0" strokeLinecap="round" />
          </svg>
        </button>

        {now && (
          <div className="text-right">
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-700">
              {now.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" })}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
              {now.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit" })}
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\admin\reports\SortableHeader.tsx =====

"use client";
// Reusable sortable column header, used by Report Management (light
// header row â€” white bg, dark text) AND Inventory (pink header row,
// white text). The `variant` prop controls which color scheme applies,
// since a shared component can't assume its background color.
export type SortDirection = "asc" | "desc" | null;

export default function SortableHeader({
  label,
  sortKey,
  activeSortKey,
  direction,
  onSort,
  variant = "dark",
}: {
  label: string;
  sortKey: string;
  activeSortKey: string | null;
  direction: SortDirection;
  onSort: (key: string) => void;
  variant?: "dark" | "light";
}) {
  const isActive = activeSortKey === sortKey;
  const isLight = variant === "light";

  const textClass = isLight
    ? "text-white hover:text-white/80"
    : `hover:text-zinc-700 ${isActive ? "text-zinc-800" : "text-zinc-500"}`;

  const arrowActiveClass = isLight ? "text-white" : "text-[#FF5F9E]";
  const arrowInactiveClass = isLight ? "text-white/40" : "text-zinc-300";

  return (
    <th className={`text-left font-semibold px-5 py-3 whitespace-nowrap ${isLight ? "" : "text-zinc-500"}`}>
      <button onClick={() => onSort(sortKey)} className={`flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors ${textClass}`}>
        {label}
        <span className="flex flex-col leading-none text-[8px]">
          <span className={isActive && direction === "asc" ? arrowActiveClass : arrowInactiveClass}>â–²</span>
          <span className={isActive && direction === "desc" ? arrowActiveClass : arrowInactiveClass}>â–¼</span>
        </span>
      </button>
    </th>
  );
}

const safeCell = (s: string) => /^[\s]*[=+\-@\t\r]/.test(s) ? `'${s}` : s;
const csvCell = (value: unknown) => `"${safeCell(String(value ?? "")).replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
const compareText = (item: unknown) => item === undefined ? "â€”" : item === null ? "None" : typeof item === "object" ? JSON.stringify(item) : String(item);

  const [applied, setApplied] = useState<AuditFilters>(empty);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<StaffAuditEntry[]>([]);
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(25);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [details, setDetails] = useState<StaffAuditEntry | null>(null);
  const [refresh, setRefresh] = useState(0);
  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await fetchStaffAuditPage(applied, page);
      setRows(result.rows); setCount(result.count); setPageSize(result.pageSize); setError(result.error);
    } catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unable to load audit logs."); }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  }, [applied, page, refresh]);

  function apply() { setPage(0); setApplied({ ...filters }); }
  function reset() { setPage(0); setFilters(empty); setApplied(empty); }

    const anchor = document.createElement("a"); anchor.href = url; anchor.download = `happytails-audit-page-${page + 1}.csv`;
    anchor.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\admin\services\PackageFormModal.tsx =====

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import type { Package, PackageInclusion, PackagePricing, PetSize, ServiceType } from "@/lib/types/services";

type PriceDraft = { rate_id: string | null; size_id: string | null; size_label: string; price: string; is_per_night: boolean; days: string };
const durationLabel = (days: number) => `${days} ${days === 1 ? "Day" : "Days"} & ${days - 1} ${days - 1 === 1 ? "Night" : "Nights"}`;

function initialDays(rate: PackagePricing) {
  if (rate.is_per_night) return "";
  if (rate.nights != null && rate.nights > 0) return String(rate.nights + 1);
  const label = `${rate.size_label} ${rate.size_detail ?? ""}`;
  const nights = label.match(/(\d+)\s*nights?/i);
  if (nights) return String(Number(nights[1]) + 1);
  return label.match(/(\d+)\s*days?/i)?.[1] ?? "";
}
const blankBoardingRate = (): PriceDraft => ({ rate_id: null, size_id: null, size_label: "", price: "", is_per_night: false, days: "" });

/** Normalize legacy size labels, including "2X Extra Large" and "2 Extra Large". */
const normalize = (value: string) => value.trim().toLowerCase()
  .replace(/\b(?:two|2)\s*(?:x|times)?\s*extra\s*large\b/g, "2extralarge")
  .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "");
function groomingDrafts(sizes: PetSize[], old: PackagePricing[]): PriceDraft[] {
  const active = sizes.filter(s => s.is_active);
  const consumed = new Set<string>();
  const rows: PriceDraft[] = active.map(size => {
    const candidates = old.filter(rate => !consumed.has(rate.id) &&
      (rate.size_id === size.id || normalize(rate.size_label) === normalize(size.label)));
    // Prefer an existing rate tied to the active size, then a legacy-labelled rate.
    // Never create an empty "2X Extra Large" tier when "2 Extra Large" exists.
    const found = candidates.find(rate => rate.size_id === size.id) ?? candidates[0];
    if (found) consumed.add(found.id);
    return { rate_id: found?.id ?? null, size_id: size.id, size_label: size.label,
      price: found ? String(found.price) : "", is_per_night: false, days: "" };
  });
  // Keep genuinely different legacy rates visible. Equivalent duplicates are
  // retained in the DB, but not displayed as an extra input row.
  const activeKeys = new Set(active.map(s => normalize(s.label)));
  for (const oldRate of old) if (!consumed.has(oldRate.id) && !activeKeys.has(normalize(oldRate.size_label))) rows.push({
    rate_id: oldRate.id, size_id: oldRate.size_id, size_label: oldRate.size_label,
    price: String(oldRate.price), is_per_night: false, days: "",
  });
  return rows;
}

export default function PackageFormModal({ serviceType, sizes, existing, existingInclusions, existingPricing, onClose, onSaved }: {
  serviceType: ServiceType;
  sizes: PetSize[];
  existing?: Package;
  existingInclusions?: PackageInclusion[];
  existingPricing?: PackagePricing[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onSaved: () => void;
}) {
  const boarding = serviceType === "boarding";
  const [name, setName] = useState(existing?.name ?? "");
  const [inclusions, setInclusions] = useState<string[]>(existingInclusions?.map(i => i.label) ?? [""]);
  const [prices, setPrices] = useState<PriceDraft[]>(() => boarding
    ? existingPricing?.length ? existingPricing.map(p => ({ rate_id: p.id, size_id: null, size_label: p.size_label,
        price: String(p.price), is_per_night: p.is_per_night, days: initialDays(p) })) : [blankBoardingRate()]
    : groomingDrafts(sizes, existingPricing ?? []));
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const patch = (index: number, update: Partial<PriceDraft>) => setPrices(prev => prev.map((p, i) => i === index ? { ...p, ...update } : p));

  async function save() {
    if (saving) return;
    setError(null);
    if (!name.trim()) { setError("Enter a package name."); return; }
    const clean = prices.filter(p => p.rate_id || p.price.trim() || (boarding && (p.days.trim() || p.is_per_night)));
    if (!clean.length) { setError("Add at least one rate."); return; }
    for (const p of clean) {
      if (!p.price.trim() || !Number.isFinite(Number(p.price)) || Number(p.price) < 0) {
        setError("Every rate needs a nonnegative numeric price."); return;
      }
      if (boarding && !p.is_per_night) {
        const days = Number(p.days);
        if (!/^\d+$/.test(p.days) || !Number.isSafeInteger(days) || days < 2) {
          setError("Enter a whole number of at least two days for fixed boarding rates."); return;
        }
      } else if (!boarding && !p.size_label.trim()) {
        setError("Every grooming rate requires a size."); return;
      }
    }
    if (boarding) {
      if (clean.filter(p => p.is_per_night).length > 1) { setError("Only one open-ended per-night rate is allowed."); return; }
      const days = clean.filter(p => !p.is_per_night).map(p => Number(p.days));
      if (new Set(days).size !== days.length) { setError("Each fixed boarding duration must have a unique day count."); return; }
    }

    const payload = {
      p_package_id: existing?.id ?? null,
      p_service_type: serviceType,
      p_name: name.trim(),
      p_inclusions: boarding ? [] : inclusions.map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean),
      p_rates: clean.map(p => ({
        size_id: p.size_id,
        size_label: boarding ? (p.is_per_night ? (p.size_label || "7 Days Up") : durationLabel(Number(p.days))) : p.size_label.trim(),
        price: Number(p.price), is_per_night: p.is_per_night,
        nights: boarding && !p.is_per_night ? Number(p.days) - 1 : null,
      })),
    };

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const db = createClient();
      if (existing) {
        const originalInclusions = (existingInclusions ?? []).map(item => item.label.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        if (name.trim() !== existing.name ||
          JSON.stringify(payload.p_inclusions) !== JSON.stringify(originalInclusions)) {
          throw new Error("This save edits pricing only. Keep the package name and inclusions unchanged.");
        }
        const existingIds = new Set((existingPricing ?? []).map(rate => rate.id));
        const supplied = prices.filter(row => row.rate_id || row.price.trim());
        // Hidden equivalent legacy rows still belong to the package. Send their
        // unchanged amounts to satisfy the SQL completeness guard without
        // exposing a duplicate or altering historical pricing references.
        const visibleIds = new Set(supplied.map(row => row.rate_id).filter(Boolean));
        const hidden = (existingPricing ?? []).filter(rate => !visibleIds.has(rate.id)).map(rate => ({
          rate_id: rate.id, size_id: rate.size_id, size_label: rate.size_label,
          price: String(rate.price), is_per_night: rate.is_per_night, days: initialDays(rate),
        }));
        if ([...visibleIds].some(id => id && !existingIds.has(id))) {
          throw new Error("The package rates have changed. Refresh Service Management and retry.");
        }
        const changes = [...supplied, ...hidden].map(row => {
          if (!row.price.trim() || !Number.isFinite(Number(row.price)) || Number(row.price) < 0) {
            throw new Error(`Enter a valid price for ${row.size_label}.`);
          }
          return { rate_id: row.rate_id, size_id: row.size_id, size_label: row.size_label,
            price: Number(row.price), is_per_night: row.is_per_night,
            nights: boarding && !row.is_per_night ? Number(row.days) - 1 : null };
        });
        const { error: priceError } = await db.rpc("happytails_edit_package_prices_and_missing_tiers_v2", {
          p_package_id: existing.id, p_rates: changes,
        });
        if (priceError) throw new Error(priceError.message);
      } else {
        const { error: failure } = await db.rpc("happytails_save_service_package_v2", payload);
        if (failure) throw new Error(failure.message);
      }
      onSaved();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not save the package. Please retry.");
    } finally { setSaving(false); }
  }

  return <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={existing ? "Edit package" : "Add package"}
    className="fixed inset-0 z-[90] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-4">

"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import type { PetSize, ServiceType } from "@/lib/types/services";

export default function SizeFormModal({
  serviceType,
  existing,
  onClose,
  onSaved,
}: {
  serviceType: ServiceType;
  existing?: PetSize;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSaved: () => void;
}) {
  const [label, setLabel] = useState(existing?.label ?? "");
  const [weightRange, setWeightRange] = useState(existing?.weight_range ?? "");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function handleSave() {
    if (!label.trim() || !weightRange.trim()) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    const supabase = createClient();

    const { error: err } = existing
      ? await supabase.from("pet_sizes").update({ label, weight_range: weightRange }).eq("id", existing.id)
      : await supabase.from("pet_sizes").insert({ service_type: serviceType, label, weight_range: weightRange, sort_order: 99 });

    setSaving(false);
    if (err) { setError(err.message); return; }
    onSaved();
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 px-4" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-xs bg-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="bg-brand-pink px-5 py-3">
          <h3 className="text-white font-bold text-sm">{existing ? "Edit Size" : "Add Size"}</h3>
        </div>
        <div className="p-5 space-y-3">
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600">Size Label</label>
            <input value={label} onChange={(e) => setLabel(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Small" className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-pink" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600">Weight Range</label>
            <input value={weightRange} onChange={(e) => setWeightRange(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Below 5 kg" className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-pink" />
          </div>
          {error && <p className="text-xs text-red-600">{error}</p>}
          <div className="flex gap-2 pt-1">
            <button onClick={onClose} className="flex-1 border-2 border-zinc-300 text-zinc-500 font-semibold text-sm py-2 rounded-full hover:border-zinc-400 transition-colors">Cancel</button>
            <button onClick={handleSave} disabled={saving} className="flex-1 bg-brand-pink hover:bg-brand-pink-dark disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-semibold text-sm py-2 rounded-full transition-colors">
              {saving ? "Saving..." : "Save"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
