===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\admin\users\AddStaffModal.tsx =====

"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { validatePassword, validatePhoneNumber, validateUsername } from "@/lib/validation/staff";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";

type StaffForm = {
  firstName: string;
  middleName: string;
  lastName: string;
  username: string;
  password: string;
  confirmPassword: string;
  phoneNumber: string;
  jobTitle: string;
};

export default function AddStaffModal({ onClose, onCreated }: { onClose: () => void; onCreated: () => void }) {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const [form, setForm] = useState<StaffForm>({
    firstName: "", middleName: "", lastName: "", username: "",
    password: "", confirmPassword: "", phoneNumber: "", jobTitle: "Staff",
  });
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  function update(field: keyof StaffForm, value: string) {
    setForm((previous) => ({ ...previous, [field]: value }));
  }

  function clientValidate(): string | null {
    if (!form.firstName.trim() || !form.lastName.trim() || !form.username.trim() || !form.password) {
      return "First name, last name, username, and password are required.";
    }
    if (form.username.trim().length > 20) return "Username must be at most 20 characters.";
    if (form.password !== form.confirmPassword) return "Passwords do not match.";
    return validateUsername(form.username.trim()) ||
      validatePassword(form.password) ||
      (form.phoneNumber.trim() ? validatePhoneNumber(form.phoneNumber.trim()) : null);
  }

  async function handleSubmit() {
    if (saving) return;
    const problem = clientValidate();
    if (problem) { setError(problem); return; }
    setSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/admin/create-staff", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          ...form,
          firstName: form.firstName.trim(),
          middleName: form.middleName.trim(),
          lastName: form.lastName.trim(),
          username: form.username.trim(),
          phoneNumber: form.phoneNumber.trim(),
          jobTitle: form.jobTitle.trim(),
        }),
      });
      const result: { error?: string } = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok) { setError(result.error ?? "Failed to create staff account."); return; }
      showToast("Staff account created successfully. The staff member can sign in with their username and password.");
      onCreated();
      onClose();
    } catch {
      setError("Could not reach the server. Check whether the account was created before trying again.");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 px-4" onClick={() => { if (!saving) onClose(); }}>
      <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Add staff account" className="w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-white max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="sticky top-0 z-10 flex items-center justify-between bg-brand-pink px-6 py-4">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white">Add Staff Account</h3>
          <button type="button" aria-label="Close" disabled={saving} onClick={onClose} className="text-white disabled:opacity-50">âœ•</button>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-3 px-6 py-5">
          <p className="rounded-xl border border-pink-100 bg-pink-50 p-3 text-xs text-zinc-600">
            Staff sign in with a <strong>username and password</strong>. No email address or customer account is needed. Password resets are handled by Superadmin.
          </p>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600">First Name *
              <input value={form.firstName} maxLength={80} autoComplete="off" onChange={(e) => update("firstName", e.target.value)} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-2 py-2 text-sm" />
            </label>
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600">Middle Name
              <input value={form.middleName} maxLength={80} autoComplete="off" onChange={(e) => update("middleName", e.target.value)} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-2 py-2 text-sm" />
            </label>
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600">Last Name *
              <input value={form.lastName} maxLength={80} autoComplete="off" onChange={(e) => update("lastName", e.target.value)} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-2 py-2 text-sm" />
            </label>
          </div>
          <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600">Role / Job Title
            <input value={form.jobTitle} maxLength={100} onChange={(e) => update("jobTitle", e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Staff, Groomer, Front Desk" className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm" />
            <span className="mt-1 block text-[11px] font-normal text-zinc-400">Job title is a display label. Accounts created here have staff-level permissions, not Superadmin access.</span>
          </label>
          <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600">Username *
            <input value={form.username} maxLength={20} autoComplete="off" onChange={(e) => update("username", e.target.value)} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm" />
          </label>
          <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600">Phone Number (optional)
            <input type="tel" value={form.phoneNumber} autoComplete="off" onChange={(e) => update("phoneNumber", e.target.value)} placeholder="09171234567" className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm" />
          </label>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600">Password *
              <input type="password" autoComplete="new-password" value={form.password} onChange={(e) => update("password", e.target.value)} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm" />
            </label>
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600">Confirm Password *
              <input type="password" autoComplete="new-password" value={form.confirmPassword} onChange={(e) => update("confirmPassword", e.target.value)} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-lg border border-zinc-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm" />
            </label>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">Password: at least eight characters, with uppercase, lowercase, a number, and a special character.</p>
          {error && <p role="alert" className="rounded-lg bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}

"use client";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { setStaffStatus, setCustomerStatus, logAudit } from "@/lib/supabase/users";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import ConfirmDialog from "@/components/ui/ConfirmDialog";
import type { StaffMember, Customer } from "@/lib/types/users";

type RestoreTarget = { type: "staff"; member: StaffMember } | { type: "customer"; member: Customer };

export default function ArchiveModal({ archivedStaff, archivedCustomers, onClose, onChanged }: {
  archivedStaff: StaffMember[];
  archivedCustomers: Customer[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onChanged: () => void;
}) {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [restore, setRestore] = useState<RestoreTarget | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const filteredStaff = useMemo(() => archivedStaff.filter(s => !search.trim() || `${s.first_name} ${s.last_name}`.toLowerCase().includes(search.trim().toLowerCase())), [archivedStaff, search]);
  const filteredCustomers = useMemo(() => archivedCustomers.filter(c => !search.trim() || c.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(search.trim().toLowerCase())), [archivedCustomers, search]);

  async function handleRestore() {
    if (!restore || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const result = restore.type === "staff"
        ? await setStaffStatus(restore.member.id, "active")
        : await setCustomerStatus(restore.member.id, "active");
      if (result.error) { showToast(result.error.message, "error"); return; }
      const { type, member } = restore;
      await logAudit(`${type}.restored`, type, member.id);
      showToast("Account restored successfully.");
      setRestore(null);
      onChanged();
    } catch {
      showToast("Unable to restore this account.", "error");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  const restoreName = restore ? restore.type === "staff"
    ? `${restore.member.first_name} ${restore.member.last_name}`
    : restore.member.full_name : "";

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 px-4" onClick={() => { if (!busy) onClose(); }}>
      <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Archived accounts" className="max-h-[85vh] w-full max-w-lg overflow-y-auto rounded-3xl bg-white" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="sticky top-0 flex items-center justify-between bg-brand-pink px-6 py-4">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white">Archived Accounts</h3>
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy} aria-label="Close" className="text-white disabled:opacity-50">âœ•</button>
        </div>
        <div className="px-6 py-5">
          <p className="mb-4 text-xs text-zinc-500">Archived accounts are kept for historical and audit records. Restore an account to grant access again.</p>
          <input value={search} onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)} aria-label="Search archived accounts" placeholder="Search archived accounts" className="w-full rounded-full border border-zinc-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm" />
          <h4 className="mt-5 text-sm font-bold text-brand-pink">Staff</h4>
          <div className="mt-2 space-y-2">
            {filteredStaff.length === 0 ? <p className="text-sm text-zinc-400">No archived staff.</p> : filteredStaff.map(member =>
              <div key={member.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 px-4 py-2.5">
                <span className="text-sm text-zinc-700">{member.first_name} {member.last_name} Â· {member.employee_id}</span>
                <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setRestore({ type: "staff", member })} className="rounded-full border border-emerald-400 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-600 disabled:opacity-50">Restore</button>
              </div>)}
          </div>
          <h4 className="mt-5 text-sm font-bold text-brand-pink">Customers</h4>
          <div className="mt-2 space-y-2">

              </div>)}

      </div>

"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { setStaffStatus, logAudit } from "@/lib/supabase/users";
import { useToast } from "@/components/ui/Toast";
import ConfirmDialog from "@/components/ui/ConfirmDialog";
import type { StaffMember } from "@/lib/types/users";

function Row({ label, value }: { label: string; value: React.ReactNode }) {
  return <div className="flex justify-between gap-3 py-1 text-sm"><span className="text-zinc-500">{label}</span><span className="text-right font-medium text-zinc-800">{value || "â€”"}</span></div>;
}

export default function StaffDetailModal({ staff, onClose, onChanged }: {
  staff: StaffMember;
  onClose: () => void;
  onChanged: () => void;
}) {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const [confirmAction, setConfirmAction] = useState<"deactivate" | "activate" | "archive" | "resetPassword" | null>(null);
  const [tempPassword, setTempPassword] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  async function handleStatusChange(status: "active" | "inactive" | "archived") {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const { error } = await setStaffStatus(staff.id, status);
      if (error) { showToast(error.message, "error"); return; }
      await logAudit(`staff.${status}`, "staff", staff.id);
      showToast(status === "archived" ? "Staff account archived." : "Staff status changed.");
      onChanged();
      if (status === "archived") onClose();
    } catch {
      showToast("Unable to change staff status.", "error");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
      setConfirmAction(null);
    }
  }

  async function handleResetPassword() {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/admin/reset-staff-password/${encodeURIComponent(staff.id)}`, { method: "POST" });
      const result: { error?: string; tempPassword?: string } = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok || !result.tempPassword) {
        showToast(result.error ?? "Failed to reset password.", "error");
        return;
      }
      setTempPassword(result.tempPassword);
    } catch {
      showToast("Password reset request failed.", "error");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
      setConfirmAction(null);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 px-4" onClick={() => { if (!busy) onClose(); }}>
      <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Staff profile" className="max-h-[90vh] w-full max-w-sm overflow-y-auto rounded-3xl bg-white" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="sticky top-0 flex items-center justify-between bg-brand-pink px-6 py-4">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-white">Staff Profile</h3>
          <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close" className="text-white disabled:opacity-50">âœ•</button>
        </div>
        <div className="px-6 py-5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex h-14 w-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-brand-tint text-xl font-bold text-brand-pink">{staff.first_name.charAt(0)}</div>
            <div><h4 className="font-bold text-zinc-900">{staff.first_name} {staff.last_name}</h4><p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">{staff.employee_id}</p></div>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-4 space-y-1">
            <Row label="Username" value={staff.username} />
            {staff.email && !staff.email.endsWith(".invalid") && <Row label="Email" value={staff.email} />}
            <Row label="Phone Number" value={staff.phone_number} />
            <Row label="Role" value={staff.job_title} />
            <Row label="Status" value={staff.status === "active" ? "Active" : staff.status === "inactive" ? "Inactive" : "Archived"} />
            <Row label="Date Created" value={new Date(staff.created_at).toLocaleDateString()} />
          </div>
          {tempPassword && <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3">
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-amber-800">New temporary password. Share it with {staff.first_name} privately; it will not be displayed again.</p>

          </div>}
          <p className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-zinc-50 p-3 text-xs text-zinc-500">Accounts are retained for audit and historical records. Use Archive instead of deleting staff accounts.</p>
          <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setConfirmAction("resetPassword")} className="rounded-full border-2 border-amber-400 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-amber-600 disabled:opacity-50">Reset Password</button>
            {staff.status === "active"
              ? <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setConfirmAction("deactivate")} className="rounded-full border-2 border-zinc-300 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-600 disabled:opacity-50">Deactivate</button>
              : <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setConfirmAction("activate")} className="rounded-full border-2 border-emerald-400 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-600 disabled:opacity-50">Activate</button>}
            {staff.status !== "archived" && <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setConfirmAction("archive")} className="col-span-2 rounded-full border-2 border-orange-300 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-orange-600 disabled:opacity-50">Archive Account</button>}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {confirmAction === "deactivate" && <ConfirmDialog title="Deactivate Account" message={`${staff.first_name} won't be able to sign in until reactivated.`} confirmLabel={busy ? "Updatingâ€¦" : "Deactivate"} onConfirm={() => void handleStatusChange("inactive")} onCancel={() => { if (!busy) setConfirmAction(null); }} />}

"Updatingâ€¦" : "Activate"} onConfirm={() => void handleStatusChange("active")} onCancel={() => { if (!busy) setConfirmAction(null); }} />}

                    </svg>
                  </button>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))
          )}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import type { GalleryPhoto, GalleryService } from "@/lib/types/gallery";
import ActionConfirmModal from "@/components/admin/operations/ActionConfirmModal";

const SERVICE_LABELS: Record<GalleryService, string> = {
  grooming: "Grooming",
  boarding: "Boarding",
  dental: "Dental Care",
  ear_cleaning: "Ear Cleaning",
  nail_trimming: "Nail Trimming",
  other: "Other",
};

type UploadedImage = { url: string; path: string };

let watermarkLogoPromise: Promise<HTMLImageElement> | null = null;

function loadWatermarkLogo(): Promise<HTMLImageElement> {
  if (!watermarkLogoPromise) {
    watermarkLogoPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const logo = new window.Image();
      logo.onload = () => resolve(logo);
      logo.onerror = () => {
        watermarkLogoPromise = null;
        reject(new Error("The Happy Tails logo could not be loaded. Check public/images/logo.png."));
      };
      logo.src = "/images/logo.png";
    });
  }
  return watermarkLogoPromise;
}

function roundedRect(
  context: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  x: number,
  y: number,
  width: number,
  height: number,
  radius: number,
) {
  const r = Math.min(radius, width / 2, height / 2);
  context.beginPath();
  context.moveTo(x + r, y);
  context.arcTo(x + width, y, x + width, y + height, r);
  context.arcTo(x + width, y + height, x, y + height, r);
  context.arcTo(x, y + height, x, y, r);
  context.arcTo(x, y, x + width, y, r);
  context.closePath();
}

async function createWatermarkedFile(file: File): Promise<File> {
  if (!file.type.startsWith("image/")) {
    throw new Error("Please choose a valid image file.");
  }

  const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
  try {
    const source = new window.Image();
    source.src = objectUrl;
    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      source.onload = () => resolve();
      source.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`The image ${file.name} could not be opened.`));
    });

    const width = source.naturalWidth;
    const height = source.naturalHeight;
    if (!width || !height) throw new Error(`The image ${file.name} has invalid dimensions.`);

    const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;
    const context = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!context) throw new Error("Your browser could not prepare the watermark.");

    context.drawImage(source, 0, 0, width, height);

    const logo = await loadWatermarkLogo();
    // Scale the brand mark relative to the photo so it remains legible on
    // portrait, landscape, and square images without covering the pet.
    const scale = Math.min(1, width / 280, height / 110);
    const badgeHeight = Math.max(20, 44 * scale);
    const logoSize = badgeHeight * 0.68;
    const padding = badgeHeight * 0.24;
    const fontSize = Math.max(8, badgeHeight * 0.27);
    context.font = `700 ${fontSize}px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`;
    const brandText = "HAPPY TAILS";
    const textWidth = context.measureText(brandText).width;
    const badgeWidth = padding * 2 + logoSize + padding * 0.65 + textWidth;
    const margin = Math.max(8, Math.min(width, height) * 0.025);
    const x = Math.max(4, width - badgeWidth - margin);
    const y = Math.max(4, height - badgeHeight - margin);

    context.save();
    context.globalAlpha = 0.9;
    context.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88)";
    context.strokeStyle = "rgba(217, 70, 139, 0.82)";
    context.lineWidth = Math.max(1, badgeHeight * 0.025);
    roundedRect(context, x, y, badgeWidth, badgeHeight, badgeHeight * 0.22);
    context.fill();
    context.stroke();

    context.globalAlpha = 0.96;
    const logoY = y + (badgeHeight - logoSize) / 2;
    context.drawImage(logo, x + padding, logoY, logoSize, logoSize);

    context.globalAlpha = 1;
    context.fillStyle = "#d9468b";
    context.textBaseline = "middle";
    context.fillText(brandText, x + padding + logoSize + padding * 0.65, y + badgeHeight / 2);
    context.restore();

    const blob = await new Promise<Blob>((resolve, reject) => {
      canvas.toBlob(
        (result) => result ? resolve(result) : reject(new Error("The watermarked image could not be generated.")),
        "image/jpeg",
        0.93,
      );
    });

    const originalName = file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "");
    return new File([blob], `${originalName}-happytails-watermarked.jpg`, {
      type: "image/jpeg",
      lastModified: Date.now(),
    });
  } finally {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
  }
}

function isWatermarked(url: string): boolean {
  return url.includes("/gallery/watermarked-");
}

export default function BeforeAfterImagesManager({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
  const [photos, setPhotos] = useState<GalleryPhoto[]>([]);
  const [service, setService] = useState<GalleryService>("grooming");
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [beforeFile, setBeforeFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [afterFile, setAfterFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [watermarking, setWatermarking] = useState(false);
  const [watermarkProgress, setWatermarkProgress] = useState("");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState(false);
  const [removeTarget, setRemoveTarget] = useState<GalleryPhoto | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const beforeRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const afterRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  async function load() {
    const supabase = createClient();
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("gallery_photos")
      .select("*")
      .order("sort_order", { ascending: true })
      .order("created_at", { ascending: false });
    if (error) setError(error.message);
    else setPhotos((data as GalleryPhoto[]) ?? []);
    setLoading(false);
  }

  useEffect(() => { void load(); }, []);

  async function upload(file: File, prefix: string): Promise<UploadedImage> {
    const supabase = createClient();
    const watermarkedFile = await createWatermarkedFile(file);
    const path = `gallery/watermarked-${prefix}-${crypto.randomUUID()}.jpg`;
    const { error } = await supabase.storage
      .from("site-images")
      .upload(path, watermarkedFile, { upsert: false, contentType: "image/jpeg" });
    if (error) throw error;
    return {
      path,
      url: supabase.storage.from("site-images").getPublicUrl(path).data.publicUrl,
    };
  }

  async function uploadFromUrl(url: string, prefix: string): Promise<UploadedImage> {
    const supabase = createClient();
    const storageMarker = "/storage/v1/object/public/site-images/";
    const markerIndex = url.indexOf(storageMarker);
    let blob: Blob;

    if (markerIndex >= 0) {
      const encodedPath = url.slice(markerIndex + storageMarker.length).split("?")[0];
      const storagePath = decodeURIComponent(encodedPath);
      const { data, error } = await supabase.storage.from("site-images").download(storagePath);
      if (error || !data) throw error ?? new Error("Could not download an existing gallery image.");
      blob = data;
    } else {
      const response = await fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Could not read an existing gallery image (HTTP ${response.status}).`);
      blob = await response.blob();
    }

    if (!blob.type.startsWith("image/")) throw new Error("An existing gallery file is not a readable image.");
    const file = new File([blob], `${prefix}-existing.${blob.type.split("/")[1] || "jpg"}`, { type: blob.type });
    return upload(file, prefix);
  }

  async function cleanupUploads(paths: string[]) {
    if (!paths.length) return;
    try { await createClient().storage.from("site-images").remove(paths); } catch { /* Preserve the original gallery records if cleanup is unavailable. */ }
  }

  async function addPhoto() {
    if (!beforeFile || !afterFile) {
      setError("Please choose both a BEFORE image and an AFTER image.");
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    setStatus(null);
    const uploadedPaths: string[] = [];
    try {
      const beforeUpload = await upload(beforeFile, "before");
      uploadedPaths.push(beforeUpload.path);
      const afterUpload = await upload(afterFile, "after");
      uploadedPaths.push(afterUpload.path);

      const supabase = createClient();
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("gallery_photos")
        .insert({
          title: title.trim() || null,
          service,
          before_url: beforeUpload.url,
          after_url: afterUpload.url,
          sort_order: photos.length,
          active: true,
        })
        .select()
        .single();
      if (error) throw error;

      setPhotos((prev) => [data as GalleryPhoto, ...prev]);
      setTitle("");
      setBeforeFile(null);
      setAfterFile(null);
      if (beforeRef.current) beforeRef.current.value = "";
      if (afterRef.current) afterRef.current.value = "";
      setStatus("Both photos were uploaded with the Happy Tails watermark permanently embedded.");
    } catch (err) {
      await cleanupUploads(uploadedPaths);
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unable to save the photos.");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  async function watermarkExistingPhotos() {
    const pending = photos.filter((photo) => !isWatermarked(photo.before_url) || !isWatermarked(photo.after_url));
    if (!pending.length || watermarking) return;

    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `Apply the permanent Happy Tails watermark to ${pending.length} existing photo pair(s)? The gallery will use newly watermarked copies. Original storage files will be kept as backups.`,
    );
    if (!confirmed) return;

    setWatermarking(true);
    setError(null);
    setStatus(null);
    let completed = 0;
    const failures: string[] = [];
    const supabase = createClient();

    for (let index = 0; index < pending.length; index += 1) {
      const photo = pending[index];
      const newPaths: string[] = [];
      setWatermarkProgress(`Watermarking photo pair ${index + 1} of ${pending.length}...`);
      try {
        let beforeUrl = photo.before_url;
        let afterUrl = photo.after_url;

        if (!isWatermarked(photo.before_url)) {
          const uploaded = await uploadFromUrl(photo.before_url, "before");
          beforeUrl = uploaded.url;
          newPaths.push(uploaded.path);
        }
        if (!isWatermarked(photo.after_url)) {
          const uploaded = await uploadFromUrl(photo.after_url, "after");
          afterUrl = uploaded.url;
          newPaths.push(uploaded.path);
        }

        const { error: updateError } = await supabase
          .from("gallery_photos")
          .update({ before_url: beforeUrl, after_url: afterUrl, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
          .eq("id", photo.id);
        if (updateError) throw updateError;

        setPhotos((current) => current.map((item) => item.id === photo.id
          ? { ...item, before_url: beforeUrl, after_url: afterUrl }
          : item));
        completed += 1;
      } catch (err) {
        await cleanupUploads(newPaths);
        failures.push(`${photo.title || "Untitled photo pair"}: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not apply watermark."}`);
      }
    }

    setWatermarkProgress("");
    setWatermarking(false);
    if (failures.length) {
      setError(`${completed} photo pair(s) watermarked. ${failures.length} could not be updated: ${failures.slice(0, 3).join("; ")}${failures.length > 3 ? "; and more." : ""}`);
    } else {
      setStatus(`Successfully embedded the watermark into ${completed} existing photo pair(s). Original storage files were kept as backups.`);
    }
  }

  async function removePhotoConfirmed() {
    if (!removeTarget || removing) return;
    setRemoving(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const { error } = await supabase.from("gallery_photos").delete().eq("id", removeTarget.id);
      if (error) { setError(error.message); return; }
      setPhotos((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== removeTarget.id));
      setRemoveTarget(null);
    } finally {
      setRemoving(false);
    }
  }

  const photosNeedingWatermark = photos.filter((photo) => !isWatermarked(photo.before_url) || !isWatermarked(photo.after_url)).length;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-3 sm:p-4">
      <div className="max-h-[90dvh] w-full max-w-6xl overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain rounded-3xl bg-white p-4 shadow-2xl sm:p-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-brand-pink">Before & After Images</h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500">Manage the before-and-after photos customers see on the landing page.</p>
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} className="min-h-11 rounded-full bg-zinc-100 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-600">Close</button>
        </div>

        {error && <p role="alert" className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}
        {status && <p role="status" className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-green-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-green-700">{status}</p>}

        <div className="mt-6 rounded-2xl bg-brand-tint p-4 sm:p-5">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-zinc-800">Add before & after</h3>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-600">The Happy Tails logo watermark is embedded into each image before upload. It remains visible when the image is saved or shared elsewhere.</p>
          <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
            <input value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} placeholder="Optional title / pet name" className="min-h-11 min-w-0 rounded-xl border border-pink-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-brand-pink" />
            <select value={service} onChange={(e) => setService(e.target.value as GalleryService)} className="min-h-11 min-w-0 rounded-xl border border-pink-200 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-brand-pink">{Object.entries(SERVICE_LABELS).map(([value, label]) => <option key={value} value={value}>{label}</option>)}</select>
            <button type="button" disabled={saving || watermarking} onClick={() => void addPhoto()} className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-brand-pink px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white disabled:opacity-50">{saving ? "Watermarking & uploading..." : "Upload Pair"}</button>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">

"Choose image"}</span><input ref={beforeRef} type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" className="hidden" onChange={(e) => setBeforeFile(e.target.files?.[0] ?? null)} /></label>

"Choose image"}</span><input ref={afterRef} type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" className="hidden" onChange={(e) => setAfterFile(e.target.files?.[0] ?? null)} /></label>

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";
import type { HeroSlide } from "@/lib/types/hero-slides";
import ActionConfirmModal from "@/components/admin/operations/ActionConfirmModal";
import { fetchAllHeroSlides, uploadHeroSlideImage, addHeroSlide, setHeroSlideActive, deleteHeroSlide, swapHeroSlideOrder } from "@/lib/supabase/hero-slides";

export default function HeroSlidesManager({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
  const [slides, setSlides] = useState<HeroSlide[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<HeroSlide | null>(null);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      setLoading(true);
      const { slides, error } = await fetchAllHeroSlides();
      if (error) setError(error);
      setSlides(slides);
      setLoading(false);
    }
    void load();
  }, []);

  async function handleFileSelected(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    e.target.value = "";
    if (!file) return;
    setUploading(true);
    setError(null);
    const uploaded = await uploadHeroSlideImage(file);
    if (uploaded.error || !uploaded.url) {
      setError(uploaded.error || "Upload failed.");
      setUploading(false);
      return;
    }
    const nextSortOrder = slides.length > 0 ? Math.max(...slides.map((s) => s.sort_order)) + 1 : 0;
    const { slide, error: insertError } = await addHeroSlide({ url: uploaded.url, width: uploaded.width!, height: uploaded.height! }, nextSortOrder);
    if (insertError || !slide) {
      setError(insertError || "Couldn't save the slide.");
      setUploading(false);
      return;
    }
    setSlides((prev) => [...prev, slide]);
    setUploading(false);
  }

  async function handleToggleActive(slide: HeroSlide) {
    setError(null);
    const { error } = await setHeroSlideActive(slide.id, !slide.active);
    if (error) { setError(error); return; }
    setSlides((prev) => prev.map((s) => s.id === slide.id ? { ...s, active: !s.active } : s));
  }

  async function handleDeleteConfirmed() {
    if (!deleteTarget || deleting) return;
    setDeleting(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const { error } = await deleteHeroSlide(deleteTarget.id);
      if (error) { setError(error); return; }
      setSlides((prev) => prev.filter((s) => s.id !== deleteTarget.id));
      setDeleteTarget(null);
    } finally { setDeleting(false); }
  }

  async function handleMove(index: number, direction: -1 | 1) {
    const targetIndex = index + direction;
    if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= slides.length) return;
    setError(null);
    const a = slides[index];
    const b = slides[targetIndex];
    const { error } = await swapHeroSlideOrder({ id: a.id, sort_order: a.sort_order }, { id: b.id, sort_order: b.sort_order });
    if (error) { setError(error); return; }
    const next = [...slides];
    [next[index], next[targetIndex]] = [{ ...next[targetIndex], sort_order: a.sort_order }, { ...next[index], sort_order: b.sort_order }];
    setSlides(next);
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-3 sm:p-4" onClick={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-lg max-h-[min(85dvh,800px)] overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain rounded-3xl bg-white p-4 shadow-2xl sm:p-6" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <h3 className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-lg font-bold text-brand-pink">Manage Hero Slides</h3>
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} className="min-h-11 px-2 text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-500">Close</button>
        </div>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-400">These rotate automatically on the homepage. Order top-to-bottom here matches left-to-right on the site.</p>
        {error && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}
        {loading ? <p className="mt-6 text-sm text-zinc-400">Loading slides...</p> : (
          <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-3">
            {slides.length === 0 && <p className="text-sm text-zinc-400">No slides yet â€” add one below to start the carousel.</p>}
            {slides.map((slide, i) => (
              <div key={slide.id} className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border-2 border-brand-tint p-2 sm:gap-3 sm:p-2.5">
                <div className="relative h-14 w-16 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-brand-tint sm:w-20"><Image src={slide.image_url} alt="" fill className="object-cover" unoptimized /></div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className={`text-sm font-semibold ${slide.active ? "text-zinc-700" : "text-zinc-400"}`}>Slide {i + 1} {!slide.active && "(hidden)"}</p>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => void handleToggleActive(slide)} className="min-h-9 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink">{slide.active ? "Hide from carousel" : "Show in carousel"}</button>
                </div>
                <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-col gap-1">
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => void handleMove(i, -1)} disabled={i === 0} aria-label="Move up" className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 border-zinc-200 text-zinc-500 disabled:opacity-30">â†‘</button>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => void handleMove(i, 1)} disabled={i === slides.length - 1} aria-label="Move down" className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 border-zinc-200 text-zinc-500 disabled:opacity-30">â†“</button>
                </div>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(slide)} aria-label={`Delete slide ${i + 1}`} className="flex h-11 w-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 border-red-200 text-red-500">âœ•</button>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        <input ref={fileInputRef} type="file" accept="image/*" className="hidden" onChange={handleFileSelected} />
        <button type="button" onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()} disabled={uploading} className="mt-5 min-h-11 w-full rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-brand-pink py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink disabled:opacity-50">{uploading ? "Uploading..." : "+ Add Slide"}</button>
      </div>
      {deleteTarget && <ActionConfirmModal title="Delete hero slide?" description="This slide will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone." confirmLabel="Delete Slide" destructive pending={deleting} onCancel={() => setDeleteTarget(null)} onConfirm={handleDeleteConfirmed} />}
    </div>
  );

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import type { SiteSettingKey } from "@/lib/supabase/site-settings";

type LoginKey = Extract<SiteSettingKey, "login_background_desktop" | "login_background_mobile">;
type BackgroundSetting = {
  key: LoginKey;
  image_url: string | null;
  image_width: number | null;
  image_height: number | null;
};

const CONFIG: { key: LoginKey; title: string; hint: string; fallback: string; ratio: string }[] = [
  {
    key: "login_background_desktop",
    title: "Landscape / Desktop",
    hint: "Recommended 1672 Ã— 941 (16:9). Use artwork WITHOUT an embedded login form.",
    fallback: "/images/happytails-login-landscape.webp",
    ratio: "16 / 9",
  },
  {
    key: "login_background_mobile",
    title: "Portrait / Mobile",
    hint: "Recommended 941 Ã— 1672 (9:16). Use artwork WITHOUT an embedded login form.",
    fallback: "/images/happytails-login-portrait-preview.webp",
    ratio: "9 / 16",
  },
];

export default function LoginBackgroundManager() {
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<BackgroundSetting[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState<LoginKey | null>(null);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [target, setTarget] = useState<LoginKey>("login_background_desktop");

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    async function loadSettings() {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const { data, error: queryError } = await supabase.from("site_settings")
        .select("key,image_url,image_width,image_height")
        .in("key", CONFIG.map(({ key }) => key));
      if (!alive) return;
      if (queryError) setError(queryError.message);
      else setSettings((data || []) as BackgroundSetting[]);
      setLoading(false);
    }
    void loadSettings();
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, []);

  function selectFile(key: LoginKey) {
    setTarget(key);
    setError(null);
    setMessage(null);
    fileInput.current?.click();
  }

  async function upload(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0];
    event.target.value = "";
    if (!file) return;
    if (!["image/png", "image/jpeg", "image/webp"].includes(file.type)) {
      setError("Use a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image.");
      return;
    }
    if (file.size > 12 * 1024 * 1024) {
      setError("The maximum allowed file size is 12 MB.");
      return;
    }
    setUploading(target);
    setError(null);
    setMessage(null);
    const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    try {
      const dimensions = await new Promise<{ width: number; height: number }>((resolve, reject) => {
        const img = new window.Image();
        img.onload = () => resolve({ width: img.naturalWidth, height: img.naturalHeight });
        img.onerror = () => reject(new Error("Could not read the image."));
        img.src = objectUrl;
      });
      if (target === "login_background_desktop" && dimensions.width <= dimensions.height) {
        throw new Error("Please select a landscape image for desktop.");
      }
      if (target === "login_background_mobile" && dimensions.height <= dimensions.width) {
        throw new Error("Please select a portrait image for mobile.");
      }

      const supabase = createClient();
      const ext = file.type === "image/png" ? "png" : file.type === "image/webp" ? "webp" : "jpg";
      const path = `login-backgrounds/${target}-${crypto.randomUUID()}.${ext}`;
      const { error: storageError } = await supabase.storage.from("site-images").upload(path, file, {
        upsert: false,
        contentType: file.type,
      });
      if (storageError) throw storageError;
      const { data: publicImage } = supabase.storage.from("site-images").getPublicUrl(path);
      const { data: changed, error: updateError } = await supabase.from("site_settings")
        .update({
          image_url: publicImage.publicUrl,
          image_width: dimensions.width,
          image_height: dimensions.height,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        })
        .eq("key", target)
        .select("key,image_url,image_width,image_height")
        .maybeSingle();
      if (updateError) throw updateError;
      if (!changed) throw new Error("Setting not found or update not permitted. Apply the included SQL migration and verify Supabase permissions.");
      setSettings((previous) => [
        ...previous.filter((item) => item.key !== target),
        changed as BackgroundSetting,
      ]);
      setMessage(`${target === "login_background_desktop" ? "Desktop" : "Mobile"} login background updated. Refresh the login page to see it.`);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not update the background.");
    } finally {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
      setUploading(null);
    }
  }

  async function useDefault(key: LoginKey) {
    setUploading(key);
    setMessage(null);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const { data, error: resetError } = await supabase.from("site_settings")
        .update({ image_url: null, image_width: null, image_height: null, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
        .eq("key", key).select("key,image_url,image_width,image_height").maybeSingle();
      if (resetError) throw resetError;
      if (!data) throw new Error("Setting not found or update not permitted.");
      setSettings((old) => [...old.filter((setting) => setting.key !== key), data as BackgroundSetting]);
      setMessage("Original HappyTails background restored.");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not restore the default.");
    } finally { setUploading(null); }
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-6xl space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-3">
        <div>
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500"><Link href="/admin/website-management" className="text-brand-pink hover:underline">Website Management</Link> / Login Page</p>
          <h1 className="mt-1 text-3xl font-bold text-brand-pink">Login Page Backgrounds</h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-zinc-600">Change the desktop and mobile backgrounds without editing code. The login fields remain interactive HTML.</p>
        </div>
        <Link href="/sign-in" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="rounded-full border-2 border-brand-pink px-5 py-2 font-semibold text-brand-pink hover:bg-brand-tint">Preview Login â†—</Link>
      </div>

      {error && <div role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-red-700">{error}</div>}
      {message && <div role="status" className="rounded-xl border border-green-200 bg-green-50 p-3 text-green-700">{message}</div>}
      {loading ? <p>Loading backgrounds...</p> : (
        <div className="grid items-start grid-cols-1 gap-6 xl:grid-cols-2">
          {CONFIG.map((config) => {
            const value = settings.find((setting) => setting.key === config.key);
            const isUploading = uploading === config.key;
            const image = value?.image_url || config.fallback;
            return (
              <section key={config.key} className="rounded-3xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
                <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-800">{config.title}</h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500">{config.hint}</p>
                <div
                  role="img"
                  aria-label={`${config.title} background preview`}
                  className="mx-auto mt-5 max-h-[480px] w-full rounded-2xl border border-pink-200 bg-[#fae7ef] bg-contain bg-center bg-no-repeat"
                  style={{ aspectRatio: config.ratio, backgroundImage: `url(${JSON.stringify(image)})` }}
                />
                <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-zinc-500">
                  {value?.image_url ? `Custom image (${value.image_width || '?'} Ã— ${value.image_height || '?'})` : "Using original HappyTails artwork"}
                </p>
                <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => selectFile(config.key)}
                    disabled={uploading !== null}
                    className="rounded-full bg-brand-pink px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-brand-pink-dark disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {isUploading ? "Uploading..." : "Upload New Background"}
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => void useDefault(config.key)}
                    disabled={uploading !== null || !value?.image_url}
                    className="rounded-full border border-pink-300 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-brand-pink disabled:opacity-40"
                  >
                    Restore Original
                  </button>
                </div>
              </section>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
      <input ref={fileInput} type="file" accept=".png,.jpg,.jpeg,.webp,image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp" className="hidden" aria-label="Select login background image" onChange={(event) => void upload(event)} />
      <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">Only a Superadmin should manage these settings. Images use the existing Supabase <code>site-images</code> storage bucket and <code>site_settings</code> table. Google sign-in is displayed as unavailable until its OAuth flow is configured.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import type { SiteSetting, SiteSettingKey } from "@/lib/supabase/site-settings";

const options: { label: string; key: SiteSettingKey; fallback: string }[] = [
  { label: "Dog Avatar", key: "pet_avatar_dog_male", fallback: "/images/pets/pet-dog.jpg" },
  { label: "Cat Avatar", key: "pet_avatar_cat_male", fallback: "/images/pets/pet-cat.jpg" },
];
export default function PetAvatarsManager({ settings, onChanged, onClose }: {
  settings: SiteSetting[]; onChanged: () => Promise<void>; onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const [active, setActive] = useState<SiteSettingKey | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  async function upload(event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0];
    event.target.value = "";
    if (!file || !active) return;
    if (!file.type.startsWith("image/")) { setError("Choose an image file."); return; }
    if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) { setError("Image must be 5 MB or less."); return; }
    setSaving(true); setError("");
    let objectUrl: string | null = null;
    try {
      objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
      const dimensions = await new Promise<{ width: number; height: number }>((resolve, reject) => {
        const img = new window.Image();
        img.onload = () => resolve({ width: img.naturalWidth, height: img.naturalHeight });
        img.onerror = () => reject(new Error("Invalid image."));
        img.src = objectUrl!;
      });
      const db = createClient();
      const suffix = file.type === "image/png" ? "png" : file.type === "image/webp" ? "webp" : "jpg";
      const path = `${active}-${Date.now()}.${suffix}`;
      const { error: uploadError } = await db.storage.from("site-images").upload(path, file, { contentType: file.type });
      if (uploadError) throw uploadError;
      const url = db.storage.from("site-images").getPublicUrl(path).data.publicUrl;
      const { data, error: saveError } = await db.from("site_settings").update({ image_url: url, image_width: dimensions.width, image_height: dimensions.height, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq("key", active).select("key");
      if (saveError) throw saveError;
      if (!data?.length) throw new Error("Avatar setting row not found in Supabase. Confirm existing site_settings keys.");
      await onChanged();
    } catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Upload failed."); }
    finally { if (objectUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl); setSaving(false); setActive(null); }
  }
  return (
    <div role="presentation" className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-4" onMouseDown={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget && !saving) onClose(); }}>
      <section role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Configure Pet Avatars" className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-3xl bg-white p-6 shadow-xl">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4"><h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800">Configure Pet Avatars</h2><button type="button" onClick={onClose} disabled={saving} className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500">Close</button></div>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500">Upload one default image for dogs and one for cats. Avatars appear in a circle across pet cards and profiles.</p>
        <input ref={input} type="file" accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp" className="hidden" onChange={upload} />
        <div className="mt-5 space-y-3">{options.map(({ label, key, fallback }) => (
          <div key={key} className="flex items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 p-3">
            <div className="h-16 w-16 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-pink-50"><img src={settings.find(s => s.key === key)?.image_url || fallback} alt={label} className="h-full w-full object-cover object-center" /></div>
            <span className="flex-1 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800">{label}</span>

      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\admin\AdminShell.tsx =====

"use client";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter, usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import AdminSidebar from "./AdminSidebar";
import ConfirmDialog from "@/components/ui/ConfirmDialog";

export default function AdminShell({ children, role }: { children: React.ReactNode; role?: string }) {
  const [sidebarOpen, setSidebarOpen] = useState(false);
  const [logoutConfirmOpen, setLogoutConfirmOpen] = useState(false);
  const [mobile, setMobile] = useState(false);
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const router = useRouter();
  useEffect(() => {
    const query = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 767px)");
    const sync = () => {
      setMobile(query.matches);
      setSidebarOpen((previous) => query.matches ? false : previous || !query.matches);
    };
    sync();
    query.addEventListener("change", sync);
    return () => query.removeEventListener("change", sync);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { if (mobile) setSidebarOpen(false); }, [pathname, mobile]);

  // The RPC validates the authenticated account and suppresses duplicate
  // session-open events within 30 minutes; route navigations are not sign-ins.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (role !== "admin" && role !== "superadmin") return;
    const db = createClient();
    void db.rpc("happytails_staff_session_activity", { p_action: "Session opened" });
  }, [role]);

  async function handleLogout() {
    setLogoutConfirmOpen(false);
    const supabase = createClient();
    // Record before clearing the authenticated session. Do not prevent logout
    // if audit logging is temporarily unavailable.
    await supabase.rpc("happytails_staff_session_activity", { p_action: "Signed out" });
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
    router.push("/");
    router.refresh();
  }

  return <div className="ht-admin-shell flex min-h-screen">
    {mobile && sidebarOpen && <button type="button" className="ht-admin-backdrop" aria-label="Close navigation" onClick={() => setSidebarOpen(false)} />}
    <div className={`ht-admin-navigation ${mobile && sidebarOpen ? "ht-admin-navigation-open" : ""}`}>
      <AdminSidebar open={sidebarOpen} onToggle={() => setSidebarOpen(v => !v)} onLogout={() => setLogoutConfirmOpen(true)} role={role} />
    </div>
    <main className="ht-admin-content flex-1 min-w-0 bg-[#FDF1F7] p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8 overflow-y-auto">

import { useState } from "react";
import { bookingsByWeek, bookingsByMonth, bookingsByYear } from "@/lib/data/admin-mock";

type Period = "Week" | "Month" | "Year";
const datasets: Record<Period, { label: string; total: number }[]> = {
  Week: bookingsByWeek, Month: bookingsByMonth, Year: bookingsByYear,
};

export default function BookingsChart() {
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<Period>("Week");
  const data = datasets[period];
  const max = Math.max(...data.map((d) => d.total));

  return (
    <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 shadow-sm p-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h3 className="font-bold text-brand-pink text-sm">Bookings Overview</h3>
        <select
          value={period}
          onChange={(e) => setPeriod(e.target.value as Period)}
          className="text-xs font-semibold bg-brand-tint text-brand-pink px-3 py-1 rounded-full border-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-pink"
        >
          <option value="Week">This Week</option>
          <option value="Month">This Year (by month)</option>
          <option value="Year">All Time (by year)</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 flex items-end justify-between gap-2 h-32">
        {data.map((d) => (
          <div key={d.label} className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5">

"use client";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { fetchAllBatches, fetchProducts, computeStatus } from "@/lib/supabase/products";
import { batchHealth, sellableStock } from "@/lib/utils/inventory-expiration";
import type { Product, ProductBatch } from "@/lib/types/products";

export default function LowStockAlerts() {
  const [products,setProducts] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [batches,setBatches] = useState<ProductBatch[]>([]);
  const [error,setError] = useState<string|null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    async function load() {
      const [p,b] = await Promise.all([fetchProducts({activeOnly:true}),fetchAllBatches()]);
      if(!active)return;
      if(p.error || b.error){setError(p.error??b.error??"Unable to load inventory alerts.");return;}
      setError(null);setProducts(p.products);setBatches(b.batches);
    }
    void load();
    const refresh = () => {if(document.visibilityState === "visible")void load();};
    window.addEventListener("focus",refresh);
    return ()=>{active=false;window.removeEventListener("focus",refresh);};
  },[]);
  const low = products.filter(p => computeStatus(sellableStock(p.id,batches),p.min_stock) !== "In Stock")
    .sort((a,b)=>sellableStock(a.id,batches)-sellableStock(b.id,batches));
  const risk = batches.filter(b => b.quantity>0 && products.some(p=>p.id===b.product_id) && ["expired","expiring"].includes(batchHealth(b)))
    .sort((a,b)=>(batchHealth(a)==="expired"?0:1)-(batchHealth(b)==="expired"?0:1) || (a.expiration_date??"").localeCompare(b.expiration_date??""));
  return <section className="h-full rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm">
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2"><h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-brand-pink">Inventory Alerts</h3><Link href="/admin/inventory" className="rounded-full border border-brand-pink px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-brand-pink hover:bg-pink-50">View All</Link></div>
    {error?<p role="alert" className="mt-3 text-xs text-rose-700">{error}</p>:<div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
      {low.length===0 && risk.length===0 && <p className="py-6 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500">No low stock or expiration warnings.</p>}
      {risk.slice(0,3).map(b=><div key={b.id} className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 text-xs"><span className="min-w-0 truncate text-zinc-700">{products.find(p=>p.id===b.product_id)?.name??"Product"} Â· {b.batch_number}</span><span className={`shrink-0 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold ${batchHealth(b)==="expired"?"bg-rose-50 text-rose-700":"bg-amber-50 text-amber-800"}`}>{batchHealth(b)==="expired"?"Expired":"Expiring"}</span></div>)}
      {low.slice(0,3).map(p=><div key={p.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs"><span className="truncate text-zinc-700">{p.name}</span><span className="shrink-0 rounded-full bg-rose-50 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-rose-700">{sellableStock(p.id,batches)} left</span></div>)}
      {(low.length>3||risk.length>3)&&<p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500">More inventory alerts available in Inventory.</p>}
    </div>}
  </section>;

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\admin\Pagination.tsx =====

"use client";

// Shared responsive pagination. Only a small window of pages is rendered,
// preventing large result sets from expanding the mobile viewport.
export default function Pagination({
  page, pageSize, totalItems, onPageChange,
}: {
  page: number;
  pageSize: number;
  totalItems: number;
  onPageChange: (page: number) => void;
}) {
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalItems / Math.max(1, pageSize)));
  const current = Math.min(Math.max(page, 0), pageCount - 1);
  const start = totalItems === 0 ? 0 : current * pageSize + 1;
  const end = Math.min(totalItems, (current + 1) * pageSize);
  const pages = new Set<number>([0, pageCount - 1]);
  for (let i = current - 1; i <= current + 1; i++) {
    if (i >= 0 && i < pageCount) pages.add(i);
  }
  const visible = [...pages].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const control = "inline-flex h-10 min-w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-sm font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-brand-pink";
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Table pagination" className="flex w-full min-w-0 flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white px-3 py-3 sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:rounded-full sm:px-5">
      <span className="text-center text-xs text-zinc-600 sm:text-left sm:text-sm">
        Showing {start}â€“{end} of {totalItems} items
      </span>
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-1 sm:gap-1.5">
        <button type="button" onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.max(0, current - 1))} disabled={current === 0}
          className={`${control} text-brand-pink disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-zinc-300`} aria-label="Previous page">â€¹</button>
        {visible.map((index, position) => (
          <span className="contents" key={index}>
            {position > 0 && index - visible[position - 1] > 1 && (
              <span className="px-0.5 text-zinc-400" aria-hidden="true">â€¦</span>
            )}
            <button type="button" aria-label={`Page ${index + 1}`} aria-current={current === index ? "page" : undefined}
              onClick={() => onPageChange(index)}
              className={`${control} border ${current === index ? "border-brand-pink bg-brand-tint text-brand-pink" : "border-transparent text-zinc-600 hover:bg-brand-tint"}`}>
              {index + 1}
            </button>
          </span>
        ))}
        <button type="button" onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.min(pageCount - 1, current + 1))} disabled={current === pageCount - 1}
          className={`${control} text-brand-pink disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-zinc-300`} aria-label="Next page">â€º</button>
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\auth\HappyTailsLogin.tsx =====

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, type CSSProperties, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowRight, Eye, EyeOff, LockKeyhole, PawPrint, UserRound } from "lucide-react";

type LoginProps = {
  landscapeUrl: string;
  portraitUrl: string;
  customPortrait: boolean;
};

function GoogleG() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" role="img" aria-label="Google" className="ht-google-icon">
      <path fill="#EA4335" d="M24 9.5c3.54 0 6.71 1.22 9.21 3.6l6.85-6.85C35.9 2.38 30.47 0 24 0 14.62 0 6.51 5.38 2.56 13.22l7.98 6.19C12.43 13.72 17.74 9.5 24 9.5Z" />
      <path fill="#4285F4" d="M46.98 24.55c0-1.57-.15-3.09-.38-4.55H24v9.02h12.94c-.58 2.96-2.26 5.48-4.78 7.18l7.73 6C44.4 38.04 46.98 31.89 46.98 24.55Z" />
      <path fill="#FBBC05" d="M10.53 28.59A14.4 14.4 0 0 1 9.75 24c0-1.59.27-3.13.76-4.59l-7.98-6.2A23.9 23.9 0 0 0 0 24c0 3.87.93 7.52 2.56 10.78l7.97-6.19Z" />
      <path fill="#34A853" d="M24 48c6.48 0 11.93-2.13 15.91-5.8l-7.73-6c-2.15 1.45-4.92 2.3-8.18 2.3-6.26 0-11.57-4.22-13.47-9.91l-7.97 6.19C6.51 42.62 14.62 48 24 48Z" />
    </svg>
  );
}

export default function HappyTailsLogin({ landscapeUrl, portraitUrl, customPortrait }: LoginProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useSearchParams();
  const [identifier, setIdentifier] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [remember, setRemember] = useState(true);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [googleBusy, setGoogleBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Only the identifier is remembered, never the password or auth tokens.
    try {
      const saved = window.localStorage.getItem("happytails-last-login");
      if (saved) setIdentifier(saved);
    } catch { /* private-browsing storage can be unavailable */ }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (params.get("deactivated") === "1") {
      setError("This account is inactive or archived. Please contact support.");
    } else if (params.get("access") === "unverified") {
      setError("Your account access could not be verified. Please retry or contact support.");
    } else if (params.get("verified") === "1") {
      setError(null);
    } else if (params.get("google_error") === "oauth") {
      setError("Google sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.");
    } else if (params.get("google_error") === "setup") {
      setError("Your Google account was verified, but HappyTails account setup is incomplete. Please contact support.");
    }
  }, [params]);

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      // Preserve the EXISTING verified server-side password, role and status checks.
      const response = await fetch("/api/auth/login", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        credentials: "same-origin",
        cache: "no-store",
        body: JSON.stringify({ identifier: identifier.trim(), password }),
      });
      const result = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as
        | { ok?: boolean; redirectTo?: string; error?: string }
        | null;
      if (!response.ok || !result?.ok) {
        setError(result?.error || "Unable to sign in. Please try again.");
        return;
      }
      try {
        if (remember) window.localStorage.setItem("happytails-last-login", identifier.trim());
        else window.localStorage.removeItem("happytails-last-login");
      } catch { /* local storage is optional */ }
      router.replace(result.redirectTo === "/admin" ? "/admin" : "/account");
      router.refresh();
    } catch {
      setError("Unable to sign in right now. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleGoogleSignIn() {
    if (busy || googleBusy) return;
    setGoogleBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const { data, error: oauthError } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
        provider: "google",
        options: {
          redirectTo: `${window.location.origin}/auth/callback`,
          queryParams: { prompt: "select_account" },
        },
      });
      if (oauthError || !data.url) {
        setError("Unable to start Google sign-in. Please try again.");
        setGoogleBusy(false);
        return;
      }
      // Supabase returns the provider authorization URL. Never embed
      // Google credentials in the frontend or manually handle ID tokens.
      window.location.assign(data.url);
    } catch {
      setError("Unable to start Google sign-in. Please try again.");
      setGoogleBusy(false);
    }
  }

  const backgroundVars = {
    "--ht-landscape": `url(${JSON.stringify(landscapeUrl)})`,
    "--ht-portrait": `url(${JSON.stringify(portraitUrl)})`,
  } as CSSProperties;

  return (
    <div className={`ht-login-page${customPortrait ? " ht-login-custom-portrait" : ""}`} style={backgroundVars}>
      <div className="ht-login-portrait-top" aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="ht-login-placement">
        <div className="ht-login-portrait-middle" aria-hidden="true" />
        <section className="ht-login-card" aria-labelledby="ht-login-title">
          <header className="ht-login-heading">
            <PawPrint className="ht-login-paw" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true" />
            <h1 id="ht-login-title">Log In</h1>
            <p>Welcome back! Please login to your account.</p>
          </header>

          <form className="ht-login-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
            <div className="ht-login-field">
              <UserRound className="ht-login-field-icon" strokeWidth={2.7} aria-hidden="true" />
              <label className="sr-only" htmlFor="ht-identifier">Email or Username</label>
              <input
                id="ht-identifier"
                autoComplete="username"
                autoCapitalize="none"
                spellCheck={false}
                type="text"
                name="identifier"
                maxLength={254}
                placeholder="Email or Username"
                required
                disabled={busy}
                value={identifier}
                onChange={(event) => setIdentifier(event.target.value)}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="ht-login-field">
              <LockKeyhole className="ht-login-field-icon" fill="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden="true" />
              <label className="sr-only" htmlFor="ht-password">Password</label>
              <input
                id="ht-password"
                type={visible ? "text" : "password"}
                name="password"
                autoComplete="current-password"
                placeholder="Password"
                required
                disabled={busy}
                value={password}
                onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                className="ht-login-password-toggle"
                aria-label={visible ? "Hide password" : "Show password"}
                aria-pressed={visible}
                onClick={() => setVisible((value) => !value)}
              >
                {visible ? <Eye aria-hidden="true" /> : <EyeOff aria-hidden="true" />}
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="ht-login-options">
              <label className="ht-login-remember">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={remember}
                  disabled={busy}
                  onChange={(event) => setRemember(event.target.checked)}
                />
                <span>Remember me</span>
              </label>
              <Link href="/forgot-password">Forgot password?</Link>
            </div>

            {error && <p role="alert" className="ht-login-error">{error}</p>}
            <button type="submit" className="ht-login-submit" disabled={busy}>
              <span>{busy ? "Signing in..." : "Log In"}</span>
              {!busy && <ArrowRight aria-hidden="true" />}
            </button>
          </form>

          {params.get("verified") === "1" && (
            <p role="status" className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-green-200 bg-green-50 px-3 py-2 text-center text-xs text-green-800">Email verified! Your HappyTails account is ready. Please log in.</p>
          )}
          <p className="mt-3 text-center text-[13px] text-zinc-600">New to HappyTails? <Link className="font-bold text-brand-pink underline underline-offset-2" href="/sign-up">Create an account</Link></p>

          <div className="ht-login-divider"><span>Or continue with</span></div>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="ht-login-google"
            disabled={busy || googleBusy}
            onClick={handleGoogleSignIn}
            aria-label="Continue with Google"
          >
            <GoogleG /> <span>{googleBusy ? "Connecting to Google..." : "Continue with Google"}</span>
          </button>
        </section>
      </div>
      <div className="ht-login-portrait-bottom" aria-hidden="true" />
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\dashboard\booking\AddPetModal.tsx =====

"use client";
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import YoungPetGroomingNotice from "@/components/shared/YoungPetGroomingNotice";
import { insertCustomerPet } from "@/lib/utils/pet-size-guide";
import { normalizePetAge } from "@/lib/utils/pet-age";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import { hasValidCustomerPhone } from "@/lib/utils/customer-phone";
import type { Pet } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import { CustomerPetFields, useCustomerPetForm } from "@/components/dashboard/CustomerPetFields";
export default function AddPetModal({ customerId, onClose, onAdded }: { customerId: string; onClose: () => void; onAdded: (pet: Pet) => void }) {
  const [showGroomingNotice, setShowGroomingNotice] = useState(true);
  const state = useCustomerPetForm();
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  async function submit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (saving || !state.validate()) return;
    setSaving(true); setError("");
    try {
      const { data: contact, error: contactError } = await createClient().from("customers").select("phone_number").eq("id", customerId).maybeSingle();
      if (contactError || !hasValidCustomerPhone(contact?.phone_number)) throw new Error("Add a valid phone number in My Account before registering a pet.");
      const { form, size } = state;
      const age = normalizePetAge(form.age);
      if (!age) throw new Error("Enter a valid pet age.");
      const { data, error: saveError } = await insertCustomerPet({
        customer_id: customerId, name: form.name.trim(), species: form.species,
        breed: form.breed.trim(), size_label: size?.label ?? "Unclassified", weight_kg: form.weight.trim() ? Number(form.weight) : null,
        pet_size_id: size?.id ?? null, ...age, sex: form.sex || null,
        vaccination_status: form.vaccination_status,
      });
      if (saveError || !data) throw new Error(saveError?.message ?? "Unable to add pet.");
      onAdded(data as Pet);
    } catch (caught) { setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : "Unable to add pet."); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  }
  if (showGroomingNotice) return <YoungPetGroomingNotice onCancel={onClose} onContinue={() => setShowGroomingNotice(false)} />;
  return <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[90] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-4" onMouseDown={e => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget && !saving) onClose(); }}>
    <form noValidate onSubmit={submit} role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="new-pet-title" className="max-h-[90vh] w-full max-w-lg overflow-y-auto rounded-3xl bg-white shadow-2xl">
      <div className="sticky top-0 flex items-center justify-between bg-brand-pink px-6 py-4 text-white"><h2 id="new-pet-title" className="text-lg font-bold">Add New Pet</h2><button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close">âœ•</button></div>
      <div className="space-y-5 p-6"><CustomerPetFields state={state}/>
        {error&&<p role="alert" className="rounded-lg bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2"><button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={onClose} className="rounded-full border px-5 py-2.5 text-sm">Cancel</button><button disabled={saving || (!!state.form.weight.trim() ? false : state.loadingGuide || !!state.guideError)} type="submit" className="rounded-full bg-brand-pink px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50">{saving ? "Savingâ€¦" : "Add Pet"}</button></div>
      </div>
    </form>
  </div>;
}
