===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\dashboard\booking\BookingPetInformationStep.tsx =====

"use client";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { PawPrint, Plus, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, CheckSquare2, X } from "lucide-react";
import type { Pet } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { Customer } from "@/lib/types/users";
import BookingPetCard from "./BookingPetCard";
import AddPetModal from "./AddPetModal";
import WalkInPetProfileModal from "@/components/admin/pos/walk-in/WalkInPetProfileModal";
import PetSizeEstimateModal, { needsPetSizeEstimate } from "./PetSizeEstimateModal";

export default function BookingPetInformationStep({ customer, pets, onPetsChange, selectedIds, onSelectionChange, onBack, onNext }: {
  customer: Customer; pets: Pet[]; onPetsChange: (pets: Pet[]) => void; selectedIds: string[];
  onSelectionChange: (ids: string[]) => void; onBack: () => void; onNext: () => void;
}) {
  const [profilePet, setProfilePet] = useState<Pet | null>(null);
  const [addingPet, setAddingPet] = useState(false);
  const [estimating, setEstimating] = useState<Pet | null>(null);
  const [sizeReview, setSizeReview] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const pageSize = 4;
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const activePets = pets.filter(p => !(p as Pet & { archived_at?: string | null }).archived_at);
  const activeIds = new Set(activePets.map(p => p.id));
  const selectedActiveIds = selectedIds.filter(id => activeIds.has(id));
  const allSelected = activePets.length > 0 && selectedActiveIds.length === activePets.length;
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(activePets.length / pageSize));
  useEffect(() => { setPage(current => Math.min(current, pageCount)); }, [pageCount]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedIds.some(id => !activeIds.has(id))) onSelectionChange(selectedIds.filter(id => activeIds.has(id)));
    // Only trim selections when the active pet IDs change.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [activePets.map(p => p.id).join("|")]);
  const shownPets = activePets.slice((page - 1) * pageSize, page * pageSize);
  const toggle = (id: string) => { onSelectionChange(selectedIds.includes(id) ? selectedIds.filter(x => x !== id) : [...selectedActiveIds,id]); setError(null); };
  const selectAll = () => { onSelectionChange(activePets.map(p => p.id)); setError(null); };
  const clearAll = () => { onSelectionChange([]); setError(null); };
  const unknown = activePets.filter(p => selectedActiveIds.includes(p.id) && needsPetSizeEstimate(p));
  useEffect(() => {
    if (sizeReview && !estimating && selectedActiveIds.length && unknown.length === 0) {
      setSizeReview(false); onNext();
    }
    // Advance only after updated pet data has reached the parent and rerendered.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [sizeReview, estimating, pets]);
  function advance() {
    if (!selectedActiveIds.length) { setError("Select at least one active pet to continue."); return; }
    if (unknown.length) { setSizeReview(true); setEstimating(unknown[0]); return; }
    setError(null); onNext();
  }
  function saveEstimate(updated: Pet) {
    const nextPets = pets.map(p => p.id === updated.id ? updated : p);
    onPetsChange(nextPets);
    const pending = nextPets.filter(p => selectedActiveIds.includes(p.id) && needsPetSizeEstimate(p));
    if (pending.length) { setEstimating(pending[0]); return; }
    setEstimating(null);
    if (sizeReview) setError(null);
  }
  return <section className="ht-pet-choice flex flex-col">
    <header className="text-center"><span className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-pink-50 text-brand-pink"><PawPrint size={23}/></span>
      <h2 className="mt-3 text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800">Choose Your Pet</h2>
      <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">Select one or more active pets. If a pet has no size yet, you can estimate it here without waiting for staff.</p>
    </header>
    <div className="mt-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">Your active pets <span className="ml-1 text-xs font-medium text-slate-400">({activePets.length})</span></p>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setAddingPet(true)} className="inline-flex min-h-10 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-brand-pink px-4 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink hover:bg-pink-50"><Plus size={15}/> Add New Pet</button>
    </div>
    {activePets.length > 0 && <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-xl border border-pink-100 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 sm:px-4">
      <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600" aria-live="polite">{selectedActiveIds.length} of {activePets.length} pets selected</span>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <button type="button" onClick={selectAll} disabled={allSelected} className="inline-flex min-h-9 items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-pink-50 px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink transition hover:bg-pink-100 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50" aria-label="Select all active pets on every page"><CheckSquare2 size={15}/> Select All Pets</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={clearAll} disabled={selectedActiveIds.length === 0} className="inline-flex min-h-9 items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-zinc-200 px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 transition hover:bg-zinc-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40" aria-label="Clear all selected pets"><X size={14}/> Clear</button>
      </div>
    </div>}
    <div className="mt-3 rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-pink-50/20 p-3">
      {activePets.length ? <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">{shownPets.map(pet => <BookingPetCard key={pet.id} pet={pet} selected={selectedActiveIds.includes(pet.id)} onToggleSelect={() => toggle(pet.id)} onViewProfile={() => setProfilePet(pet)}/>)}</div>
      : <div className="py-12 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">No active pets available. Add a new pet or restore one in My Pets.</div>}
    </div>
    {activePets.length > pageSize && <nav aria-label="Pet pages" className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2">
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setPage(p => Math.max(1, p - 1))} disabled={page === 1} className="rounded-full border border-pink-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink disabled:opacity-40">Previous</button>
      {Array.from({length: pageCount}, (_, i) => i + 1).map(n => <button type="button" key={n} onClick={() => setPage(n)} aria-current={page === n ? "page" : undefined} className={`h-8 min-w-8 rounded-full px-2 text-xs font-bold ${page === n ? "bg-brand-pink text-white" : "border border-pink-200 bg-white text-brand-pink"}`}>{n}</button>)}
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setPage(p => Math.min(pageCount, p + 1))} disabled={page === pageCount} className="rounded-full border border-pink-200 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink disabled:opacity-40">Next</button>
      <span className="w-full text-center text-xs text-slate-500">Showing {(page - 1) * pageSize + 1}â€“{Math.min(activePets.length, page * pageSize)} of {activePets.length} pets</span>
    </nav>}
    {unknown.length > 0 && <p className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 text-xs text-amber-900">{unknown.length} selected pet{unknown.length === 1 ? " needs" : "s need"} a size estimate for service pricing and kennel safety. You can continue after estimating; no exact weight or staff assistance is required.</p>}
    {error && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}
    <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 border-t border-pink-100 pt-5">
      <button type="button" onClick={onBack} className="flex min-h-12 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full border-2 border-pink-200 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink"><ArrowLeft size={16}/> Back</button>
      <button type="button" disabled={selectedActiveIds.length === 0} onClick={advance} className="flex min-h-12 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-brand-pink text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40">Next <ArrowRight size={16}/></button>
    </div>
    {profilePet && <WalkInPetProfileModal pet={profilePet} owner={customer} onClose={() => setProfilePet(null)}/>}
    {addingPet && <AddPetModal customerId={customer.id} onClose={() => setAddingPet(false)} onAdded={(pet) => {onPetsChange([...pets,pet]);onSelectionChange([...selectedActiveIds,pet.id]);setAddingPet(false);setPage(Math.ceil((activePets.length + 1) / pageSize));}}/>}
    {estimating && <PetSizeEstimateModal key={estimating.id} pet={estimating} onSaved={saveEstimate} onCancel={() => { setEstimating(null); setSizeReview(false); }} />}
  </section>;
}

"use client";
import { Check } from "lucide-react";
import "./booking-progress-mobile.css";
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

export type BookingPhase = "pet-info" | "service" | "waiver" | "selection" | "schedule" | "add-more" | "summary";
const steps = [
  { key: "pet-info", label: "Choose a Pet" },
  { key: "service", label: "Select Service" },
  { key: "waiver", label: "Service Waiver" },
  { key: "selection", label: "Details" },
  { key: "schedule", label: "Schedule" },
  { key: "add-more", label: "More Services" },
  { key: "summary", label: "Review" },
] as const;
export default function BookingProgress({ step, hasCompletedServices, combinedBoarding = false }: {
  step: BookingPhase; hasCompletedServices: boolean; combinedBoarding?: boolean;
}) {
  const shownSteps = combinedBoarding
    ? steps.filter((item) => item.key !== "schedule").map((item) =>
        item.key === "selection" ? { ...item, label: "Boarding Details & Dates" } : item)
    : [...steps];
  const active = shownSteps.findIndex((item) => item.key === step);
  const trackRef = useRef<HTMLOListElement | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const track = trackRef.current;
    if (!track || typeof window === "undefined" || window.innerWidth > 760) return;
    const target = track.children[active] as HTMLElement | undefined;
    if (!target) return;
    const center = target.offsetLeft - track.offsetLeft + target.offsetWidth / 2 - track.clientWidth / 2;
    track.scrollTo({ left: Math.max(0, center), behavior: "smooth" });
  }, [active]);
  return <aside className="ht-booking-progress" aria-label="Booking progress">
    <p className="ht-progress-overline">YOUR APPOINTMENT</p>
    <h2>Booking steps</h2>
    <ol ref={trackRef}>{shownSteps.map((item, i) => {
      const completed = i < active || (hasCompletedServices && (item.key === "service" || item.key === "selection" || item.key === "schedule"));
      return <li key={item.key} aria-current={active === i ? "step" : undefined} className={active === i ? "active" : completed ? "completed" : ""}>
        <span className="ht-progress-marker">{completed ? <Check size={14} strokeWidth={3} /> : i + 1}</span><span>{item.label}</span>
      </li>;
    })}</ol>
    <p className="ht-progress-help">You can review all selected services before confirming.</p>
  </aside>;
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { fetchPackagesFull, fetchPetSizes, fetchAddonsByCategory } from "@/lib/supabase/services";
import { fetchGroomers } from "@/lib/supabase/pet-services";
import type { ServiceType, Package, PackageInclusion, PackagePricing, PetSize, Addon, AddonPrice } from "@/lib/types/services";
import type { Groomer } from "@/lib/types/pet-services";
import type { Pet, DraftPetSelection } from "@/lib/types/appointments";

type DataSet = { packages: Package[]; inclusions: PackageInclusion[]; pricing: PackagePricing[]; sizes: PetSize[]; addons: Addon[]; addonPrices: AddonPrice[] };
const empty: DataSet = {packages: [], inclusions: [], pricing: [], sizes: [], addons: [], addonPrices: []};

export default function CustomerGroomingPackagesStep({ serviceType, pets, selections, onChange, onBack, onNext }: {
  serviceType: "grooming" | "dog_grooming" | "cat_grooming";
  pets: Pet[]; selections: DraftPetSelection[];
  onChange: (selections: DraftPetSelection[]) => void;
  onBack: () => void; onNext: () => void;
}) {
  const [lookup, setLookup] = useState<Record<"dog_grooming" | "cat_grooming", DataSet>>({dog_grooming: empty,cat_grooming: empty});
  const [groomers, setGroomers] = useState<Groomer[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const kinds: ("dog_grooming" | "cat_grooming")[] = serviceType === "grooming" ? ["dog_grooming", "cat_grooming"] : [serviceType];
    Promise.all([
      Promise.all(kinds.map(async kind => {
        const [packages, sizes, addons] = await Promise.all([fetchPackagesFull(kind), fetchPetSizes(kind), fetchAddonsByCategory("Grooming Add-ons")]);
        return [kind, { packages: packages.packages.filter(p => p.is_active), inclusions: packages.inclusions, pricing: packages.pricing,
          sizes: sizes.sizes.filter(s => s.is_active), addons: addons.addons.filter(a => a.is_active), addonPrices: addons.prices }] as const;
      })), fetchGroomers({activeOnly:true})
    ]).then(([rows, groomersResult]) => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      setLookup(prev => ({...prev,...Object.fromEntries(rows)}));
      setGroomers(groomersResult.groomers);
    }).finally(() => {if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);});
    return () => {cancelled = true;};
  }, [serviceType]);
  const pet = pets[activeIndex];
  const data = lookup[pet?.species === "Cat" ? "cat_grooming" : "dog_grooming"];
  const current = pet ? selections.find(s => s.pet.id === pet.id) : undefined;
  const priceFor = (packageId: string, sizeId: string, label: string) =>
    data.pricing.find(p => p.package_id === packageId && (p.size_id === sizeId || p.size_label === label)) ??
    data.pricing.find(p => p.package_id === packageId && p.size_id === null);
  function calculate(sel: DraftPetSelection) {
    const size = data.sizes.find(s => s.id === sel.sizeId);
    let total = sel.packageId && sel.sizeId ? (priceFor(sel.packageId,sel.sizeId,size?.label ?? "")?.price ?? 0) : 0;
    for(const addonId of sel.addonIds) {
      total += (data.addonPrices.find(p=>p.addon_id===addonId && p.size_label===size?.label)
        ?? data.addonPrices.find(p=>p.addon_id===addonId))?.price ?? 0;
    }
    return total;
  }
  function patch(changes: Partial<DraftPetSelection>) {
    if (!pet) return;
    const base: DraftPetSelection = current ?? {pet, packageId:null, packagePricingId:null, sizeId:null, kennelId:null, groomerId:null, addonIds:[],lineAmount:0};
    const updated = {...base,...changes};
    updated.lineAmount = calculate(updated);
    onChange([...selections.filter(s=>s.pet.id!==pet.id),updated]);
  }
  if (loading) return <p className="py-16 text-center text-slate-500">Loading packages...</p>;
  if (!pet) return null;
  const allReady = pets.every(p => {const s=selections.find(x=>x.pet.id===p.id);return !!s?.packageId && !!s.sizeId;});
  return <section className="mx-auto max-w-3xl">
    <header className="text-center"><h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800">Choose a Package</h2>
      <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">Compare full package inclusions from Service Management for each pet.</p></header>
    <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2">{pets.map((p,i)=><button key={p.id} type="button" onClick={()=>setActiveIndex(i)}
      className={`rounded-full border-2 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold ${i===activeIndex?"border-brand-pink bg-brand-pink text-white":"border-pink-100 text-slate-700"}`}>
      {p.name}{selections.find(s=>s.pet.id===p.id)?.packageId?" âœ“":""}</button>)}</div>
    <div className="mt-5 rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 p-5"><h3 className="font-bold text-slate-800">{pet.name} <span className="font-normal text-slate-500">({pet.species})</span></h3>
      <p className="mt-5 font-bold text-slate-800">Select Package</p>
      <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">{data.packages.map(pkg=>{
        const active=current?.packageId===pkg.id;
        const inclusions=data.inclusions.filter(i=>i.package_id===pkg.id).sort((a,b)=>a.sort_order-b.sort_order);
        return <button type="button" key={pkg.id} aria-pressed={active} onClick={()=>patch({packageId:pkg.id,packagePricingId:null,sizeId:null})}
          className={`rounded-2xl border-2 p-4 text-left transition ${active?"border-brand-pink bg-pink-50":"border-pink-100 bg-white hover:border-brand-pink"}`}>
          <span className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2"><span className="font-bold text-slate-800">{pkg.name}</span>{active&&<span className="text-sm font-bold text-brand-pink">âœ“</span>}</span>
          <span className="mt-3 block space-y-1">{inclusions.length>0?inclusions.map(item=><span key={item.id} className="block text-xs leading-5 text-slate-600">â€¢ {item.label}</span>):<span className="block text-xs text-slate-500">No inclusions specified</span>}</span>
        </button>;
      })}</div>
      {current?.packageId && <>
        <p className="mt-6 font-bold text-slate-800">Select Size</p>
        <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">{data.sizes.map(size=>{
          const price=priceFor(current.packageId!,size.id,size.label);
          return <button type="button" key={size.id} aria-pressed={current.sizeId===size.id} onClick={()=>patch({sizeId:size.id})}
            className={`rounded-xl border-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold ${current.sizeId===size.id?"border-brand-pink bg-brand-pink text-white":"border-pink-100 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:border-brand-pink"}`}>
            {size.label}{size.weight_range?` (${size.weight_range})`:""}{price?` Â· â‚±${price.price.toLocaleString()}`:""}</button>;
        })}</div>
        <label className="mt-6 block text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">Select Groomer <span className="font-normal text-slate-400">(Optional)</span>
          <select value={current.groomerId??""} onChange={e=>patch({groomerId:e.target.value||null})} className="mt-2 block w-full rounded-xl border border-pink-100 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm sm:w-72">
            <option value="">No preference</option>{groomers.map(g=><option value={g.id} key={g.id}>{g.name}</option>)}
          </select></label>
        {data.addons.length>0&&<><p className="mt-6 font-bold text-slate-800">Add-ons <span className="text-sm font-normal text-slate-400">(Optional)</span></p>
          <div className="mt-2 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">{data.addons.map(addon=>{

function timeLabel(value: string): string {
  const [hours, minutes] = value.split(":").map(Number);
  return `${hours % 12 || 12}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")} ${hours >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM"}`;
}
function overlaps(aStart: number, aDuration: number, bStart: number, bEnd: number): boolean {
  return aStart < bEnd && aStart + aDuration > bStart;
}

  function availableForPlan(

      const key = `${String(Math.floor(minute / 60)).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(minute % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
      if (!rows[key]?.includes(groomerId)) return false;
    }
    return !reserved.some(item => item.groomerId === groomerId &&
      overlaps(start, duration, item.startMinute, item.endMinute));

    } catch (cause) {

const empty: Lookups = { packages: [], inclusions: [], pricing: [], sizes: [], addons: [], addonPrices: [] };
type PetWithSize = Pet & { pet_size_id?: string | null; weight_kg?: number | null };
const normalize = (v: string) => v.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "").replace(/^size/, "");
function minimumSizeIndex(pet: Pet, sizes: PetSize[]) {
  const saved = pet as PetWithSize;
  if (pet.species === "Cat" && saved.weight_kg != null && Number(saved.weight_kg) > 0) {
    const category = Number(saved.weight_kg) <= CAT_SMALL_MAX_KG ? "small" : "large";
    return sizes.findIndex(s => s.label.trim().toLowerCase() === category);
  }
  if (saved.pet_size_id) { const i = sizes.findIndex(s => s.id === saved.pet_size_id); if (i >= 0) return i; }
  const label = normalize(pet.size_label ?? "");
  if (!label || ["unknown", "unclassified", "notset", "na"].includes(label)) return -1;
  const direct = sizes.findIndex(s => normalize(s.label) === label);
  if (direct >= 0) return direct;
  return sizes.findIndex(s => label.startsWith(normalize(s.label)) || normalize(s.label).startsWith(label)) < 0
    ? -2 : sizes.findIndex(s => label.startsWith(normalize(s.label)) || normalize(s.label).startsWith(label));
}

export default function CustomerGroomingSelectionStep({ serviceType, pets, selections, onChange, onBack, onNext }: {
  serviceType: GroomingChoice; pets: Pet[]; selections: DraftPetSelection[];
  onChange: (items: DraftPetSelection[]) => void; onBack: () => void; onNext: () => void;
}) {
  const [lookups, setLookups] = useState<Record<ServiceType, Lookups>>({ dog_grooming: empty, cat_grooming: empty, boarding: empty });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [activePetIdx, setActivePetIdx] = useState(0);
  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState<"back" | "proceed" | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    let valid = true;
    setLoading(true); setError(null);
    const services: ServiceType[] = serviceType === "grooming" ? ["dog_grooming", "cat_grooming"] : [serviceType];
    void Promise.all(services.map(async type => {
      const [p, sz, a] = await Promise.all([fetchPackagesFull(type), fetchPetSizes(type), fetchAddonsByCategory("Grooming Add-ons")]);
      if (p.error || sz.error || a.error) throw new Error(p.error ?? sz.error ?? a.error ?? "Unable to load grooming services");
      const sizes = sz.sizes.filter(s => s.is_active);
      return [type, { packages: p.packages.filter(row => row.is_active), inclusions: p.inclusions, pricing: p.pricing,
        sizes: type === "cat_grooming" ? catGroomingSizeGuide(sizes) : sizes,
        addons: a.addons.filter(row => row.is_active), addonPrices: a.prices }] as const;
    })).then(rows => { if (valid) setLookups(previous => ({ ...previous, ...Object.fromEntries(rows) })); })
      .catch(e => { if (valid) setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unable to load grooming packages"); })
      .finally(() => { if (valid) setLoading(false); });
    return () => { valid = false; };
  }, [serviceType]);

  const pet = pets[activePetIdx];
  const data = lookups[pet?.species === "Cat" ? "cat_grooming" : "dog_grooming"];
  const selected = selections.find(s => s.pet.id === pet?.id);
  const minimum = pet ? minimumSizeIndex(pet, data.sizes) : -1;
  function rateFor(packageId: string, size: PetSize, lookup = data) {
    const rows = lookup.pricing.filter(row => row.package_id === packageId);
    return rows.find(row => row.size_id === size.id || normalize(row.size_label) === normalize(size.label)) ?? rows.find(row => row.size_id === null);
  }
  function addonRate(addonId: string, sizeLabel?: string, lookup = data) {
    return groomingAddonPrice(lookup.addonPrices.filter(row => row.addon_id === addonId), sizeLabel);
  }
  function update(patch: Partial<DraftPetSelection>) {
    if (!pet) return;
    const base = selected ?? { pet, packageId: null, packagePricingId: null, sizeId: null, kennelId: null, groomerId: null, addonIds: [], lineAmount: 0 };
    const draft: DraftPetSelection = { ...base, ...patch };
    if (draft.sizeId) {
      const idx = data.sizes.findIndex(size => size.id === draft.sizeId);
      if (minimum === -2 || idx < 0 || idx < minimum) return;
    }
    const size = data.sizes.find(s => s.id === draft.sizeId);
    const rate = draft.packageId && size ? rateFor(draft.packageId, size) : null;
    const addons = draft.addonIds.map(id => addonRate(id, size?.label));
    draft.lineAmount = (rate?.price ?? 0) + addons.reduce((sum, row) => sum + (row?.price ?? 0), 0);
    draft.groomerId = null;
    onChange([...selections.filter(s => s.pet.id !== pet.id), draft]);
  }
  function configured(item: Pet) {
    const s = selections.find(row => row.pet.id === item.id);
    const lookup = lookups[item.species === "Cat" ? "cat_grooming" : "dog_grooming"];
    const min = minimumSizeIndex(item, lookup.sizes);
    const idx = lookup.sizes.findIndex(size => size.id === s?.sizeId);
    return !!s?.packageId && idx >= 0 && min !== -2 && idx >= min &&
      !!lookup.pricing.find(rate => rate.id === s.packagePricingId && rate.package_id === s.packageId) &&
      (s.addonIds ?? []).every(id => !!groomingAddonPrice(lookup.addonPrices.filter(a => a.addon_id === id), lookup.sizes[idx]?.label));
  }
  const ready = pets.length > 0 && pets.every(configured);
  function next() {
    if (!pet || !configured(pet)) return;
    if (ready) { setPrompt("proceed"); return; }
    const idx = Array.from({ length: pets.length - 1 }, (_, offset) => (activePetIdx + offset + 1) % pets.length)
      .find(i => !configured(pets[i]));
    if (idx !== undefined) setActivePetIdx(idx);
  }
  if (loading) return <p className="py-16 text-center text-zinc-400">Loading grooming optionsâ€¦</p>;
  if (error) return <div role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-red-50 p-4 text-sm text-red-700">{error}<button type="button" onClick={onBack} className="ml-3 font-semibold underline">Back</button></div>;
  if (!pet) return null;
  return <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl">
    <h2 className="text-center text-2xl font-bold text-brand-pink">{serviceType === "grooming" ? "Grooming" : pet.species === "Cat" ? "Cat Grooming" : "Dog Grooming"}</h2>
    <p className="mt-1 text-center text-sm text-zinc-500">Choose the package, size and add-ons. You will select an available groomer after choosing a date and start time.</p>
    <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2">{pets.map((p, i) => <button type="button" key={p.id} onClick={() => setActivePetIdx(i)}
      className={`rounded-full border-2 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold ${i === activePetIdx ? "border-brand-pink bg-brand-pink text-white" : "border-pink-100 bg-white text-zinc-600"}`}>
      {p.species === "Cat" ? "ðŸˆ" : "ðŸ•"} {p.name} {configured(p) ? "âœ“" : ""}</button>)}</div>
    <div className="mt-6 rounded-2xl border-2 border-pink-100 bg-white p-5">
      <p className="font-bold text-zinc-800">{pet.name} <span className="font-normal text-zinc-400">({pet.species})</span></p>
      <p className="mt-5 font-bold">Select Package</p>
      <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">{data.packages.map(pkg => <button type="button" key={pkg.id}
        onClick={() => update({ packageId: pkg.id, packagePricingId: null, sizeId: null, addonIds: [], groomerId: null })}
        className={`rounded-xl border-2 p-3 text-left text-sm ${selected?.packageId === pkg.id ? "border-brand-pink bg-brand-tint" : "border-pink-100 hover:border-brand-pink"}`}>
        <p className="font-semibold">{pkg.name}</p>{data.inclusions.filter(row => row.package_id === pkg.id).map(row => <p key={row.id} className="text-xs text-zinc-500">â€¢ {row.label}</p>)}
      </button>)}</div>
      {selected?.packageId && <>
        <p className="mt-6 font-bold">Select Size</p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">Registered size: <strong>{pet.size_label || "Unclassified"}</strong>. {minimum === -2 ? "Saved size needs correction by staff." : pet.species === "Cat" ? "Cat grooming uses Small and Large only." : "You may select the registered size or larger."}</p>
        <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">{data.sizes.map((size, idx) => {
          const price = rateFor(selected.packageId!, size);
          const blocked = minimum === -2 || idx < minimum || !price;
          return <button type="button" key={size.id} disabled={blocked}
            onClick={() => update({ sizeId: size.id, packagePricingId: price?.id ?? null })}
            className={`rounded-lg border-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold ${blocked ? "border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-400" : selected.sizeId === size.id ? "border-brand-pink bg-brand-pink text-white" : "border-pink-200"}`}>
            {size.label} {size.weight_range && <span className="font-normal">({size.weight_range})</span>} {price && `â‚±${price.price}`}
          </button>;
        })}</div>
        <p className="mt-6 rounded-xl bg-pink-50 p-3 text-xs text-zinc-600">Groomers are selected in the Schedule step, where the system can hide groomers already booked at your chosen start time.</p>
        {!!data.addons.length && <><p className="mt-6 font-bold">Add-ons (Optional)</p>
          <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">{data.addons.map(addon => {
            const size = data.sizes.find(s => s.id === selected.sizeId);
            const rate = addonRate(addon.id, size?.label);
            const selectedAddon = selected.addonIds.includes(addon.id);
            return <button type="button" key={addon.id} disabled={!selected.sizeId || (!rate && !selectedAddon)}
              onClick={() => update({ addonIds: selectedAddon ? selected.addonIds.filter(id => id !== addon.id) : [...selected.addonIds, addon.id] })}
              className={`rounded-xl border-2 px-3 py-2 text-left text-xs ${selectedAddon ? "border-brand-pink bg-brand-pink text-white" : "border-pink-100 text-zinc-700"} disabled:opacity-40`}>
              <span className="block font-semibold">{addon.name}</span>{rate && <span>â‚±{rate.price}</span>}
            </button>;
          })}</div></>}
      </>}
    </div>
    <div className="mt-8 flex gap-3"><button type="button" onClick={() => { if (selections.length) setPrompt("back"); else onBack(); }} className="flex-1 rounded-full border-2 border-zinc-300 py-2.5 font-semibold text-zinc-500">Back</button>
      <button type="button" onClick={next} disabled={!configured(pet)} className="flex-1 rounded-full bg-brand-pink py-2.5 font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-40">{ready ? "Next: Schedule" : "Next Pet"}</button></div>

"use client";

import type { ReactNode, MouseEvent, KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { useBookingClosures } from "@/lib/booking/use-booking-closures";

/** Keeps the existing live-capacity planner intact while visibly marking and
 * blocking declared holidays. The database still enforces final submission. */
export default function CustomerHolidayCalendarGuard({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const closures = useBookingClosures();
  const closed = new Set(closures.dates.map(item => item.date));
  const selector = '.ht-customer-holiday-guard section[aria-label="Preferred grooming date calendar"] button[aria-label="';
  const rules = closures.dates.filter(d => /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(d.date)).map(d => {
    const base = `${selector}${d.date}"]`;
    return `${base}{background:#fff1f2!important;color:#be123c!important;border:1px solid #fecdd3!important;pointer-events:none!important;position:relative!important;}` +
      `${base}::after{content:"Closed";display:block;color:#be123c;font-weight:800;font-size:8px;line-height:10px;}`;
  }).join("\n");
  function blockEvent(event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement> | KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) {
    const target = event.target;
    if (!(target instanceof Element)) return;
    const button = target.closest('section[aria-label="Preferred grooming date calendar"] button[aria-label]');
    if (button && closed.has(button.getAttribute("aria-label") ?? "")) {
      event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation();
    }
  }
  return <div className="ht-customer-holiday-guard" onClickCapture={blockEvent} onKeyDownCapture={event => {
    if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") blockEvent(event);
  }}>
    <style>{rules}</style>
    {children}
  </div>;
}

"use client";

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createAppointmentsAtomic, type CreateAppointmentInput } from "@/lib/supabase/appointments";
import { isGrooming, verifyGroomingLegPlans, type ScheduledGroomingSelection } from "@/lib/supabase/grooming-booking";
import type { BookingLeg } from "@/lib/types/booking-leg";
import type { Customer } from "@/lib/types/users";
import type { AppointmentServiceType, DraftPetSelection } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { Package, PetSize, Addon } from "@/lib/types/services";
import type { Groomer, Kennel } from "@/lib/types/pet-services";

const labels: Record<string, string> = { grooming: "Grooming", dog_grooming: "Dog Grooming", cat_grooming: "Cat Grooming", boarding: "Boarding", ala_carte: "Ã€ La Carte" };
const prettyTime = (time?: string | null) => { if (!time || !/^\d{2}:\d{2}/.test(time)) return "â€”"; const [h, m] = time.split(":").map(Number); return `${h % 12 || 12}:${String(m).padStart(2, "0")} ${h >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM"}`; };
const selectionsOf = (leg: BookingLeg) => (leg.petSelections ?? []).filter((s): s is DraftPetSelection => !!s?.pet?.id);

export default function MultiServiceSummaryStep({ customer, legs, packagesByService, sizesByService, addonsByService, groomers, onBack, onEditLeg, onBooked }: {
  customer: Customer; legs: BookingLeg[];
  packagesByService: Record<string, Package[]>; sizesByService: Record<string, PetSize[]>;
  addonsByService: Record<string, Addon[]>; groomers: Groomer[]; kennels: Kennel[];
  onBack: () => void; onEditLeg: (legId: string) => void; onBooked?: () => void;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [ack, setAck] = useState(false);
  const lock = useRef(false);
  const hasGrooming = legs.some(l => isGrooming(l.serviceChoice));
  const total = legs.reduce((sum, leg) => sum + selectionsOf(leg).reduce((n, s) => n + Number(s.lineAmount || 0), 0), 0);
  const makeInput = (leg: BookingLeg, service: AppointmentServiceType, selection: DraftPetSelection[], start: string | null): CreateAppointmentInput => ({
    service_type: service, is_walk_in: false, customer_id: customer.id, owner_name: customer.full_name,
    owner_contact: customer.phone_number ?? "", owner_address: customer.address ?? null,
    scheduled_date: leg.scheduledDate ?? "", scheduled_time: start,
    drop_off_at: null, pick_up_at: null, special_requests: leg.specialRequests || null, petSelections: selection,
  });
  async function submit() {
    if (lock.current || saving || saved || (hasGrooming && !ack)) return;
    setError(null);
    if (!legs.length || legs.some(l => !selectionsOf(l).length)) { setError("Select a service for at least one pet."); return; }
    const writes: CreateAppointmentInput[] = [];
    for (const leg of legs) {
      for (const selection of selectionsOf(leg)) {
        if (!Number.isFinite(Number(selection.lineAmount)) || Number(selection.lineAmount) < 0) { setError("A pet has an invalid service price. Edit the service."); return; }
      }
      if (leg.serviceChoice === "boarding") {
        for (const s of selectionsOf(leg)) {
          if (!s.boardingScheduledDate || !s.boardingDropOffAt || !s.boardingPickUpAt) { setError(`Complete the boarding dates for ${s.pet.name}.`); return; }
          writes.push({ ...makeInput(leg, "boarding", [s], null), scheduled_date: s.boardingScheduledDate,
            drop_off_at: s.boardingDropOffAt, pick_up_at: s.boardingPickUpAt });
        }
      } else if (isGrooming(leg.serviceChoice)) {
        if (!leg.scheduledDate || !leg.scheduledTime) { setError("Edit the grooming schedule first."); return; }
        for (const s of selectionsOf(leg) as ScheduledGroomingSelection[]) {
          if (!s.groomingScheduledTime || !s.groomerId || !s.packagePricingId) { setError(`Complete grooming scheduling for ${s.pet.name}.`); return; }
          writes.push(makeInput(leg, s.pet.species === "Cat" ? "cat_grooming" : "dog_grooming", [s], s.groomingScheduledTime));
        }
      } else if (leg.serviceChoice === "ala_carte") {
        if (!leg.scheduledDate) { setError("Choose an Ã€ La Carte date."); return; }
        for (const selection of selectionsOf(leg)) {
          const s = selection as DraftPetSelection & { alaCarteScheduledTime?: string | null };
          if (!s.addonIds?.length || Number(s.lineAmount) <= 0 || !s.groomerId || !s.alaCarteScheduledTime) {
            setError(`Select Ã€ La Carte items, a time, and an available groomer for ${s.pet.name}.`); return;
          }
          // Individual appointments retain each pet's own start time and
          // allow sequential reuse of the same groomer without overlap.
          writes.push(makeInput(leg, "ala_carte", [s], s.alaCarteScheduledTime));
        }
      }
    }
    lock.current = true; setSaving(true);
    try {
      const problem = await verifyGroomingLegPlans(legs);
      if (problem) { setError(problem); lock.current = false; return; }
      const result = await createAppointmentsAtomic(writes);
      if (result.error) { setError(`Booking not completed: ${result.error}`); lock.current = false; return; }
      if (result.appointments.length !== writes.length) throw new Error("Unexpected booking confirmation. Check existing appointments before retrying.");
      onBooked?.();
      setSaved(true);
    } catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unexpected booking result. Check appointments before retrying."); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  }
  if (saved) return <div className="mx-auto max-w-md py-12 text-center">
    <h2 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-emerald-700">Booking Complete</h2>

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import BookingDayCalendar from "@/components/shared/BookingDayCalendar";
import { useBookingClosures, manilaTime, manilaToday } from "@/lib/booking/use-booking-closures";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import {
  formatGroomingClock, groomingMinutes, groomingPlanClosingError,
  GROOMING_CLOSE_MINUTES, type GroomingPlannedSlot,
} from "@/lib/booking/grooming-closing";
import type { DraftPetSelection } from "@/lib/types/appointments";

type Planned = GroomingPlannedSlot & { index: number };
type LiveSlot = { slot_time: string; capacity: number; booked: number; remaining: number };
type MonthDay = { day: string; open_slots: number; capacity: number };
type Choice = { groomer_id: string; groomer_name: string; available: boolean };
type Props = {
  petSelections: DraftPetSelection[];
  scheduledDate: string | null;
  scheduledTime: string | null;
  specialRequests: string;
  onDateChange: (date: string) => void;
  onTimeChange: (time: string) => void;
  onRequestsChange: (text: string) => void;
  onSelectionsChange: (items: DraftPetSelection[]) => void;
  onBack: () => void;
  onConfirmed: (items: DraftPetSelection[]) => void;
};

const slots = Array.from({ length: 17 }, (_, index) => {
  const minutes = 9 * 60 + index * 30;
  return `${String(Math.floor(minutes / 60)).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(minutes % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
});

export default function OnlineCapacityGroomingSchedule({ petSelections, scheduledDate, scheduledTime,
  specialRequests, onDateChange, onTimeChange, onRequestsChange, onSelectionsChange,
  onBack, onConfirmed }: Props) {
  const closures = useBookingClosures();
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(() => (scheduledDate ?? manilaToday()).slice(0, 7));
  const [fullDates, setFullDates] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [monthError, setMonthError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [live, setLive] = useState<Record<string, LiveSlot>>({});
  const [capacity, setCapacity] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [plan, setPlan] = useState<Planned[] | null>(null);
  const planRef = useRef<Planned[] | null>(null);
  const [choices, setChoices] = useState<Record<string, Choice[]>>({});
  const [preference, setPreference] = useState<Record<string, string | null>>(() =>
    Object.fromEntries(petSelections.map(s => [s.pet.id, s.groomerId])));
  const [refresh, setRefresh] = useState(0);
  const [durationByRate, setDurationByRate] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const rateKey = [...new Set(petSelections.map(s => s.packagePricingId).filter((id): id is string => Boolean(id)))].sort().join("|");
  const today = manilaToday();

  // These durations are a fast UI hint; the PostgreSQL planner and insert
  // trigger independently check authoritative, verified package durations.
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    if (!rateKey) { setDurationByRate({}); return; }
    void (async () => {
      const pricingIds = rateKey.split("|");
      const db = createClient();
      const { data: rates, error: rateError } = await db.from("package_pricing")
        .select("id,package_id").in("id", pricingIds);
      if (rateError) throw rateError;
      const packageIds = [...new Set((rates ?? []).map(r => r.package_id))];
      if (!packageIds.length) return {} as Record<string, number>;
      const { data: durations, error: durationError } = await db.from("grooming_package_durations")
        .select("package_id,duration_minutes,verified").in("package_id", packageIds);
      if (durationError) throw durationError;
      const verified = new Map((durations ?? []).filter(d => d.verified &&
        Number.isSafeInteger(d.duration_minutes) && d.duration_minutes >= 30)
        .map(d => [d.package_id, d.duration_minutes]));
      return Object.fromEntries((rates ?? []).flatMap(rate => {
        const minutes = verified.get(rate.package_id);
        return minutes ? [[rate.id, minutes] as const] : [];
      }));
    })().then(rows => { if (active) setDurationByRate(rows ?? {}); })
      .catch(() => { if (active) setDurationByRate({}); });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [rateKey]);

  function invalidate() { planRef.current = null; setPlan(null); setError(null); }

  const reloadMonth = useCallback(async (key: string) => {
    const { data, error: failure } = await createClient().rpc("happytails_groomer_month_availability", {
      p_first_day: `${key}-01`,
    });
    if (failure) { setMonthError(failure.message); setFullDates({}); return; }
    const unavailable: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const item of (data ?? []) as MonthDay[]) {
      if (item.open_slots === 0) unavailable[item.day] = item.capacity === 0 ? "No groomers available" : "Fully booked";
    }
    // A previously cached monthly result may treat a Philippine holiday as
    // closed even after SuperAdmin has explicitly opened it. Cross-check live
    // groomer slots for reopened holidays before labeling them unavailable.
    // Do NOT invent capacity: if no groomers are free, the day stays blocked.
    const reopened = closures.dates.filter(d => d.is_open_override && d.date.startsWith(`${key}-`));
    if (reopened.length) {
      const checks = await Promise.all(reopened.map(async d => {
        const { data: slots, error: slotError } = await createClient().rpc("happytails_live_groomer_slots", { p_date: d.date });
        return { day: d.date, available: !slotError && Array.isArray(slots) && slots.some((s: LiveSlot) => Number(s.remaining) > 0) };
      }));
      for (const item of checks) {
        if (item.available) delete unavailable[item.day];
        // Otherwise preserve the reason from the authoritative planner.
      }
    }
    setMonthError(null);
    setFullDates(unavailable);
  // Re-evaluate monthly availability whenever Calendar Management changes.
  }, [closures.dates]);

  useEffect(() => { void reloadMonth(month); }, [month, refresh, reloadMonth]);

  const loadSlots = useCallback(async (date: string) => {
    const { data, error: failure } = await createClient().rpc("happytails_live_groomer_slots", { p_date: date });
    if (failure) throw new Error(failure.message);
    const rows = (data ?? []) as LiveSlot[];
    setLive(Object.fromEntries(rows.map(item => [item.slot_time, item])));
    setCapacity(rows[0]?.capacity ?? 0);
    return rows;
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!scheduledDate) { setLive({}); setCapacity(null); return; }
    let valid = true;
    setLoading(true);
    void loadSlots(scheduledDate)
      .catch(cause => { if (valid) { setLive({}); setError(String(cause?.message ?? cause)); } })
      .finally(() => { if (valid) setLoading(false); });
    return () => { valid = false; };
  }, [scheduledDate, refresh, loadSlots]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      if (document.visibilityState === "visible") setRefresh(value => value + 1);
    }, 30000);
    const focus = () => setRefresh(value => value + 1);
    window.addEventListener("focus", focus);
    return () => { window.clearInterval(timer); window.removeEventListener("focus", focus); };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!scheduledDate || !scheduledTime || !petSelections.length) { setChoices({}); return; }
    let valid = true;
    void Promise.all(petSelections.map(async selection => {
      if (!selection.packagePricingId) return [selection.pet.id, []] as const;
      const { data, error: failure } = await createClient().rpc("happytails_groomer_choices_v2", {
        p_date: scheduledDate, p_time: scheduledTime, p_pricing_id: selection.packagePricingId,
      });
      if (failure) throw new Error(failure.message);
      return [selection.pet.id, (data ?? []) as Choice[]] as const;
    })).then(rows => { if (valid) setChoices(Object.fromEntries(rows)); })
      .catch(cause => { if (valid) { setChoices({}); setError(`Unable to verify groomers: ${String(cause?.message ?? cause)}`); } });
    return () => { valid = false; };
  }, [scheduledDate, scheduledTime, petSelections, refresh]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (scheduledDate && (closures.nameFor(scheduledDate) || fullDates[scheduledDate])) {
      planRef.current = null;
      setPlan(null);
      onTimeChange("");
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [scheduledDate, closures.dates, fullDates]);

  /** Fast necessary check for the calendar before the actual SQL planner.
   * Every pet requires at least 30 minutes. Selected same-groomer pets are
   * sequential; separate groomers can work simultaneously.
   */
  function startRestriction(time: string, slot: LiveSlot | undefined, slotRows: LiveSlot[] = Object.values(live)): string | null {
    const start = groomingMinutes(time);
    if (start === null || start + 30 > GROOMING_CLOSE_MINUTES) return "Finishes after 5:30 PM";
    if (!slot) return "Checking groomer availability";
    if (slot.remaining < 1) return "Fully booked";
    const minutesAvailable = GROOMING_CLOSE_MINUTES - start;
    const minutesByGroomer = new Map<string, number>();
    let totalMinutes = 0;
    for (const selection of petSelections) {
      const duration = durationByRate[selection.packagePricingId ?? ""] ?? 30;
      totalMinutes += duration;
      // Even with multiple groomers, a single pet cannot finish after closing.
      if (duration > minutesAvailable) return "The selected package finishes after 5:30 PM";
      const groomer = preference[selection.pet.id];
      if (groomer) minutesByGroomer.set(groomer, (minutesByGroomer.get(groomer) ?? 0) + duration);
    }
    if ([...minutesByGroomer.values()].some(minutes => minutes > minutesAvailable)) {
      return "Selected groomer cannot finish every pet by 5:30 PM";
    }
    // At 5 PM, each currently free groomer can do only one 30-minute pet.
    if (start === 17 * 60 && petSelections.length > slot.remaining) {
      return `${petSelections.length} pets need ${petSelections.length} groomers at 5 PM`;
    }
    // Bound capacity across the FULL remaining time window, including groomers
    // who are busy at the chosen start but become free in later half-hour slots.
    // Multiplying only the initial free count by the time remaining would reject
    // bookings that are in fact schedulable. The SQL planner resolves exact fit.
    const availableMinutes = slotRows.reduce((sum, row) => {
      const minute = groomingMinutes(row.slot_time);
      return minute !== null && minute >= start && minute < GROOMING_CLOSE_MINUTES
        ? sum + Math.max(0, row.remaining) * 30 : sum;
    }, 0);
    if (availableMinutes > 0 && totalMinutes > availableMinutes) {
      return "Not enough groomer time remains before 5:30 PM";
    }
    return null;
  }

  async function calculate(date: string, time: string): Promise<Planned[] | null> {
    if (closures.loading || closures.error || monthError) {
      setError("Unable to verify the calendar. Refresh before proceeding.");
      return null;
    }
    const closed = await closures.verifyOpen(date);
    if (closed) { setError(closed); return null; }
    if (date < manilaToday() || (date === manilaToday() && time <= manilaTime())) {
      setError("Choose a future start time."); return null;
    }
    if (!petSelections.length || petSelections.some(s => !s.packagePricingId)) {
      setError("Select a package and size for every pet first."); return null;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const rows = await loadSlots(date);
      const restriction = startRestriction(time, rows.find(row => row.slot_time === time), rows);
      if (restriction) throw new Error(`${restriction}. Choose an earlier slot or more available groomers.`);
      const { data, error: failure } = await createClient().rpc("happytails_grooming_plan_v2", {
        p_date: date,
        p_pricing_ids: petSelections.map(s => s.packagePricingId as string),
        p_preferred_start: time,
        p_groomer_ids: petSelections.map(s => preference[s.pet.id] || null),
      });
      if (failure) throw new Error(failure.message);
      const arranged = data as Planned[];
      if (!Array.isArray(arranged) || arranged.length !== petSelections.length ||
          arranged.some(item => !item.groomerId || !item.time || !item.endTime)) {
        throw new Error("The selected groomers cannot serve every pet within opening hours.");
      }
      const closingError = groomingPlanClosingError(arranged);
      if (closingError) throw new Error(closingError);
      planRef.current = arranged;
      setPlan(arranged);
      return arranged;
    } catch (cause) {
      planRef.current = null;
      setPlan(null);
      setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Unable to plan grooming appointments.");
      return null;
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }

  function chooseDate(date: string) {
    invalidate(); setLive({}); setCapacity(null); setChoices({});
    onDateChange(date); onTimeChange("");
    onSelectionsChange(petSelections.map(s => ({ ...s, groomingScheduledTime: undefined } as DraftPetSelection)));
  }
  function chooseTime(time: string) {
    if (!scheduledDate) return;
    const restriction = startRestriction(time, live[time]);
    if (restriction) { setError(restriction); return; }
    invalidate(); onTimeChange(time);
    onSelectionsChange(petSelections.map(s => ({ ...s, groomingScheduledTime: undefined } as DraftPetSelection)));
  }
  function chooseGroomer(petId: string, id: string) {
    invalidate();
    setPreference(previous => ({ ...previous, [petId]: id || null }));
  }
  function applyGroomerToAll(id: string) {
    invalidate();
    setPreference(Object.fromEntries(petSelections.map(s => [s.pet.id, id || null])));
  }
  async function proceed() {
    if (!scheduledDate || !scheduledTime || busy) return;
    const previous = planRef.current;
    const rechecked = await calculate(scheduledDate, scheduledTime);
    if (!rechecked) return;
    if (previous && JSON.stringify(previous) !== JSON.stringify(rechecked)) {
      setError("Groomer availability changed. Review the new times before continuing.");
      return;
    }
    const updated = petSelections.map((selection, index) => ({ ...selection,
      groomerId: rechecked[index].groomerId,
      groomingScheduledTime: rechecked[index].time,
    } as DraftPetSelection));
    onSelectionsChange(updated);
    onConfirmed(updated);
  }

  const disabled = closures.loading || !!closures.error || !!monthError;
  const commonGroomers = petSelections.length && petSelections.every(s => choices[s.pet.id])
    ? (choices[petSelections[0].pet.id] ?? []).filter(g => g.available && petSelections.every(s =>
        (choices[s.pet.id] ?? []).some(option => option.groomer_id === g.groomer_id && option.available)))
    : [];
  const selectedForAll = petSelections.length && petSelections.every(s =>
    preference[s.pet.id] === preference[petSelections[0].pet.id])
    ? preference[petSelections[0].pet.id] ?? "" : "mixed";

  return <section className="mx-auto w-full max-w-4xl space-y-5">
    <header className="text-center">
      <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-brand-pink">Grooming Schedule</h2>
      <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-zinc-600">One pet at a time per groomer. Pets sharing a groomer are scheduled consecutively, with no overlap.</p>
    </header>
    <p className="rounded-xl border border-pink-100 bg-pink-50 px-4 py-3 text-center text-xs leading-5 text-zinc-700">
      Active groomers: <strong>{capacity ?? "Checkingâ€¦"}</strong> Â· 30-minute start slots Â· All grooming must <strong>finish by 5:30 PM</strong> (Philippine time). Package duration and available groomers determine how many pets fit.
    </p>
    <BookingDayCalendar value={scheduledDate} onChange={chooseDate} closures={closures} unavailable={fullDates}
      onMonthChange={setMonth} title="Grooming" />
    {monthError && <p role="alert" className="rounded-lg bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-700">{monthError}</p>}
    {scheduledDate && closures.dates.some(d => d.date === scheduledDate && d.is_open_override) && fullDates[scheduledDate] &&
      <p role="alert" className="mt-2 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 text-sm text-amber-900">
        Calendar Management has opened this holiday, but groomer availability currently reports {fullDates[scheduledDate].toLowerCase()}.
        The date cannot be booked until an available groomer is confirmed. Check Groomer Availability settings and the database availability rules.
      </p>}
    <div>
      <h3 className="mb-2 font-semibold">Choose preferred start time</h3>
      <p className="mb-3 text-xs text-zinc-500">For example, two 30-minute pets with the same groomer must start by 4:30 PM. Two groomers may each begin a pet at 5:00 PM.</p>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6">
        {slots.map(time => {
          const item = live[time];
          const past = !scheduledDate || scheduledDate < today || (scheduledDate === today && time <= manilaTime());
          const full = !!item && item.remaining === 0;
          const restriction = item ? startRestriction(time, item) : null;
          const inactive = disabled || loading || busy || past || !item || !!restriction || !!fullDates[scheduledDate ?? ""];
          const selected = scheduledTime === time;
          return <button key={time} type="button" disabled={inactive} title={restriction ?? undefined}
            aria-label={`${formatGroomingClock(time)}: ${restriction || (item ? `${item.remaining} groomers available` : "Checking")}`}
            onClick={() => chooseTime(time)} aria-pressed={selected}

            <span className="block">{formatGroomingClock(time)}</span>
            <span className="text-[10px]">{past ? "Unavailable" : !item ? "Checkingâ€¦" : restriction ? "Too late / Full" : `${item.remaining} available`}</span>
          </button>;
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
    {scheduledDate && scheduledTime && <section className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-200 bg-white p-4">
      <h3 className="font-semibold">Groomer preference for each pet</h3>
      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">The system checks package durations, breaks, existing bookings and the 5:30 PM finish limit. Choosing the same groomer means pets are served one after another.</p>
      {petSelections.length > 1 && <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-pink-200 bg-pink-50 p-3">
        <label htmlFor="groomer-quick-select" className="block text-sm font-bold text-zinc-800">Quick select â€” apply to all {petSelections.length} pets</label>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-600">Choose a single groomer for the entire group, or assign groomers separately below.</p>
        <select id="groomer-quick-select" value={selectedForAll} onChange={(event: { target: { value: string } }) => applyGroomerToAll(event.target.value)}
          disabled={busy} className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-pink-200 bg-white px-3 py-3 text-sm">
          {selectedForAll === "mixed" && <option value="mixed" disabled>Different groomers selected</option>}
          <option value="">No preference â€” assign automatically</option>
          {commonGroomers.map(g => <option key={g.groomer_id} value={g.groomer_id}>{g.groomer_name}</option>)}
          {selectedForAll && selectedForAll !== "mixed" && !commonGroomers.some(g => g.groomer_id === selectedForAll) &&
            <option value={selectedForAll} disabled>Selected groomer no longer available</option>}

        {!commonGroomers.length && <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-amber-700">No single groomer can start every pet at the chosen time. Try separate groomers or an earlier slot.</p>}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { getActiveSizeGuide, matchPetSize } from "@/lib/utils/pet-size-guide";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import type { Pet } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { PetSize } from "@/lib/types/services";

type SizedPet = Pet & { pet_size_id?: string | null; weight_kg?: number | null; size_assessment_source?: string | null };
const recognized = (label: string) => ["small", "medium", "large", "extra large", "2x extra large"].includes(label.trim().toLowerCase()) || /^(?:x{1,5}l|[2-9]xl)$/.test(label.trim().toLowerCase());
export function needsPetSizeEstimate(pet: Pet): boolean {
  return !recognized(pet.size_label ?? "");
}

/** Shared Customer / registered-POS self-service path. Uses editable shop size guides.
 * An estimate is NOT represented as staff verification or a guaranteed kennel fit. */
export default function PetSizeEstimateModal({ pet, onSaved, onCancel }: {
  pet: Pet; onSaved: (pet: Pet) => void; onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const [guide, setGuide] = useState<PetSize[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [method, setMethod] = useState<"guide" | "weight">("guide");
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState("");
  const [weight, setWeight] = useState("");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [confirmEstimate, setConfirmEstimate] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    setLoading(true); setError(null); setSelectedId("");
    void getActiveSizeGuide(pet.species)
      .then((items) => { if (active) setGuide(items.filter((item) => recognized(item.label))); })
      .catch((cause) => { if (active) setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Could not load the shop size guide."); })
      .finally(() => { if (active) setLoading(false); });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [pet.species]);

  const validWeight = weight.trim() !== "" && Number.isFinite(Number(weight)) && Number(weight) > 0;
  const weightMatch = useMemo(() => validWeight ? matchPetSize(Number(weight), guide) : null, [validWeight, weight, guide]);
  const selected = method === "weight" ? guide.find((item) => item.id === weightMatch?.id) : guide.find((item) => item.id === selectedId);
  async function save() {
    if (!selected || !confirmEstimate || saving) return;
    setSaving(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const db = createClient();
      const { data: auth, error: authError } = await db.auth.getUser();
      if (authError || !auth.user) throw new Error("Your session has expired. Sign in again before proceeding.");
      const changes = {
        size_label: selected.label,
        pet_size_id: selected.id,
        weight_kg: method === "weight" ? Number(weight) : null,
        customer_estimated_size: selected.label,
        size_assessment_source: "customer_estimated",
      };
      const { data, error: saveError } = await db.from("pets").update(changes)
        .eq("id", pet.id).eq("customer_id", pet.customer_id ?? "")
        .select("*").maybeSingle();
      if (saveError) throw new Error(saveError.message);
      if (!data) throw new Error("The estimate was not saved. Check that you own this pet record and the SQL migration has been applied.");
      onSaved(data as SizedPet);
    } catch (cause) { setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Unable to save the estimate."); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  }

  return <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[180] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 p-3 sm:p-4">
    <section role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="pet-size-estimate-title" className="max-h-[92dvh] w-full max-w-xl overflow-y-auto rounded-3xl bg-white p-4 shadow-2xl sm:p-6">
      <h2 id="pet-size-estimate-title" className="text-xl font-bold text-brand-pink">Estimate {pet.name}&apos;s Size</h2>
      <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-zinc-600">A size is needed to calculate service prices and safely check kennels. You do not need an exact measurement. Choose the closest category using HappyTails&apos; size guide.</p>
      {loading && <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-zinc-500">Loading current {pet.species.toLowerCase()} size guideâ€¦</p>}
      {!loading && guide.length === 0 && <p role="alert" className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 p-3 text-sm text-amber-800">The shop size guide is unavailable. Please retry after the guide is configured.</p>}
      {!loading && !!guide.length && <>
        <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 rounded-xl bg-pink-50 p-1">
          <button type="button" onClick={() => { setMethod("guide"); setConfirmEstimate(false); }} aria-pressed={method === "guide"} className={`rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold ${method === "guide" ? "bg-white text-brand-pink shadow-sm" : "text-zinc-600"}`}>Choose a size</button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => { setMethod("weight"); setConfirmEstimate(false); }} aria-pressed={method === "weight"} className={`rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold ${method === "weight" ? "bg-white text-brand-pink shadow-sm" : "text-zinc-600"}`}>Approx. weight</button>
        </div>
        {method === "guide" ? <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2" role="group" aria-label="Estimated pet size">
          {guide.map((item) => <button type="button" key={item.id} aria-pressed={selectedId === item.id} onClick={() => { setSelectedId(item.id); setConfirmEstimate(false); }}
            className={`min-h-20 rounded-xl border-2 px-4 py-3 text-left ${selectedId === item.id ? "border-brand-pink bg-pink-50" : "border-pink-100 bg-white hover:border-pink-300"}`}>
            <span className="block text-sm font-bold">{item.label}</span>
            <span className="mt-1 block text-xs text-zinc-600">{item.weight_range || "Compare your pet with the size guide"}</span>
          </button>)}
        </div> : <label className="mt-4 block text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-700">Approximate weight (kg)
          <input type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" inputMode="decimal" value={weight} onChange={(e) => { setWeight(e.target.value); setConfirmEstimate(false); }} placeholder="e.g. 8.5"
            className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-pink-200 p-3 text-sm" />
          <span className="mt-2 block text-xs font-normal text-zinc-500">{!weight.trim() ? "Enter a rough estimate." : weightMatch ? `Suggested shop tier: ${weightMatch.label}` : "No size matches that weight. Check the weight or choose a size instead."}</span>
        </label>}
        <p className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 text-xs leading-5 text-amber-900">If you are between two categories, choose the larger one. The selected size is <strong>customer-estimated, not staff-verified</strong>. Staff will recheck at arrival; if it changes, kennel availability and pricing must be reviewed before check-in.</p>
        <label className="mt-4 flex items-start gap-2 text-sm text-zinc-700"><input type="checkbox" checked={confirmEstimate} onChange={(e) => setConfirmEstimate(e.target.checked)} className="mt-1 accent-pink-600" />I understand this is an estimate and may change after staff verification.</label>
      </>}
      {error && <p role="alert" className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-700">{error}</p>}
      <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={onCancel} className="min-h-12 rounded-full border border-pink-200 font-semibold text-brand-pink">Back</button>
        <button type="button" disabled={saving || loading || !selected || !confirmEstimate} onClick={() => void save()} className="min-h-12 rounded-full bg-brand-pink px-3 font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-40">{saving ? "Savingâ€¦" : "Save Estimate"}</button>
      </div>
    </section>
  </div>;
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { X, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import { fetchAppointmentDetail, type AppointmentRow } from "@/lib/supabase/appointment-management";
import { cancelCustomerAppointment } from "@/lib/supabase/customer-appointment-cancellation";
import { rescheduleCustomerAppointment } from "@/lib/supabase/customer-appointment-reschedule";
import CustomerCancellationReason from "./CustomerCancellationReason";
import CustomerRescheduleCalendar from "./CustomerRescheduleCalendar";

const reasons = ["Change of plans", "Schedule conflict", "Pet is unwell", "Booked by mistake", "Other"];
const serviceNames: Record<string, string> = { dog_grooming: "Dog Grooming", cat_grooming: "Cat Grooming", boarding: "Boarding", ala_carte: "Ã€ La Carte" };
function manilaDateTime(iso: string) {
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleString("en-PH", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" });
}
function originalTimeFor(row: AppointmentRow) {
  if (row.service_type === "boarding" && row.drop_off_at) {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23" }).format(new Date(row.drop_off_at));
  }
  return row.scheduled_time?.slice(0, 5) ?? "";
}

type Stage = "details" | "reason" | "reschedule" | "success" | "rescheduled";
export default function CustomerAppointmentDetailModal({ appointmentId, onClose, onCancelled }: {
  appointmentId: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  onCancelled?: () => void;
}) {
  const [row, setRow] = useState<AppointmentRow | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<Stage>("details");
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [details, setDetails] = useState("");
  const [date, setDate] = useState("");
  const [time, setTime] = useState("");
  const [scheduleValid, setScheduleValid] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const onScheduleValidityChange = useCallback((valid: boolean) => setScheduleValid(valid), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    setLoading(true); setError(null); setStage("details"); setScheduleValid(false);
    void fetchAppointmentDetail(appointmentId).then(result => {
      if (!alive) return;
      setRow(result.row); setError(result.error); setLoading(false);
      if (result.row) { setDate(result.row.scheduled_date); setTime(originalTimeFor(result.row)); }
    }).catch(() => {
      if (alive) { setError("Unable to load appointment details."); setLoading(false); }
    });
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [appointmentId]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const esc = (event: KeyboardEvent) => { if (event.key === "Escape" && !saving) onClose(); };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", esc);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", esc);
  }, [saving, onClose]);

  const canCancel = !!row && !row.is_walk_in && (row.status === "pending" || row.status === "confirmed");
  const canReschedule = !!row && !row.is_walk_in && row.status === "pending";
  const effective = reason === "Other" ? details.trim() : reason;
  const validReason = effective.length >= 5 && effective.length <= 500;

  async function cancel() {
    if (!row || !canCancel || !validReason || saving) return;
    setSaving(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const result = await cancelCustomerAppointment(row.id, effective);
      if (result.error) { setError(result.error); return; }
      setRow({ ...row, status: "cancelled" }); setStage("success"); onCancelled?.();
    } catch { setError("Unable to cancel this appointment. Please try again."); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  }

  async function reschedule() {
    if (!row || !canReschedule || !scheduleValid || saving) return;
    setSaving(true); setError(null);
    try {
      // This RPC is responsible for ownership, Pending status, current availability,
      // and preservation of boarding pickup duration. UI previews are advisory.
      const result = await rescheduleCustomerAppointment(row.id, date, time);
      if (result.error) { setError(result.error); return; }
      const stayDuration = row.drop_off_at && row.pick_up_at
        ? new Date(row.pick_up_at).getTime() - new Date(row.drop_off_at).getTime() : 0;
      const drop = row.service_type === "boarding" ? new Date(`${date}T${time}:00+08:00`) : null;
      setRow({ ...row, scheduled_date: date, scheduled_time: row.service_type === "boarding" ? null : time,
        drop_off_at: drop?.toISOString() ?? row.drop_off_at,
        pick_up_at: drop && stayDuration > 0 ? new Date(drop.getTime() + stayDuration).toISOString() : row.pick_up_at });
      setStage("rescheduled"); onCancelled?.();
    } catch { setError("Unable to reschedule this appointment. Please try again."); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  }

  return <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[90] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/55 p-3 sm:p-5"
    onMouseDown={event => { if (event.currentTarget === event.target && !saving) onClose(); }}>
    <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Appointment details"
      className={`flex max-h-[92dvh] w-full flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-white shadow-2xl ${stage === "reschedule" ? "max-w-2xl" : "max-w-xl"}`}>
      <header className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-between border-b border-pink-100 px-5 py-4">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-800">{stage === "reason" ? "Cancel Appointment" : stage === "reschedule" ? "Reschedule Appointment" : stage === "success" ? "Appointment Cancelled" : stage === "rescheduled" ? "Appointment Rescheduled" : "Appointment Details"}</h2>
        <button type="button" onClick={onClose} disabled={saving} aria-label="Close" className="rounded-full p-2 hover:bg-pink-50 disabled:opacity-40"><X size={20}/></button>
      </header>
      <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-5">
        {loading && <p className="py-8 text-center text-zinc-500">Loading appointmentâ€¦</p>}
        {error && <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-700">{error}</p>}
        {row && stage === "details" && <>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div><h3 className="font-bold text-zinc-800">{serviceNames[row.service_type] ?? row.service_type}</h3>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500">{row.scheduled_date}{row.scheduled_time ? ` Â· ${row.scheduled_time}` : ""}</p>
              {row.drop_off_at && <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">Drop off: {manilaDateTime(row.drop_off_at)}</p>}
              {row.pick_up_at && <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">Pick up: {manilaDateTime(row.pick_up_at)}</p>}
            </div>
            <span className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold ${row.status === "cancelled" ? "bg-red-100 text-red-700" : "bg-pink-100 text-brand-pink"}`}>{row.status.replace("_", " ")}</span>
          </div>
          <section className="space-y-3"><h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase text-zinc-500">Pets ({row.pets.length})</h4>
            {row.pets.map(p => <div key={p.appointmentPetId} className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-pink-50/30 p-4">
              <div className="flex justify-between gap-2"><strong className="text-zinc-800">{p.name}</strong><strong className="text-brand-pink">â‚±{p.lineAmount.toFixed(2)}</strong></div>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">{p.breed} Â· {p.size_label}</p>
              {p.packageName && <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-zinc-600">Package: {p.packageName}{p.packagePricingLabel ? ` (${p.packagePricingLabel})` : ""}</p>}
              {p.addonNames.length > 0 && <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">Add-ons: {p.addonNames.join(", ")}</p>}
              {p.groomerName && <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">Groomer: {p.groomerName}</p>}
              {p.kennelLabel && <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">Kennel: {p.kennelLabel}</p>}
            </div>)}
          </section>
          {row.status === "cancelled" && <CustomerCancellationReason appointmentId={row.id}/>} 
          {row.special_requests && <section className="rounded-xl border border-pink-100 p-3"><h4 className="text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500">Special requests</h4><p className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-sm">{row.special_requests}</p></section>}
          <div className="flex justify-between border-t border-pink-100 pt-4"><strong>Total amount</strong><strong className="text-brand-pink">â‚±{row.total_amount.toFixed(2)}</strong></div>
        </>}
        {row && stage === "reschedule" && <CustomerRescheduleCalendar appointment={row} date={date} time={time}
          onDateChange={setDate} onTimeChange={setTime} onValidityChange={onScheduleValidityChange}/>} 
        {stage === "reason" && <>
          <div className="flex gap-2 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-3 text-sm"><AlertTriangle size={20} className="shrink-0 text-amber-600"/>Cancelling affects every pet on this appointment and cannot be undone.</div>
          <label className="block text-sm font-semibold">Reason *<select value={reason} onChange={e => setReason(e.target.value)} className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-pink-200 p-3"><option value="">Select a reason</option>{reasons.map(item => <option key={item} value={item}>{item}</option>)}</select></label>
          {reason === "Other" && <label className="block text-sm font-semibold">Please explain *<textarea rows={3} maxLength={500} value={details} onChange={e => setDetails(e.target.value)} className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-pink-200 p-3"/></label>}
        </>}
        {stage === "success" && <p role="status" className="py-8 text-center font-semibold text-green-700">Your appointment has been cancelled.</p>}
        {stage === "rescheduled" && <p role="status" className="py-8 text-center font-semibold text-green-700">Your new schedule has been saved. The appointment remains Pending until staff confirm it.</p>}
      </div>
      {!loading && row && <footer className="shrink-0 border-t border-pink-100 p-4">
        {stage === "details" && (canCancel || canReschedule) && <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          {canReschedule && <button type="button" onClick={() => { setScheduleValid(false); setError(null); setStage("reschedule"); }} className="rounded-full bg-brand-pink py-3 font-semibold text-white">Reschedule</button>}
          {canCancel && <button type="button" onClick={() => { setError(null); setStage("reason"); }} className="rounded-full border-2 border-red-400 py-3 font-semibold text-red-600">Cancel Appointment</button>}
        </div>}
        {stage === "reason" && <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"><button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={() => { setError(null); setStage("details"); }} className="rounded-full border border-zinc-300 py-3">Back</button><button type="button" disabled={!validReason || saving} onClick={() => void cancel()} className="rounded-full bg-red-600 py-3 font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-40">{saving ? "Cancellingâ€¦" : "Confirm Cancellation"}</button></div>}
        {stage === "reschedule" && <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"><button type="button" disabled={saving} onClick={() => { setError(null); setStage("details"); }} className="rounded-full border border-zinc-300 py-3">Back</button><button type="button" disabled={!scheduleValid || saving} onClick={() => void reschedule()} className="rounded-full bg-brand-pink py-3 font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-40">{saving ? "Checkingâ€¦" : "Confirm Schedule"}</button></div>}
        {(stage === "success" || stage === "rescheduled") && <button type="button" onClick={onClose} className="w-full rounded-full bg-brand-pink py-3 font-semibold text-white">Done</button>}
      </footer>}
    </div>
  </div>;
}
