"use client";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { COMMON_BREEDS } from "@/lib/data/breed-suggestions";
import type { Species, Sex } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { PetSize } from "@/lib/types/services";
import { getActiveSizeGuide, matchPetSize, validatePetInput } from "@/lib/utils/pet-size-guide";
import { normalizePetAge } from "@/lib/utils/pet-age";
import type { VaccinationStatus } from "@/lib/utils/pet-vaccination";

export type CustomerPetForm = { name: string; species: Species; breed: string; weight: string; age: string; sex: Sex | ""; vaccination_status: VaccinationStatus };
export const blankCustomerPet: CustomerPetForm = { name: "", species: "Dog", breed: "", weight: "", age: "", sex: "", vaccination_status: "not_sure" };

export function useCustomerPetForm(initial: CustomerPetForm = blankCustomerPet) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState<CustomerPetForm>(initial);
  const [sizes, setSizes] = useState<PetSize[]>([]);
  const [guideError, setGuideError] = useState("");
  const [loadingGuide, setLoadingGuide] = useState(true);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    setLoadingGuide(true); setSizes([]); setGuideError("");
    getActiveSizeGuide(form.species).then(rows => {
      if (!active) return;
      setSizes(rows);
      if (!rows.length) setGuideError(`No active ${form.species.toLowerCase()} size guide is configured in Service Management.`);
    }).catch(err => { if (active) setGuideError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unable to load size guide."); })
      .finally(() => { if (active) setLoadingGuide(false); });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [form.species]);
  const size = useMemo(() => matchPetSize(Number(form.weight), sizes), [form.weight, sizes]);
  function setField<K extends keyof CustomerPetForm>(key: K, value: CustomerPetForm[K]) {
    setForm(old => ({ ...old, [key]: value }));
    setErrors(old => { const next = { ...old }; delete next[key]; return next; });
  }
  function validate() {
    // The shared old validator expects whole-year numeric ages. Validate
    // the new text age independently and preserve its existing other checks.
    const e = validatePetInput({ ...form, age: "" }, size);
    if (normalizePetAge(form.age) === null) e.age = "Use an age such as 3 weeks, 6 months, or 2 years (or leave it blank).";
    setErrors(e);
    return Object.keys(e).length === 0 && (!form.weight.trim() || (!guideError && !loadingGuide));
  }
  return { form, setForm, setField, size, loadingGuide, guideError, errors, setErrors, validate };
}

const CAT_BREEDS = ["Persian", "Siamese", "Sphynx", "British Shorthair", "Puspin", "Maine Coon", "Ragdoll", "Bengal", "Scottish Fold", "Russian Blue", "American Shorthair", "Exotic Shorthair", "Mixed Breed"];
const CAT_SET = new Set(CAT_BREEDS.filter(b => b !== "Mixed Breed"));
const DOG_BREEDS = [...COMMON_BREEDS.filter(b => !CAT_SET.has(b)), "Aspin", "Corgi", "Maltese", "Yorkshire Terrier", "Jack Russell Terrier", "Border Collie", "Doberman", "Rottweiler", "Mixed Breed"];
const sortedBreeds = (items: string[]) => Array.from(new Set(items)).sort((a,b) => a.localeCompare(b));

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { CalendarClock, Clock3, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react";
import BookingDayCalendar from "@/components/shared/BookingDayCalendar";
import { manilaToday, manilaTime, useBookingClosures } from "@/lib/booking/use-booking-closures";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import type { AppointmentRow } from "@/lib/supabase/appointment-management";

const slots = Array.from({ length: 19 }, (_, i) => {
  const minutes = 9 * 60 + i * 30;
  return `${String(Math.floor(minutes / 60)).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(minutes % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
});
const clockLabel = (value: string) => {
  const [h, m] = value.split(":").map(Number);
  return `${h % 12 || 12}:${String(m).padStart(2, "0")} ${h >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM"}`;
};
type LiveSlot = { slot_time: string; remaining: number; capacity: number };
type Props = {
  appointment: AppointmentRow;
  date: string;
  time: string;
  onDateChange: (date: string) => void;
  onTimeChange: (time: string) => void;
  onValidityChange: (valid: boolean) => void;
};

/** Reuses Grooming's calendar. Live capacity is informational; the save RPC makes the final decision. */
export default function CustomerRescheduleCalendar({ appointment, date, time, onDateChange, onTimeChange, onValidityChange }: Props) {
  const closures = useBookingClosures();
  const isGrooming = appointment.service_type === "dog_grooming" || appointment.service_type === "cat_grooming";
  const isBoarding = appointment.service_type === "boarding";
  const [slotsByTime, setSlotsByTime] = useState<Record<string, LiveSlot>>({});
  const [loadingSlots, setLoadingSlots] = useState(false);
  const [slotsError, setSlotsError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [refresh, setRefresh] = useState(0);
  const [clock, setClock] = useState(0);
  const today = manilaToday();
  const nowTime = manilaTime();
  const closed = closures.nameFor(date);
  const originalTime = isBoarding && appointment.drop_off_at
    ? new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23" }).format(new Date(appointment.drop_off_at))
    : (appointment.scheduled_time?.slice(0, 5) ?? "");
  const dateChanged = date !== appointment.scheduled_date || time !== originalTime;
  const currentAppointmentSlot = date === appointment.scheduled_date && time === originalTime;
  void clock;

  const reload = useCallback(async (target: string, signal: AbortSignal) => {
    const { data, error } = await createClient().rpc("happytails_live_groomer_slots", { p_date: target }).abortSignal(signal);
    if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
    return Object.fromEntries(((data ?? []) as LiveSlot[]).map(slot => [slot.slot_time, slot]));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isGrooming || !date || closures.loading || !!closures.error || !!closed) {
      setSlotsByTime({}); setLoadingSlots(false); setSlotsError(null); return;
    }
    const controller = new AbortController();
    let active = true;
    setLoadingSlots(true); setSlotsError(null); setSlotsByTime({});
    void reload(date, controller.signal).then(results => { if (active) setSlotsByTime(results); })
      .catch(error => { if (active) setSlotsError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unable to check live availability."); })
      .finally(() => { if (active) setLoadingSlots(false); });
    return () => { active = false; controller.abort(); };
  }, [isGrooming, date, closed, closures.loading, closures.error, reload, refresh]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      setClock(n => n + 1);
      if (document.visibilityState === "visible") setRefresh(n => n + 1);
    }, 30000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  const validTime = /^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(time) && time >= "09:00" && time <= (isGrooming ? "17:00" : "18:00");
  const inFuture = !!date && (date > today || (date === today && time > nowTime));
  // The current appointment already occupies its original grooming slot.
  // The server handles its own reservation when saving a reschedule.
  const selectedGroomingSlot = slotsByTime[time];
  const roomForSelection = !isGrooming || (selectedGroomingSlot !== undefined &&
    (selectedGroomingSlot.remaining > 0 || currentAppointmentSlot));
  const canProceed = dateChanged && validTime && inFuture && !closed && !closures.loading && !closures.error &&
    (!isGrooming || (!loadingSlots && !slotsError && roomForSelection));

  useEffect(() => { onValidityChange(Boolean(canProceed)); }, [canProceed, onValidityChange]);

  return <div className="space-y-4">
    <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-pink-100 bg-pink-50 p-3 text-sm text-zinc-700">
      <CalendarClock size={21} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-brand-pink" />
      <span>Select a new date and {isBoarding ? "drop-off" : "appointment"} time. Your pet services and prices stay the same. Only Pending appointments can be rescheduled.</span>
    </div>
    <BookingDayCalendar value={date || null} onChange={next => { onDateChange(next); onTimeChange(""); }} closures={closures} title="Reschedule" />
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
      <h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-zinc-800"><Clock3 size={17} className="text-brand-pink" />Choose {isBoarding ? "drop-off" : "start"} time</h3>
      {isGrooming && <button type="button" onClick={() => setRefresh(n => n + 1)} disabled={!date || loadingSlots}
        className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-brand-pink disabled:opacity-40"><RefreshCw size={13}/> Refresh availability</button>}
    </div>
    {isGrooming && <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">Availability is checked live and refreshed every 30 seconds. Final capacity is verified again when you save.</p>}
    {!isGrooming && <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500">Closed dates and past times are blocked. {isBoarding ? "Kennel availability and pickup constraints" : "Final availability"} will be checked when you confirm the change.</p>}
    {slotsError && <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 p-3 text-sm text-rose-700">Unable to load live grooming availability: {slotsError}</p>}
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3" aria-label="Rescheduling time slots">
      {slots.filter(slot => slot <= (isGrooming ? "17:00" : "18:00")).map(slot => {
        const past = !date || date < today || (date === today && slot <= nowTime);
        const live = slotsByTime[slot];
        const ownSlot = date === appointment.scheduled_date && slot === originalTime;
        const noRoom = isGrooming && (!live || (live.remaining <= 0 && !ownSlot));
        const unavailable = past || !!closed || closures.loading || !!closures.error || (isGrooming && (loadingSlots || !!slotsError || noRoom));
        const chosen = slot === time;
        const status = past ? "Past" : closed ? "Closed" : isGrooming
          ? loadingSlots ? "Checkingâ€¦" : slotsError || !live ? "Unavailable" : noRoom ? "Full" : `${Math.max(0, live.remaining)} available${ownSlot ? " Â· your slot" : ""}`
          : "Select time";
        return <button type="button" key={slot} disabled={unavailable} onClick={() => onTimeChange(slot)} aria-pressed={chosen && !unavailable}
          className={`flex min-h-14 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-xl border px-2 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition ${chosen && !unavailable ? "border-brand-pink bg-brand-pink text-white" : unavailable ? "border-zinc-100 bg-zinc-50 text-zinc-400" : "border-pink-200 bg-white text-zinc-700 hover:border-brand-pink hover:bg-pink-50"} disabled:cursor-not-allowed`}>
          <span>{clockLabel(slot)}</span><span className={`text-[10px] font-normal ${chosen && !unavailable ? "text-white/90" : "opacity-75"}`}>{status}</span>
        </button>;
      })}
    </div>
    {isBoarding && <p className="rounded-xl bg-zinc-50 p-3 text-xs text-zinc-600">Your original boarding stay length is preserved; pickup shifts with the new drop-off. The database validates the requested schedule.</p>}
    {!!date && !!time && !dateChanged && <p className="text-xs text-amber-700">Choose a different date or time from your current appointment.</p>}
  </div>;
}

    };
    void refreshPhone();
    window.addEventListener("happytails:contact-updated", refreshPhone);
    const channel = createClient().channel(`customer-contact-${customer.id}`)
      .on("postgres_changes", { event: "UPDATE", schema: "public", table: "customers", filter: `id=eq.${customer.id}` }, refreshPhone).subscribe();
    return () => { active = false; window.removeEventListener("happytails:contact-updated", refreshPhone); void createClient().removeChannel(channel); };
  }, [customer.id]);

  const loadUnreadCount = useCallback(async () => {
    const { count } = await fetchUnreadNotificationCount(customer.id);
    setUnreadCount(count);
  }, [customer.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadUnreadCount();
    const unsubscribe = subscribeToNotifications(customer.id, loadUnreadCount);
    return unsubscribe;
  }, [customer.id, loadUnreadCount]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!logoutOpen) return;
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape" && !signingOut) setLogoutOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
  }, [logoutOpen, signingOut]);

  async function handleSignOut() {
    if (signingOut) return;
    setSigningOut(true);
    setSignOutError("");
    try {
      const supabase = createClient();
      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signOut();
      if (error) throw error;
      setLogoutOpen(false);
      router.replace("/");
      router.refresh();
    } catch {
      setSignOutError("Could not log out. Please try again.");
    } finally {
      setSigningOut(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <nav className="bg-brand-pink shadow-md">
        <div className="mx-auto flex min-h-[64px] items-center justify-between px-4 sm:px-6 md:px-10">
          <Link href="/" className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2">
            <Image src="/images/logo.png" alt="Happy Tails" width={36} height={36} className="h-9 w-9 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-white" />
            <span className="truncate text-base font-semibold italic text-white sm:text-lg">Happy Tails</span>
          </Link>
          <div className="hidden items-center gap-8 text-sm font-medium text-white md:flex">
            {topNavLinks.map((link) => <Link key={link.label} href={link.href} className="hover:opacity-80">{link.label}</Link>)}
          </div>
          <div className="relative flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setMenuOpen((v) => !v)} aria-label="Open navigation menu" aria-expanded={menuOpen} className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/15 text-white transition-colors hover:bg-white/25 md:hidden">
              <svg width="21" height="21" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.2" strokeLinecap="round"><path d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16" /></svg>
            </button>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setAccountOpen((v) => !v)} aria-label="Account menu" aria-expanded={accountOpen} className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/20 text-white transition-colors hover:bg-white/30">
              <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 12c2.7 0 4.9-2.2 4.9-4.9S14.7 2.2 12 2.2 7.1 4.4 7.1 7.1 9.3 12 12 12zm0 2.5c-3.3 0-9.8 1.6-9.8 4.9v2.4h19.6v-2.4c0-3.3-6.5-4.9-9.8-4.9z" /></svg>
            </button>
            {accountOpen && (
              <div className="absolute right-0 top-full z-50 mt-2 w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] max-w-56 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white py-1 shadow-xl sm:w-56">
                <div className="border-b border-pink-50 px-4 py-3"><p className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800">{customer.full_name}</p></div>
                <Link href="/account/profile" onClick={() => setAccountOpen(false)} className="block px-4 py-3 text-sm text-zinc-600 hover:bg-brand-tint">My Account{!phoneComplete && <span title="Phone number required" className="ml-2 inline-block h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-red-500" />}</Link>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => { setAccountOpen(false); setSignOutError(""); setLogoutOpen(true); }} className="w-full px-4 py-3 text-left text-sm text-red-500 hover:bg-red-50">Sign Out</button>

"use client";
// Full-size before/after viewer. Opens when a GalleryCard is clicked.
// Takes the FULL photo list (not just the current page's visible slice)
// so prev/next inside the lightbox can move through everything, not just
// the 3-4 cards that happened to be on screen when it was opened.
import { useEffect } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";
import type { GalleryPhoto } from "@/lib/types/gallery";

export default function GalleryLightbox({
  photos,
  index,
  onClose,
  onNavigate,
}: {
  photos: GalleryPhoto[];
  index: number;
  onClose: () => void;
  onNavigate: (nextIndex: number) => void;
}) {
  const photo = photos[index];

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (e.key === "Escape") onClose();
      if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") onNavigate((index - 1 + photos.length) % photos.length);
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight") onNavigate((index + 1) % photos.length);
    }
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKey);
  }, [index, photos.length, onClose, onNavigate]);

  if (!photo) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/85 px-4 py-8"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className="w-full max-w-4xl rounded-3xl bg-white p-4 sm:p-6"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <p className="flex-1 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-700 sm:text-base">
            {photo.title || "Before & After"}
          </p>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close"
            className="shrink-0 rounded-full p-1.5 text-zinc-400 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-600"
          >
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" className="h-6 w-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round">
              <path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6 6 18" />
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="relative aspect-square overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-pink-50 sm:aspect-[4/5]">
            <Image src={photo.before_url} alt={`${photo.title ?? "Pet"} before`} fill sizes="(min-width: 640px) 45vw, 90vw" className="object-cover" unoptimized />
            <span className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 rounded-full bg-black/65 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase text-white">
              Before
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="relative aspect-square overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-pink-50 sm:aspect-[4/5]">
            <Image src={photo.after_url} alt={`${photo.title ?? "Pet"} after`} fill sizes="(min-width: 640px) 45vw, 90vw" className="object-cover" unoptimized />
            <span className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 rounded-full bg-brand-pink px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase text-white">
              After
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {photos.length > 1 && (
          <div className="mt-5 flex items-center justify-between">
            <button
              onClick={() => onNavigate((index - 1 + photos.length) % photos.length)}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-brand-tint px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink transition-colors hover:bg-pink-100"
            >
              â€¹ Previous
            </button>
            <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
              {index + 1} / {photos.length}
            </span>
            <button
              onClick={() => onNavigate((index + 1) % photos.length)}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-brand-tint px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink transition-colors hover:bg-pink-100"
            >
              Next â€º
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\gallery\GalleryPageClient.tsx =====

"use client";
// Full gallery page. Same fix as the homepage teaser: fewer columns so
// each photo is bigger, and clicking a card opens the shared lightbox.
import { useState } from "react";
import type { GalleryPhoto } from "@/lib/types/gallery";
import GalleryCard from "@/components/gallery/GalleryCard";
import GalleryLightbox from "@/components/gallery/GalleryLightbox";

const PAGE_SIZE = 9;

export default function GalleryPageClient({ photos }: { photos: GalleryPhoto[] }) {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const [lightboxIndex, setLightboxIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(photos.length / PAGE_SIZE));
  const visible = photos.slice(page * PAGE_SIZE, page * PAGE_SIZE + PAGE_SIZE);

  return (
    <div className="site-container mt-8 rounded-3xl bg-brand-pink p-6 md:p-8">
      {visible.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="py-10 text-center text-white">No before-and-after photos yet.</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
          {visible.map((photo) => (
            <GalleryCard
              key={photo.id}
              photo={photo}
              onClick={() => setLightboxIndex(photos.findIndex((p) => p.id === photo.id))}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {pageCount > 1 && (
        <div className="mt-8 flex justify-center gap-2">
          {Array.from({ length: pageCount }).map((_, i) => (
            <button
              key={i}
              onClick={() => setPage(i)}
              className={`h-9 w-9 rounded-full text-sm font-semibold ${
                page === i ? "bg-white text-brand-pink" : "bg-pink-400 text-white hover:bg-pink-300"
              }`}
            >
              {i + 1}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {lightboxIndex !== null && (
        <GalleryLightbox
          photos={photos}
          index={lightboxIndex}
          onClose={() => setLightboxIndex(null)}
          onNavigate={setLightboxIndex}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// The public website reads active package names, inclusions and prices from
// Service Management. Nothing monetary is hard-coded into these cards.
import PricingCard, { type IncludeItem } from "./PricingCard";
import PoliciesInlineCard from "./PoliciesInlineCard";
import {
  PawHeaderIcon, DiamondHeaderIcon, CrownHeaderIcon, BathDryIcon,
  TrimIcon, ConditionerIcon, EarCleanIcon, NailTrimIcon, TeethBrushingIcon,
  HeartCupIcon, FragranceIcon, ClipboardIcon, AlertIcon,
} from "./pricing-icons";
import {
  activePackages, groomingTiers, packageInclusions,
  type PublicPricingCatalog,
} from "@/lib/landing/public-pricing";

function DecorativePaw() {
  return <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" className="h-16 w-16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
    <circle cx="17" cy="20" r="7" /><circle cx="32" cy="13" r="7" /><circle cx="47" cy="20" r="7" />
    <path d="M32 27c-10 0-19 8-19 18 0 8 6 13 14 13 3 0 4-3 5-3s2 3 5 3c8 0 14-5 14-13 0-10-9-18-19-18Z" />
  </svg>;
}
function DecorativeHeart() {
  return <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" className="h-10 w-10" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.2" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M16 27S4 19 4 11a6 6 0 0 1 11-3 6 6 0 0 1 11 3c0 8-10 14-10 14Z" />
  </svg>;
}

function iconForInclusion(label: string): React.ReactNode {
  const name = label.toLowerCase();
  if (/bath|dry/.test(name)) return <BathDryIcon />;
  if (/hair|cut|trim|style/.test(name)) return <TrimIcon />;
  if (/condition/.test(name)) return <ConditionerIcon />;
  if (/ear/.test(name)) return <EarCleanIcon />;
  if (/nail/.test(name)) return <NailTrimIcon />;
  if (/teeth|tooth|brush/.test(name)) return <TeethBrushingIcon />;
  if (/pupucino|pupuccino|treat|anal/.test(name)) return <HeartCupIcon />;
  if (/fragrance|perfume/.test(name)) return <FragranceIcon />;
  return <PawHeaderIcon />;
}

function packageStyle(name: string, images: { basic?: string | null; diamond?: string | null; premium?: string | null }) {
  const key = name.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (key.includes("diamond")) return {
    icon: <DiamondHeaderIcon />,
    tagline: "Our complete grooming and pampering experience.",
    image: images.diamond || "/images/pomeranian.png",
  };
  if (key.includes("premium")) return {
    icon: <CrownHeaderIcon />,
    tagline: "Specialty grooming and coat care for your pet.",
    image: images.premium || "/images/poodle.png",
  };
  return {
    icon: <PawHeaderIcon />,
    tagline: key.includes("basic") ? "Essential care to keep your pet clean and fresh." : "Gentle, professional grooming for your pet.",
    image: images.basic || "/images/pomeranian.png",
  };
}

export default function GroomingPricing({ basicImage, diamondImage, premiumImage, catalog }: {
  basicImage?: string | null;
  diamondImage?: string | null;
  premiumImage?: string | null;
  catalog: PublicPricingCatalog;
}) {
  const dogs = activePackages(catalog, "dog_grooming");
  const images = { basic: basicImage, diamond: diamondImage, premium: premiumImage };

  const renderCards = (packages: typeof dogs) => (
    <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-1 items-stretch gap-5 md:mt-6 md:gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3">
      {packages.map(pkg => {
        const style = packageStyle(pkg.name, images);
        const included: IncludeItem[] = packageInclusions(catalog, pkg.id)
          .map(label => ({ label, icon: iconForInclusion(label) }));
        const tiers = groomingTiers(catalog, pkg.id);
        return <PricingCard key={pkg.id}
          headerIcon={style.icon}
          label={pkg.name.toUpperCase()}
          tagline={style.tagline}
          imageSrc={style.image}
          imageAlt={`${pkg.name} pet grooming service`}
          includes={included}
          tiers={tiers.length ? tiers : [{ label: "Rate details are being updated", price: "â€”" }]} />;
      })}
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <section className="relative overflow-hidden bg-brand-tint py-8 md:py-9 lg:py-10">
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute left-5 top-20 rotate-[-12deg] text-brand-pink-light/40"><DecorativeHeart /></div>
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute right-8 top-10 rotate-[12deg] text-brand-pink-light/40"><DecorativeHeart /></div>
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-7 left-8 rotate-[-12deg] text-brand-pink-light/25"><DecorativePaw /></div>
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-7 right-8 rotate-[12deg] text-brand-pink-light/25"><DecorativePaw /></div>
      <div className="site-container relative z-10">
        <header className="text-center">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 text-brand-pink-dark">
            <span className="text-brand-pink [&>svg]:h-7 [&>svg]:w-7"><PawHeaderIcon /></span>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-tight md:text-4xl lg:text-[2.7rem]">Grooming Services</h2>
            <span className="text-brand-pink-light [&>svg]:h-8 [&>svg]:w-8"><DecorativeHeart /></span>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-zinc-700 md:text-base">Care tailored to your pet&apos;s needs. Clean, happy, and ready to shine!</p>
        </header>
        {!catalog.loaded ? (
          <p role="status" className="mx-auto mt-6 max-w-xl rounded-xl bg-white p-4 text-center text-sm text-zinc-700">
            Grooming prices are temporarily unavailable. Please contact HappyTails for current rates.
          </p>
        ) : dogs.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="mt-6 text-center text-sm text-zinc-600">Grooming packages are currently being updated.</p>
        ) : renderCards(dogs)}
        <div className="mx-auto mt-6 max-w-5xl">
          <PoliciesInlineCard items={[
            { icon: <ClipboardIcon />, text: "Prices may vary depending on your pet's condition and coat." },
            { icon: <AlertIcon />, text: "Additional charges may apply for severe matting or fleas." },
            { icon: <PawHeaderIcon />, text: "Please inform us of any medical conditions or special needs." },
          ]} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\landing\Hero.tsx =====

"use client";

import Image from "next/image";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import type { HeroSlide } from "@/lib/types/hero-slides";
import styles from "./Hero.module.css";
import "./hero-overflow.css";

const AUTOPLAY_MS = 2000;

export default function Hero({ slides, logoUrl }: { slides: HeroSlide[]; logoUrl?: string | null }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const resolvedLogo = logoUrl || "/images/logo.png";
  const isRemoteLogo = !!logoUrl && logoUrl !== "/images/logo.png";
  const displaySlides: { id: string; image_url: string }[] = slides.length > 0
    ? slides
    : [{ id: "default", image_url: "/images/hero-bg.png" }];
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);
  const touchStartX = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const activeIndex = index < displaySlides.length ? index : 0;
  const activeSlide = displaySlides[activeIndex];

  const goTo = useCallback((next: number) => {
    setIndex(((next % displaySlides.length) + displaySlides.length) % displaySlides.length);
  }, [displaySlides.length]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (displaySlides.length <= 1 || paused) return;
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => setIndex(i => (i + 1) % displaySlides.length), AUTOPLAY_MS);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, [paused, displaySlides.length]);

  async function handleBookNow() {
    const supabase = createClient();
    const { data } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
    router.push(data.user ? "/account/appointments" : "/sign-in");
  }

  function handleTouchStart(e: React.TouchEvent) {
    touchStartX.current = e.touches[0]?.clientX ?? null;
  }
  function handleTouchEnd(e: React.TouchEvent) {
    const start = touchStartX.current;
    touchStartX.current = null;
    if (start === null) return;
    const delta = (e.changedTouches[0]?.clientX ?? start) - start;
    if (Math.abs(delta) > 40) goTo(activeIndex + (delta < 0 ? 1 : -1));
  }

  return (
    <section
      className={`${styles.root} ht-hero-root`}
      aria-label="Happy Tails featured promotions"
      onMouseEnter={() => setPaused(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => setPaused(false)}
      onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
      onTouchEnd={handleTouchEnd}
    >
      <div className={styles.frame}>
        {/* Only one slide is painted at a time. Avoid overlapping, transparent
            full-frame layers that can leave Safari compositor artifacts. */}
        <div key={activeSlide.id} className={styles.slide}>
          <Image
            src={activeSlide.image_url}
            alt="Happy Tails Pet Grooming Cafe promotion"
            fill
            priority={activeIndex === 0}
            className={styles.slideImage}
            sizes="100vw"
            unoptimized={activeSlide.image_url !== "/images/hero-bg.png"}
          />
        </div>

        <div className={styles.content}>
          <Image
            src={resolvedLogo}
            alt="Happy Tails Pet Grooming Cafe â€” Supplies, Boarding and Coffee"
            width={340}
            height={340}
            className={styles.logo}
            unoptimized={isRemoteLogo}
          />
          <button type="button" onClick={handleBookNow} className={styles.bookButton}>
            Book Now
          </button>
        </div>

        {displaySlides.length > 1 && (
          <>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => goTo(activeIndex - 1)} aria-label="Previous slide" className={`${styles.arrow} ${styles.previous}`}>
              <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M15 18l-6-6 6-6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" /></svg>
            </button>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => goTo(activeIndex + 1)} aria-label="Next slide" className={`${styles.arrow} ${styles.next}`}>
              <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" /></svg>
            </button>
            <div className={styles.dots} aria-label="Choose carousel slide">
              {displaySlides.map((slide, i) => (
                <button
                  key={slide.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => goTo(i)}
                  aria-label={`Go to slide ${i + 1}`}
                  aria-current={i === activeIndex ? "true" : undefined}
                  className={`${styles.dot} ${i === activeIndex ? styles.dotActive : ""}`}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

"use client";
// Shared site nav bar. Logo is dynamic and the account action reflects auth state.
// The active navigation item follows both direct navigation and homepage scrolling.
import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import Image from "next/image";
import Link from "next/link";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";

const navLinks = [
  { href: "/", label: "Home", key: "home" },
  { href: "/#services", label: "Services", key: "services" },
  { href: "/products", label: "Products", key: "products" },
  { href: "/#about", label: "About Us", key: "about" },
  { href: "/#footer", label: "Contact Us", key: "contact" },
] as const;

const trackedSections = [
  { id: "services", key: "services" },
  { id: "products", key: "products" },
  { id: "about", key: "about" },
  { id: "footer", key: "contact" },
] as const;

function scrollToId(id: string) {
  document.getElementById(id)?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
}

export default function Navbar({ logoUrl }: { logoUrl?: string | null }) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isLoggedIn, setIsLoggedIn] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [activeLink, setActiveLink] = useState<string>("home");
  const pathname = usePathname();

  useEffect(() => {
    const supabase = createClient();
    supabase.auth.getUser().then(({ data }) => setIsLoggedIn(!!data.user));

    const { data: subscription } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, session) => {
      setIsLoggedIn(!!session?.user);
    });
    return () => subscription.subscription.unsubscribe();
  }, []);

  // Keep the active state accurate on route changes and while scrolling the homepage.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (pathname === "/products") {
      setActiveLink("products");
      return;
    }

    if (pathname !== "/") {
      setActiveLink("");
      return;
    }

    const initialHash = window.location.hash.slice(1);
    const initialHashLink = trackedSections.find((section) => section.id === initialHash);
    if (initialHashLink) setActiveLink(initialHashLink.key);
    else if (window.scrollY < 120) setActiveLink("home");

    const navHeight = document.querySelector("nav")?.getBoundingClientRect().height ?? 72;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        const visibleSections = entries
          .filter((entry) => entry.isIntersecting)
          .sort((a, b) => a.boundingClientRect.top - b.boundingClientRect.top);

        const currentSection = visibleSections[0]?.target.id;
        const matchingLink = trackedSections.find((section) => section.id === currentSection);
        if (matchingLink) setActiveLink(matchingLink.key);
      },
      {
        root: null,
        rootMargin: `-${Math.round(navHeight)}px 0px -65% 0px`,
        threshold: 0,
      }
    );

    trackedSections.forEach(({ id }) => {
      const section = document.getElementById(id);
      if (section) observer.observe(section);
    });

    const handleScrollToTop = () => {
      if (window.scrollY < 120) setActiveLink("home");
    };
    window.addEventListener("scroll", handleScrollToTop, { passive: true });

    return () => {
      observer.disconnect();
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScrollToTop);
    };
  }, [pathname]);

  function handleNavClick(e: React.MouseEvent, href: string) {
    setIsOpen(false);
    const selectedLink = navLinks.find((link) => link.href === href);
    if (selectedLink) setActiveLink(selectedLink.key);

    if (href === "/") {
      if (pathname === "/") {
        e.preventDefault();
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
      }
      return;
    }

    if (href.startsWith("/#")) {
      const id = href.slice(2);
      if (pathname === "/") {
        e.preventDefault();
        scrollToId(id);
        window.history.pushState(null, "", href);
      }
    }
  }

  const resolvedLogo = logoUrl || "/images/logo.png";
  const isRemote = !!logoUrl && logoUrl !== "/images/logo.png";

  return (
    <nav className="sticky top-0 z-50 bg-brand-pink shadow-md">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-3 md:px-10">
        <Link href="/" className="flex items-center gap-2" onClick={(e) => handleNavClick(e, "/")}>
          <Image src={resolvedLogo} alt="Happy Tails" width={36} height={36} className="rounded-full bg-white" unoptimized={isRemote} />
          <span className="text-lg font-semibold italic text-white">Happy Tails</span>
        </Link>

        <div className="hidden items-center gap-8 text-sm font-medium text-white md:flex">
          {navLinks.map((link) => {
            const isActive = activeLink === link.key;
            return (
              <Link
                key={link.key}
                href={link.href}
                onClick={(e) => handleNavClick(e, link.href)}
                aria-current={isActive ? "page" : undefined}
                className={`relative inline-flex items-center py-2 transition-colors duration-200 hover:text-white/80 ${isActive ? "font-bold" : "font-medium"}`}
              >
                {link.label}
                <span
                  aria-hidden="true"
                  className={`absolute -bottom-0.5 left-0 h-[3px] w-full origin-center rounded-full bg-white transition-transform duration-200 ${isActive ? "scale-x-100" : "scale-x-0"}`}
                />
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {isLoggedIn === null ? (
            <div className="h-9 w-9" aria-hidden="true" />
          ) : isLoggedIn ? (
            <Link
              href="/account"
              aria-label="Go to your account"
              className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/20 text-white transition-colors hover:bg-white/30"
            >
              <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M12 12c2.7 0 4.9-2.2 4.9-4.9S14.7 2.2 12 2.2 7.1 4.4 7.1 7.1 9.3 12 12 12zm0 2.5c-3.3 0-9.8 1.6-9.8 4.9v2.4h19.6v-2.4c0-3.3-6.5-4.9-9.8-4.9z" />
              </svg>
            </Link>
          ) : (
            <Link href="/sign-in" className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-sky-300 px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:bg-sky-400">
              <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
                <path d="M12 12c2.7 0 4.9-2.2 4.9-4.9S14.7 2.2 12 2.2 7.1 4.4 7.1 7.1 9.3 12 12 12zm0 2.5c-3.3 0-9.8 1.6-9.8 4.9v2.4h19.6v-2.4c0-3.3-6.5-4.9-9.8-4.9z" />
              </svg>
              Login
            </Link>
          )}

          <button
            onClick={() => setIsOpen((value) => !value)}
            aria-label={isOpen ? "Close menu" : "Open menu"}
            aria-expanded={isOpen}
            className="p-1 text-white md:hidden"
          >
            {isOpen ? (
              <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5"><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" strokeLinecap="round" /></svg>
            ) : (
              <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5"><path d="M4 7h16M4 12h16M4 17h16" strokeLinecap="round" /></svg>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className={`overflow-hidden transition-[max-height] duration-300 ease-in-out md:hidden ${isOpen ? "max-h-64" : "max-h-0"}`}>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 bg-brand-pink-dark px-6 pb-4 pt-1 text-sm font-medium text-white">
          {navLinks.map((link) => {
            const isActive = activeLink === link.key;
            return (
              <Link
                key={link.key}
                href={link.href}
                onClick={(e) => handleNavClick(e, link.href)}
                aria-current={isActive ? "page" : undefined}
                className={`flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border-b border-white/15 px-3 py-2.5 transition-colors last:border-none ${isActive ? "bg-white/10 font-bold" : "hover:bg-white/10"}`}
              >
                <span aria-hidden="true" className={`h-5 w-1 rounded-full transition-colors ${isActive ? "bg-white" : "bg-transparent"}`} />
                {link.label}
              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\landing\PoliciesModalContext.tsx =====

"use client";
// Shared state so the "POLICIES" buttons in both the Grooming and Boarding
// pricing sections can open the same modal, without prop-drilling through
// the page. Wrap the page content in <PoliciesModalProvider> once, and any
// button anywhere on the page can call usePoliciesModal().open().
import { createContext, useContext, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";

type PoliciesModalContextValue = {
  isOpen: boolean;
  open: () => void;
  close: () => void;
};

const PoliciesModalContext = createContext<PoliciesModalContextValue | null>(
  null
);

export function PoliciesModalProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <PoliciesModalContext.Provider
      value={{
        isOpen,
        open: () => setIsOpen(true),
        close: () => setIsOpen(false),
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </PoliciesModalContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function usePoliciesModal() {
  const ctx = useContext(PoliciesModalContext);
  if (!ctx) {
    throw new Error(
      "usePoliciesModal must be used within a PoliciesModalProvider"
    );
  }
  return ctx;
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\landing\ProductsCarousel.tsx =====

"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import type { Product, ProductCategory } from "@/lib/types/products";
import ProductCard from "@/components/products/ProductCard";
import CategoryTabs from "@/components/products/CategoryTabs";

const PAGE_SIZE = 4;
const AUTOPLAY_MS = 3000;

export default function ProductsCarousel({ products }: { products: Product[] }) {
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<ProductCategory | "all">("all");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);

  const filtered = useMemo(
    () => (category === "all" ? products : products.filter((p) => p.category === category)),
    [products, category]
  );

  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / PAGE_SIZE));
  const currentPage = Math.min(page, pageCount - 1);
  const visible = filtered.slice(currentPage * PAGE_SIZE, currentPage * PAGE_SIZE + PAGE_SIZE);

  function changeCategory(next: ProductCategory | "all") {
    setCategory(next);
    setPage(0);
  }

  function prev() {
    setPage((p) => (p - 1 + pageCount) % pageCount);
  }

  function next() {
    setPage((p) => (p + 1) % pageCount);
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (pageCount <= 1 || paused) return;

    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      setPage((p) => (p + 1) % pageCount);
    }, AUTOPLAY_MS);

    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, [pageCount, paused]);

  return (
    <section
      id="products"
      className="bg-brand-pink pb-8 pt-4 md:pb-9 md:pt-4 lg:pb-10 lg:pt-5"
      onMouseEnter={() => setPaused(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => setPaused(false)}
    >
      <div className="site-container">
        {/* The editable title and description are rendered once by LandingTextSection. */}
        <div>
          <CategoryTabs active={category} onChange={changeCategory} />
        </div>

        {visible.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="mt-10 text-center text-sm text-white/90">No products in this category yet.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="relative mt-5 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 md:gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={prev}
              aria-label="Previous products"
              className="h-8 w-8 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-sky-400 text-white transition-colors hover:bg-sky-500 md:h-9 md:w-9"
            >
              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3" className="mx-auto">
                <path d="M15 18l-6-6 6-6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
              </svg>
            </button>

            <div className="grid min-w-0 flex-1 grid-cols-2 items-stretch gap-3 md:grid-cols-4 md:gap-4">
              {visible.map((product) => (
                <ProductCard key={product.id} product={product} />
              ))}
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={next}
              aria-label="Next products"
              className="h-8 w-8 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-sky-400 text-white transition-colors hover:bg-sky-500 md:h-9 md:w-9"
            >
              <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3" className="mx-auto">
                <path d="M9 6l6 6-6 6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-5 text-center">
          <Link href="/products" className="inline-block rounded-full bg-white px-6 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink transition-colors hover:bg-pink-50">
            View All Products

        </div>

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\products\ProductsPageContent.tsx =====

"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";
import type { Product, ProductCategory } from "@/lib/types/products";
import ProductCard from "@/components/products/ProductCard";
import CategoryTabs from "@/components/products/CategoryTabs";

const PAGE_SIZE = 8;
type SortOption = "featured" | "price-asc" | "price-desc" | "name-asc";

function formatPeso(value: number) {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PH", { style: "currency", currency: "PHP", maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(Number(value) || 0);
}

export default function ProductsPageContent({ products }: { products: Product[] }) {
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<ProductCategory | "all">("all");
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<SortOption>("featured");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Product | null>(null);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    let result = products.filter((product) => {
      const matchesCategory = category === "all" || product.category === category;
      const search = query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
      const matchesSearch = !search || [product.name, product.product_code, product.category, product.package_size, product.unit]
        .some((value) => String(value ?? "").toLocaleLowerCase().includes(search));
      return matchesCategory && matchesSearch;
    });
    if (sort === "price-asc") result = [...result].sort((a, b) => Number(a.price) - Number(b.price));
    if (sort === "price-desc") result = [...result].sort((a, b) => Number(b.price) - Number(a.price));
    if (sort === "name-asc") result = [...result].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    return result;
  }, [products, category, query, sort]);

  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / PAGE_SIZE));
  const currentPage = Math.min(page, pageCount - 1);
  const visible = filtered.slice(currentPage * PAGE_SIZE, (currentPage + 1) * PAGE_SIZE);
  const hasFilters = category !== "all" || query.trim() !== "" || sort !== "featured";

  function resetFilters() {
    setCategory("all");
    setQuery("");
    setSort("featured");
    setPage(0);
  }

"bg-brand-pink text-white shadow-sm" : "border border-pink-100 bg-white text-zinc-600 hover:border-brand-pink hover:text-brand-pink"}`}>{index + 1}</button>)}
            <button type="button" disabled={currentPage >= pageCount - 1} onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(pageCount - 1, p + 1))} className="rounded-full border border-pink-100 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-600 shadow-sm transition hover:border-brand-pink hover:text-brand-pink disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40">Next</button>
          </nav>
        )}

        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center overflow-y-auto bg-zinc-950/50 p-3 backdrop-blur-sm sm:p-6" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="product-detail-title" onMouseDown={(event) => { if (event.target === event.currentTarget) setSelected(null); }}>

              <h2 id="product-detail-title" className="pr-8 text-xl font-extrabold leading-snug text-zinc-900 sm:text-2xl">{selected.name}</h2>
              <p className="mt-3 text-2xl font-extrabold text-brand-pink">{formatPeso(selected.price)}</p>
              <dl className="mt-6 divide-y divide-pink-50 rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 px-4">
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-4 py-3 text-sm"><dt className="text-zinc-500">Category</dt><dd className="text-right font-semibold text-zinc-800">{selected.category}</dd></div>
                <div className="flex justify-between gap-4 py-3 text-sm"><dt className="text-zinc-500">Unit</dt><dd className="text-right font-semibold text-zinc-800">{selected.package_size || selected.unit}</dd></div>

            </div>

    </>

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import BookingDayCalendar from "@/components/shared/BookingDayCalendar";
import { useBookingClosures, manilaToday, manilaTime } from "@/lib/booking/use-booking-closures";
import { fetchBoardingMonth, checkBoardingStay, type BoardingDayCapacity } from "@/lib/supabase/boarding-availability";
import { hasValidBoardingDuration, isExtendedBoardingRate, parseExtendedBoardingNights } from "@/lib/booking/boarding-duration";
import type { DraftPetSelection } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { PackagePricing, AddonPrice } from "@/lib/types/services";
import type { Kennel, KennelSize } from "@/lib/types/pet-services";

const BELONGINGS = ["Pet Bed", "Toys", "Cat Litter", "Leash/Collar", "Others"];
const MS_DAY = 86_400_000;
type Schedule = { date: string; time: string };
type Snapshot = { key: string; days: BoardingDayCapacity[]; error: string | null };

export type BoardingScheduleProps = {
  petSelections: DraftPetSelection[];
  kennels: Kennel[];
  pricing: PackagePricing[];
  addonPrices: AddonPrice[];
  scheduledDate: string | null;
  dropOffAt: string | null;
  pickUpAt: string | null;
  petBelongings: string[];
  specialRequests: string;
  onDateChange: (date: string) => void;
  onDropOffChange: (value: string) => void;
  onPickUpChange: (value: string) => void;
  onBelongingsChange: (items: string[]) => void;
  onRequestsChange: (value: string) => void;
  onSelectionsChange: (items: DraftPetSelection[]) => void;
  onBack: () => void;
  onConfirmed: (selections: DraftPetSelection[]) => void;
};

function getNights(sel: DraftPetSelection, pricing: PackagePricing[]): number {
  const rate = pricing.find((r) => r.id === sel.packagePricingId);
  if (!rate) return 0;
  if (isExtendedBoardingRate(rate)) return parseExtendedBoardingNights(sel.boardingNights) ?? 0;
  if (rate.nights && Number.isSafeInteger(rate.nights)) return rate.nights;
  const match = `${rate.size_detail ?? ""} ${rate.size_label}`.match(/(\d+)\s*nights?/i);
  return match ? Number(match[1]) : 0;
}
function toDate(date: string, time: string) { return new Date(`${date}T${time}:00+08:00`); }
function fromIso(iso: string): Schedule {
  const pieces = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23" }).formatToParts(new Date(iso));
  const get = (field: string) => pieces.find((p) => p.type === field)?.value ?? "00";
  return { date: `${get("year")}-${get("month")}-${get("day")}`, time: `${get("hour")}:${get("minute")}` };
}
function addDays(day: string, nights: number) {
  return new Date(Date.parse(`${day}T00:00:00Z`) + nights * MS_DAY).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}
function overlaps(a: string, an: number, b: string, bn: number) {
  return a < addDays(b, bn) && b < addDays(a, an);
}
function prettyDate(iso: string) {
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleString("en-PH", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric", hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", hour12: true });
}

export default function BoardingAvailabilitySchedule({
  petSelections, pricing, petBelongings, specialRequests, onSelectionsChange,
  onBelongingsChange, onRequestsChange, onBack, onConfirmed,
}: BoardingScheduleProps) {
  const closures = useBookingClosures();
  const [schedules, setSchedules] = useState<Record<string, Schedule>>({});
  const [months, setMonths] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [capacity, setCapacity] = useState<Record<string, Snapshot>>({});
  const [refresh, setRefresh] = useState(0);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(false);
  const [confirmed, setConfirmed] = useState(false);
  const [confirmedSelections, setConfirmedSelections] = useState<DraftPetSelection[]>([]);
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const today = manilaToday();

  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setInterval(() => { setRefresh((n) => n + 1); setNow(Date.now()); }, 30_000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    setSchedules((previous) => {
      const next = { ...previous };
      for (const s of petSelections) {
        if (!next[s.pet.id]) {
          const saved = s.boardingDropOffAt ? fromIso(s.boardingDropOffAt) : null;
          next[s.pet.id] = { date: s.boardingScheduledDate ?? saved?.date ?? "", time: saved?.time ?? "09:00" };
        }
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, [petSelections]);

  const specs = petSelections.map((sel) => ({
    id: sel.pet.id,
    size: sel.boardingKennelSize,
    nights: getNights(sel, pricing),
    month: months[sel.pet.id] ?? (schedules[sel.pet.id]?.date || today).slice(0, 7),
  }));
  const specKey = JSON.stringify(specs);
  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    const requested = JSON.parse(specKey) as typeof specs;
    setCapacity((previous) => {
      const next = { ...previous };
      for (const spec of requested) {
        const key = `${spec.size}:${spec.nights}:${spec.month}`;
        if (next[spec.id]?.key !== key) delete next[spec.id];
      }
      return next;
    });
    void Promise.all(requested.map(async (spec) => {
      const key = `${spec.size}:${spec.nights}:${spec.month}`;
      if ((spec.size !== "small" && spec.size !== "big") || spec.nights < 1 || spec.nights > 365) return;
      const result = await fetchBoardingMonth(spec.month, spec.size, spec.nights);
      if (!alive) return;
      setCapacity((previous) => ({ ...previous, [spec.id]: { key, days: result.days, error: result.error } }));
    }));
    return () => { alive = false; };
  }, [specKey, refresh]);

  const onMonth = useCallback((id: string, month: string) => {
    setMonths((previous) => previous[id] === month ? previous : { ...previous, [id]: month });
  }, []);
  const localOverlap = useCallback((id: string, date: string, size: KennelSize, nights: number) =>
    petSelections.filter((other) => other.pet.id !== id && other.boardingKennelSize === size &&
      !!schedules[other.pet.id]?.date && getNights(other, pricing) > 0 &&
      overlaps(date, nights, schedules[other.pet.id].date, getNights(other, pricing))).length,
    [petSelections, pricing, schedules]);
  const availableOn = (sel: DraftPetSelection, day: string): number | null => {
    const spec = specs.find((s) => s.id === sel.pet.id);
    if (!spec || !day || !spec.size || spec.nights < 1) return null;
    const snap = capacity[sel.pet.id];
    if (!snap || snap.key !== `${spec.size}:${spec.nights}:${spec.month}` || snap.error) return null;
    const record = snap.days.find((row) => row.day === day);
    if (!record) return null;
    return Math.max(0, record.remaining - localOverlap(sel.pet.id, day, spec.size, spec.nights));
  };
  const dateReason = (sel: DraftPetSelection, schedule: Schedule) => {
    if (!hasValidBoardingDuration(sel, pricing)) return "The boarding duration is invalid. Return to the previous step.";
    if (sel.boardingKennelSize !== "small" && sel.boardingKennelSize !== "big") return "Choose the kennel size again.";
    if (!schedule.date || !schedule.time) return "Choose a drop-off date and time.";
    if (schedule.date < today) return "Past dates cannot be booked.";
    const closure = closures.nameFor(schedule.date);
    if (closure) return `Check-in closed on ${schedule.date} â€” ${closure}`;
    const pickupDay = addDays(schedule.date, getNights(sel, pricing));
    const pickupClosure = closures.nameFor(pickupDay);
    if (pickupClosure) return `Pickup closed on ${pickupDay} â€” ${pickupClosure}. Choose a different check-in day or duration.`;
    if (schedule.time < "09:00" || schedule.time > "18:00") return "Drop-off must be between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM.";
    if (toDate(schedule.date, schedule.time).getTime() <= now) return "Choose a future drop-off time.";
    const free = availableOn(sel, schedule.date);
    if (free === null) return "Checking kennel availability. Please select an available date.";
    if (free < 1) return "Fully booked for this kennel size and entire stay. Choose another date.";
    return null;
  };
  const valid = useMemo(() => petSelections.length > 0 && !checking && !closures.loading && !closures.error &&
    petSelections.every((sel) => !dateReason(sel, schedules[sel.pet.id] ?? { date: "", time: "" })),
    // Re-evaluated against updated availability snapshots, all pet dates and the clock.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [petSelections, pricing, schedules, capacity, checking, closures.dates, closures.loading, closures.error, now, months]);

  const saveSchedule = (sel: DraftPetSelection, next: Schedule) => {
    setSchedules((previous) => ({ ...previous, [sel.pet.id]: next }));
    setError(null);
    const okay = Boolean(next.date && next.time && hasValidBoardingDuration(sel, pricing) &&
      !closures.nameFor(next.date) && !closures.nameFor(addDays(next.date, getNights(sel, pricing))) && next.date >= manilaToday() && next.time >= "09:00" && next.time <= "18:00" &&
      toDate(next.date, next.time).getTime() > Date.now() && (availableOn(sel, next.date) ?? 0) > 0);
    onSelectionsChange(petSelections.map((p) => {
      if (p.pet.id !== sel.pet.id) return p;
      if (!okay) return { ...p, boardingScheduledDate: null, boardingDropOffAt: null, boardingPickUpAt: null, kennelId: null };
      const start = toDate(next.date, next.time);
      const end = new Date(start.getTime() + getNights(p, pricing) * MS_DAY);
      return { ...p, boardingScheduledDate: next.date, boardingDropOffAt: start.toISOString(), boardingPickUpAt: end.toISOString(), kennelId: null };
    }));
  };
  const chooseDate = async (sel: DraftPetSelection, day: string) => {
    if (checking || closures.loading || closures.error || !sel.boardingKennelSize) return;
    setChecking(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const closureError = await closures.verifyOpen(day);
      if (closureError) { setError(`${sel.pet.name}: Check-in: ${closureError}`); return; }
      const pickupDay = addDays(day, getNights(sel, pricing));
      const pickupError = await closures.verifyOpen(pickupDay);
      if (pickupError) { setError(`${sel.pet.name}: Pickup on ${pickupDay}: ${pickupError} Choose a different arrival date.`); return; }
      const count = await checkBoardingStay(day, sel.boardingKennelSize, getNights(sel, pricing));
      if (count.error) { setError(count.error); return; }
      if (count.remaining <= localOverlap(sel.pet.id, day, sel.boardingKennelSize, getNights(sel, pricing))) {
        setError(`${sel.pet.name}: All ${sel.boardingKennelSize === "big" ? "Big" : "Small"} Kennels are fully booked for the selected stay.`);
        setRefresh((n) => n + 1);
        return;
      }
      saveSchedule(sel, { date: day, time: schedules[sel.pet.id]?.time ?? "09:00" });
    } finally { setChecking(false); }
  };
  const confirm = async () => {
    if (checking || !valid) return;
    setChecking(true); setError(null);
    try {
      for (const sel of petSelections) {
        const s = schedules[sel.pet.id];
        const reason = dateReason(sel, s);
        if (reason) { setError(`${sel.pet.name}: ${reason}`); return; }
        const closed = await closures.verifyOpen(s.date);
        if (closed) { setError(`${sel.pet.name}: Check-in: ${closed}`); return; }
        const pickupDay = addDays(s.date, getNights(sel, pricing));
        const pickupClosed = await closures.verifyOpen(pickupDay);
        if (pickupClosed) { setError(`${sel.pet.name}: Pickup on ${pickupDay}: ${pickupClosed} Select another stay.`); return; }
        const size = sel.boardingKennelSize as KennelSize;
        const count = await checkBoardingStay(s.date, size, getNights(sel, pricing));
        if (count.error) { setError(count.error); return; }
        if (count.remaining <= localOverlap(sel.pet.id, s.date, size, getNights(sel, pricing))) {
          setError(`${sel.pet.name}: No ${size === "big" ? "Big" : "Small"} Kennels remain for the full stay. Please choose another date.`);
          setRefresh((n) => n + 1);
          return;
        }
      }
      // Always write the FINAL verified schedule, not a stale interim form
      // value. The parent uses these fields to create one booking per pet.
      const finalSelections = petSelections.map((sel) => {
        const selected = schedules[sel.pet.id];
        const drop = toDate(selected.date, selected.time);
        const pickup = new Date(drop.getTime() + getNights(sel, pricing) * MS_DAY);
        return { ...sel, boardingScheduledDate: selected.date,
          boardingDropOffAt: drop.toISOString(), boardingPickUpAt: pickup.toISOString(), kennelId: null };
      });
      setConfirmedSelections(finalSelections);
      onSelectionsChange(finalSelections);
      // The database makes the final atomic room assignment at checkout;
      // this calendar is a live estimate, not a temporary reservation.
      setConfirmed(true);
    } finally { setChecking(false); }
  };

  if (confirmed) return <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Boarding schedule review" className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-4">
    <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl bg-white p-6 text-center shadow-2xl">
      <div className="mx-auto mb-3 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-pink-50 text-2xl">ðŸ¾</div>
      <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-zinc-800">Boarding Schedule Verified</h3>
      <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-zinc-600">The selected kennel size and dates currently have space. <strong>Your kennel is reserved only after you finish booking.</strong> Availability may change in the meantime.</p>
      <div className="mt-5 flex gap-2"><button type="button" onClick={() => setConfirmed(false)} className="flex-1 rounded-full border border-pink-200 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink">Review</button><button type="button" onClick={() => onConfirmed(confirmedSelections)} className="flex-1 rounded-full bg-brand-pink py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white">Continue</button></div>
    </div>
  </div>;

  return <section className="mx-auto max-w-4xl space-y-5">
    <div className="text-center"><h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-brand-pink">Boarding Availability & Schedule</h2><p className="mt-2 text-sm text-zinc-600">Choose an available kennel for each pet's <strong>entire stay</strong>, not just the arrival date.</p></div>
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-pink-100 bg-pink-50 px-4 py-3 text-xs leading-5 text-zinc-700">Small and Big Kennels have separate availability. Each boarding pet reserves one kennel. <strong>Both check-in and pickup must fall on an open day.</strong> Red <strong>Full / Closed / Pickup Closed</strong> dates cannot be booked. Check-in and pickup: 9:00 AMâ€“6:00 PM (Philippine time). Pickup is calculated automatically.</div>

"" : "s"}</p><p>{schedule.date ? `${schedule.date} â†’ ${addDays(schedule.date, nights || 0)}` : "Select a check-in day"}</p>

    <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-800">Special Requests / Notes<textarea rows={3} value={specialRequests} onChange={(e) => onRequestsChange(e.target.value)} className="mt-2 block w-full rounded-xl border border-pink-200 p-3 text-sm"/></label>
    {error && <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-700">{error}</p>}
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"><button type="button" onClick={onBack} className="rounded-full border border-pink-200 py-3 font-semibold text-brand-pink">Back</button><button type="button" onClick={() => { void confirm(); }} disabled={!valid} className="rounded-full bg-brand-pink py-3 font-semibold text-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40">{checking ? "Checkingâ€¦" : "Next"}</button></div>
  </section>;

"use client";

import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import BoardingSelectionStep from "@/components/admin/pos/walk-in/BoardingSelectionStep";
import BoardingGroupSchedule from "@/components/shared/BoardingGroupSchedule";
import BookingStepConfirmation from "@/components/shared/BookingStepConfirmation";
import type { DraftPetSelection, Pet } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { Kennel } from "@/lib/types/pet-services";
import type { PackagePricing } from "@/lib/types/services";

type Props = {
  pets: Pet[];
  selections: DraftPetSelection[];
  kennels: Kennel[];
  scheduledDate: string | null;
  petBelongings: string[];
  specialRequests: string;
  alreadyGroomedPetIds: string[];
  onChange: (items: DraftPetSelection[]) => void;
  onBelongingsChange: (items: string[]) => void;
  onRequestsChange: (text: string) => void;
  onBack: () => void;
  onConfirmed: (items: DraftPetSelection[]) => void;
};

/** Separate Boarding Details and Dates screens, keeping Customer/POS routes intact. */
export default function BoardingDetailsAndSchedule(props: Props) {
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<"details" | "dates">("details");
  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState<"back" | "dates" | null>(null);
  const [pricing, setPricing] = useState<PackagePricing[]>([]);
  const [detailsValid, setDetailsValid] = useState(false);
  const prepared = useCallback((rows: PackagePricing[], valid: boolean) => {
    setPricing(rows);
    setDetailsValid(valid);
  }, []);
  const signature = props.selections.map((s) =>
    `${s.pet.id}:${s.boardingKennelSize ?? ""}:${s.packagePricingId ?? ""}:${s.boardingNights ?? ""}`
  ).sort().join("|");
  const hasDetails = props.selections.some(s => Boolean(s.packageId || s.packagePricingId || s.boardingKennelSize || s.addonIds.length));

  return <div className="mx-auto max-w-4xl space-y-5">
    <nav aria-label="Boarding booking steps" className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-3 sm:p-4">
      <div aria-current={stage === "details" ? "step" : undefined} className={`rounded-xl px-3 py-3 text-center text-sm font-bold ${stage === "details" ? "bg-brand-pink text-white" : "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800"}`}>
        1. Boarding Details
      </div>
      <div aria-current={stage === "dates" ? "step" : undefined} className={`rounded-xl px-3 py-3 text-center text-sm font-bold ${stage === "dates" ? "bg-brand-pink text-white" : "bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-500"}`}>
        2. Boarding Dates
      </div>
    </nav>

    {stage === "details" ? <BoardingSelectionStep
      pets={props.pets} selections={props.selections}
      onChange={props.onChange} scheduledDate={props.scheduledDate}
      alreadyGroomedPetIds={props.alreadyGroomedPetIds}
      onPrepared={prepared} onBack={() => { if (hasDetails) setPrompt("back"); else props.onBack(); }}
      onNext={() => { if (detailsValid) setPrompt("dates"); }}
    /> : !detailsValid ? <div className="rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-5 text-sm text-amber-900">
      Please complete valid Boarding Details first.
      <button type="button" className="ml-2 font-bold underline" onClick={() => setStage("details")}>Back to Details</button>
    </div> : <BoardingGroupSchedule
      key={signature}
      petSelections={props.selections} pricing={pricing} kennels={props.kennels}
      petBelongings={props.petBelongings} specialRequests={props.specialRequests}
      onBelongingsChange={props.onBelongingsChange} onRequestsChange={props.onRequestsChange}
      onSelectionsChange={props.onChange}
      onBack={() => setStage("details")}
      onConfirmed={props.onConfirmed}
    />}
    {prompt === "back" && <BookingStepConfirmation title="Go back to the service waiver?"
      description="This leaves the boarding details step. Your selections remain in the current draft, but changing services or pets may require entering them again."
      confirmLabel="Go Back" danger onCancel={() => setPrompt(null)}
      onConfirm={() => { setPrompt(null); props.onBack(); }} />}
    {prompt === "dates" && <BookingStepConfirmation title="Proceed to boarding dates?"
      description="Review the selected kennel sizes, sharing options, rates, and durations. The next step verifies availability for the entire stay."
      confirmLabel="Proceed" onCancel={() => setPrompt(null)}
      onConfirm={() => { setPrompt(null); setStage("dates"); }} />}
  </div>;
}
