"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import BookingDayCalendar from "@/components/shared/BookingDayCalendar";
import { useBookingClosures, manilaToday } from "@/lib/booking/use-booking-closures";
import { checkBoardingGroup, fetchBoardingGroupMonth, type BoardingGroupPet, type BoardingGroupDay, fetchBoardingKennelCounts, type BoardingKennelCounts } from "@/lib/supabase/boarding-group-availability";
import { hasValidBoardingDuration, isExtendedBoardingRate, parseExtendedBoardingNights } from "@/lib/booking/boarding-duration";
import type { DraftPetSelection } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { PackagePricing } from "@/lib/types/services";
import type { Kennel } from "@/lib/types/pet-services";
import { shareGroups, type ShareSelection } from "@/lib/booking/boarding-share";
import FeedbackDialog from "@/components/admin/operations/FeedbackDialog";
import BookingStepConfirmation from "@/components/shared/BookingStepConfirmation";

const BELONGINGS = ["Pet Bed", "Toys", "Cat Litter", "Leash/Collar", "Others"];
const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;

function nightsFor(sel: DraftPetSelection, rates: PackagePricing[]): number | null {
  const rate = rates.find((p) => p.id === sel.packagePricingId);
  if (!rate || !hasValidBoardingDuration(sel, rates)) return null;
  if (isExtendedBoardingRate(rate)) return parseExtendedBoardingNights(sel.boardingNights);
  if (rate.nights != null) return rate.nights;
  const match = `${rate.size_detail ?? ""} ${rate.size_label}`.match(/(\d+)\s*nights?/i);
  return match ? Number(match[1]) : sel.boardingNights ?? null;
}
function addNights(day: string, nights: number) {
  return new Date(Date.parse(`${day}T00:00:00Z`) + nights * DAY_MS).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}
function dateTime(day: string, time: string) {
  return new Date(`${day}T${time}:00+08:00`).toISOString();
}
function display(iso: string) {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-PH", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" }).format(new Date(iso));
}

type Props = {
  petSelections: DraftPetSelection[];
  pricing: PackagePricing[];
  kennels: Kennel[];
  petBelongings: string[];
  specialRequests: string;
  onBelongingsChange: (items: string[]) => void;
  onRequestsChange: (text: string) => void;
  onSelectionsChange: (items: DraftPetSelection[]) => void;
  onBack: () => void;
  onConfirmed: (items: DraftPetSelection[]) => void;
};

export default function BoardingGroupSchedule({ petSelections, pricing, kennels, petBelongings, specialRequests,
  onBelongingsChange, onRequestsChange, onSelectionsChange, onBack, onConfirmed }: Props) {
  const closures = useBookingClosures();
  const savedDates = petSelections.map((s) => s.boardingScheduledDate).filter(Boolean);
  const restored = savedDates.length === petSelections.length && new Set(savedDates).size === 1 ? savedDates[0]! : "";
  const [date, setDate] = useState(restored);
  const [time, setTime] = useState(() => {
    const saved = petSelections[0]?.boardingDropOffAt;
    if (!restored || !saved) return "09:00";
    try {
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {
        timeZone: "Asia/Manila", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23",
      }).formatToParts(new Date(saved));
      const hour = parts.find((part) => part.type === "hour")?.value ?? "09";
      const minute = parts.find((part) => part.type === "minute")?.value ?? "00";
      return `${hour}:${minute}`;
    } catch { return "09:00"; }
  });
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(() => (restored || manilaToday()).slice(0, 7));
  const [days, setDays] = useState<BoardingGroupDay[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(false);
  const [refresh, setRefresh] = useState(0);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [counts, setCounts] = useState<BoardingKennelCounts | null>(null);
  const [countsLoading, setCountsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [countsError, setCountsError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [review, setReview] = useState(false);
  const [confirmBack, setConfirmBack] = useState(false);
  const [verified, setVerified] = useState<DraftPetSelection[]>([]);

  // Exceptional closures prevent boarding; regular holidays can be handled by caretakers.
  // Honor the holiday-open override recorded in Calendar Management.
  const boardingClosures = useMemo(() => ({
    ...closures,
    nameFor: (day: string | null | undefined) => day ? closures.dates.find((d) =>
      d.date === day && d.category === "exceptional_closure" && !d.is_open_override)?.name ?? null : null,
  }), [closures]);

  const requirements = useMemo((): BoardingGroupPet[] => petSelections.map((sel) => ({
    pet_id: sel.pet.id,
    kennel_size: sel.boardingKennelSize === "big" ? "big" : "small",
    nights: nightsFor(sel, pricing) ?? 0,
    share_group: (sel as ShareSelection).boardingShareGroupId ?? null,
  })), [petSelections, pricing]);
  const longestStay = requirements.reduce((max, pet) => Math.max(max, pet.nights), 0);
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    setCounts(null); setCountsError(null);
    if (!date || !longestStay || !/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(time)) { setCountsLoading(false); return; }
    setCountsLoading(true);
    void fetchBoardingKennelCounts(date, time, longestStay).then(({ counts: result, error: failure }) => {
      if (!active) return;
      setCounts(result); setCountsError(failure); setCountsLoading(false);
    });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [date, time, longestStay, refresh]);
  const signature = JSON.stringify(requirements);
  const validDetails = petSelections.length > 0 && requirements.every((s, index) =>
    s.nights >= 1 && !!petSelections[index].packagePricingId && !!petSelections[index].boardingKennelSize &&
    (s.kennel_size === "big" || ["small", "medium"].includes(petSelections[index].pet.size_label.trim().toLowerCase())));

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    if (!validDetails) { setLoading(false); setDays([]); return; }
    setLoading(true); setLoadError(null);
    void fetchBoardingGroupMonth(month, time, requirements).then((result) => {
      if (!active) return;
      setDays(result.days);
      setLoadError(result.error);
      setLoading(false);
    });
    return () => { active = false; };
    // Recheck when kennel sizes, nights, arrival time, or month change.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [month, time, signature, validDetails, refresh]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => setRefresh((x) => x + 1), 30_000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  const onMonthChange = useCallback((next: string) => setMonth((current) => current === next ? current : next), []);
  const availability: Record<string, number> = {};
  const unavailable: Record<string, string> = {};
  const today = manilaToday();
  for (const item of days) {
    // A day explicitly opened in Calendar Management can still be in the past.
    // Do not mislabel past days as shop closures when the SQL planner rejects them.
    if (item.day < today) continue;
    availability[item.day] = item.available ? 1 : 0;
    if (!item.available) {
      const selectedDropOff = new Date(`${item.day}T${time}:00+08:00`).getTime();
      unavailable[item.day] = item.day === today && selectedDropOff <= Date.now()
        ? "Drop-off time has passed"
        : item.reason ?? "Fully booked for the selected group";
    }
  }

  const setSchedule = (day: string, clock: string) => petSelections.map((s) => {
    const nights = nightsFor(s, pricing)!;
    return {
      ...s,
      boardingScheduledDate: day,
      boardingDropOffAt: dateTime(day, clock),
      boardingPickUpAt: dateTime(addNights(day, nights), clock),
      kennelId: null,
    };
  });
  const clearSchedules = () => onSelectionsChange(petSelections.map((s) => ({
    ...s, boardingScheduledDate: null, boardingDropOffAt: null, boardingPickUpAt: null, kennelId: null,
  })));

  async function choose(day: string) {
    if (checking || loading || closures.loading || closures.error) return;
    setChecking(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const result = await checkBoardingGroup(day, time, requirements);
      if (!result.available) { setError(result.reason || "The requested group no longer fits. Choose another date."); setRefresh((n) => n + 1); return; }
      setDate(day);
      onSelectionsChange(setSchedule(day, time));
    } finally { setChecking(false); }
  }
  function changeTime(next: string) {
    setTime(next); setDate(""); setError(null); clearSchedules();
  }
  const selectedAvailable = !!date && days.some((row) => row.day === date && row.available);
  const valid = validDetails && selectedAvailable && !loading && !checking && !loadError && !closures.loading && !closures.error &&
    /^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(time) && time >= "09:00" && time <= "18:00" &&
    new Date(`${date}T${time}:00+08:00`).getTime() > Date.now();
  async function confirm() {
    if (!valid || checking) return;
    setChecking(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const result = await checkBoardingGroup(date, time, requirements);
      if (!result.available) { setError(result.reason || "Kennel availability changed. Choose another date."); setRefresh((n) => n + 1); return; }
      const final = setSchedule(date, time);
      onSelectionsChange(final);
      setVerified(final);
      setReview(true);
    } finally { setChecking(false); }
  }

  if (review) return <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[110] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 p-4" role="presentation">
    <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Review boarding allocation" className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-3xl bg-white p-5 shadow-xl sm:p-6">
      <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-zinc-800">Review Boarding Reservation</h3>
      <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-zinc-600">All {petSelections.length} pet(s) fit the selected stay. Only the explicitly selected eligible sharing groups will occupy one Big kennel. Other pets have separate kennels.</p>
      <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
        {shareGroups(verified as ShareSelection[]).map(group => <div key={group[0].boardingShareGroupId} className="rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-3 text-sm">
          <b>One shared Big kennel</b> Â· {group.map(s => s.pet.name).join(" + ")}
          <p className="mt-1 font-semibold text-emerald-900">Combined charge: â‚±{group.reduce((sum,s) => sum + s.lineAmount,0).toLocaleString()}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-emerald-800">One kennel base rate; per-pet add-ons remain retained.</p>
        </div>)}
        {verified.map((s) => <div key={s.pet.id} className="mt-2 rounded-xl border border-pink-100 bg-pink-50 p-3 text-sm">
          <b>{s.pet.name}</b> Â· {s.boardingKennelSize === "big" ? "Big" : "Small"} Kennel Â· â‚±{s.lineAmount.toLocaleString()}
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-600">{display(s.boardingDropOffAt!)} â†’ {display(s.boardingPickUpAt!)}</p>
        </div>)}
      </div>
      <p className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 p-3 text-xs text-amber-900">Availability is not reserved until final booking submission. On official holidays, caretakers supervise pets and can assist with pickup during the 9 AMâ€“6 PM window. Exceptional closures remain unavailable.</p>
      <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3"><button onClick={() => setReview(false)} className="rounded-full border border-pink-200 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-brand-pink">Review dates</button><button onClick={() => { setReview(false); onConfirmed(verified); }} className="rounded-full bg-brand-pink py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white">Confirm & Proceed</button></div>
    </div>
  </div>;

  return <div className="mx-auto max-w-4xl space-y-5">
    {confirmBack && <BookingStepConfirmation
      title="Return to boarding details?"
      description="You can review or change the kennel and duration. Changing those details may clear the selected boarding schedule and require another availability check."
      confirmLabel="Go Back" danger
      onCancel={() => setConfirmBack(false)}
      onConfirm={() => { setConfirmBack(false); onBack(); }} />}
    <div className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-pink-50 p-4">
      <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-brand-pink">Boarding Dates â€” Live Group Availability</h2><p className="mt-1 text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-500">Step 2 of 2 Â· Choose your drop-off day and review each pickup date</p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-700">The calendar checks all selected pets together. The current active capacity is {kennels.filter((k) => k.size === "small" && k.is_active !== false).length} Small and {kennels.filter((k) => k.size === "big" && k.is_active !== false).length} Big.</p>
      <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-zinc-600"><b>Sharing rules:</b> One shared Big kennel holds two Small pets, Small + Medium, Medium + Medium, or three Small pets, only when the Share One Big Kennel option was selected in Details. A Large or larger pet uses one Big kennel alone. A Small kennel holds one Small or Medium pet.</p>
    </div>
    <p className="rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-3 text-xs leading-5 text-amber-900">The calendar checks the <strong>entire stay</strong>, not just the arrival date. For example, arriving November 3 for six nights overlaps Big kennels reserved from November 5, so the date is unavailable. A stay that checks out before those reservations begin may still be available.</p>
    <div className="grid items-start gap-5 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_230px]">
      <div className="min-w-0 space-y-5">
        <BookingDayCalendar title="Group check-in" value={date} closures={boardingClosures}
          availability={availability} unavailable={unavailable} groupMode onBlocked={setError}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { manilaToday, useBookingClosures } from "@/lib/booking/use-booking-closures";

type Closures = ReturnType<typeof useBookingClosures>;
export default function BookingDayCalendar({ value, onChange, closures, unavailable = {}, availability,
  capacityLoading = false, capacityError = null, onMonthChange, title = "Choose a date", groupMode = false, onBlocked,
}: {
  value: string | null;
  onChange: (date: string) => void;
  closures: Closures;
  unavailable?: Record<string, string>;
  availability?: Record<string, number>;
  capacityLoading?: boolean;
  capacityError?: string | null;
  onMonthChange?: (month: string) => void;
  title?: string;
  /** Show a yes/no capacity result for the whole multi-pet booking instead of a misleading kennel count. */
  groupMode?: boolean;
  /** Optional modal feedback for dates that cannot be booked. */
  onBlocked?: (message: string) => void;
}) {
  const today = manilaToday();
  const [explanation, setExplanation] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(() => {
    const [year, m] = (value || today).split("-").map(Number);
    return new Date(year, m - 1, 1);
  });
  const year = month.getFullYear();
  const m = month.getMonth();
  const monthKey = `${year}-${String(m + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  useEffect(() => { onMonthChange?.(monthKey); }, [monthKey, onMonthChange]);
  const offset = new Date(year, m, 1).getDay();
  const length = new Date(year, m + 1, 0).getDate();
  const cells = Array.from({ length: Math.ceil((offset + length) / 7) * 7 }, (_, index) => index - offset + 1);
  const unavailableNow = closures.loading || Boolean(closures.error) || capacityLoading || Boolean(capacityError);
  // Avoid stretching to the height of the adjacent boarding-details grid column.
  return <section className="mx-auto h-fit w-full max-w-[490px] self-start rounded-2xl border border-pink-100 bg-white p-3 sm:p-4" aria-label="Booking date calendar">
    <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
      <button type="button" aria-label="Previous month" disabled={monthKey <= today.slice(0, 7)} onClick={() => setMonth(new Date(year, m - 1, 1))} className="rounded-full p-2 text-zinc-600 hover:bg-pink-50 disabled:opacity-30"><ChevronLeft size={18}/></button>
      <h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-zinc-800"><CalendarDays size={16} className="text-brand-pink"/>{title} Â· {month.toLocaleDateString("en-PH", { month: "long", year: "numeric" })}</h3>
      <button type="button" aria-label="Next month" onClick={() => setMonth(new Date(year, m + 1, 1))} className="rounded-full p-2 text-zinc-600 hover:bg-pink-50"><ChevronRight size={18}/></button>
    </div>
    <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1 text-center">

      {cells.map((day, index) => {
        const inMonth = day > 0 && day <= length;
        const date = inMonth ? `${monthKey}-${String(day).padStart(2, "0")}` : "";
        const past = inMonth && date < today;
        const reason = past ? null : (closures.nameFor(date) ?? unavailable[date] ?? null);
        // Blocked dates remain inspectable to explain why they cannot be booked.
        const blocked = !inMonth || past || unavailableNow || (Boolean(availability) && inMonth && availability?.[date] === undefined);
        return <button type="button" key={index} disabled={blocked} aria-disabled={Boolean(reason)} aria-label={!inMonth ? "Outside month" : reason ? `${date}: Closed - ${reason}` : past ? `${date}: Past date` : date}
          title={reason ? `Unavailable: ${reason}` : availability && inMonth ? groupMode ? "Whole booking can fit" : `${availability[date] ?? "Checking"} kennels available for the selected stay` : undefined}
          aria-pressed={value === date} onClick={() => { if (reason) { if (onBlocked) onBlocked(`${date}: ${reason}`); else setExplanation(`${date}: ${reason}`); return; } setExplanation(null); onChange(date); }}
          className={`flex min-h-12 flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-lg border px-0.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold transition ${reason ? "border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-700" : past ? "border-transparent bg-rose-50/60 text-rose-400" : value === date ? "border-brand-pink bg-brand-pink text-white" : "border-transparent text-zinc-700 hover:bg-pink-50"} disabled:cursor-not-allowed ${reason ? "cursor-not-allowed" : ""}`}>
          {inMonth ? day : ""}
          {reason ? <span className="mt-0.5 max-w-full truncate text-[8px] font-extrabold leading-3 text-rose-600">{reason.toLowerCase().includes("time has passed") ? "Past time" : reason.toLowerCase().includes("pickup") ? "Pickup closed" : reason.toLowerCase().includes("full") || reason.toLowerCase().includes("no ") ? "Full" : "Closed"}</span>
            : past ? <span className="mt-0.5 text-[8px] font-bold text-rose-500">Past</span>
            : availability && inMonth ? <span className="mt-0.5 text-[8px] font-bold text-emerald-700">{availability[date] === undefined ? "Checking" : groupMode ? "Available" : `${availability[date]} left`}</span> : null}
        </button>;
      })}
    </div>
    <p className="mt-3 text-center text-[11px] text-rose-700">Red dates cannot be selected. Tap a red date to see why. {groupMode ? "Availability covers the entire multi-pet booking." : "Counts cover the entire stay, including pickup-day opening hours."}</p>

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\shared\ManagementStepConfirmation.tsx =====

"use client";

import { useCallback, useRef, useState, type MouseEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import ActionConfirmModal from "@/components/admin/operations/ActionConfirmModal";

type PendingAction = {
  button: HTMLButtonElement;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  confirmLabel: string;
};

/**
 * Confirms only consequential navigation, not routine Back/Next/Continue steps.
 *
 * - Walking out of an unfinished POS booking is confirmed automatically.
 * - Other screens can explicitly opt in with data-confirm-step="leave".
 * - Existing save, cancellation, archive, and checkout dialogs continue to
 *   manage their own confirmations and are never intercepted here.
 *
 * This keeps the existing handlers untouched, including form validations.
 */
export default function ManagementStepConfirmation({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<PendingAction | null>(null);
  const allowedButton = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);

  const intercept = useCallback((event: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!(event.target instanceof Element)) return;
    const button = event.target.closest("button");
    if (!(button instanceof HTMLButtonElement) || button.disabled) return;

    // Allow the confirmed click through exactly once.
    if (allowedButton.current === button) {
      allowedButton.current = null;
      return;
    }
    if (button.dataset.skipStepConfirmation === "true") return;

    const label = (button.textContent ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
    const leavingPos = pathname.startsWith("/admin/pos/walk-in") &&
      /^(?:â†\s*)?back to pos$/i.test(label);
    const explicitlyLeaving = button.dataset.confirmStep === "leave";

    // No global matching for "Back", "Next", or "Continue".
    // Those are normal wizard navigation, not consequential operations.
    if (!leavingPos && !explicitlyLeaving) return;

    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    setPending({
      button,
      title: leavingPos ? "Leave walk-in booking?" : "Leave this step?",
      description: leavingPos
        ? "Are you sure you want to return to POS? The unfinished walk-in booking will not be saved."
        : "Are you sure you want to leave? Any unsaved changes on this step may be lost.",
      confirmLabel: leavingPos ? "Yes, return to POS" : "Yes, leave",
    });
  }, [pathname]);

  const confirm = () => {
    if (!pending) return;
    const button = pending.button;
    setPending(null);
    if (!button.isConnected || button.disabled) return;
    allowedButton.current = button;
    try {
      button.click();
    } finally {
      allowedButton.current = null;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div onClickCapture={intercept} className="min-w-0 w-full">
      {children}
      {pending && (
        <ActionConfirmModal
          title={pending.title}
          description={pending.description}
          confirmLabel={pending.confirmLabel}
          onCancel={() => setPending(null)}
          onConfirm={confirm}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\components\shared\PetPhotoEditor.tsx =====

"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { PointerEvent as ReactPointerEvent } from "react";
import { Camera, Minus, Plus, RotateCcw, X } from "lucide-react";

/** Produces a square 512px JPEG. The circular mask is visual; the saved square
 * can also be displayed in lists, booking cards and printed pet records. */
export default function PetPhotoEditor({ petId, petName, onSaved, onClose }: {
  petId: string;
  petName: string;
  onSaved: (url: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const imageRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement | null>(null);
  const dragRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number; startX: number; startY: number } | null>(null);
  const [objectUrl, setObjectUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dimensions, setDimensions] = useState({ width: 1, height: 1 });
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(1);
  const [position, setPosition] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const FRAME = 280;
  const fit = Math.max(FRAME / dimensions.width, FRAME / dimensions.height);
  const scale = fit * zoom;
  const renderedWidth = dimensions.width * scale;
  const renderedHeight = dimensions.height * scale;
  const boundX = Math.max(0, (renderedWidth - FRAME) / 2);
  const boundY = Math.max(0, (renderedHeight - FRAME) / 2);
  const clamp = (x: number, y: number) => ({ x: Math.max(-boundX, Math.min(boundX, x)), y: Math.max(-boundY, Math.min(boundY, y)) });

  useEffect(() => () => { if (objectUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl); }, [objectUrl]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const keydown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => { if (event.key === "Escape" && !busy) onClose(); };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", keydown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", keydown);
  }, [busy, onClose]);

  function choose(file?: File) {
    if (!file) return;
    if (!["image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp"].includes(file.type)) { setError("Choose a JPG, PNG, or WebP photo."); return; }
    if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) { setError("Choose a photo under 10 MB."); return; }
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    const picture = new Image();
    picture.onload = () => {
      if (picture.naturalWidth < 64 || picture.naturalHeight < 64) { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); setError("Please choose an image at least 64 Ã— 64 pixels."); return; }
      imageRef.current = picture;
      setDimensions({ width: picture.naturalWidth, height: picture.naturalHeight });
      setObjectUrl(url); setPosition({ x: 0, y: 0 }); setZoom(1); setError(null);
    };
    picture.onerror = () => { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); setError("This image cannot be read."); };
    picture.src = url;
    if (inputRef.current) inputRef.current.value = "";
  }

  function startDrag(event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
    if (!objectUrl || busy) return;
    dragRef.current = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY, startX: position.x, startY: position.y };
    event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  }
  function drag(event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
    if (!dragRef.current) return;
    const d = dragRef.current;
    setPosition(clamp(d.startX + event.clientX - d.x, d.startY + event.clientY - d.y));
  }
  function changeZoom(next: number) {
    const value = Math.max(1, Math.min(3, next));
    const maxX = Math.max(0, (dimensions.width * fit * value - FRAME) / 2);
    const maxY = Math.max(0, (dimensions.height * fit * value - FRAME) / 2);
    setZoom(value);
    setPosition(p => ({ x: Math.max(-maxX, Math.min(maxX, p.x)), y: Math.max(-maxY, Math.min(maxY, p.y)) }));
  }
  async function save() {
    const img = imageRef.current;
    if (!img || busy) return;
    setBusy(true); setError(null);
    try {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = canvas.height = 512;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
      if (!ctx) throw new Error("Unable to prepare the photo on this device.");
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);
      const factor = 512 / FRAME;
      ctx.drawImage(img, (FRAME / 2 + position.x - renderedWidth / 2) * factor,
        (FRAME / 2 + position.y - renderedHeight / 2) * factor,
        renderedWidth * factor, renderedHeight * factor);
      const blob = await new Promise<Blob | null>(resolve => canvas.toBlob(resolve, "image/jpeg", 0.88));
      if (!blob) throw new Error("Unable to export the cropped photo.");
      const payload = new FormData();
      payload.append("photo", blob, "pet.jpg");
      const response = await fetch(`/api/pets/photo?petId=${encodeURIComponent(petId)}`, { method: "POST", body: payload });
      const result = await response.json().catch(() => ({})) as { error?: string; url?: string };
      if (!response.ok || !result.url) throw new Error(result.error || "Could not save the pet photo.");
      onSaved(result.url);
      onClose();
    } catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Unable to update the pet photo."); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
  return <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[300] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/65 p-3 sm:p-5" role="presentation" onMouseDown={e => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget && !busy) onClose(); }}>
    <section role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={`Edit ${petName}'s profile picture`} className="max-h-[95dvh] w-full max-w-md overflow-y-auto rounded-3xl bg-white p-5 shadow-2xl sm:p-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><div><h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">Pet profile picture</h2><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{petName} Â· Move and zoom the photo to fit the circle.</p></div><button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close photo editor" className="rounded-full p-2 hover:bg-pink-50"><X size={20}/></button></div>
      <input ref={inputRef} type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" className="sr-only" onChange={e => choose(e.target.files?.[0])}/>
      {objectUrl ? <>
        <div className="mx-auto mt-5 flex h-[280px] w-[280px] max-w-full items-center justify-center">

"use client";

import { Fragment, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";

type AppointmentRecord = {
  id: string; service_type: string; scheduled_date: string; scheduled_time: string | null;
  drop_off_at: string | null; pick_up_at: string | null; status: string;
  is_walk_in: boolean; special_requests: string | null; created_at: string;
};
type HistoryRow = {
  id: string; appointment: AppointmentRecord; amount: number; groomer: string;
  packageName: string; checkedInAt: string | null; checkedOutAt: string | null;
};
const PAGE_SIZE = 5;
const SERVICE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  dog_grooming: "Dog Grooming", cat_grooming: "Cat Grooming",
  boarding: "Boarding", ala_carte: "Ã€ La Carte",
};

function formatDate(date: string) {
  return new Date(`${date}T12:00:00+08:00`).toLocaleDateString("en-PH", {
    timeZone: "Asia/Manila", year: "numeric", month: "short", day: "numeric",
  });
}
function formatTime(time: string | null) {
  if (!time) return "â€”";
  const [h, m] = time.split(":").map(Number);
  return `${h % 12 || 12}:${String(m).padStart(2, "0")} ${h >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM"}`;
}
function dateTime(iso: string | null) {
  if (!iso) return "Not recorded";
  const date = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "Not recorded";
  return date.toLocaleString("en-PH", {
    timeZone: "Asia/Manila", month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric",
    hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit", hour12: true,
  });
}

export default function PetServiceHistory({ petId }: { petId: string }) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<HistoryRow[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    setPage(1); setExpanded(null); setLoading(true); setError(null);
    (async () => {
      try {
        const supabase = createClient();
        const { data, error: historyError } = await supabase.from("appointment_pets")
          .select("id, appointment_id, groomer_id, package_id, line_amount, checked_in_at, checked_out_at, appointments!inner(id, service_type, scheduled_date, scheduled_time, drop_off_at, pick_up_at, status, is_walk_in, special_requests, created_at)")
          .eq("pet_id", petId);
        if (historyError) throw historyError;
        type RawRow = {
          id: string; groomer_id: string | null; package_id: string | null;
          line_amount: number | null; checked_in_at: string | null;
          checked_out_at: string | null;
          appointments: AppointmentRecord | AppointmentRecord[] | null;
        };
        const source = (data ?? []) as unknown as RawRow[];
        const groomerIds = [...new Set(source.map(r => r.groomer_id).filter((id): id is string => !!id))];
        const packageIds = [...new Set(source.map(r => r.package_id).filter((id): id is string => !!id))];
        const [groomers, packages] = await Promise.all([
          groomerIds.length ? supabase.from("groomers").select("id,name").in("id", groomerIds) : Promise.resolve({ data: [], error: null }),
          packageIds.length ? supabase.from("packages").select("id,name").in("id", packageIds) : Promise.resolve({ data: [], error: null }),
        ]);
        // Display history even if associated names were archived.
        const groomerNames = new Map((groomers.data ?? []).map(r => [r.id as string, r.name as string]));
        const packageNames = new Map((packages.data ?? []).map(r => [r.id as string, r.name as string]));
        const mapped: HistoryRow[] = source.flatMap(r => {
          const appointment = Array.isArray(r.appointments) ? r.appointments[0] : r.appointments;
          if (!appointment) return [];
          return [{
            id: r.id, appointment, amount: Number(r.line_amount ?? 0),
            groomer: r.groomer_id ? groomerNames.get(r.groomer_id) ?? "â€”" : "â€”",

            checkedInAt: r.checked_in_at,
            checkedOutAt: r.checked_out_at,
          }];
        });
        mapped.sort((a, b) =>
          (b.appointment.scheduled_date + (b.appointment.scheduled_time ?? "") + b.appointment.created_at)
            .localeCompare(a.appointment.scheduled_date + (a.appointment.scheduled_time ?? "") + a.appointment.created_at)
        );
        if (alive) setRows(mapped);
      } catch (cause) {

    })();
    return () => { alive = false; };

"use client";
// Minimal toast system: a context + provider anyone can call, no
// external library. Matches the pattern used for confirm dialogs below â€”
// simple, self-contained, reusable beyond just this module.
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useState } from "react";

type Toast = { id: number; message: string; type: "success" | "error" };
type ToastContextValue = { showToast: (message: string, type?: Toast["type"]) => void };

const ToastContext = createContext<ToastContextValue | null>(null);

export function ToastProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<Toast[]>([]);

  const showToast = useCallback((message: string, type: Toast["type"] = "success") => {
    const id = Date.now();
    setToasts((prev) => [...prev, { id, message, type }]);
    setTimeout(() => setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== id)), 3500);
  }, []);

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={{ showToast }}>
      {children}
      <div className="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-[100] flex flex-col gap-2">
        {toasts.map((t) => (
          <div
            key={t.id}
            className={`px-4 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-lg text-sm font-medium text-white animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-2 ${
              t.type === "success" ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-red-500"
            }`}
          >
            {t.message}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useToast() {
  const ctx = useContext(ToastContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("useToast must be used within ToastProvider");
  return ctx;
}

"use client";
// Keep an already-open page in sync with account-status changes.
// Middleware and server layouts still enforce authorization on requests.
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";

type BlockReason = "deactivated" | "unverified" | null;

export default function AccountStatusWatcher({
  userId,
  table,
}: {
  userId: string;
  table: "customers" | "staff_profiles";
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [blockReason, setBlockReason] = useState<BlockReason>(null);
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(false);
  // One browser client for the lifetime of this mounted watcher.
  const [supabase] = useState(createClient);

  const recheck = useCallback(async () => {
    setChecking(true);
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.from(table)
        .select("status")
        .eq("id", userId)
        .maybeSingle();
      if (error || !data) setBlockReason("unverified");
      else if (data.status !== "active") setBlockReason("deactivated");
      else setBlockReason(null);
    } catch {
      setBlockReason("unverified");
    } finally {
      setChecking(false);
    }
  }, [supabase, table, userId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void recheck();
    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`account-status-${table}-${userId}`)
      .on(
        "postgres_changes",
        { event: "*", schema: "public", table, filter: `id=eq.${userId}` },
        () => { void recheck(); }
      )
      .subscribe();
    window.addEventListener("focus", recheck);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("focus", recheck);
      void supabase.removeChannel(channel);
    };
  }, [supabase, userId, table, recheck]);

  async function handleSignOut() {
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
    router.replace(blockReason === "deactivated" ? "/sign-in?deactivated=1" : "/sign-in?access=unverified");
    router.refresh();
  }

  if (!blockReason) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 px-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm bg-white rounded-3xl overflow-hidden text-center">
        <div className="px-6 pt-7 pb-5">
          <div className="mx-auto w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-red-100 flex items-center justify-center">
            <svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" className="text-red-600">
              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
              <path d="M15 9l-6 6M9 9l6 6" strokeLinecap="round" />
            </svg>
          </div>
          <h3 className="mt-3 text-lg font-bold text-zinc-800">
            {blockReason === "deactivated" ? "Your account is now deactivated" : "Account access could not be verified"}
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-500">
            {blockReason === "deactivated"
              ? "Your account is inactive or archived. Please contact support."
              : "We couldn't confirm that your account is active. Retry or contact support."}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="px-6 pb-6 space-y-2">
          {blockReason === "unverified" && (
            <button type="button" onClick={() => void recheck()} disabled={checking}
              className="w-full border-2 border-brand-pink text-brand-pink font-semibold py-2.5 rounded-full disabled:opacity-50">
              {checking ? "Checkingâ€¦" : "Retry verification"}
            </button>
          )}
          <button onClick={handleSignOut}
            className="w-full bg-brand-pink hover:bg-brand-pink-dark text-white font-semibold py-2.5 rounded-full">
            Sign out
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\diagnostics\CHECK-SUPERADMIN-READ-ONLY.sql =====

-- HAPPYTAILS ISSUE #6: READ-ONLY superadmin login diagnostic.
-- Run this in Supabase SQL Editor on the SAME project your local app uses.
-- Replace the placeholder email locally. Do not share your password or
-- paste sensitive account IDs/email addresses into chat.
-- This query does not modify any account or permission.
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT id FROM auth.users
  WHERE lower(email) = lower('REPLACE_WITH_SUPERADMIN_EMAIL')
)
SELECT
  (u.id IS NOT NULL) AS auth_account_exists,
  COALESCE(p.role::text, 'MISSING') AS profile_role,
  CASE WHEN s.id IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' ELSE COALESCE(s.status::text, 'MISSING') END AS staff_status
FROM (SELECT true AS one_row) AS anchor
LEFT JOIN matched AS u ON true
LEFT JOIN public.profiles AS p ON p.id = u.id
LEFT JOIN public.staff_profiles AS s ON s.id = u.id;

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\diagnostics\CHECK_STAFF_AUTH_READ_ONLY.sql =====

-- HAPPYTAILS STAFF ACCOUNT DIAGNOSTIC â€” READ ONLY
-- Use the staff member's UID from Supabase > Authentication > Users.
-- Do not share the UID, email address, or secrets in screenshots.
WITH target AS (
  SELECT id, email FROM auth.users
  WHERE id = 'PASTE_EXISTING_STAFF_AUTH_UID_HERE'::uuid
)
SELECT
  (t.id IS NOT NULL) AS auth_account_exists,
  COALESCE(p.role::text, 'MISSING') AS profile_role,
  CASE WHEN s.id IS NULL THEN 'MISSING'
       ELSE COALESCE(s.status::text, 'MISSING') END AS staff_status,
  CASE WHEN s.id IS NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(s.username), '') IS NULL
       THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'PRESENT' END AS staff_username,
  CASE WHEN t.email IS NULL OR btrim(t.email) = ''
       THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'PRESENT' END AS auth_email
FROM (SELECT 1) anchor
LEFT JOIN target t ON true
LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = t.id
LEFT JOIN public.staff_profiles s ON s.id = t.id;

import { createHash, randomBytes, randomInt } from "node:crypto";
import { createClient, type SupabaseClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

export const OTP_EXPIRY_MINUTES = 10;
export const RESET_TOKEN_EXPIRY_MINUTES = 10;
export const MAX_OTP_ATTEMPTS = 5;
export const RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS = 60;

export function normalizeEmail(email: string) { return email.trim().toLowerCase(); }

export function getAdminClient(): SupabaseClient {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL?.trim();
  const serviceRoleKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY?.trim();
  if (!url) throw new Error("CONFIG_SUPABASE_URL_MISSING");
  if (!serviceRoleKey) throw new Error("CONFIG_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY_MISSING");
  return createClient(url, serviceRoleKey, { auth: { autoRefreshToken: false, persistSession: false } });
}

function getPepper() {
  const pepper = process.env.PASSWORD_RESET_OTP_SECRET?.trim();
  if (!pepper) throw new Error("CONFIG_PASSWORD_RESET_OTP_SECRET_MISSING");
  return pepper;
}

export function hashValue(value: string) { return createHash("sha256").update(`${getPepper()}:${value}`).digest("hex"); }

export async function findUserByEmail(supabase: SupabaseClient, email: string) {
  for (let page = 1; page <= 20; page += 1) {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.admin.listUsers({ page, perPage: 1000 });
    if (error) throw new Error(`SUPABASE_ADMIN_LIST_USERS_FAILED:${error.message}`);
    const user = data.users.find((candidate) => candidate.email?.toLowerCase() === email);
    if (user) return user;
    if (data.users.length < 1000) return null;
  }
  return null;
}

export async function sendPasswordResetOtp(email: string, otp: string) {
  const apiKey = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY?.trim();
  const from = process.env.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL?.trim();
  if (!apiKey) throw new Error("CONFIG_RESEND_API_KEY_MISSING");
  if (!from) throw new Error("CONFIG_RESEND_FROM_EMAIL_MISSING");

  const response = await fetch("https://api.resend.com/emails", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      from,
      to: [email],
      subject: "Your Happy Tails password reset code",
      html: `<div style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;padding:32px;color:#27272a"><h2>Reset your Happy Tails password</h2><p>We received a request to reset your password.</p><p>Your verification code is:</p><div style="font-size:36px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:10px;margin:16px 0 24px">${otp}</div><p>This code expires in ${OTP_EXPIRY_MINUTES} minutes and can only be used once.</p><p style="color:#71717a">If you did not request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email.</p></div>`,
    }),
  });

  const body = await response.text();
  if (!response.ok) {
    let detail = body;
    try { const parsed = JSON.parse(body) as { message?: string; name?: string }; detail = parsed.message ?? parsed.name ?? body; } catch {}
    throw new Error(`RESEND_${response.status}:${detail.slice(0, 300)}`);
  }
}

export function publicPasswordResetError(error: unknown) {
  const raw = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
  if (raw === "CONFIG_SUPABASE_URL_MISSING") return "Server configuration error: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL is missing.";
  if (raw === "CONFIG_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY_MISSING") return "Server configuration error: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is missing from .env.local.";
  if (raw === "CONFIG_PASSWORD_RESET_OTP_SECRET_MISSING") return "Server configuration error: PASSWORD_RESET_OTP_SECRET is missing from .env.local.";
  if (raw === "CONFIG_RESEND_API_KEY_MISSING") return "Server configuration error: RESEND_API_KEY is missing from .env.local.";
  if (raw === "CONFIG_RESEND_FROM_EMAIL_MISSING") return "Server configuration error: RESEND_FROM_EMAIL is missing from .env.local.";
  if (raw.startsWith("SUPABASE_ADMIN_LIST_USERS_FAILED:")) return `Supabase admin authentication failed: ${raw.slice(34)}`;
  if (raw.startsWith("RESEND_401:")) return `Resend rejected the API key: ${raw.slice(10)}`;
  if (raw.startsWith("RESEND_403:")) return `Resend rejected the sender/account: ${raw.slice(10)}`;
  if (raw.startsWith("RESEND_422:")) return `Resend rejected the email data: ${raw.slice(10)}`;
  if (raw.startsWith("RESEND_429:")) return `Resend rate limit reached: ${raw.slice(10)}`;
  if (raw.startsWith("RESEND_")) return `Resend email request failed: ${raw.slice(raw.indexOf(":") + 1)}`;
  if (/password_reset_otps/i.test(raw) && /(relation|table|does not exist|schema cache|PGRST116|PGRST2)/i.test(raw)) return `Password reset database error: ${raw}`;
  return `Password reset server error: ${raw.slice(0, 300)}`;
}

// SERVER-ONLY utility for Issue #6. Import only from app/api/ route handlers.
// Never export service_role access or username->email information to clients.
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";
import type { createAdminClient } from "@/lib/supabase/admin";

export type AuthScope = "login" | "availability";

type Admin = ReturnType<typeof createAdminClient>;

export function isSameOriginJsonPost(request: NextRequest): boolean {
  const origin = request.headers.get("origin");
  const contentType = request.headers.get("content-type") ?? "";
  return origin === new URL(request.url).origin &&
    /^application\/json(?:\s*;|$)/i.test(contentType);
}

export async function readSmallJson(request: NextRequest): Promise<Record<string, unknown> | null> {
  const rawLength = request.headers.get("content-length");
  if (rawLength && Number(rawLength) > 2048) return null;
  const raw = await request.text();
  if (raw.length > 2048) return null;
  try {
    const data: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    return data && typeof data === "object" && !Array.isArray(data)
      ? data as Record<string, unknown>
      : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// A durable, atomic, per-IP database rate limit. Hash IPs with the
// server-only Supabase key so the database never holds raw addresses.
// x-vercel-forwarded-for is supplied by Vercel; x-forwarded-for is the
// fallback for local development and other trusted reverse proxies.
export async function consumeAuthQuota(
  admin: Admin,
  request: NextRequest,
  scope: AuthScope,
): Promise<{ allowed: boolean; unavailable: boolean }> {
  const ip = (
    request.headers.get("x-vercel-forwarded-for") ??
    request.headers.get("x-forwarded-for") ??
    request.headers.get("cf-connecting-ip") ??
    "unknown"
  ).split(",")[0].trim().slice(0, 128);
  const secret = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;
  if (!secret) return { allowed: false, unavailable: true };
  const ipHash = createHash("sha256")
    .update(`${secret}:issue06:${scope}:${ip}`)
    .digest("hex");
  const { data, error } = await admin.rpc("sec006_take_auth_slot", {
    p_scope: scope,
    p_ip_hash: ipHash,
  });
  if (error || typeof data !== "boolean") {
    console.error("Issue #6 auth rate limiter unavailable", error?.code ?? "invalid result");
    return { allowed: false, unavailable: true };
  }
  return { allowed: data, unavailable: false };
}

import type { BookingLeg } from "@/lib/types/booking-leg";

export type PendingGroomerInterval = {
  groomerId: string;
  startMinute: number;
  endMinute: number;
};
export function clockMinutes(value: string | null | undefined): number | null {
  if (!value || !/^\d{2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?$/.test(value)) return null;
  const [hours, minutes] = value.split(":").map(Number);
  return hours <= 23 && minutes <= 59 ? hours * 60 + minutes : null;
}
export function isPendingGroomerBusy(
  intervals: PendingGroomerInterval[], groomerId: string, startMinute: number, durationMinutes = 30,
): boolean {
  return intervals.some(item => item.groomerId === groomerId &&
    item.startMinute < startMinute + durationMinutes && item.endMinute > startMinute);
}
export function pendingGroomerSelections(legs: BookingLeg[], selectedDate: string) {
  return legs.flatMap(leg => {
    if (leg.scheduledDate !== selectedDate ||
      !["grooming", "dog_grooming", "cat_grooming", "ala_carte"].includes(leg.serviceChoice)) return [];
    return leg.petSelections.flatMap(selection => {
      const individual = selection as typeof selection & {
        groomingScheduledTime?: string;
        alaCarteScheduledTime?: string | null;
      };
      const start = clockMinutes(leg.serviceChoice === "ala_carte"
        ? individual.alaCarteScheduledTime ?? leg.scheduledTime
        : individual.groomingScheduledTime ?? leg.scheduledTime);
      if (!selection.groomerId || start === null) return [];
      return [{
        groomerId: selection.groomerId, startMinute: start,
        packagePricingId: leg.serviceChoice === "ala_carte" ? null : selection.packagePricingId,
        addonIds: leg.serviceChoice === "ala_carte" ? (selection.addonIds ?? []) : [],
      }];
    });
  });
}

import type { DraftPetSelection } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { Kennel } from "@/lib/types/pet-services";
import { shareGroups, validShareGroup, type ShareSelection } from "@/lib/booking/boarding-share";

/** Physical-capacity precheck only. Availability for a particular date/stay is
 * still decided by the existing SQL group planner. */
export function boardingPhysicalCapacity(selections: DraftPetSelection[], kennels: Kennel[]) {
  const active = kennels.filter(k => k.is_active !== false);
  const smallAvailable = active.filter(k => k.size === "small").length;
  const bigAvailable = active.filter(k => k.size === "big").length;
  const grouped = new Set<string>();
  let smallNeeded = 0;
  let bigNeeded = 0;
  for (const group of shareGroups(selections as ShareSelection[])) {
    if (!validShareGroup(group)) continue;
    bigNeeded++;
    for (const pet of group) grouped.add(pet.pet.id);
  }
  for (const pet of selections) {
    if (grouped.has(pet.pet.id)) continue;
    if (pet.boardingKennelSize === "big") bigNeeded++;
    else if (pet.boardingKennelSize === "small") smallNeeded++;
  }
  return {
    smallNeeded, bigNeeded, smallAvailable, bigAvailable,
    exceeded: smallNeeded > smallAvailable || bigNeeded > bigAvailable,
  };
}

export function boardingCapacityMessage(counts: ReturnType<typeof boardingPhysicalCapacity>) {
  const issues = [
    counts.bigNeeded > counts.bigAvailable
      ? `${counts.bigNeeded} Big kennel${counts.bigNeeded === 1 ? "" : "s"} needed, but only ${counts.bigAvailable} active Big kennel${counts.bigAvailable === 1 ? "" : "s"} configured`
      : null,
    counts.smallNeeded > counts.smallAvailable
      ? `${counts.smallNeeded} Small kennel${counts.smallNeeded === 1 ? "" : "s"} needed, but only ${counts.smallAvailable} active Small kennel${counts.smallAvailable === 1 ? "" : "s"} configured`
      : null,
  ].filter(Boolean);
  return `These pets cannot all stay in one Boarding appointment: ${issues.join("; ")}. Select fewer pets using the Editing list, finish this reservation, then create another Boarding appointment for the remaining pets. Separate appointments still require their own date and kennel availability checks.`;
}

import type { DraftPetSelection } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { PackagePricing } from "@/lib/types/services";

export const MIN_EXTENDED_BOARDING_NIGHTS = 7;
export const MAX_BOARDING_NIGHTS = 365;

/** A fixed "7 Days & 6 Nights" package must NOT be mistaken for "7 Days & Up". */
export function isExtendedBoardingRate(rate: PackagePricing): boolean {
  if (rate.is_per_night) return true;
  return /(?:7\s*(?:days?|nights?)\s*(?:&\s*)?(?:and\s*)?(?:up|above)|7\s*\+\s*(?:days?|nights?))/i
    .test(`${rate.size_label} ${rate.size_detail ?? ""}`);
}

export function parseExtendedBoardingNights(value: string | number | null | undefined): number | null {
  const raw = value == null ? "" : String(value).trim();
  if (!/^\d+$/.test(raw)) return null;
  const nights = Number(raw);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(nights) && nights >= MIN_EXTENDED_BOARDING_NIGHTS && nights <= MAX_BOARDING_NIGHTS ? nights : null;
}

export function extendedBoardingNightError(value: string | number | null | undefined): string | null {
  const raw = value == null ? "" : String(value).trim();
  if (!raw) return `Enter the number of nights. The minimum is ${MIN_EXTENDED_BOARDING_NIGHTS}.`;
  if (!/^\d+$/.test(raw) || !Number.isSafeInteger(Number(raw))) {
    return `Enter a valid whole number of nights (at least ${MIN_EXTENDED_BOARDING_NIGHTS}).`;
  }
  const number = Number(raw);
  if (number < MIN_EXTENDED_BOARDING_NIGHTS) return `${MIN_EXTENDED_BOARDING_NIGHTS} nights is the starting minimum for 7 Days & Up.`;
  if (number > MAX_BOARDING_NIGHTS) return `The maximum supported stay is ${MAX_BOARDING_NIGHTS} nights.`;
  return null;
}

export function hasValidBoardingDuration(selection: DraftPetSelection, pricing: PackagePricing[]): boolean {
  const rate = pricing.find((r) => r.id === selection.packagePricingId);
  if (!rate) return false;
  if (isExtendedBoardingRate(rate)) return parseExtendedBoardingNights(selection.boardingNights) !== null;
  const match = `${rate.size_detail ?? ""} ${rate.size_label}`.match(/(\d+)\s*nights?/i);
  const nights = rate.nights ?? selection.boardingNights ?? (match ? Number(match[1]) : null);
  return typeof nights === "number" && Number.isSafeInteger(nights) && nights >= 1 && nights <= MAX_BOARDING_NIGHTS;
}

/** One canonical definition for booking and walk-in boarding promotions. */
export const BATH_DRY_FREE_NIGHTS = 4;
export function hasFreeBathDry(nights: number | null | undefined): boolean {
  return Number.isInteger(nights) && (nights ?? 0) >= BATH_DRY_FREE_NIGHTS;
}
export function isBathDry(name: string): boolean { return /bath\s*(?:&|and|\+)\s*(?:blow\s*)?dry/i.test(name) || /bath\s*(?:&|and|\+)\s*blow/i.test(name); }
export function isFullGrooming(name: string): boolean { return /full\s*(?:pet\s*)?groom/i.test(name); }
/** Boarding Bath & Dry rates are per pet, regardless of dog/cat species.
 * Small and Medium use the Small rate; Large and larger use the Large rate. */
export function boardingBathDryPrice(sizeLabel: string | null | undefined): number {
  const size = (sizeLabel ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  return size === "small" || size === "medium" ? 500 : 600;
}
export function blockingReason(name: string, nights: number | null | undefined, hasGroomingPackage: boolean): string | null {
  if (hasFreeBathDry(nights) && isBathDry(name)) return "Free Bath & Dry is already included for boarding of 4 or more nights.";
  if (hasGroomingPackage && isFullGrooming(name)) return "This pet already has a grooming package in the booking.";
  return null;
}
/** XL and 2XL must never fall back to a Smallâ€“Medium add-on rate. */
export function groomingAddonPrice<T extends {size_label:string;price:number}>(rows: T[], sizeLabel?: string | null): T | undefined {
  const normalize = (s:string) => s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
  const size = normalize(sizeLabel ?? "");
  const tier = /^(?:2xl|xxl|extraextralarge|2extralarge|xl|extralarge|large|l)$/.test(size) ? "large" : "smallmedium";
  const mapped = rows.find(row => { const s=normalize(row.size_label);return tier === "large" ? s === "large" || s === "largesize" : s === "smallmedium" || s === "small"; });
  if (tier === "large") return mapped;
  const matching = rows.find(row => normalize(row.size_label) === size);
  return matching ?? mapped ?? (rows.length === 1 && /standard|allsize|fixed/i.test(rows[0].size_label) ? rows[0] : undefined);
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\lib\booking\boarding-share.ts =====

import type { DraftPetSelection } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { PackagePricing } from "@/lib/types/services";
import { isExtendedBoardingRate } from "@/lib/booking/boarding-duration";

export type ShareSelection = DraftPetSelection & { boardingShareGroupId?: string | null };
export const tier = (size: string): "small" | "medium" | "large" | null => {
  const s = size.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (s === "small" || s === "medium") return s;
  return /large|^(?:[2-9]xl|x{1,5}l)$/.test(s) ? "large" : null;
};
export function validShareGroup(selections: ShareSelection[]): boolean {
  if (![2, 3].includes(selections.length)) return false;
  const values = selections.map(s => tier(s.pet.size_label)).sort();
  const combo = values.join("+");
  if (!(["small+small", "medium+small", "medium+medium", "small+small+small"].includes(combo))) return false;
  const first = selections[0];
  return selections.every(s => s.boardingKennelSize === "big" && s.packageId === first.packageId &&
    !!s.packagePricingId && s.packagePricingId === first.packagePricingId &&
    s.boardingNights === first.boardingNights && s.pet.id !== "");
}
export function shareGroups(selections: ShareSelection[]): ShareSelection[][] {
  const groups = new Map<string, ShareSelection[]>();
  for (const sel of selections) if (sel.boardingShareGroupId) {
    groups.set(sel.boardingShareGroupId, [...(groups.get(sel.boardingShareGroupId) ?? []), sel]);
  }
  return [...groups.values()];
}
export function shareError(selections: ShareSelection[]): string | null {
  for (const group of shareGroups(selections)) {
    if (!validShareGroup(group)) return "Shared Big kennels require 2 Small, Small + Medium, Medium + Medium, or 3 Small pets, with the same package and nights.";
  }
  return null;
}
export function baseBoardingCharge(selection: ShareSelection, prices: PackagePricing[]): number {
  const rate = prices.find(p => p.id === selection.packagePricingId && p.package_id === selection.packageId);
  if (!rate) return 0;
  return rate.price * (isExtendedBoardingRate(rate) ? selection.boardingNights ?? 0 : 1);
}
/** Pass complete, independently priced selections; removes only duplicate kennel BASE charges. */
export function withSharedKennelPrices(selections: ShareSelection[], prices: PackagePricing[]): ShareSelection[] {
  if (shareError(selections)) return selections;
  const groups = shareGroups(selections);
  const nonPayers = new Set(groups.flatMap(group => group.slice(1).map(s => s.pet.id)));
  return selections.map(s => nonPayers.has(s.pet.id)
    ? { ...s, lineAmount: Math.max(0, Math.round((s.lineAmount - baseBoardingCharge(s, prices)) * 100) / 100) }
    : s);
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\lib\booking\boarding-shared-checkout.ts =====

import type { CreateAppointmentInput } from "@/lib/supabase/appointments";
import { validShareGroup, type ShareSelection } from "@/lib/booking/boarding-share";

type Prepared = { inputs: CreateAppointmentInput[]; inputToSaved: number[]; error: string | null };

/** The original summary passes one boarding appointment PER pet. Convert explicitly
 * selected same-stay sharing groups to ONE appointment with multiple pet rows.
 * This is a real shared kennel + single appointment/total, not a visual discount.
 */
export function prepareBoardingShares(inputs: CreateAppointmentInput[]): Prepared {
  const groups = new Map<string, number[]>();
  const mapped: number[] = [];
  const output: CreateAppointmentInput[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < inputs.length; i++) {
    const entry = inputs[i];
    const sel = entry.petSelections[0] as ShareSelection | undefined;
    const id = entry.service_type === "boarding" && entry.petSelections.length === 1 ? sel?.boardingShareGroupId : null;
    if (id) groups.set(id, [...(groups.get(id) ?? []), i]);
  }
  for (const [id, indices] of groups) {
    const first = inputs[indices[0]];
    const selections = indices.map(i => inputs[i].petSelections[0] as ShareSelection);
    const matched = selections.every(s => s.boardingShareGroupId === id);
    const sameAppointment = indices.every(i => {
      const item = inputs[i];
      return item.service_type === "boarding" && item.is_walk_in === first.is_walk_in &&
        item.customer_id === first.customer_id && item.owner_name === first.owner_name &&
        item.owner_contact === first.owner_contact && item.scheduled_date === first.scheduled_date &&
        item.drop_off_at === first.drop_off_at && item.pick_up_at === first.pick_up_at &&
        item.special_requests === first.special_requests;
    });
    if (!matched || !sameAppointment || !validShareGroup(selections) ||
      new Set(selections.map(s=>s.pet.id)).size !== selections.length) {
      return { inputs, inputToSaved: [], error: "Shared pets must have an allowed combination, the same Big-kennel package, stay duration, owner and schedule." };
    }
  }
  const preparedGroups = new Map<string, number>();
  for (let i = 0; i < inputs.length; i++) {
    const entry = inputs[i];
    const sel = entry.petSelections[0] as ShareSelection | undefined;
    const groupId = entry.service_type === "boarding" && entry.petSelections.length === 1 ? sel?.boardingShareGroupId : null;
    if (groupId) {
      let saved = preparedGroups.get(groupId);
      if (saved === undefined) {
        saved = output.length;
        const originalIndices = groups.get(groupId)!;
        output.push({ ...entry, petSelections: originalIndices.map(index => inputs[index].petSelections[0]) });
        preparedGroups.set(groupId, saved);
      }
      mapped.push(saved);
    } else {
      mapped.push(output.length);
      output.push(entry);
    }
  }
  return { inputs: output, inputToSaved: mapped, error: null };
}

import type { Pet } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { BookingLeg } from "@/lib/types/booking-leg";
import type { WalkInServiceChoice } from "@/components/admin/pos/walk-in/ServiceChoiceStep";

export type CustomerBookingDraft = {
  step: BookingPhase;
  draftServiceChoice: WalkInServiceChoice | null;
  waiverBackStep: "service" | "add-more";
  selectedPetIds: string[];
  queuedLegs: BookingLeg[];
  completedLegs: BookingLeg[];
  currentLeg: BookingLeg | null;
};

const VERSION = 1;
const LIFETIME_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
const STEPS: BookingPhase[] = ["pet-info", "service", "waiver", "selection", "schedule", "add-more", "summary"];

function key(customerId: string): string {
  return `happytails:customer-booking-draft:v${VERSION}:${customerId}`;
}

export function clearCustomerBookingDraft(customerId: string): void {
  try { window.sessionStorage.removeItem(key(customerId)); } catch { /* unavailable storage */ }
}

export function saveCustomerBookingDraft(customerId: string, draft: CustomerBookingDraft): void {
  try { window.sessionStorage.setItem(key(customerId), JSON.stringify({ version: VERSION, savedAt: Date.now(), draft })); }
  catch { /* private mode or storage quota: booking still works in memory */ }
}

function restoreLeg(value: unknown, pets: Pet[]): BookingLeg | null {
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return null;
  const leg = value as Partial<BookingLeg>;
  if (typeof leg.id !== "string" || typeof leg.serviceChoice !== "string" || !Array.isArray(leg.petIds) || !Array.isArray(leg.petSelections)) return null;
  if (!["grooming", "dog_grooming", "cat_grooming", "boarding", "ala_carte"].includes(leg.serviceChoice)) return null;
  const petById = new Map(pets.map(p => [p.id, p]));
  const petIds = leg.petIds.filter((id): id is string => typeof id === "string" && petById.has(id));
  if (!petIds.length) return null;
  const petSelections = leg.petSelections.filter(s => s && typeof s === "object" && s.pet && typeof s.pet.id === "string" && petIds.includes(s.pet.id))
    .map(s => ({ ...s, pet: petById.get(s.pet.id)! }));
  return {
    ...leg,
    id: leg.id,
    serviceChoice: leg.serviceChoice as BookingLeg["serviceChoice"],
    petIds,
    petSelections,
    scheduledDate: typeof leg.scheduledDate === "string" ? leg.scheduledDate : null,
    scheduledTime: typeof leg.scheduledTime === "string" ? leg.scheduledTime : null,
    dropOffAt: typeof leg.dropOffAt === "string" ? leg.dropOffAt : null,
    pickUpAt: typeof leg.pickUpAt === "string" ? leg.pickUpAt : null,
    petBelongings: Array.isArray(leg.petBelongings) ? leg.petBelongings.filter((v): v is string => typeof v === "string") : [],
    specialRequests: typeof leg.specialRequests === "string" ? leg.specialRequests : "",
  };
}

export function readCustomerBookingDraft(customerId: string, pets: Pet[]): CustomerBookingDraft | null {
  try {
    const raw = window.sessionStorage.getItem(key(customerId));
    if (!raw) return null;
    const stored: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!stored || typeof stored !== "object") { clearCustomerBookingDraft(customerId); return null; }
    const entry = stored as { version?: unknown; savedAt?: unknown; draft?: unknown };
    if (entry.version !== VERSION || typeof entry.savedAt !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(entry.savedAt) ||
      entry.savedAt > Date.now() || Date.now() - entry.savedAt > LIFETIME_MS || !entry.draft || typeof entry.draft !== "object") {
      clearCustomerBookingDraft(customerId); return null;
    }
    const d = entry.draft as Partial<CustomerBookingDraft>;
    const selectedPetIds = Array.isArray(d.selectedPetIds)
      ? d.selectedPetIds.filter((id): id is string => typeof id === "string" && pets.some(p => p.id === id)) : [];
    const queuedLegs = Array.isArray(d.queuedLegs) ? d.queuedLegs.map(l => restoreLeg(l, pets)).filter((l): l is BookingLeg => !!l) : [];
    const completedLegs = Array.isArray(d.completedLegs) ? d.completedLegs.map(l => restoreLeg(l, pets)).filter((l): l is BookingLeg => !!l && l.petSelections.length > 0) : [];
    const currentLeg = restoreLeg(d.currentLeg, pets);
    let step: BookingPhase = STEPS.includes(d.step as BookingPhase) ? d.step as BookingPhase : "pet-info";
    if (selectedPetIds.length === 0) step = "pet-info";
    if (["waiver", "selection", "schedule"].includes(step) && !currentLeg) step = "service";
    if (step === "schedule" && !currentLeg?.petSelections.length) step = "selection";
    if (["add-more", "summary"].includes(step) && !completedLegs.length) step = "service";
    return {
      step,
      draftServiceChoice: typeof d.draftServiceChoice === "string" && ["grooming", "dog_grooming", "cat_grooming", "boarding", "ala_carte"].includes(d.draftServiceChoice) ? d.draftServiceChoice as WalkInServiceChoice : null,
      waiverBackStep: d.waiverBackStep === "add-more" ? "add-more" : "service",
      selectedPetIds,
      queuedLegs,
      completedLegs,
      currentLeg,
    };
  } catch {
    clearCustomerBookingDraft(customerId);
    return null;
  }
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\lib\booking\grooming-closing.ts =====

/** Philippine grooming booking cut-off: all work must FINISH by 5:30 PM.
 * Actual treatment durations come from the verified package duration planner.
 * A 30-minute booking may start at 5 PM; a second 30-minute pet assigned to
 * the same groomer cannot start at 5:30 PM.
 */
export const GROOMING_OPEN_MINUTES = 9 * 60;
export const GROOMING_CLOSE_MINUTES = 17 * 60 + 30;
export const GROOMING_MIN_SESSION_MINUTES = 30;

export function groomingMinutes(time: string | null | undefined): number | null {
  if (!time || !/^\d{2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?$/.test(time)) return null;
  const [hour, minute, second = 0] = time.split(":").map(Number);
  if (hour > 23 || minute > 59 || second > 59 || second !== 0) return null;
  return hour * 60 + minute;
}

export type GroomingPlannedSlot = {
  time: string;
  endTime: string;
  groomerId: string;
  durationMinutes: number;
};

/** All pets must fit before closing; check the whole planner result, not the selected start only. */
export function groomingPlanClosingError(plan: GroomingPlannedSlot[]): string | null {
  if (!plan.length) return "Select pets and arrange their grooming times first.";
  const perGroomer = new Map<string, Array<{ start: number; end: number }>>();
  for (const item of plan) {
    const start = groomingMinutes(item.time);
    const end = groomingMinutes(item.endTime);
    if (!item.groomerId || start === null || end === null ||
        !Number.isInteger(item.durationMinutes) || item.durationMinutes < GROOMING_MIN_SESSION_MINUTES ||
        start < GROOMING_OPEN_MINUTES || end !== start + item.durationMinutes) {
      return "The grooming schedule contains an invalid start, duration, or groomer. Arrange the times again.";
    }
    if (end > GROOMING_CLOSE_MINUTES) {
      return `Grooming must finish by 5:30 PM. A pet scheduled at ${formatGroomingClock(item.time)} would finish at ${formatGroomingClock(item.endTime)}. Choose an earlier time or additional available groomers.`;
    }
    const rows = perGroomer.get(item.groomerId) ?? [];
    rows.push({ start, end });
    perGroomer.set(item.groomerId, rows);
  }
  for (const rows of perGroomer.values()) {
    rows.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
    if (rows.some((row, index) => index > 0 && row.start < rows[index - 1].end)) {
      return "A groomer was assigned overlapping pet sessions. Choose different grooming times.";
    }
  }
  return null;
}

export function formatGroomingClock(value: string): string {
  const minutes = groomingMinutes(value);
  if (minutes === null) return value;
  const hour = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  return `${hour % 12 || 12}:${String(minutes % 60).padStart(2, "0")} ${hour >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM"}`;
}

/** A *necessary*, not sufficient, capacity bound. The server planner performs
 * the authoritative groomer, package-duration, and time-off check.
 */
export function minimumGroomersNeeded(petCount: number, start: string): number {
  const minutes = groomingMinutes(start);
  if (minutes === null || minutes < GROOMING_OPEN_MINUTES) return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  const availableMinutes = GROOMING_CLOSE_MINUTES - minutes;
  const maxPetsPerGroomer = Math.floor(availableMinutes / GROOMING_MIN_SESSION_MINUTES);
  return maxPetsPerGroomer > 0 ? Math.ceil(petCount / maxPetsPerGroomer) : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\lib\booking\unique-pet-addons.ts =====

import type { BookingLeg } from "@/lib/types/booking-leg";
import type { Addon } from "@/lib/types/services";

/** Match equivalent catalog entries from Grooming, Boarding and Ã€ La Carte.
 * IDs differ across categories; only the same pet in the same booking is restricted.
 */
export function normalizeAddonName(name: string): string {
  return name.toLocaleLowerCase("en-US")
    .replace(/&/g, " and ")
    .replace(/\bplus\b|\+/g, " and ")
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ")
    .replace(/\band\b/g, " ")
    .replace(/\btrimming\b/g, "trim")
    .replace(/\bcleaning\b/g, "clean")
    .replace(/\bbrushing\b/g, "brush")
    .replace(/\bteeth\b/g, "tooth")
    .replace(/\bhair cut\b/g, "haircut")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

export type AddonCatalogs = Record<string, Pick<Addon, "id" | "name">[]>;

function catalogFor(leg: BookingLeg, petSpecies: string, catalogs: AddonCatalogs) {
  if (leg.serviceChoice === "grooming") return catalogs[petSpecies === "Cat" ? "cat_grooming" : "dog_grooming"] ?? [];
  return catalogs[leg.serviceChoice] ?? [];
}

export function chosenAddonNamesByPet(legs: BookingLeg[], catalogs: AddonCatalogs): Record<string, Set<string>> {
  const result: Record<string, Set<string>> = {};
  for (const leg of legs) {
    for (const selected of leg.petSelections) {
      const names = catalogFor(leg, selected.pet.species, catalogs);
      const chosen = result[selected.pet.id] ?? new Set<string>();
      for (const id of selected.addonIds ?? []) {
        const name = names.find(item => item.id === id)?.name;
        if (name) chosen.add(normalizeAddonName(name));
      }
      result[selected.pet.id] = chosen;
    }
  }
  return result;
}

export function findDuplicatePetAddon(legs: BookingLeg[], catalogs: AddonCatalogs): string | null {
  const known = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  for (const leg of legs) {
    for (const selection of leg.petSelections) {
      const petId = selection.pet.id;
      const names = catalogFor(leg, selection.pet.species, catalogs);
      const seen = known.get(petId) ?? new Set<string>();
      for (const id of selection.addonIds ?? []) {
        const item = names.find(a => a.id === id);
        if (!item) continue;
        const key = normalizeAddonName(item.name);
        if (seen.has(key)) return `${selection.pet.name} already has â€œ${item.name}â€ selected in another service. Remove it from one service before proceeding.`;
        seen.add(key);
      }
      known.set(petId, seen);
    }
  }
  return null;
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\lib\booking\use-booking-closures.tsx =====

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import { checkBookingClosedDate, fetchBookingClosedDates, type BookingClosedDate } from "@/lib/supabase/booking-closures";

/** Every booking calendar uses the same store-wide Calendar Management closures.
 * Refresh on focus, tab visibility, a database notification and a low-frequency
 * fallback: realtime may not be enabled for booking_closed_dates in a project.
 */
export function useBookingClosures() {
  const [dates, setDates] = useState<BookingClosedDate[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const reload = useCallback(async () => {
    // Never leave stale dates looking available when an updated read fails.
    const result = await fetchBookingClosedDates();
    setDates(result.error ? [] : result.dates);
    setError(result.error);
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    let generation = 0;
    const refresh = () => {
      const id = ++generation;
      void fetchBookingClosedDates().then(result => {
        if (!active || id !== generation) return;
        setDates(result.error ? [] : result.dates);
        setError(result.error);
        setLoading(false);
      }).catch(cause => {
        if (!active || id !== generation) return;
        setDates([]);
        setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Unable to read store closures.");
        setLoading(false);
      });
    };
    refresh();
    const onFocus = () => refresh();
    const onVisible = () => { if (document.visibilityState === "visible") refresh(); };
    const onStorage = (event: StorageEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "happytails-booking-calendar-updated") refresh();
    };
    window.addEventListener("focus", onFocus);
    window.addEventListener("storage", onStorage);
    window.addEventListener("happytails-booking-calendar-updated", onFocus);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisible);
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      if (document.visibilityState === "visible") refresh();
    }, 30_000);
    const db = createClient();
    const channel = db.channel("happytails-store-closure-calendar")
      .on("postgres_changes", { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "booking_closed_dates" }, refresh)
      .subscribe();
    return () => {
      active = false;
      ++generation;
      window.clearInterval(timer);
      window.removeEventListener("focus", onFocus);
      window.removeEventListener("storage", onStorage);
      window.removeEventListener("happytails-booking-calendar-updated", onFocus);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisible);
      void db.removeChannel(channel);
    };
  }, []);

  const byDate = useMemo(() => new Map(dates.filter(day => !day.is_open_override).map(day => [day.date, day.name])), [dates]);
  const nameFor = useCallback((day: string | null | undefined) => day ? byDate.get(day) ?? null : null, [byDate]);
  const verifyOpen = useCallback(async (day: string): Promise<string | null> => {
    if (!day) return "Choose an appointment date.";
    if (loading || error) return `Unable to verify store calendar availability. ${error ?? "Please try again."}`;
    const result = await checkBookingClosedDate(day);
    if (result.error) return `Unable to verify store calendar availability: ${result.error}`;
    return result.closed ? `${result.name ?? "Shop closure"} â€” HappyTails is closed on this date.` : null;
  }, [error, loading]);
  return { dates, loading, error, nameFor, verifyOpen, reload };
}

export function manilaToday(): string {
  const pieces = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit" }).formatToParts(new Date());
  const get = (type: string) => pieces.find(part => part.type === type)?.value ?? "";
  return `${get("year")}-${get("month")}-${get("day")}`;
}
export function manilaTime(): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23" }).format(new Date());
}
export function ClosureNotice({ date, name }: { date: string; name: string }) {
  return <p role="alert" className="mt-2 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-rose-700">{date}: Closed â€” {name}. Please select another date.</p>;
}

// One starter batch per product â€” 25 units, 180-day expiration â€” matching
// the real database seed exactly.
export const stockBatches: StockBatch[] = inventoryProducts.map((p, i) => ({
  id: `b-init-${i + 1}`,
  productId: p.id,
  batchNumber: "B-2026-INIT",
  quantity: 25,
  expirationDate: "2027-01-25",
  receivedDate: "2026-07-29",
}));

export function getTotalStock(productId: string, batches: StockBatch[]): number {
  return batches.filter((b) => b.productId === productId).reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.quantity, 0);
}

export function getStatus(totalStock: number, minStock: number): "In Stock" | "Low Stock" {
  return totalStock <= minStock ? "Low Stock" : "In Stock";
}

export function isExpiringSoon(expirationDate: string | null, withinDays = 30): boolean {
  if (!expirationDate) return false;
  const days = (new Date(expirationDate).getTime() - Date.now()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
  return days >= 0 && days <= withinDays;
}

// Mock completed POS transactions, shaped close to what a real
// `transactions` table will look like â€” used for the Return/Exchange
// receipt lookup. `maxReturnable` per line item is how many units are
// still eligible to be returned (starts equal to qty purchased, decreases
// if partially returned already).
export type TransactionLineItem = {
  productId: string;
  name: string;
  unitPrice: number;
  qty: number;
  maxReturnable: number;
};

export type Transaction = {
  id: string; // receipt number, e.g. "TXN-UF19VE"
  timestamp: string;
  lineItems: TransactionLineItem[];
  subtotal: number;
