export type EmailAction = "confirmed" | "completed" | "cancelled";

export type AppointmentEmailData = {
  id: string;
  owner_name: string;
  service_type: string;
  scheduled_date: string;
  scheduled_time: string | null;
  drop_off_at: string | null;
  pick_up_at: string | null;
  appointment_pets: { pets: { name: string } | null; packages: { name: string } | null }[] | null;
};

const SERVICE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  dog_grooming: "Dog Grooming",
  cat_grooming: "Cat Grooming",
  boarding: "Boarding",
  ala_carte: "Ã€ La Carte",
};

const SERVICE_CODES: Record<string, string> = {
  dog_grooming: "DOG",
  cat_grooming: "CAT",
  boarding: "BRD",
  ala_carte: "ALC",
};

const THEME = {
  navy: "#14283e",
  navySoft: "#243b53",
  pink: "#F53D93",
  pinkSoft: "#FDF1F7",
  blush: "#FDF1F7",
  border: "#f3d4e4",
  text: "#25364a",
  muted: "#667085",
  surface: "#ffffff",
  footer: "#f8fafc",
  success: "#16a34a",
  successBg: "#dcfce7",
  amber: "#b45309",
  amberBg: "#fef3c7",
  danger: "#b42318",
  dangerBg: "#fee4e2",
};

function escapeHtml(value: unknown): string {
  return String(value ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (char) => ({
    "&": "&amp;",
    "<": "&lt;",
    ">": "&gt;",
    '"': "&quot;",
    "'": "&#39;",
  }[char]!));
}

function formatDate(value: string | null) {
  if (!value) return "Not specified";
  const parsed = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value) ? new Date(`${value}T12:00:00+08:00`) : new Date(value);
  return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())
    ? value
    : new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-PH", { dateStyle: "long", timeZone: "Asia/Manila" }).format(parsed);
}

function formatTime(value: string | null) {
  if (!value) return "Not specified";
  const match = /^(\d{2}):(\d{2})/.exec(value);
  if (!match) return value;
  const hours = Number(match[1]);
  return `${hours % 12 || 12}:${match[2]} ${hours < 12 ? "AM" : "PM"}`;
}

function formatDateTime(value: string | null) {
  if (!value) return "Not specified";
  const parsed = new Date(value);
  return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())
    ? value
    : parsed.toLocaleString("en-PH", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" });
}

function serviceLabel(type: string) {
  return SERVICE_LABELS[type] ?? "Pet Service";
}

export function displayAppointmentReference(appointmentId: string, serviceType: string, scheduledDate: string | null) {
  const shortId = appointmentId.split("-")[0]?.toUpperCase() || appointmentId.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase();
  const serviceCode = SERVICE_CODES[serviceType] ?? "APT";
  const year = scheduledDate?.slice(0, 4) || new Date().getFullYear().toString();
  return `HT-${serviceCode}-${year}-${shortId}`;
}

function statusCopy(action: EmailAction) {
  if (action === "confirmed") {
    return {
      heading: "Appointment Confirmed",
      bannerLabel: "Confirmed",
      badgeColor: THEME.amber,
      badgeBg: THEME.amberBg,
      intro: "Your appointment has been confirmed by our team. We look forward to welcoming you and your pet at HappyTails Pet Grooming CafÃ©.",
      closing: "Please arrive on time and let us know ahead of schedule if you need to make changes to your booking.",
    };
  }
  if (action === "completed") {
    return {
      heading: "Service Completed",
      bannerLabel: "Completed",
      badgeColor: THEME.success,
      badgeBg: THEME.successBg,
      intro: "Weâ€™re happy to let you know that your petâ€™s scheduled service has been completed. Thank you for trusting HappyTails with your companion.",
      closing: "We appreciate your trust and look forward to caring for your pet again soon.",
    };
  }
  return {
    heading: "Appointment Cancelled",
    bannerLabel: "Cancelled",
    badgeColor: THEME.danger,
    badgeBg: THEME.dangerBg,
    intro: "We regret to inform you that your appointment has been cancelled. Please review the details below for reference.",
    closing: "If you would like to rebook or need assistance, please contact HappyTails and weâ€™ll be glad to help.",
  };
}

export function buildAppointmentEmail({
  appointment,
  action,
  reason,
}: {
  appointment: AppointmentEmailData;
  action: EmailAction;
  reason?: string;
}) {
  const content = statusCopy(action);
  const reference = displayAppointmentReference(appointment.id, appointment.service_type, appointment.scheduled_date);
  const pets = (appointment.appointment_pets ?? [])
    .map((row) => row.pets?.name?.trim())
    .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value))
    .join(", ") || "Your pet";
  const packages = Array.from(new Set((appointment.appointment_pets ?? [])
    .map((row) => row.packages?.name?.trim())
    .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value))));

  const configuredLogoUrl = process.env.HAPPYTAILS_EMAIL_LOGO_URL?.trim() || "";
  // Only use hosted HTTPS images. Email clients cannot load localhost or relative paths.
  const logoUrl = /^https:\/\/[^\s]+$/i.test(configuredLogoUrl) ? configuredLogoUrl : "";
  const supportEmail = process.env.HAPPYTAILS_SUPPORT_EMAIL?.trim() || process.env.GMAIL_SMTP_USER || "";
  const supportPhone = process.env.HAPPYTAILS_SUPPORT_PHONE?.trim() || "";
  const contactLine = [supportEmail, supportPhone].filter(Boolean).join(" â€¢ ");
  const detailRows: Array<[string, string]> = [
    ["Appointment Reference", reference],
    ["Service", serviceLabel(appointment.service_type)],
    ["Pet(s)", pets],
    ...(packages.length ? [["Selected Package(s)", packages.join(", ")]] as Array<[string, string]> : []),
    ["Scheduled Date", formatDate(appointment.scheduled_date)],
  ];

  if (appointment.service_type === "boarding") {
    detailRows.push(["Drop-off", formatDateTime(appointment.drop_off_at)]);
    detailRows.push(["Pick-up", formatDateTime(appointment.pick_up_at)]);
  } else {
    detailRows.push(["Scheduled Time", formatTime(appointment.scheduled_time)]);
  }

  if (action === "cancelled") {
    detailRows.push(["Cancellation Reason", reason?.trim() || "Please contact HappyTails for more information."]);
  }

  const rowsHtml = detailRows.map(([label, value], index) => `
    <tr>
      <td style="padding:14px 16px;border-bottom:${index === detailRows.length - 1 ? "0" : `1px solid ${THEME.border}`};color:${THEME.muted};font-size:13px;font-weight:600;vertical-align:top;width:38%">${escapeHtml(label)}</td>
      <td style="padding:14px 16px;border-bottom:${index === detailRows.length - 1 ? "0" : `1px solid ${THEME.border}`};color:${THEME.text};font-size:14px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.5;vertical-align:top;overflow-wrap:anywhere">${escapeHtml(value)}</td>
    </tr>`).join("");

  const subject = `HappyTails | ${content.heading} | ${reference}`;
  const html = `<!doctype html>
<html>
  <body style="margin:0;background:${THEME.blush};padding:24px 12px;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;color:${THEME.text}">
    <div style="max-width:680px;margin:0 auto;background:${THEME.surface};border:1px solid ${THEME.border};border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(20,40,62,.08)">
      <div style="background:${THEME.surface};padding:24px 26px;border-bottom:3px solid ${THEME.pink}">
        <table role="presentation" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="border-collapse:collapse;width:100%">
          <tr>
            <td style="width:78px;vertical-align:middle;padding-right:16px">
              ${logoUrl ? `<img src="${escapeHtml(logoUrl)}" width="68" alt="HappyTails logo" style="width:68px;max-height:76px;object-fit:contain;display:block;border:0" />` : `<span style="display:block;font-weight:800;color:${THEME.pink};font-size:20px">HT</span>`}
            </td>
            <td style="vertical-align:middle">
              <div style="color:${THEME.pink};font-weight:800;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.2px">HappyTails Pet Grooming CafÃ©</div>
              <h1 style="font-size:25px;line-height:1.3;color:${THEME.navy};margin:7px 0 10px;font-weight:800">${escapeHtml(content.heading)}</h1>
              <span style="display:inline-block;background:${content.badgeBg};color:${content.badgeColor};padding:5px 10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700">${escapeHtml(content.bannerLabel)}</span>
            </td>
          </tr>
        </table>
      </div>

      <div style="padding:30px 26px 10px 26px">
        <p style="margin:0 0 14px 0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.8">Hello <strong>${escapeHtml(appointment.owner_name)}</strong>,</p>
        <p style="margin:0 0 20px 0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.8;color:${THEME.text}">${escapeHtml(content.intro)}</p>

        <div style="border:1px solid ${THEME.border};border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:${THEME.surface}">
          <div style="padding:16px 18px;background:${THEME.footer};border-bottom:1px solid ${THEME.border};font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:${THEME.navy}">Appointment Details</div>

        <div style="font-weight:700;color:${THEME.navy};margin-bottom:4px">HappyTails Pet Grooming CafÃ©</div>
        ${contactLine ? `<div style="margin-bottom:4px">${escapeHtml(contactLine)}</div>` : ""}
        <div>This is an automated appointment update from HappyTails. Please do not reply directly unless your sending mailbox is monitored.</div>
        <div style="margin-top:6px">Appointment ID (for support): ${escapeHtml(appointment.id)}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </body>
</html>`;

  const text = [
    `${content.heading}`,
    `Hello ${appointment.owner_name},`,
    content.intro,
    "",
    `Appointment Reference: ${reference}`,
    `Service: ${serviceLabel(appointment.service_type)}`,
    `Pet(s): ${pets}`,
    ...(packages.length ? [`Selected Package(s): ${packages.join(", ")}`] : []),
    `Scheduled Date: ${formatDate(appointment.scheduled_date)}`,
    appointment.service_type === "boarding"
      ? `Drop-off: ${formatDateTime(appointment.drop_off_at)}`
      : `Scheduled Time: ${formatTime(appointment.scheduled_time)}`,
    ...(appointment.service_type === "boarding" ? [`Pick-up: ${formatDateTime(appointment.pick_up_at)}`] : []),

    "",
    content.closing,
    "",

export type RescheduleEmailDetails = {
  id: string;
  ownerName: string;
  serviceType: string;
  petNames: string[];
  reason: string;

const labels: Record<string, string> = {
  dog_grooming: "Dog Grooming", cat_grooming: "Cat Grooming", boarding: "Boarding", ala_carte: "Ã€ La Carte",
};
function escapeHtml(value: string) {
  return value.replace(/[&<>"']/g, char => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" })[char]!);
}
function dateLabel(value: string | null) {
  if (!value) return "Not recorded";
  const date = new Date(`${value}T12:00:00+08:00`);
  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? value : date.toLocaleDateString("en-PH", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", dateStyle: "long" });
}
function timeLabel(value: string | null) {
  if (!value) return "Not recorded";
  const match = /^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})/.exec(value);
  if (!match) return value;
  const hours = Number(match[1]);
  return `${hours % 12 || 12}:${match[2]} ${hours < 12 ? "AM" : "PM"}`;
}
function dateTimeLabel(value: string | null) {
  if (!value) return "Not recorded";
  const date = new Date(value);
  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? "Not recorded" : date.toLocaleString("en-PH", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", dateStyle: "long", timeStyle: "short" });
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\lib\hooks\usePetAvatarSettings.ts =====

"use client";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import type { SiteSetting } from "@/lib/supabase/site-settings";
import { PET_AVATAR_KEYS } from "@/lib/utils/pet-avatar";

let cache: SiteSetting[] | null = null;
let inflight: Promise<SiteSetting[]> | null = null;
async function readSettings() {
  if (cache) return cache;
  if (!inflight) {
    inflight = (async () => {
      const { data, error } = await createClient().from("site_settings").select("*").in("key", PET_AVATAR_KEYS);
      if (error) throw error;
      cache = (data as SiteSetting[]) ?? [];
      return cache;
    })().finally(() => { inflight = null; });
  }
  return inflight;
}
export function usePetAvatarSettings() {
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<SiteSetting[]>(cache ?? []);
  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    readSettings().then((rows) => { if (mounted) setSettings(rows); }).catch(() => {});
    return () => { mounted = false; };
  }, []);
  return settings;
}

import type { Package, PackageInclusion, PackagePricing, PetSize } from "@/lib/types/services";
import type { PriceTier } from "@/components/landing/PricingCard";

/** Public cards use exactly the active packages/rates configured in Service Management. */
export type PublicPricingCatalog = {
  packages: Package[];
  pricing: PackagePricing[];
  sizes: PetSize[];
  inclusions: PackageInclusion[];
  /** False if the database query failed; never fall back to obsolete price constants. */
  loaded: boolean;
};

const money = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-PH", { minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
export function pesos(value: number): string {
  return `â‚±${money.format(value)}`;
}

function validRate(rate: PackagePricing): boolean {
  return Number.isFinite(Number(rate.price)) && Number(rate.price) >= 0;
}

function normalize(value: string): string {
  return value.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
}

export function activePackages(catalog: PublicPricingCatalog, service: Package["service_type"]): Package[] {
  return catalog.packages.filter(p => p.service_type === service && p.is_active)
    .sort((a, b) => a.sort_order - b.sort_order || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
}

export function packageInclusions(catalog: PublicPricingCatalog, packageId: string): string[] {
  return catalog.inclusions.filter(i => i.package_id === packageId)
    .sort((a, b) => a.sort_order - b.sort_order)
    .map(i => i.label.trim()).filter(Boolean);
}

/** Prefer a referenced size row, then fall back to the legacy size label. */
export function groomingTiers(catalog: PublicPricingCatalog, packageId: string): PriceTier[] {
  const rows = catalog.pricing.filter(rate => rate.package_id === packageId && validRate(rate));
  const indexed = rows.flatMap(rate => {
    const size = catalog.sizes.find(s =>
      (rate.size_id != null && rate.size_id === s.id) ||
      (rate.size_id == null && normalize(s.label) === normalize(rate.size_label)));
    // Deactivated size rows are not advertised for new appointments.
    if (size && !size.is_active) return [];
    const name = size?.label || rate.size_label;
    const weight = size?.weight_range?.trim();
    return [{ rank: size?.sort_order ?? 999, label: weight ? `${name} (${weight})` : name,
      price: pesos(Number(rate.price)), id: rate.id }];
  });
  return indexed.sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank || a.label.localeCompare(b.label) || a.id.localeCompare(b.id))
    .map(({ label, price }) => ({ label, price }));
}

function boardingNights(rate: PackagePricing): number | null {
  if (rate.is_per_night) return null;
  if (Number.isInteger(rate.nights) && Number(rate.nights) > 0) return Number(rate.nights);
  const text = `${rate.size_label} ${rate.size_detail ?? ""}`;
  const nights = text.match(/(\d+)\s*nights?/i);
  if (nights) return Number(nights[1]);
  const days = text.match(/(\d+)\s*days?/i);
  return days ? Number(days[1]) - 1 : null;
}

export function boardingTiers(catalog: PublicPricingCatalog, packageIds: string[]): PriceTier[] {
  const idSet = new Set(packageIds);
  return catalog.pricing.filter(rate => idSet.has(rate.package_id) && validRate(rate))
    .map(rate => {
      const nights = boardingNights(rate);
      const label = rate.is_per_night
        ? `${rate.size_label.trim() || "7 Days & Up"} Â· Per night`
        : nights != null && nights > 0
          ? `${nights + 1} ${nights + 1 === 1 ? "Day" : "Days"} & ${nights} ${nights === 1 ? "Night" : "Nights"}`
          : (rate.size_detail?.trim() || rate.size_label.trim() || "Boarding rate");
      return { nights: rate.is_per_night ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : nights ?? 999,
        label, price: pesos(Number(rate.price)), id: rate.id };
    }).sort((a, b) => a.nights - b.nights || a.label.localeCompare(b.label) || a.id.localeCompare(b.id))
    .map(({ label, price }) => ({ label, price }));
}

/** Kennel type is currently encoded in the package name by the booking allocator. */
export function kennelPackageSize(name: string): "small" | "big" | null {
  const small = /(^|[^a-z])small([^a-z]|$)/i.test(name);
  const big = /(^|[^a-z])(big|large)([^a-z]|$)/i.test(name);
  return small === big ? null : small ? "small" : "big";
}

export async function cancelStaffAppointment(appointmentId: string, reason: string): Promise<{ error: string | null }> {
  const clean = reason.trim();
  if (clean.length < 5 || clean.length > 500) return { error: "Enter a cancellation reason between 5 and 500 characters." };
  try {
    const response = await fetch("/api/admin/appointment-status", {
      method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ appointmentId, status: "cancelled", reason: clean }),
    });
    const result = await response.json();
    return { error: response.ok ? null : result.error ?? "Unable to cancel appointment." };
  } catch { return { error: "Network error. Please try again." }; }
}

// Supabase client using the SERVICE ROLE KEY â€” full admin privileges,
// bypasses Row Level Security entirely. This must NEVER be imported into
// any Client Component or anything that ships to the browser â€” only
// Route Handlers (app/api/.../route.ts) running on the server. The key
// itself comes from an env var WITHOUT the NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix, so
// Next.js never bundles it into client-side JavaScript.
import { createClient as createSupabaseClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";

export function createAdminClient() {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!;
  const serviceRoleKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY;

  if (!serviceRoleKey) {
    throw new Error(
      "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is not set. Add it to .env.local (server-only, no NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix) â€” find it in Supabase Dashboard > Project Settings > API > service_role key."
    );
  }

  return createSupabaseClient(url, serviceRoleKey, {
    auth: { autoRefreshToken: false, persistSession: false },
  });
}

 id,pet_id,groomer_id,kennel_id,line_amount,status,pets(id,name,breed,size_label),

 const rows=((data??[]) as unknown as RawAppointment[]).map(a=>{
  const pets=(a.appointment_pets??[]).map(p=>({
   appointmentPetId:p.id,id:p.pets?.id??"",name:p.pets?.name??"â€”",breed:p.pets?.breed??"â€”",
   size_label:p.pets?.size_label??"â€”",status:p.status,groomerId:p.groomer_id,groomerName:p.groomers?.name??null,
   packageName:p.packages?.name??null,
   packagePricingLabel:p.package_pricing?(p.package_pricing.size_detail??p.package_pricing.size_label):null,

    const text = `${p.packages?.name??p.package_pricing?.packages?.name??""} ${p.package_pricing?.size_label??""} ${p.package_pricing?.size_detail??""}`.toLowerCase();
    if (text.includes("small")) return "small" as const;
    if (text.includes("big")) return "big" as const;

   lineAmount:p.line_amount??0
  }));
  return {...a,pets,groomerNames:Array.from(new Set(pets.map(p=>p.groomerName).filter(Boolean))) as string[]};
 });
 return {rows,error:null};
}

export async function updatePet(id: string, fields: { name: string; species: Species; breed: string; size_label: string; age: number | null; sex: Sex | null }) {

  if(error) return {data,error};
  if (!data?.length) return {data,error:{message:"Update didn't apply â€” you may not have permission to edit this pet."}};
  return {data,error:null};
}
export async function addPet(pet: { customer_id: string|null; name: string; species: Species; breed: string; size_label: string; sex?: Sex|null; age?: number|null; owner_name?: string|null; owner_contact?: string|null }) {

}

export function kennelFitCategory(sizeLabel: string): "small"|"medium"|"large" {
  const s=sizeLabel.trim().toLowerCase(); return s==="small"?"small":s==="medium"?"medium":"large";
}
export function weightKgToSizeTier(weightKg: number): GroomingSizeTier {
  if(weightKg<5) return "Small";if(weightKg<=12)return "Medium";if(weightKg<=17)return "Large";if(weightKg<=29)return "Extra Large";return "2X Extra Large";
}
export type KennelOccupant={size_label:string};
/** Legacy helper retained for existing callers. One Small kennel holds 1 Small or Medium;
 * a Big kennel holds 1 Large, Small+Medium, Medium+Medium, or 3 Small. */
export function canFitInKennel(kennelSize:"small"|"big",occupants:KennelOccupant[],newPetSizeLabel:string):{fits:boolean;reason?:string}{
  const all=[...occupants.map(p=>kennelFitCategory(p.size_label)),kennelFitCategory(newPetSizeLabel)].sort();
  const key=all.join("+");
  const okay=kennelSize==="small" ? (all.length===1 && all[0]!=="large")
    : ["small","medium","large","medium+small","medium+medium","small+small","small+small+small"].includes(key);
  return okay?{fits:true}:{fits:false,reason:"This combination exceeds the kennel's capacity or sharing policy."};
}
export async function fetchKennelOccupants(kennelId:string,date:string){
  const {data,error}=await createClient().from("appointment_pets")
   .select("pet_id,pets(size_label),appointments!inner(scheduled_date,drop_off_at,pick_up_at,status)")
   .eq("kennel_id",kennelId).neq("appointments.status","cancelled");
  if(error)return {occupants:[] as KennelOccupant[],error:error.message};
  const time=new Date(date).getTime();
  const found=(data??[]).filter((item:any)=>{
    const start=item.appointments?.drop_off_at?new Date(item.appointments.drop_off_at).getTime():null;
    const end=item.appointments?.pick_up_at?new Date(item.appointments.pick_up_at).getTime():null;
    return start!==null&&end!==null&&time>=start&&time<=end;
  });
  return {occupants:found.map((item:any)=>({size_label:item.pets?.size_label??""})),error:null};
}
export async function checkGroomerTimeConflict(groomerId:string,date:string,time:string,customerId:string|null,ownerContact:string){
  const {data,error}=await createClient().from("appointment_pets")
    .select("appointments!inner(id,customer_id,owner_contact,scheduled_date,scheduled_time,status)").eq("groomer_id",groomerId);
  if(error)return {conflict:false,error:error.message};
  const conflict=(data??[]).some((item:any)=>{
    const a=item.appointments;
    if(!a||a.status==="cancelled"||a.scheduled_date!==date||a.scheduled_time!==time)return false;
    return customerId?a.customer_id===customerId:a.owner_contact===ownerContact;
  });
  return {conflict,error:null};
}

export type CreateAppointmentInput={
  service_type:AppointmentServiceType;is_walk_in:boolean;customer_id:string|null;
  owner_name:string;owner_contact:string;owner_address:string|null;
  scheduled_date:string;scheduled_time:string|null;drop_off_at:string|null;
  pick_up_at:string|null;special_requests:string|null;petSelections:DraftPetSelection[];
};

/** Submit all services atomically. Explicit shared Boarding groups become ONE
 * appointment each. Return one response entry per ORIGINAL input for backward
 * compatibility with both existing summary screens' count checks.
 */
export async function createAppointmentsAtomic(params:CreateAppointmentInput[]){
  if(!params.length)return {appointments:[] as Appointment[],error:"No appointments to save."};
  const prepared=prepareBoardingShares(params);
  if(prepared.error)return {appointments:[] as Appointment[],error:prepared.error};
  const payload=prepared.inputs.map(appt=>({
    service_type:appt.service_type,is_walk_in:appt.is_walk_in,customer_id:appt.customer_id,
    owner_name:appt.owner_name,owner_contact:appt.owner_contact,owner_address:appt.owner_address,
    scheduled_date:appt.scheduled_date,scheduled_time:appt.scheduled_time,
    drop_off_at:appt.drop_off_at,pick_up_at:appt.pick_up_at,
    special_requests:appt.special_requests,
    pet_selections:appt.petSelections.map(sel=>({pet_id:sel.pet.id,package_id:sel.packageId,
      package_pricing_id:sel.packagePricingId,size_id:sel.sizeId,kennel_id:sel.kennelId,
      groomer_id:sel.groomerId,line_amount:sel.lineAmount,addon_ids:sel.addonIds})),
  }));
  const {data,error}=await createClient().rpc("happytails_create_appointments_atomic",{p_appointments:payload});
  if(error)return {appointments:[] as Appointment[],error:error.message};
  if(!Array.isArray(data)||data.length!==prepared.inputs.length)return {appointments:[] as Appointment[],error:"The booking result could not be confirmed. Check existing appointments before retrying."};
  const mapped=prepared.inputToSaved.map(index=>data[index] as Appointment);
  return {appointments:mapped,error:null};
}
export async function createAppointment(params:CreateAppointmentInput){
  const {appointments,error}=await createAppointmentsAtomic([params]);
  return {appointment:appointments[0]??null,error};
}

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import type { KennelSize } from "@/lib/types/pet-services";

export type BoardingDayCapacity = { day: string; total: number; remaining: number };

/** Aggregated occupancy only; guest names and records are never fetched. */
export async function fetchBoardingMonth(month: string, size: KennelSize, nights: number): Promise<{
  days: BoardingDayCapacity[]; error: string | null;
}> {
  if (!/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/.test(month) || !Number.isSafeInteger(nights) || nights < 1 || nights > 365) {
    return { days: [], error: "Choose a valid boarding duration (1â€“365 nights)." };
  }
  const { data, error } = await createClient().rpc("happytails_boarding_month_availability", {
    p_first_day: `${month}-01`, p_size: size, p_nights: nights,
  });
  if (error) return { days: [], error: error.message };
  if (!Array.isArray(data)) return { days: [], error: "Kennel availability could not be verified." };
  const days = data.map((row: Record<string, unknown>) => ({
    day: String(row.day ?? ""), total: Number(row.total), remaining: Number(row.remaining),
  }));
  if (days.some((row) => !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(row.day) || !Number.isSafeInteger(row.total) ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(row.remaining) || row.remaining < 0 || row.remaining > row.total)) {
    return { days: [], error: "The kennel availability response was invalid." };
  }
  return { days, error: null };
}

export async function checkBoardingStay(day: string, size: KennelSize, nights: number): Promise<{
  total: number; remaining: number; error: string | null;
}> {
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(day) || !Number.isSafeInteger(nights) || nights < 1 || nights > 365) {
    return { total: 0, remaining: 0, error: "Choose a valid date and 1â€“365 night stay." };
  }
  const { data, error } = await createClient().rpc("happytails_boarding_stay_capacity", {
    p_date: day, p_size: size, p_nights: nights,
  });
  if (error) return { total: 0, remaining: 0, error: error.message };
  const row = Array.isArray(data) ? data[0] : null;
  if (!row || !Number.isSafeInteger(Number(row.remaining)) || !Number.isSafeInteger(Number(row.total))) {
    return { total: 0, remaining: 0, error: "Unable to verify kennel availability. Try again." };
  }
  return { total: Number(row.total), remaining: Number(row.remaining), error: null };
}

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";

export type BoardingGroupPet = {
  pet_id: string;
  kennel_size: "small" | "big";
  nights: number;
  share_group?: string | null;
};
export type BoardingKennelCounts = { small: number; big: number; totalSmall: number; totalBig: number };
export type BoardingGroupDay = {
  day: string;
  available: boolean;
  reason: string | null;
};

function validPets(pets: BoardingGroupPet[]): boolean {
  return pets.length >= 1 && pets.length <= 30 &&
    new Set(pets.map((pet) => pet.pet_id)).size === pets.length &&
    pets.every((pet) => /^[a-f\d-]{36}$/i.test(pet.pet_id) &&
      (pet.kennel_size === "small" || pet.kennel_size === "big") &&
      Number.isSafeInteger(pet.nights) && pet.nights >= 1 && pet.nights <= 365);
}

export async function checkBoardingGroup(date: string, time: string, pets: BoardingGroupPet[]): Promise<{
  available: boolean; reason: string | null;
}> {
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date) || !/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(time) || !validPets(pets)) {
    return { available: false, reason: "Please review the selected pets, stay durations, date, and arrival time." };
  }
  const { data, error } = await createClient().rpc("happytails_boarding_group_plan", {
    p_date: date, p_time: time, p_pets: pets,
  });
  if (error) return { available: false, reason: error.message };
  if (!data || typeof data !== "object" || typeof data.available !== "boolean") {
    return { available: false, reason: "Unable to verify shared kennel capacity." };
  }
  return { available: data.available, reason: typeof data.reason === "string" ? data.reason : null };
}

export async function fetchBoardingGroupMonth(month: string, time: string, pets: BoardingGroupPet[]): Promise<{
  days: BoardingGroupDay[]; error: string | null;
}> {
  if (!/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/.test(month) || !/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(time) || !validPets(pets)) {
    return { days: [], error: "Please complete the kennel and duration for each pet." };
  }
  const { data, error } = await createClient().rpc("happytails_boarding_group_month", {
    p_month: `${month}-01`, p_time: time, p_pets: pets,
  });
  if (error) return { days: [], error: error.message };
  if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length < 28 || data.length > 31 || data.some((row) =>
    !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(row.day) || typeof row.available !== "boolean")) {
    return { days: [], error: "Boarding group availability response was incomplete." };
  }
  return { days: data.map((row) => ({
    day: String(row.day), available: row.available,
    reason: typeof row.reason === "string" ? row.reason : null,
  })), error: null };
}

/** Physical kennels free throughout the longest selected stay, not just on arrival day.
 * Shares and individual pets do not consume capacity until booking succeeds.
 */
export async function fetchBoardingKennelCounts(date: string, time: string, nights: number): Promise<{
  counts: BoardingKennelCounts | null; error: string | null;
}> {
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date) || !/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(time) ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(nights) || nights < 1 || nights > 365) {
    return { counts: null, error: "Choose valid arrival details to view kennel availability." };
  }
  const { data, error } = await createClient().rpc("happytails_boarding_available_kennel_counts", {
    p_date: date, p_time: time, p_nights: nights,
  });
  if (error) return { counts: null, error: error.message };
  const counts = data as Record<string, unknown> | null;
  if (!counts || !["small", "big", "totalSmall", "totalBig"].every((key) =>
    typeof counts[key] === "number" && Number.isSafeInteger(counts[key]) && (counts[key] as number) >= 0)) {
    return { counts: null, error: "Kennel availability counts were not returned." };
  }
  return { counts: {
    small: counts.small as number, big: counts.big as number,
    totalSmall: counts.totalSmall as number, totalBig: counts.totalBig as number,
  }, error: null };
}

/** One staff-confirmed checkout closes occupancy but retains the kennel ID for history. */
export async function checkoutBoardingPet(appointmentPetId: string): Promise<{ error: string | null }> {
  const db = createClient();
  const { error } = await db.rpc("happytails_checkout_boarding_pet", {
    p_appointment_pet_id: appointmentPetId,
  });
  if (error) return { error: error.message };
  // A successful RPC is not the same as proof of the persisted transition.
  // Never show a success modal while the row still occupies a kennel.
  const { data, error: readError } = await db.from("appointment_pets")
    .select("status,actual_checkout_at").eq("id", appointmentPetId).single();
  if (readError) return { error: `Checkout was submitted, but verification failed: ${readError.message}. Refresh before trying again.` };
  if (data?.status !== "completed" || !data.actual_checkout_at) {
    return { error: "Checkout could not be verified. Refresh Boarding Management before trying again." };
  }
  return { error: null };
}

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";

export type BookingClosedDate = {
  date: string;
  name: string;
  category: "regular_holiday" | "special_non_working" | "exceptional_closure";
  source: string | null;
  is_open_override: boolean;
};

const CALENDAR_UPDATED = "happytails-booking-calendar-updated";
function publishCalendarChange() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(CALENDAR_UPDATED));
  try { window.localStorage.setItem(CALENDAR_UPDATED, String(Date.now())); } catch { /* optional */ }
}

export async function fetchBookingClosedDates(): Promise<{ dates: BookingClosedDate[]; error: string | null }> {
  const { data, error } = await createClient().from("booking_closed_dates")
    .select("date,name,category,source,is_open_override").order("date");
  return { dates: (data ?? []) as BookingClosedDate[], error: error?.message ?? null };
}

export async function checkBookingClosedDate(date: string): Promise<{ closed: boolean; name: string | null; error: string | null }> {
  const { data, error } = await createClient().from("booking_closed_dates")
    .select("name,is_open_override").eq("date", date).maybeSingle();
  return { closed: Boolean(data && !data.is_open_override), name: data && !data.is_open_override ? data.name : null, error: error?.message ?? null };
}

/**
 * Friendly preflight for Calendar Management. The database trigger is the
 * authoritative protection against concurrent bookings and direct writes.
 * Includes an overnight boarding stay whose check-in is before this date.
 */
async function existingAppointmentConflict(date: string): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date)) return "Choose a valid calendar date.";
  const db = createClient();
  const [scheduled, boarding] = await Promise.all([
    db.from("appointments").select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
      .eq("scheduled_date", date).neq("status", "cancelled").neq("status", "completed"),
    db.from("appointments").select("id", { count: "exact", head: true })
      .eq("service_type", "boarding").lt("scheduled_date", date)
      .gte("pick_up_at", `${date}T00:00:00+08:00`)
      .neq("status", "cancelled").neq("status", "completed"),
  ]);
  if (scheduled.error || boarding.error) {
    return `Unable to verify existing appointments for ${date}: ${scheduled.error?.message ?? boarding.error?.message}. No calendar changes were made.`;
  }
  const count = (scheduled.count ?? 0) + (boarding.count ?? 0);
  if (count > 0) {
    return `Cannot close ${date}: ${count} active or upcoming appointment${count === 1 ? "" : "s"} would be affected (including boarding stays). Reschedule or cancel these appointments before marking the shop closed.`;
  }
  return null;
}

export async function addExceptionalClosure(date: string, name: string) {
  const conflict = await existingAppointmentConflict(date);
  if (conflict) return conflict;
  const { error } = await createClient().from("booking_closed_dates")
    .insert({ date, name: name.trim(), category: "exceptional_closure", is_open_override: false });
  if (!error) publishCalendarChange();
  return error?.message ?? null;
}

export async function deleteExceptionalClosure(date: string) {
  const { error } = await createClient().from("booking_closed_dates")
    .delete().eq("date", date).eq("category", "exceptional_closure");
  if (!error) publishCalendarChange();
  return error?.message ?? null;
}

export async function setHolidayOpen(date: string, open: boolean): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!open) {
    const conflict = await existingAppointmentConflict(date);
    if (conflict) return conflict;
  }
  const { error } = await createClient().rpc("happytails_set_holiday_open", { p_date: date, p_open: open });
  if (!error) publishCalendarChange();
  return error?.message ?? null;
}

// Issue #6: username availability uses a rate-limited same-origin API.
// Resolving a username to an email in the browser is intentionally removed.
// The login POST endpoint handles username/email -> password verification
// privately and NEVER returns the resolved email to the browser.
import { validateUsername as validateStaffUsername } from "@/lib/validation/staff";

export function looksLikeEmail(value: string): boolean {
  return value.includes("@");
}

export async function isUsernameTaken(username: string): Promise<{ taken: boolean; error: string | null }> {
  try {
    const response = await fetch("/api/auth/check-username", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      credentials: "same-origin",
      cache: "no-store",
      body: JSON.stringify({ username }),
    });
    const result = (await response.json().catch(() => null)) as
      | { taken?: boolean; error?: string }
      | null;
    if (!response.ok || typeof result?.taken !== "boolean") {
      return {
        taken: false,
        error: result?.error ?? "Username availability could not be checked. Please try again.",
      };
    }
    return { taken: result.taken, error: null };
  } catch {
    return { taken: false, error: "Username availability could not be checked. Please try again." };
  }
}

export function validateUsernameFormat(username: string): string | null {
  if (username.includes("@")) return "Username can't contain @ â€” that would be ambiguous with an email.";
  if (username.length > 20) return "Username must be 20 characters or fewer.";
  return validateStaffUsername(username);
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\lib\supabase\grooming-booking.ts =====

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import type { BookingLeg } from "@/lib/types/booking-leg";
import type { DraftPetSelection } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import { groomingPlanClosingError, type GroomingPlannedSlot } from "@/lib/booking/grooming-closing";

export const isGrooming = (choice: string) => ["grooming", "dog_grooming", "cat_grooming"].includes(choice);
export type ScheduledGroomingSelection = DraftPetSelection & { groomingScheduledTime?: string };

/** Final read-only check prior to atomic saving. The SQL insert trigger is
 * still the authoritative guard against stale or concurrent bookings.
 */
export async function verifyGroomingLegPlans(legs: BookingLeg[]): Promise<string | null> {
  for (const leg of legs.filter(item => isGrooming(item.serviceChoice))) {
    if (!leg.scheduledDate || !leg.scheduledTime || !leg.petSelections.length) return "Grooming date or start time is missing.";
    const selections = leg.petSelections as ScheduledGroomingSelection[];
    if (selections.some(s => !s.packagePricingId || !s.groomerId || !s.groomingScheduledTime)) {
      return "A grooming reservation is incomplete. Edit the schedule to reassign each pet.";
    }
    const { data, error } = await createClient().rpc("happytails_grooming_plan_v2", {
      p_date: leg.scheduledDate,
      p_preferred_start: leg.scheduledTime,
      p_pricing_ids: selections.map(s => s.packagePricingId),
      p_groomer_ids: selections.map(s => s.groomerId),
    });
    if (error) return `Grooming availability changed: ${error.message}. Edit the schedule and review again.`;
    const next = data as Array<GroomingPlannedSlot> | null;
    if (!Array.isArray(next) || next.length !== selections.length || next.some((item, i) =>
      item.time !== selections[i].groomingScheduledTime || item.groomerId !== selections[i].groomerId)) {
      return "A groomer reservation has changed. Edit the grooming schedule and review the new times before saving.";
    }
    const closingError = groomingPlanClosingError(next);
    if (closingError) return closingError;
  }
  return null;
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\lib\supabase\grooming-verification.ts =====

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import { fetchPetSizes, fetchPackagesFull } from "@/lib/supabase/services";
import { catGroomingSizeGuide, matchPetSize } from "@/lib/utils/pet-size-guide";
import type { ServiceType } from "@/lib/types/services";

export type VerificationPreview = {
  sizeId: string;
  sizeLabel: string;
  weightKg: number;
  previousLineAmount: number;
  newLineAmount: number;
  previousPackageAmount: number;
  newPackageAmount: number;
};

/**
 * Use exactly the same cat-size policy as pet registration and online booking:
 * Small = up to 5 kg, Large = above 5 kg. The raw pet_sizes.weight_range
 * field can contain legacy ranges, so it must not determine the cat tier here.
 *
 * Cat packages historically used one "Standard" price row for both sizes.
 * The accompanying migration creates size-specific price aliases with the
 * same amount, so the existing database verification RPC can also find them.
 */
export async function previewGroomingVerification(args: {
  serviceType: "dog_grooming" | "cat_grooming";
  packageId: string;
  oldPricingId: string;
  oldLineAmount: number;
  weightKg: number;
}): Promise<{ preview: VerificationPreview | null; error: string | null }> {
  const { serviceType, packageId, oldPricingId, oldLineAmount, weightKg } = args;
  const isCat = serviceType === "cat_grooming";
  if (!Number.isFinite(weightKg) || weightKg <= 0 || weightKg > 200 ||
      (isCat && !Number.isInteger(weightKg))) {
    return {
      preview: null,
      error: isCat
        ? "Enter a whole-number weight for the cat (1â€“200 kg)."
        : "Enter a valid measured weight (above 0 and up to 200 kg).",
    };
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(oldLineAmount) || oldLineAmount < 0) {
    return { preview: null, error: "The original appointment amount is invalid. Please review the booking." };
  }

  const [{ sizes, error: sizeError }, { pricing, error: priceError }] = await Promise.all([
    fetchPetSizes(serviceType as ServiceType), fetchPackagesFull(serviceType as ServiceType),
  ]);
  if (sizeError || priceError) {
    return { preview: null, error: sizeError || priceError || "Unable to load grooming pricing." };
  }

  const activeSizes = sizes.filter((size) => size.is_active);
  const serviceSizes = isCat ? catGroomingSizeGuide(activeSizes) : activeSizes;
  if (isCat && (!serviceSizes.some((size) => size.label.trim().toLowerCase() === "small") ||
                !serviceSizes.some((size) => size.label.trim().toLowerCase() === "large"))) {
    return {
      preview: null,
      error: "Cat grooming needs active Small and Large sizes in Service Management before the price can be verified.",
    };
  }

  const matchedSize = matchPetSize(weightKg, serviceSizes);
  if (!matchedSize) {
    return {
      preview: null,
      error: isCat
        ? "The cat's weight could not be classified as Small (up to 5 kg) or Large (above 5 kg)."
        : "The measured weight does not match an active size bracket in Service Management.",
    };
  }

  const quotedRate = pricing.find((row) => row.id === oldPricingId && row.package_id === packageId);
  if (!quotedRate) {
    return {
      preview: null,
      error: "The original booked pricing row is no longer available. Please review the appointment and its package pricing; the quoted amount was not changed.",
    };
  }

  // Prefer the database size ID, then an exact size label. Do not quietly
  // substitute a generic row just for the preview: the database verification
  // function must find the same size-specific row before any charge is saved.
  const packageRates = pricing.filter((row) => row.package_id === packageId);
  const verifiedRate = packageRates.find((row) => row.size_id === matchedSize.id)
    ?? packageRates.find((row) => row.size_label.trim().toLowerCase() === matchedSize.label.trim().toLowerCase());

  if (!verifiedRate) {
    const hasLegacyStandard = packageRates.some((row) =>
      ["standard", "all sizes", "all size", "fixed", "any size"].includes(row.size_label.trim().toLowerCase()));
    return {
      preview: null,
      error: isCat && hasLegacyStandard
        ? `This cat package has a legacy Standard price but no ${matchedSize.label} price row. Apply the Cat Size Verification pricing migration, then calculate again. No price was changed.`
        : `This package has no configured price for the verified ${matchedSize.label} size. Ask an admin to review Service Management before confirming.`,
    };
  }

  const extraAmount = Math.round((oldLineAmount - quotedRate.price) * 100) / 100;
  if (!Number.isFinite(extraAmount) || extraAmount < -0.01) {
    return { preview: null, error: "The original line price is below its package rate. Please review its pricing manually." };
  }

  return {
    preview: {
      sizeId: matchedSize.id,
      sizeLabel: matchedSize.label,
      weightKg,
      previousLineAmount: oldLineAmount,
      newLineAmount: Math.round((verifiedRate.price + extraAmount) * 100) / 100,
      previousPackageAmount: quotedRate.price,
      newPackageAmount: verifiedRate.price,
    },
    error: null,
  };
}

export async function saveGroomingVerification(args: {
  appointmentPetId: string;
  weightKg: number;
  customerApproved: boolean;
  expectedPreviousLineAmount: number;
}) {
  // Keep the existing server-authoritative RPC. The UI's calculation never
  // writes a price; the database must revalidate weight, approved amount and
  // appointment state before committing any verification changes.
  const { data, error } = await createClient().rpc("happytails_verify_online_grooming_price", {
    p_appointment_pet_id: args.appointmentPetId,
    p_weight_kg: args.weightKg,
    p_customer_approved: args.customerApproved,
    p_expected_line_amount: args.expectedPreviousLineAmount,
  });
  return { result: data, error: error?.message ?? null };
}

export async function uploadHeroSlideImage(file: File) {
  const supabase = createClient();
  const ext = file.name.split(".").pop();
  const path = `hero-slides/${Date.now()}.${ext}`;

  const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
    .from("site-images")
    .upload(path, file, { upsert: true, contentType: file.type });
  if (uploadError) return { url: null, width: null, height: null, error: uploadError.message };

  const dimensions = await new Promise<{ width: number; height: number }>((resolve) => {
    const img = new window.Image();
    img.onload = () => resolve({ width: img.naturalWidth, height: img.naturalHeight });
    img.src = URL.createObjectURL(file);
  });

  const { data } = supabase.storage.from("site-images").getPublicUrl(path);
  return { url: data.publicUrl, width: dimensions.width, height: dimensions.height, error: null };
}

// Swaps sort_order between two slides â€” used by the up/down reorder
// buttons. Two separate awaited updates on purpose (never fire-and-forget
// a mutation): if the second one fails, the caller still knows exactly
// which write succeeded and which didn't, instead of silently drifting
// out of sync with the DB.
export async function swapHeroSlideOrder(a: { id: string; sort_order: number }, b: { id: string; sort_order: number }) {
  const supabase = createClient();
  const { error: errA } = await supabase.from("hero_slides").update({ sort_order: b.sort_order }).eq("id", a.id);
  if (errA) return { error: errA.message };
  const { error: errB } = await supabase.from("hero_slides").update({ sort_order: a.sort_order }).eq("id", b.id);
  if (errB) return { error: errB.message };
  return { error: null };
}

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";

export type InventoryChangeLog = {
  id: string;
  product_id: string | null;
  product_name: string;
  product_code: string | null;
  batch_id: string | null;
  batch_number: string | null;
  action: string;
  old_quantity: number | null;
  new_quantity: number | null;
  quantity_delta: number | null;
  details: string | null;
  actor_id: string | null;
  created_at: string;
};

/** Server-side pagination avoids silently omitting history beyond 1,000 rows. */
export async function fetchInventoryChangeLogs({page, pageSize, search, action}: {
  page: number; pageSize: number; search: string; action: string;
}): Promise<{ rows: InventoryChangeLog[]; count: number; error: string | null }> {
  const db = createClient();
  let query = db.from("inventory_change_logs")
    .select("id,product_id,product_name,product_code,batch_id,batch_number,action,old_quantity,new_quantity,quantity_delta,details,actor_id,created_at", {count:"exact"});
  if (action !== "all") query = query.eq("action",action);
  const q = search.trim();
  if (q) {
    // Escape PostgREST pattern delimiters so search cannot alter filter syntax.
    const safe = q.replace(/[,%()]/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
    if (safe) query = query.or(`product_name.ilike.%${safe}%,product_code.ilike.%${safe}%,batch_number.ilike.%${safe}%`);
  }
  const from = Math.max(0,page) * pageSize;
  const {data,count,error} = await query.order("created_at",{ascending:false}).order("id",{ascending:false}).range(from,from+pageSize-1);
  return {rows:(data??[]) as InventoryChangeLog[],count:count??0,error:error?.message??null};
}

// Inventory Reports must use the same sellable quantities as POS and Inventory.
// Expired batches remain in the audit history, but do not inflate stock.
import { fetchProducts, fetchAllBatches, computeStatus } from "./products";
import { sellableStock } from "@/lib/utils/inventory-expiration";
import type { InventoryReportRow, InventoryReportStatus } from "@/lib/data/inventory-reports-mock";

export async function fetchInventoryReportRows() {
  const [{ products, error: productsError }, { batches, error: batchesError }] = await Promise.all([
    fetchProducts(), fetchAllBatches(),
  ]);
  const error = productsError || batchesError;
  if (error) return { rows: [] as InventoryReportRow[], error };
  const rows: InventoryReportRow[] = products.map(p => {
    const stock = sellableStock(p.id,batches);
    const status: InventoryReportStatus = computeStatus(stock,p.min_stock);
    const expirationDate = batches.filter(b => b.product_id === p.id && b.quantity > 0 && !b.is_adjustment && !!b.expiration_date)
      .map(b => b.expiration_date as string).sort()[0] ?? null;
    return { id:p.product_code,itemName:p.name,category:p.category,stock,unit:p.unit,price:p.price,status,expirationDate };
  });
  return { rows, error: null };
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\lib\supabase\middleware.ts =====

// Issue #5: server-side, fail-closed authentication + account-status checks.
// The proxy runs for /account and /admin on every matched request.
import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
import { isSuperadminOnlyRoute } from "@/lib/admin-access";

export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {
  let response = NextResponse.next({ request });

  const supabase = createServerClient(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll() {
          return request.cookies.getAll();
        },
        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) => request.cookies.set(name, value));
          response = NextResponse.next({ request });
          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
            response.cookies.set(name, value, options)
          );
        },
      },
    }
  );

  // Preserve any refreshed/cleared auth cookies when redirecting. Otherwise
  // a redirect could discard cookie updates made by getUser()/signOut().
  function redirectTo(target: string) {
    const redirect = NextResponse.redirect(new URL(target, request.url));
    response.cookies.getAll().forEach((cookie) => redirect.cookies.set(cookie));
    redirect.headers.set("Cache-Control", "no-store");
    return redirect;
  }

  const pathname = request.nextUrl.pathname;
  const isAdminRoute = pathname === "/admin" || pathname.startsWith("/admin/");
  const isAccountRoute = pathname === "/account" || pathname.startsWith("/account/");
  if (!isAdminRoute && !isAccountRoute) return response;

  const { data: auth, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (authError || !auth.user) return redirectTo("/sign-in");

  // Never assume missing profiles or unreadable account rows are active.
  const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("role")
    .eq("id", auth.user.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (profileError || !profile || typeof profile.role !== "string") {
    return redirectTo("/sign-in?access=unverified");
  }

  const isStaff = profile.role === "admin" || profile.role === "superadmin";
  // Staff/superadmin accounts must have an ACTIVE staff_profiles row.
  // Customers must have an ACTIVE customers row. Never fall back to
  // another account table just because the authoritative row is missing.
  const table = isStaff ? "staff_profiles" : "customers";
  const { data: account, error: accountError } = await supabase
    .from(table)
    .select("status")
    .eq("id", auth.user.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (accountError || !account) return redirectTo("/sign-in?access=unverified");

  if (account.status !== "active") {
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
    return redirectTo("/sign-in?deactivated=1");
  }

  if (isAdminRoute) {
    if (!isStaff) return redirectTo("/account");
    // "admin" is a staff role. Management/configuration is superadmin-only.
    if (profile.role === "admin" && isSuperadminOnlyRoute(pathname)) {
      return redirectTo("/admin");
    }
  }

  // Do not let staff/superadmin accounts enter the customer dashboard.
  if (isAccountRoute && isStaff) return redirectTo("/admin");

  return response;
}

// Same shape as subscribeToAppointments() in appointment-management.ts â€”
// fires onChange for any insert/update on this customer's own
// notifications, so the badge count and list update live (e.g. right
// when staff marks an appointment "Completed" on the admin side).
// Returns an unsubscribe function; caller must call it on unmount.
//
// The channel name includes a random suffix on purpose: the unread
// badge in DashboardNavbar and the notifications page itself both call
// this for the SAME customerId at the same time (the page renders
// inside the layout the navbar belongs to), and Supabase Realtime
// rejects a second channel trying to reuse a topic name that's already
// subscribed. Each caller needs its own channel, not a shared one.
export function subscribeToNotifications(customerId: string, onChange: () => void) {
  const supabase = createClient();
  const uniqueSuffix = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  const channel = supabase
    .channel(`notifications-${customerId}-${uniqueSuffix}`)
    .on(
      "postgres_changes",
      { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "notifications", filter: `customer_id=eq.${customerId}` },
      onChange
    )
    .subscribe();

  return () => { supabase.removeChannel(channel); };
}

// HappyTails Issue #2: one authenticated RPC replaces the old client-side
// sequence of deduct_stock_fefo + sales INSERT + sale_items INSERT.
// The SQL migration MUST be applied before deploying this frontend.
import { createClient } from "./client";

export type PosCheckoutLine = { productId: string; quantity: number };
export type PosCheckoutReceiptLine = {
  productId: string;
  name: string;
  quantity: number;
  unitPrice: number;
  lineAmount: number;
};
export type PosCheckoutResult = {
  invoiceNumber: string;
  totalAmount: number;
  amountPaid: number;
  changeAmount: number;
  items: PosCheckoutReceiptLine[];
};

export async function checkoutPosSale(request: {
  requestId: string;
  items: PosCheckoutLine[];
  amountPaid: number;
  method: "Cash";
}): Promise<{ sale: PosCheckoutResult | null; error: string | null }> {
  if (!request.items.length || request.items.some(
    (item) => !Number.isSafeInteger(item.quantity) || item.quantity < 1
  )) {
    return { sale: null, error: "The cart contains an invalid quantity." };
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(request.amountPaid) || request.amountPaid < 0) {
    return { sale: null, error: "Enter a valid cash amount." };
  }

  const supabase = createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc("happytails_checkout_pos", {
    p_request_id: request.requestId,
    p_items: request.items,
    p_amount_paid: request.amountPaid,
    p_payment_method: request.method,
  });
  if (error) return { sale: null, error: error.message };

  // Do not clear the cart if the database returns an incomplete response.
  if (!data || typeof data !== "object" || Array.isArray(data)) {
    return { sale: null, error: "Checkout returned an invalid response; check the sales report before retrying." };
  }
  const result = data as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (typeof result.invoiceNumber !== "string" || !Array.isArray(result.items) ||
      !Number.isFinite(Number(result.totalAmount)) ||
      !Number.isFinite(Number(result.amountPaid)) ||
      !Number.isFinite(Number(result.changeAmount))) {
    return { sale: null, error: "Checkout result is missing details; check the sales report before retrying." };
  }

  const items: PosCheckoutReceiptLine[] = [];
  for (const item of result.items) {
    if (!item || typeof item !== "object" ||
      typeof item.name !== "string" || typeof item.productId !== "string" ||
      !Number.isFinite(Number(item.quantity)) ||
      !Number.isFinite(Number(item.unitPrice)) ||
      !Number.isFinite(Number(item.lineAmount))) {
      return { sale: null, error: "Checkout receipt has an invalid item; check sales reports before retrying." };
    }
    items.push({
      productId: item.productId,
      name: item.name,
      quantity: Number(item.quantity),
      unitPrice: Number(item.unitPrice),
      lineAmount: Number(item.lineAmount),
    });
  }
  return {
    error: null,
    sale: {
      invoiceNumber: result.invoiceNumber,
      totalAmount: Number(result.totalAmount),
      amountPaid: Number(result.amountPaid),
      changeAmount: Number(result.changeAmount),
      items,
    },
  };
}

// Inventory and POS share batch-aware stock calculations. Mutations are handled
// by Supabase; reductions use an auditable, transactional server-side RPC.
import { createClient } from "./client";
import { philippinesToday } from "@/lib/utils/inventory-expiration";
import type { Product, ProductBatch, ProductCategory } from "@/lib/types/products";

// PostgREST usually caps a single response at 1,000 rows. Never silently
// under-count stock or omit batches because inventory grew past that limit.
const PAGE = 1000;
async function loadProducts(activeOnly?: boolean) {
  const db = createClient();
  const rows: Product[] = [];
  for (let offset = 0;; offset += PAGE) {
    let q = db.from("products").select("*");
    if (activeOnly) q = q.eq("status","active");
    const { data, error } = await q.order("product_code").range(offset,offset+PAGE-1);
    if (error) return { rows: [] as Product[], error: error.message };
    rows.push(...((data ?? []) as Product[]));
    if (!data || data.length < PAGE) break;
  }
  return { rows, error: null as string | null };
}
async function loadBatches(): Promise<{ rows: ProductBatch[]; error: string|null }> {
  const db = createClient();
  const rows: ProductBatch[] = [];
  for (let offset=0;;offset+=PAGE) {
    const { data, error } = await db.from("product_batches").select("*").order("id").range(offset,offset+PAGE-1);
    if (error) return { rows: [] as ProductBatch[], error: error.message };
    rows.push(...((data ?? []) as unknown as ProductBatch[]));
    if (!data || data.length < PAGE) break;
  }
  return { rows, error: null };
}
export async function fetchProducts(options?: { activeOnly?: boolean }) {
  const [p,b] = await Promise.all([loadProducts(options?.activeOnly),loadBatches()]);
  if (p.error || b.error) return { products: [] as Product[], error: `Unable to read inventory: ${p.error ?? b.error}` };
  const today = philippinesToday();
  const stockById = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const batch of b.rows) {
    if (options?.activeOnly && !batch.is_adjustment && batch.expiration_date && batch.expiration_date < today) continue;
    stockById.set(batch.product_id, (stockById.get(batch.product_id) ?? 0) + Number(batch.quantity ?? 0));
  }
  return { products: p.rows.map(p => ({ ...p, stock: Math.max(0, stockById.get(p.id) ?? 0) })), error: undefined };
}
export async function fetchAllBatches() {
  const result = await loadBatches();
  return { batches: result.rows.sort((a,b) => b.received_date.localeCompare(a.received_date)), error: result.error ?? undefined };
}
export async function fetchBatchesForProduct(productId: string) {
  const { data, error } = await createClient().from("product_batches").select("*").eq("product_id", productId).order("received_date", { ascending: false });
  return { batches: (data ?? []) as ProductBatch[], error: error?.message };
}
export function computeTotalStock(productId: string, batches: ProductBatch[]) {
  return batches.filter(b => b.product_id === productId).reduce((sum, b) => sum + Number(b.quantity), 0);
}
export function computeStatus(qty: number, minStock: number): "Out of Stock" | "Low Stock" | "In Stock" {
  return qty <= 0 ? "Out of Stock" : qty <= minStock ? "Low Stock" : "In Stock";
}
export async function addProduct(product: { name: string; category: ProductCategory; unit: string; package_size: string | null; price: number; min_stock: number }) {
  return createClient().from("products").insert(product).select().single();
}
export async function updateProduct(id: string, fields: { name: string; category: ProductCategory; unit: string; min_stock: number }) {
  const { data, error } = await createClient().from("products").update(fields).eq("id", id).select("id");
  return { error: error ?? (!data?.length ? { message: "No product was updated; check inventory permissions." } : null) };
}
export async function uploadProductImage(file: File, productCode: string) {
  const db = createClient();
  const ext = file.name.split(".").pop();
  const path = `products/${productCode}-${Date.now()}.${ext}`;
  const { error: uploadError } = await db.storage.from("site-images").upload(path, file, { upsert: true });
  if (uploadError) return { error: uploadError.message, url: null };
  const { data } = db.storage.from("site-images").getPublicUrl(path);
  return { error: null, url: data.publicUrl };
}
export async function setProductImage(id: string, url: string) {
  const { error } = await createClient().from("products").update({ image_url: url }).eq("id", id);
  return { error };
}
export async function addBatch(batch: { product_id: string; quantity: number; expiration_date: string | null }) {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(batch.quantity) || batch.quantity <= 0) return { error: { message: "Batch quantity must be a positive whole number." } };
  if (batch.expiration_date && batch.expiration_date < philippinesToday()) return { error: { message: "Expired stock cannot be received as sellable inventory." } };
  return createClient().from("product_batches").insert(batch);
}

// Keep legacy signature for existing callers; positive/unattributed adjustments
// are forbidden. The detail form calls the batch-specific version instead.
export async function adjustStock(_productId: string, _delta: number, _reason: string) {
  return { error: { message: "Choose a specific batch for stock removal. To increase stock, receive a new batch." } };
}
export async function adjustInventoryBatch(batchId: string, quantity: number, reason: string) {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(quantity) || quantity <= 0) return { error: { message: "Enter a positive whole number to remove." } };
  const { error } = await createClient().rpc("happytails_remove_inventory_batch_stock", {
    p_batch_id: batchId, p_quantity: quantity, p_reason: reason,
  });
  return { error: error ? { message: error.message } : null };
}
export async function setInventoryBatchExpiration(batchId: string, expirationDate: string, reason: string) {
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(expirationDate) || reason.trim().length < 3) return { error: { message: "Enter an expiration date and correction reason." } };
  const { error } = await createClient().rpc("happytails_set_inventory_batch_expiration", {
    p_batch_id: batchId, p_expiration_date: expirationDate, p_reason: reason.trim(),
  });
  return { error: error ? { message: error.message } : null };
}

  return { error: error ?? (!data?.length ? { message: "No product status changed; check inventory permissions." } : null) };
}

  const { error } = await createClient().rpc("deduct_stock_fefo", { p_product_id: productId, p_quantity: quantity });
  return { error: error?.message ?? null };
}

// Query + mutation helpers for the logged-in user's OWN profile.
import { createClient } from "./client";
import type { OwnProfile } from "@/lib/types/profile";

export async function fetchOwnProfile(): Promise<{ profile: OwnProfile | null; error: string | null }> {
  const supabase = createClient();
  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (authError || !user) return { profile: null, error: authError?.message ?? "Not signed in." };

  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .select("id, full_name, username, phone_number, profile_picture_url, role, created_at, employee_id, date_of_birth, address, recovery_email, password_changed_at")
    .eq("id", user.id)
    .single();

  if (error || !data) return { profile: null, error: error?.message ?? "Profile not found." };

  return { profile: { ...data, email: user.email ?? "" }, error: null };
}

export async function updateOwnProfile(fields: {
  fullName: string;
  phoneNumber: string;
  email: string;
  dateOfBirth: string | null;
  address: string;
  recoveryEmail: string;
}) {
  const supabase = createClient();
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { error: "Not signed in." };

  const { error: profileError } = await supabase
    .from("profiles")
    .update({
      full_name: fields.fullName,
      phone_number: fields.phoneNumber,
      date_of_birth: fields.dateOfBirth,
      address: fields.address,
      recovery_email: fields.recoveryEmail || null,
    })
    .eq("id", user.id);
  if (profileError) return { error: profileError.message };

  const requestedEmail = fields.email.trim();
  if (requestedEmail.toLowerCase() !== (user.email ?? "").toLowerCase()) {
    // The email address is not changed immediately. Supabase verifies its
    // email-change confirmation(s), then updates auth.users automatically.
    // This dedicated destination is separate from Google's OAuth callback.
    const { error: emailError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser(
      { email: requestedEmail },
      { emailRedirectTo: `${window.location.origin}/auth/email-change` }
    );
    if (emailError) return { error: emailError.message };
    return { error: null, emailChangePending: true };
  }

  return { error: null, emailChangePending: false };
}

export async function changeOwnPassword(currentPassword: string, newPassword: string) {
  const supabase = createClient();
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user?.email) return { error: "Not signed in." };

  const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
    email: user.email,
    password: currentPassword,
  });
  if (verifyError) return { error: "Current password is incorrect." };

  const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password: newPassword });
  if (error) return { error: error.message };

  await supabase.from("profiles").update({ password_changed_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq("id", user.id);
  return { error: null };
}

export async function uploadAvatar(file: File) {
  const supabase = createClient();
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return { error: "Not signed in.", url: null };

  const ext = file.name.split(".").pop();
  const path = `avatars/${user.id}-${Date.now()}.${ext}`;
  const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage.from("site-images").upload(path, file, { upsert: true });
  if (uploadError) return { error: uploadError.message, url: null };

  const { data } = supabase.storage.from("site-images").getPublicUrl(path);
  const { error: updateError } = await supabase.from("profiles").update({ profile_picture_url: data.publicUrl }).eq("id", user.id);
  if (updateError) return { error: updateError.message, url: null };
  return { error: null, url: data.publicUrl };
}

// Service reports use permanent per-pet service codes and stable, human-readable
// appointment numbers. UUIDs remain the database's internal relationship keys.
import { createClient } from "./client";
import { fetchAppointments, type AppointmentRow } from "./appointment-management";
import type { AppointmentStatus, AppointmentServiceType } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { ServiceReport, ReportStatus, ServiceCategory } from "@/lib/data/service-reports-mock";

function mapStatus(status: AppointmentStatus): ReportStatus {
  switch (status) {
    case "completed": return "Completed";
    case "checked_in": return "Ongoing";
    case "cancelled": return "Cancelled";
    case "pending":
    case "confirmed":
    default: return "Scheduled";
  }
}

function categoryForService(type: AppointmentServiceType): ServiceCategory {
  switch (type) {
    case "boarding": return "Boarding";
    case "ala_carte": return "Ala Carte";
    case "dog_grooming":
    case "cat_grooming": return "Grooming";
  }
}

function serviceLabel(appt: AppointmentRow, pet: AppointmentRow["pets"][number]): string {
  if (pet.packageName) return pet.packageName;
  if (appt.service_type === "boarding") {
    return pet.packagePricingLabel ? `Boarding â€“ ${pet.packagePricingLabel}` : "Boarding";
  }
  return appt.service_type.replace(/_/g, " ").replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
}

function displayDate(iso: string): string {
  return new Date(`${iso}T00:00:00`).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric",
  });
}

/** Database-assigned identifiers never depend on UI sorting, filtering, or pagination. */
export async function fetchServiceReports(): Promise<{ rows: ServiceReport[]; error: string | null }> {
  const { rows: appointments, error } = await fetchAppointments();
  if (error) return { rows: [], error };
  if (appointments.length === 0) return { rows: [], error: null };

  const petRowIds = appointments.flatMap((a) => a.pets.map((p) => p.appointmentPetId));
  const supabase = createClient();
  const codes = new Map<string, string>();
  for (let start = 0; start < petRowIds.length; start += 150) {
    const ids = petRowIds.slice(start, start + 150);
    const { data, error: codeError } = await supabase
      .from("appointment_pets")
      .select("id, report_code")
      .in("id", ids);
    if (codeError) return { rows: [], error: `Could not load service IDs: ${codeError.message}. Apply the report-code SQL migration first.` };
    for (const pet of data ?? []) if (pet.report_code) codes.set(pet.id, pet.report_code);
  }

  // A second, bounded lookup keeps the normal appointment loader unchanged.
  // appointment_number is the permanent public-facing integer; id remains UUID.
  const appointmentNumbers = new Map<string, string>();
  for (let start = 0; start < appointments.length; start += 150) {
    const ids = appointments.slice(start, start + 150).map((a) => a.id);
    const { data, error: numberError } = await supabase
      .from("appointments")
      .select("id, appointment_number")
      .in("id", ids);
    if (numberError) {
      return { rows: [], error: `Could not load appointment numbers: ${numberError.message}. Apply the sequential appointment-number SQL migration first.` };
    }
    for (const appointment of data ?? []) {
      if (appointment.appointment_number !== null && appointment.appointment_number !== undefined) {
        appointmentNumbers.set(appointment.id, String(appointment.appointment_number));
      }
    }
  }

  const newestFirst = [...appointments].sort((a, b) => {
    const diff = new Date(b.created_at).getTime() - new Date(a.created_at).getTime();
    return diff || b.scheduled_date.localeCompare(a.scheduled_date);
  });

  const rows: ServiceReport[] = [];
  for (const appt of newestFirst) {
    const appointmentNumber = appointmentNumbers.get(appt.id);
    if (!appointmentNumber) return { rows: [], error: `Appointment number missing for ${appt.id}. Check the sequential appointment-number migration and table permissions.` };
    for (const pet of appt.pets) {
      const reportCode = codes.get(pet.appointmentPetId);
      if (!reportCode) return { rows: [], error: `Service ID missing for appointment ${appointmentNumber}. Check the report-code migration and table permissions.` };
      rows.push({
        id: reportCode,
        appointmentId: appointmentNumber,
        appointmentPetId: pet.appointmentPetId,
        pet: pet.name,
        owner: appt.owner_name || "â€”",
        category: categoryForService(appt.service_type),
        service: serviceLabel(appt, pet),
        source: appt.is_walk_in ? "Walk-in" : "Online",
        amount: pet.lineAmount,
        date: appt.scheduled_date,
        displayDate: displayDate(appt.scheduled_date),
        status: mapStatus(pet.status ?? appt.status),
      });
    }
  }
  return { rows, error: null };
}

// POS sales ledger. One row per INVOICE for reporting, with nested items.
// recordSale is retained unchanged for existing POS code compatibility.
import { createClient } from "./client";
import type { SalesReportRow, SalesInvoiceItem } from "@/lib/data/sales-reports-mock";

export type SaleLineInput = { productId: string; quantity: number; unitPrice: number };

export async function recordSale(
  lines: SaleLineInput[],
  payment: { method: string; amountPaid: number }
) {
  if (lines.length === 0) return { error: "No items to record." };
  const supabase = createClient();
  const totalAmount = lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.quantity * l.unitPrice, 0);

  const { data: sale, error: saleError } = await supabase
    .from("sales")
    .insert({ total_amount: totalAmount, payment_method: payment.method, amount_paid: payment.amountPaid })
    .select()
    .single();
  if (saleError || !sale) return { error: saleError?.message ?? "Couldn't create the sale record." };

  const { error: itemsError } = await supabase.from("sale_items").insert(
    lines.map((l) => ({
      sale_id: sale.id,
      product_id: l.productId,
      quantity: l.quantity,
      unit_price: l.unitPrice,
      line_amount: l.quantity * l.unitPrice,
    }))
  );
  if (itemsError) return { error: itemsError.message };
  return { error: null, invoiceNumber: sale.invoice_number as string };
}

type RawSaleItem = {
  quantity: number;
  unit_price: number;
  line_amount: number | null;
  products: { name: string; category: string } | null;
};
type RawSale = {
  id: string;
  invoice_number: string;
  sold_at: string;
  total_amount: number;
  amount_paid: number | null;
  payment_method: string;
  sale_items: RawSaleItem[] | null;
};

function displayDate(iso: string): string {
  return new Date(iso + "T00:00:00").toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric",
  });
}

export async function fetchSalesReportRows(): Promise<{ rows: SalesReportRow[]; error: string | null }> {
  const supabase = createClient();
  // Query invoice headers, not sale_items, otherwise every product line
  // repeats the same cash received and change given amounts.
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from("sales")
    .select(`id, invoice_number, sold_at, total_amount, amount_paid, payment_method,
      sale_items(quantity, unit_price, line_amount, products(name, category))`)
    .order("sold_at", { ascending: false });

  if (error) return { rows: [], error: error.message };

  const rows: SalesReportRow[] = ((data ?? []) as unknown as RawSale[]).map((sale) => {
    const items: SalesInvoiceItem[] = (sale.sale_items ?? []).map((item) => ({
      name: item.products?.name ?? "Unknown product",
      category: item.products?.category ?? "Unknown",
      quantity: item.quantity,
      unitPrice: item.unit_price,
      lineTotal: item.line_amount ?? item.quantity * item.unit_price,
    }));
    const cashReceived = sale.amount_paid == null ? null : Number(sale.amount_paid);
    const totalPrice = Number(sale.total_amount ?? 0);
    const date = sale.sold_at.slice(0, 10);
    return {
      id: sale.id,
      invoiceNumber: sale.invoice_number,
      items,
      itemName: items.map((item) => item.name).join(", ") || "â€”",
      quantity: items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0),
      totalPrice,
      cashReceived,
      changeGiven: cashReceived == null ? null : Math.max(0, Math.round((cashReceived - totalPrice) * 100) / 100),
      paymentMethod: sale.payment_method ?? "â€”",
      date,
      displayDate: displayDate(date),
    };
  });

  return { rows, error: null };
}

// Supabase client for use on the SERVER (Server Components, Server Actions, Route Handlers).
// This is what you'll import in things like a page.tsx that loads a customer's pets
// directly on the server before sending HTML to the browser.
//
// It's async because reading cookies in Next.js 15+/16 requires an await.
import { createServerClient } from "@supabase/ssr";
import { cookies } from "next/headers";

export async function createClient() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();

  return createServerClient(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll() {
          return cookieStore.getAll();
        },
        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
          try {
            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
              cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
            );
          } catch {
            // setAll was called from a Server Component, which can't set cookies.
            // This is safe to ignore IF you have middleware refreshing sessions
            // (which we're about to set up below).
          }
        },
      },
    }
  );
}

import { createClient } from "./client";

    .not("groomer_id", "is", null).eq("appointments.status", "checked_in")
