export async function fetchBoardingSessions() {
  const s = createClient();
  const { data, error } = await s.from("appointment_pets").select(`id,pet_id,kennel_id,appointments!inner(id,owner_name,drop_off_at,pick_up_at,status,service_type),pets(id,name,breed),kennels(id,size,number)`)
    .not("kennel_id", "is", null).in("appointments.status", ["confirmed", "checked_in"])
    .eq("appointments.service_type", "boarding").neq("status", "completed");
  if (error) return { sessions: [] as BoardingSessionRow[], error: error.message };
  return { sessions: ((data ?? []) as any[]).map(r => ({
    appointmentId: r.appointments.id, appointmentPetId: r.id, petId: r.pets?.id ?? r.pet_id,
    petName: r.pets?.name ?? "Unknown pet", breed: r.pets?.breed ?? "â€”", ownerName: r.appointments.owner_name,
    dropOffAt: r.appointments.drop_off_at, pickUpAt: r.appointments.pick_up_at,
    kennelId: r.kennels?.id ?? r.kennel_id, kennelSize: r.kennels?.size ?? "small",
    kennelNumber: r.kennels?.number ?? 0,
    stage: r.appointments.status === "confirmed" ? "booked" : "checked_in",
  })) as BoardingSessionRow[], error: null };
}
export async function fetchAvailableGroomers() {
  const s = createClient();
  const [{ data, error }, { sessions, error: se }] = await Promise.all([
    s.from("groomers").select("*").eq("status", "active").order("name"), fetchGroomingSessions(),
  ]);
  if (error || se) return { groomers: [] as Groomer[], error: error?.message ?? se };
  const busy = new Set(sessions.map(x => x.groomerId));
  return { groomers: ((data ?? []) as Groomer[]).filter(x => !busy.has(x.id)), error: null };
}
export async function fetchAvailableKennels() {
  const s = createClient();
  const [{ data, error }, { sessions, error: se }] = await Promise.all([
    s.from("kennels").select("*").eq("is_active", true).order("size").order("number"),
    fetchBoardingSessions(),
  ]);
  if (error || se) return { kennels: [] as Kennel[], error: error?.message ?? se };
  const busy = new Set(sessions.map(x => x.kennelId));
  return { kennels: ((data ?? []) as Kennel[]).filter(x => !busy.has(x.id)), error: null };
}
export async function checkInAppointment(id: string, assignments: { appointmentPetId: string; resourceId: string; resourceType: "groomer" | "kennel" }[]) {
  const s = createClient();
  if (!assignments.length) return { error: "Assign a resource to every pet before checking in." };
  const { data: a, error: ae } = await s.from("appointments").select("id,service_type,status").eq("id", id).single();
  if (ae || !a) return { error: ae?.message ?? "Appointment not found." };
  if (a.status !== "confirmed") return { error: "Only confirmed appointments can be checked in." };
  const type = a.service_type === "boarding" ? "kennel" : "groomer";
  if (assignments.some(x => x.resourceType !== type)) return { error: `This appointment requires ${type} assignment.` };
  if (new Set(assignments.map(x => x.appointmentPetId)).size !== assignments.length) return { error: "Each pet can only have one assignment." };
  if (type === "groomer" && new Set(assignments.map(x => x.resourceId)).size !== assignments.length) return { error: "A groomer cannot be assigned twice in the same check-in." };
  const active = type === "groomer" ? await fetchGroomingSessions() : await fetchBoardingSessions();
  if (active.error) return { error: active.error };
  const busy = new Set(active.sessions.filter(x => x.appointmentId !== id && (type === "groomer" || (x as BoardingSessionRow).stage === "checked_in")).map(x => type === "groomer" ? (x as GroomingSessionRow).groomerId : (x as BoardingSessionRow).kennelId));
  if (type === "groomer" && assignments.some(x => busy.has(x.resourceId))) return { error: "A selected groomer is already in use." };
  const { count, error: ce } = await s.from("appointment_pets").select("id", { head: true, count: "exact" }).eq("appointment_id", id);
  if (ce) return { error: ce.message };
  if (count !== assignments.length) return { error: "Assign every pet in this appointment." };
  if (type === "kennel") {
    const ids = assignments.map(x => x.appointmentPetId);
    const [{ data: petRows, error: pe }, { data: kennelRows, error: ke }] = await Promise.all([
      s.from("appointment_pets").select("id,kennel_id,package_id,package_pricing_id,packages(name),package_pricing(package_id,size_label,size_detail,packages(name))").eq("appointment_id", id).in("id", ids),
      s.from("kennels").select("id,size,is_active").in("id", assignments.map(x => x.resourceId)),
    ]);
    if (pe || ke) return { error: pe?.message ?? ke?.message ?? "Unable to verify kennels." };
    const pets = new Map((petRows ?? []).map((r: any) => [r.id, r]));
    const kennels = new Map((kennelRows ?? []).map((k: any) => [k.id, k]));
    for (const x of assignments) {
      const row: any = pets.get(x.appointmentPetId); const kennel: any = kennels.get(x.resourceId);
      if (!row || !kennel || kennel.is_active !== true) return { error: "The selected kennel is disabled or no longer exists." };
      if (row.kennel_id && row.kennel_id !== x.resourceId) return { error: "This pet already has a reserved kennel. Confirm the booked kennel instead of replacing it." };
      if (!row.kennel_id && busy.has(x.resourceId)) return { error: "This kennel is currently occupied. Choose another active kennel." };
      const description = `${row.packages?.name ?? row.package_pricing?.packages?.name ?? ""} ${row.package_pricing?.size_label ?? ""} ${row.package_pricing?.size_detail ?? ""}`.toLowerCase();
      const required = description.includes("small") ? "small" : description.includes("big") ? "big" : null;
      if (!required) return { error: "This booking has no recorded kennel size. Review the booking." };
      if (kennel.size !== required) return { error: `This pet requires a ${required} kennel.` };
    }
  }
  for (const x of assignments) {
    // Keep existing boarding reservation IDs unchanged. A new kennel is saved only when no reservation exists.
    if (type === "kennel") {
      const { error } = await s.from("appointment_pets").update({ kennel_id: x.resourceId }).eq("id", x.appointmentPetId).eq("appointment_id", id).is("kennel_id", null);
      if (error) return { error: error.message };
    } else {
      const { error } = await s.from("appointment_pets").update({ groomer_id: x.resourceId }).eq("id", x.appointmentPetId).eq("appointment_id", id);
      if (error) return { error: error.message };
    }
  }
  const { error } = await s.from("appointments").update({ status: "checked_in" }).eq("id", id);
  return { error: error?.message ?? null };
}
export function subscribeToServiceSessions(onChange: () => void) {
  const s = createClient(), ch = s.channel("pet-service-sessions-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2))
    .on("postgres_changes", { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "appointments" }, onChange)
    .on("postgres_changes", { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "appointment_pets" }, onChange)
    .on("postgres_changes", { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "groomers" }, onChange)
    .on("postgres_changes", { event: "*", schema: "public", table: "kennels" }, onChange).subscribe();
  return () => { s.removeChannel(ch); };
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\lib\supabase\staff-audit.ts =====

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
export type StaffAuditEntry = {
  id: number; occurred_at: string; actor_id: string | null;
  actor_name: string; actor_role: string; module: string;
  action: string; severity: "info" | "high" | "critical";
  entity_table: string; entity_id: string | null;
  before_data: Record<string, unknown>; after_data: Record<string, unknown>;
  changed_fields: string[]; origin: string;
};
export type AuditFilters = {
  search: string; module: string; severity: string;
  fromDate: string; toDate: string;
};
const PAGE_SIZE = 25;
export async function fetchStaffAuditPage(filters: AuditFilters, page: number) {
  const db = createClient();
  let query = db.from("staff_audit_logs").select("*", { count: "exact" });
  if (filters.module !== "all") query = query.eq("module", filters.module);
  if (filters.severity !== "all") query = query.eq("severity", filters.severity);
  if (filters.fromDate) query = query.gte("occurred_at", `${filters.fromDate}T00:00:00+08:00`);
  if (filters.toDate) query = query.lte("occurred_at", `${filters.toDate}T23:59:59.999+08:00`);
  const search = filters.search.trim();
  // Supabase "or" syntax uses a mini-language. Escape wildcard/structural
  // characters so a typed search cannot alter the filter expression.
  if (search) {
    const term = search.replace(/[,%().*\\]/g, "").slice(0, 75);
    if (term) {
      const numericId = /^\d+$/.test(term) && Number.isSafeInteger(Number(term)) && Number(term) > 0 ? Number(term) : null;
      query = query.or(`${numericId !== null ? `id.eq.${numericId},` : ""}actor_name.ilike.%${term}%,action.ilike.%${term}%,entity_id.ilike.%${term}%`);
    }
  }
  const { data, error, count } = await query.order("occurred_at", { ascending: false })
    .order("id", { ascending: false })
    .range(page * PAGE_SIZE, (page + 1) * PAGE_SIZE - 1);
  return { rows: (data ?? []) as StaffAuditEntry[], count: count ?? 0,
    error: error?.message ?? null, pageSize: PAGE_SIZE };
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\lib\supabase\superadmin-username.ts =====

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import { validateUsername } from "@/lib/validation/staff";

/** Atomic, authenticated change of the current Super Admin username. */
export async function changeSuperadminUsername(value: string): Promise<{ username: string | null; error: string | null }> {
  const username = value.trim();
  const invalid = validateUsername(username);
  if (invalid) return { username: null, error: invalid };
  if (username.length > 20) return { username: null, error: "Username must not exceed 20 characters." };

  const { data, error } = await createClient().rpc("happytails_change_superadmin_username", {
    p_username: username,
  });
  if (error) return { username: null, error: error.message };
  if (typeof data !== "string") return { username: null, error: "Could not verify that the username was updated." };
  return { username: data, error: null };
}

export async function logAudit(action: string, targetType: "staff" | "customer", targetId: string, details?: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const supabase = createClient();
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) return;
  const { data: profile } = await supabase.from("profiles").select("role").eq("id", user.id).single();
  await supabase.from("audit_logs").insert({
    actor_id: user.id,
    actor_role: profile?.role,
    action,
    target_type: targetType,
    target_id: targetId,
    details,
  });
}

import type { WalkInServiceChoice } from "@/components/admin/pos/walk-in/ServiceChoiceStep";
import type { Pet, DraftPetSelection } from "@/lib/types/appointments";

export type BookingLeg = {
  id: string;
  serviceChoice: WalkInServiceChoice;
  petIds: string[];
  petSelections: DraftPetSelection[];
  scheduledDate: string | null;
  scheduledTime: string | null;
  dropOffAt: string | null;
  pickUpAt: string | null;
  petBelongings: string[];
  specialRequests: string;
};

export function emptyLeg(serviceChoice: WalkInServiceChoice, petIds: string[]): BookingLeg {
  return {
    id: `leg-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,
    serviceChoice,
    petIds,
    petSelections: [],
    scheduledDate: null,
    scheduledTime: null,
    dropOffAt: null,
    pickUpAt: null,
    petBelongings: [],
    specialRequests: "",
  };
}

export function eligibleServicesFor(
  allPets: Pet[],
  selectedPetIds: string[],
  completedLegs: BookingLeg[]
): WalkInServiceChoice[] {
  const selected = allPets.filter((p) => selectedPetIds.includes(p.id));
  const results: WalkInServiceChoice[] = [];
  const coveredBy = (service: WalkInServiceChoice) =>
    new Set(completedLegs.filter((l) => l.serviceChoice === service).flatMap((l) => l.petIds));

  const hasDog = selected.some((p) => p.species === "Dog");
  const hasCat = selected.some((p) => p.species === "Cat");
  if (hasDog || hasCat) results.push("grooming");

  // Boarding is one group reservation for the selected pets. Once added,
  // do not offer it again in "Other Services", even for an unselected pet.
  // This avoids a second Boarding leg accidentally competing for the same
  // two Big kennels and splitting pets that were meant to share.
  if (selected.length > 0 && !completedLegs.some((l) => l.serviceChoice === "boarding")) {
    results.push("boarding");
  }

  const alaCovered = coveredBy("ala_carte");
  if (selected.some((p) => !alaCovered.has(p.id))) results.push("ala_carte");
  return results;
}

export function autoQueuedGroomingLegs(_selectedPets: Pet[]): BookingLeg[] {
  return [];
}

export type ProductCategory =
  | "Food"
  | "Treats"
  | "Grooming"
  | "Accessories"
  | "Hygiene";

export type ProductStatus = "active" | "discontinued";
export type PetType = "dog" | "cat";

export type Product = {
  id: string;
  product_code: string;
  name: string;
  category: ProductCategory;
  unit: string;
  package_size: string | null;
  price: number;
  min_stock: number;
  image_url: string | null;
  status: ProductStatus;
  created_at: string;
  description?: string;

// app, but the reference shows 3 separate input fields.
export function splitFullName(fullName: string | null): { first: string; middle: string; last: string } {
  const parts = (fullName ?? "").trim().split(/\s+/);
  if (parts.length <= 1) return { first: parts[0] ?? "", middle: "", last: "" };
  if (parts.length === 2) return { first: parts[0], middle: "", last: parts[1] };
  return { first: parts[0], middle: parts.slice(1, -1).join(" "), last: parts[parts.length - 1] };
}

// HappyTails customer contact requirement: Philippine mobile numbers.
// Store a normalized 09XXXXXXXXX local-format number in customers.phone_number.
export function normalizeCustomerPhone(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  const digits = (value ?? "").replace(/[^0-9]/g, "");
  if (/^639\d{9}$/.test(digits)) return `0${digits.slice(2)}`;
  if (/^9\d{9}$/.test(digits)) return `0${digits}`;
  return digits;
}
export function hasValidCustomerPhone(value: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  return /^09\d{9}$/.test(normalizeCustomerPhone(value));
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\lib\utils\inventory-expiration.ts =====

import type { ProductBatch } from "@/lib/types/products";

export const EXPIRY_WARNING_DAYS = 30;
export type BatchHealth = "adjustment" | "depleted" | "expired" | "expiring" | "healthy" | "unknown";

// Date-only values are compared as dates in the Philippine store's timezone.
// Parsing YYYY-MM-DD as a UTC timestamp would produce incorrect boundary days.
export function philippinesToday(now: Date = new Date()): string {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", { timeZone: "Asia/Manila", year: "numeric", month: "2-digit", day: "2-digit" }).formatToParts(now);
  const value = (name: string) => parts.find(p => p.type === name)?.value ?? "";
  return `${value("year")}-${value("month")}-${value("day")}`;
}

export function expiryDaysLeft(expiry: string | null, today = philippinesToday()): number | null {
  if (!expiry) return null;
  const start = Date.parse(`${today}T00:00:00Z`);
  const end = Date.parse(`${expiry}T00:00:00Z`);
  return Number.isFinite(end) ? Math.round((end - start) / 86400000) : null;
}

export function batchHealth(batch: ProductBatch, today = philippinesToday()): BatchHealth {
  if (batch.is_adjustment) return "adjustment";
  if (batch.quantity <= 0) return "depleted";
  const days = expiryDaysLeft(batch.expiration_date, today);
  if (days === null) return "unknown";
  if (days < 0) return "expired";
  if (days <= EXPIRY_WARNING_DAYS) return "expiring";
  return "healthy";
}

export function batchHealthLabel(health: BatchHealth): string {
  return ({ adjustment: "Legacy adjustment", depleted: "Depleted", expired: "Expired â€” Not for sale", expiring: "Expiring Soon", healthy: "Good", unknown: "No expiry recorded" } as const)[health];
}

export function sellableStock(productId: string, batches: ProductBatch[], today = philippinesToday()): number {
  // Existing negative adjustment rows must keep reducing sellable inventory.
  // Any legacy positive adjustment rows remain included for compatibility.
  const sum = batches.filter(b => b.product_id === productId).reduce((n, b) => {
    if (!b.is_adjustment && b.expiration_date && b.expiration_date < today) return n;
    return n + Number(b.quantity || 0);
  }, 0);
  return Math.max(0, sum);
}

export function physicalStock(productId: string, batches: ProductBatch[]): number {
  return Math.max(0, batches.filter(b => b.product_id === productId).reduce((n, b) => n + Number(b.quantity || 0), 0));
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\lib\utils\pet-age.ts =====

/** A text age preserves the unit; legacy `pets.age` is years only. */
export type PetAge = { age?: number | null; age_text?: string | null };

export function normalizePetAge(input: string): { age: number | null; age_text: string | null } | null {
  const value = input.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ").toLowerCase();
  if (!value) return { age: null, age_text: null };
  const match = /^(\d{1,4})\s*(weeks?|wks?|months?|mos?|years?|yrs?)?$/.exec(value);
  if (!match) return null;
  const amount = Number(match[1]);
  const unit = match[2] ?? "years";
  const kind = /^(w|wk)/.test(unit) ? "week" : /^(m|mo)/.test(unit) ? "month" : "year";
  const maximum = kind === "year" ? 100 : kind === "month" ? 1200 : 5200;
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(amount) || amount > maximum || (amount === 0 && kind !== "year")) return null;
  // Numeric age remains populated only for ages explicitly entered in years.
  return { age: kind === "year" ? amount : null,
    age_text: `${amount} ${kind}${amount === 1 ? "" : "s"}` };
}

export function petAgeLabel(pet: PetAge): string | null {
  if (pet.age_text?.trim()) return pet.age_text.trim();
  if (pet.age == null) return null;
  return `${pet.age} ${pet.age === 1 ? "year" : "years"}`;
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\lib\utils\pet-size-guide.ts =====

import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
import type { PetSize } from "@/lib/types/services";
import type { Species } from "@/lib/types/appointments";
import type { VaccinationStatus } from "@/lib/utils/pet-vaccination";

// HappyTails grooming pricing policy (not a universal veterinary classification).
// Use only the shop's existing Small/Large cat tier IDs; no database changes.
export const CAT_SMALL_MAX_KG = 5;
export function catGroomingSizeGuide(rows: PetSize[]): PetSize[] {
  return rows.filter((s) => ["small", "large"].includes(s.label.trim().toLowerCase()))
    .map((s) => ({ ...s, weight_range: s.label.trim().toLowerCase() === "small"
      ? `Up to ${CAT_SMALL_MAX_KG} kg` : `Above ${CAT_SMALL_MAX_KG} kg` }))
    .sort((a,b) => (a.label.trim().toLowerCase() === "small" ? -1 : 1) - (b.label.trim().toLowerCase() === "small" ? -1 : 1));
}

export type SizeMatch = { id: string; label: string; weight_range: string };

export async function getActiveSizeGuide(species: Species): Promise<PetSize[]> {
  const supabase = createClient();
  const serviceType = species === "Cat" ? "cat_grooming" : "dog_grooming";
  const { data, error } = await supabase.from("pet_sizes").select("*")
    .eq("service_type", serviceType).eq("is_active", true).order("sort_order");
  if (error) throw new Error(`Unable to load ${species.toLowerCase()} size guide: ${error.message}`);
  const rows = (data ?? []) as PetSize[];
  if (species !== "Cat") return rows;
  // Cat grooming has only Small and Large service tiers. Never select Medium.
  const cats = catGroomingSizeGuide(rows);
  if (!cats.some((s) => s.label.trim().toLowerCase() === "small") ||
      !cats.some((s) => s.label.trim().toLowerCase() === "large")) {
    throw new Error("Cat grooming requires active Small and Large tiers in Service Management.");
  }
  return cats;
}

// Reads editable Service Management weight ranges, not hardcoded size tiers.
// Supported: "Below 5 kg", "5â€“12 kg", "12 to 17 kg", "Above 29 kg",
// "> 29 kg", "29 kg and above", "Up to 5 kg", and "5 kg+".
export function weightBounds(input: string): { min: number; max: number; minOpen: boolean; maxOpen: boolean } | null {
  const str = input.toLowerCase().replace(/[â€“â€”]/g, "-").replace(/,/g, "").trim();
  const values = [...str.matchAll(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g)].map((x) => Number(x[0]));
  if (!values.length) return null;
  if (values.length >= 2) return { min: values[0], max: values[1], minOpen: false, maxOpen: false };
  const n = values[0];
  if (/below|under|less than|<\s*\d/.test(str)) return { min: 0, max: n, minOpen: false, maxOpen: !/<=/.test(str) };
  if (/up to|at most|maximum|â‰¤|<=/.test(str)) return { min: 0, max: n, minOpen: false, maxOpen: false };
  if (/above|over|greater than|more than|>\s*\d/.test(str)) return { min: n, max: Infinity, minOpen: !/>=/.test(str), maxOpen: false };
  if (/\+|and above|or above|at least|minimum|â‰¥|>=/.test(str)) return { min: n, max: Infinity, minOpen: false, maxOpen: false };
  return null;
}

export function matchPetSize(weight: number, sizes: PetSize[]): SizeMatch | null {
  if (!Number.isFinite(weight) || weight <= 0) return null;
  // On shared endpoints (e.g. 5â€“12 and 12â€“17), the higher category wins.
  const matching = sizes.map((s) => ({ size: s, bounds: weightBounds(s.weight_range) }))
    .filter((v): v is { size: PetSize; bounds: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof weightBounds>> } => !!v.bounds)
    .filter(({ bounds }) => (bounds.minOpen ? weight > bounds.min : weight >= bounds.min) && (bounds.maxOpen ? weight < bounds.max : weight <= bounds.max))
    .sort((a, b) => b.bounds.min - a.bounds.min || a.bounds.max - b.bounds.max);
  const size = matching[0]?.size;
  return size ? { id: size.id, label: size.label, weight_range: size.weight_range } : null;
}

export function validatePetInput(form: { name: string; species: Species; breed: string; weight: string; age: string; sex: string }, size: SizeMatch | null) {
  const errors: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (!form.name.trim()) errors.name = "Pet name is required.";
  if (!form.species) errors.species = "Species is required.";
  if (!form.breed.trim()) errors.breed = "Breed is required.";
  if (form.weight.trim() && (!Number.isFinite(Number(form.weight)) || Number(form.weight) <= 0)) errors.weight = "Enter a valid weight greater than 0 kg.";
  else if (form.weight.trim() && !size) errors.weight = "Weight is not covered by the active size guide. Please contact staff.";
  if (form.age.trim() && (!Number.isInteger(Number(form.age)) || Number(form.age) < 0 || Number(form.age) > 100)) errors.age = "Enter a valid age in whole years (0â€“100).";
  if (!form.sex) errors.sex = "Sex is required.";
  return errors;
}

export async function insertCustomerPet(input: {
  customer_id: string; name: string; species: Species; breed: string;
  size_label: string; weight_kg: number | null; pet_size_id: string | null;
  age: number | null; sex: "Male" | "Female" | null; vaccination_status: VaccinationStatus;
}) {
  return createClient().from("pets").insert(input).select().single();
}
export async function editCustomerPet(id: string, input: {
  name: string; species: Species; breed: string; size_label: string;
  weight_kg: number | null; pet_size_id: string | null; age: number | null; sex: "Male" | "Female" | null;
  vaccination_status: VaccinationStatus;
}) {
  const { data, error } = await createClient().from("pets").update(input).eq("id", id).select();
  if (error) return { data, error };
  if (!data?.length) return { data, error: { message: "Pet update could not be saved. Check your account permissions." } };
  return { data, error: null };
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\lib\utils\report-export.ts =====

// Shared export engine for Report Management. Every tab (Service,
// Inventory, Transaction, Sales) hands this the same shape â€” a title,
// a column list, and its currently-filtered rows â€” and gets back a
// real downloaded file. Previously the Export dropdown in every
// FilterToolbar variant was UI-only (buttons that just closed the
// menu); this is what actually makes it do something.
//
// PDF and Print both carry a letterhead (logo + business name +
// address) per Josh's spec. Excel gets the same name/address as plain
// header rows (SheetJS's base xlsx writer can't place a raster image
// short of a much heavier library, so the letterhead there is
// text-only â€” flagged to Josh rather than silently skipped). CSV is
// left as plain data only, since a logo/name block would just become
// junk cells in spreadsheet software that don't round-trip cleanly.
import { BUSINESS_NAME, BUSINESS_ADDRESS, BUSINESS_LOGO_PATH } from "@/lib/constants/business";

export type ExportColumn<T> = {
  header: string;
  accessor: (row: T) => string | number;
};

type ExportOptions<T> = {
  title: string;
  columns: ExportColumn<T>[];
  rows: T[];
  filename: string;
};

function triggerDownload(blob: Blob, filename: string) {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

function csvEscape(value: string | number): string {
  const s = String(value);
  return /[",\n]/.test(s) ? `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : s;
}

export function exportReportCSV<T>({ columns, rows, filename }: ExportOptions<T>) {
  const header = columns.map((c) => csvEscape(c.header)).join(",");
  const lines = rows.map((row) => columns.map((c) => csvEscape(c.accessor(row))).join(","));
  // Leading BOM so Excel opens UTF-8 (e.g. the â‚± sign) correctly instead of mangling it.
  const csv = "\uFEFF" + [header, ...lines].join("\n");
  triggerDownload(new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" }), `${filename}.csv`);
}

export async function exportReportExcel<T>({ title, columns, rows, filename }: ExportOptions<T>) {
  const XLSX = await import("xlsx");

  const aoa: (string | number)[][] = [
    [BUSINESS_NAME],
    [BUSINESS_ADDRESS],
    [title],
    [],
    columns.map((c) => c.header),
    ...rows.map((row) => columns.map((c) => c.accessor(row))),
  ];

  const sheet = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(aoa);
  sheet["!merges"] = [
    { s: { r: 0, c: 0 }, e: { r: 0, c: Math.max(0, columns.length - 1) } },
    { s: { r: 1, c: 0 }, e: { r: 1, c: Math.max(0, columns.length - 1) } },
    { s: { r: 2, c: 0 }, e: { r: 2, c: Math.max(0, columns.length - 1) } },
  ];
  sheet["!cols"] = columns.map(() => ({ wch: 18 }));

  const workbook = XLSX.utils.book_new();
  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(workbook, sheet, title.slice(0, 31) || "Report");
  const buffer = XLSX.write(workbook, { type: "array", bookType: "xlsx" });
  triggerDownload(new Blob([buffer], { type: "application/octet-stream" }), `${filename}.xlsx`);
}

async function loadLogoDataUrl(): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(BUSINESS_LOGO_PATH);
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    const blob = await res.blob();
    return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
      reader.onerror = reject;
      reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
    });
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function exportReportPDF<T>({ title, columns, rows, filename }: ExportOptions<T>) {
  const [{ default: jsPDF }, logoDataUrl] = await Promise.all([
    import("jspdf"),
    loadLogoDataUrl(),
  ]);
  const autoTable = (await import("jspdf-autotable")).default;

  const doc = new jsPDF({ orientation: columns.length > 6 ? "landscape" : "portrait" });
  const pageWidth = doc.internal.pageSize.getWidth();
  let textX = 14;

  if (logoDataUrl) {
    try {
      doc.addImage(logoDataUrl, "PNG", 14, 10, 18, 18);
      textX = 36;
    } catch {
      // Corrupt/unsupported image data â€” fall back to text-only header.
    }
  }

  doc.setFontSize(13);
  doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
  doc.text(BUSINESS_NAME, textX, 17);
  doc.setFontSize(9);
  doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
  doc.text(BUSINESS_ADDRESS, textX, 23);

  doc.setDrawColor(255, 95, 158); // brand-pink
  doc.setLineWidth(0.5);
  doc.line(14, 32, pageWidth - 14, 32);

  doc.setFontSize(12);
  doc.setFont("helvetica", "bold");
  doc.text(title, 14, 40);
  doc.setFontSize(8.5);
  doc.setFont("helvetica", "normal");
  doc.text(`Generated ${new Date().toLocaleString("en-US", { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" })}`, 14, 45);

  autoTable(doc, {
    startY: 50,
    head: [columns.map((c) => c.header)],
    body: rows.map((row) => columns.map((c) => c.accessor(row))),
    headStyles: { fillColor: [255, 95, 158] },
    styles: { fontSize: 8.5 },
    margin: { left: 14, right: 14 },
  });

  doc.save(`${filename}.pdf`);
}

export async function printReport<T>({ title, columns, rows }: ExportOptions<T>) {
  const printWindow = window.open("", "_blank", "width=900,height=1100");
  if (!printWindow) return; // popup blocked â€” nothing more we can do here

  const tableRows = rows
    .map(
      (row) =>
        `<tr>${columns.map((c) => `<td>${String(c.accessor(row))}</td>`).join("")}</tr>`
    )
    .join("");

  printWindow.document.write(`
    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html>
      <head>
        <title>${title}</title>
        <meta charset="utf-8" />
        <style>
          * { box-sizing: border-box; }
          body { font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; color: #27272a; padding: 32px; }
          .letterhead { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; border-bottom: 2px solid #FF5F9E; padding-bottom: 14px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
          .letterhead img { width: 56px; height: 56px; object-fit: contain; }
          .letterhead h1 { font-size: 16px; margin: 0; }
          .letterhead p { font-size: 11px; color: #71717a; margin: 2px 0 0; }
          h2 { font-size: 14px; margin: 0 0 2px; }
          .meta { font-size: 10.5px; color: #71717a; margin: 0 0 16px; }
          table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 11px; }
          th, td { border: 1px solid #E8E8E8; padding: 6px 8px; text-align: left; }
          th { background: #FCE4F0; }
          @media print { body { padding: 0; } }
        </style>
      </head>
      <body>
        <div class="letterhead">
          <img src="${BUSINESS_LOGO_PATH}" alt="Logo" />
          <div>
            <h1>${BUSINESS_NAME}</h1>
            <p>${BUSINESS_ADDRESS}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <h2>${title}</h2>
        <p class="meta">Generated ${new Date().toLocaleString("en-US", { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" })}</p>
        <table>
          <thead><tr>${columns.map((c) => `<th>${c.header}</th>`).join("")}</tr></thead>
          <tbody>${tableRows}</tbody>
        </table>
        <script>
          window.onload = function () {
            window.print();
          };
        </script>
      </body>
    </html>
  `);
  printWindow.document.close();
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\lib\utils\sort.ts =====

export type SortDirection = "asc" | "desc" | null;

export function sortRows<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
  rows: T[],
  key: string | null,
  direction: SortDirection
): T[] {
  if (!key || !direction) return rows;
  return [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
    const aVal = a[key];
    const bVal = b[key];
    let cmp = 0;
    if (typeof aVal === "number" && typeof bVal === "number") cmp = aVal - bVal;
    else cmp = String(aVal ?? "").localeCompare(String(bVal ?? ""));
    return direction === "asc" ? cmp : -cmp;
  });
}

// Toggles: none -> asc -> desc -> none, matching common table UX.
export function nextSortState(
  currentKey: string | null,
  currentDir: SortDirection,
  clickedKey: string
): { key: string | null; direction: SortDirection } {
  if (currentKey !== clickedKey) return { key: clickedKey, direction: "asc" };
  if (currentDir === "asc") return { key: clickedKey, direction: "desc" };
  return { key: null, direction: null };
}

===== FILE: C:\Users\josh\Desktop\Thesis\happy-tails-mis-v2\lib\validation\staff.ts =====

// Shared validation for staff account creation â€” used both client-side
// (instant feedback in the Add Account modal) and server-side (the real
// security check, in the API route). Client-side validation can always
// be bypassed by a direct API call, so the server MUST re-check
// everything here too, not just trust what the form sent.

export function validatePassword(password: string): string | null {
  if (password.length < 8) return "Password must be at least 8 characters.";
  if (!/[A-Z]/.test(password)) return "Password must include at least one uppercase letter.";
  if (!/[a-z]/.test(password)) return "Password must include at least one lowercase letter.";
  if (!/[0-9]/.test(password)) return "Password must include at least one number.";
  if (!/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(password)) return "Password must include at least one special character.";
  return null;
}

export function validateEmail(email: string): string | null {
  const pattern = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
  if (!pattern.test(email)) return "Enter a valid email address.";
  return null;
}

// Philippine mobile format: 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX
export function validatePhoneNumber(phone: string): string | null {
  const pattern = /^(09\d{9}|\+639\d{9})$/;
  if (!pattern.test(phone.replace(/[\s-]/g, ""))) {
    return "Enter a valid Philippine mobile number (e.g. 09171234567).";
  }
  return null;
}

export function validateUsername(username: string): string | null {
  if (username.length < 3) return "Username must be at least 3 characters.";
  if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9_.]+$/.test(username)) return "Username can only contain letters, numbers, underscores, and periods.";
  return null;
}

  { id: "faq-vaccine", question: "What if I'm unsure whether my pet is vaccinated?", answer: "Choose Not sure when registering or editing your pet's vaccination status. This is a record of the information you provided, not confirmation that your pet meets any service-specific health requirements. Contact the shop before your visit if you need clarification.", published: true },
  { id: "faq-reschedule", question: "Can I reschedule an existing appointment?", answer: "Open My Appointments to check whether your booking can be rescheduled. Available new dates and times are shown in the rescheduling calendar. If you cannot make a change online, contact the shop for assistance.", published: true },
  { id: "faq-boarding", question: "Can my pets stay together in one boarding kennel?", answer: "Eligible pets may share a kennel when the chosen combination fits HappyTails' boarding capacity rules and their stay dates match. The booking system will indicate when a separate appointment or kennel is needed.", published: true },
];

export function parseFAQs(raw: string | null | undefined): FAQItem[] {
  if (raw == null) return defaultFAQs.map(item => ({ ...item }));
  try {
    const value: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
    return value.slice(0, 60).filter((entry): entry is FAQItem =>
      !!entry && typeof entry === "object" &&
      typeof entry.id === "string" && typeof entry.question === "string" &&
      typeof entry.answer === "string" && typeof entry.published === "boolean"
    ).map(item => ({ id: item.id, question: item.question, answer: item.answer, published: item.published }));
  } catch { return []; }
}

export function isValidFAQJson(raw: string): boolean {
  try {
    const value: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(value) && value.every(item => !!item && typeof item === "object" &&
      typeof item.id === "string" && typeof item.question === "string" &&
      typeof item.answer === "string" && typeof item.published === "boolean");
  } catch { return false; }
}

// The canonical URL must be the public, production website, not a Vercel preview URL.
// Set SITE_URL in Vercel only when the production hostname differs from this default.
const DEFAULT_SITE_URL = "https://happytailspgc.vercel.app";

function resolveSiteUrl(): string {
  const configured = (process.env.SITE_URL || process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL || "").trim();
  if (!configured) return DEFAULT_SITE_URL;

  try {
    const url = new URL(configured);
    if (url.protocol !== "https:" && url.protocol !== "http:") {
      return DEFAULT_SITE_URL;
    }
    return url.origin;
  } catch {
    return DEFAULT_SITE_URL;
  }
}

export const SITE_URL = resolveSiteUrl();
export const IS_PREVIEW_DEPLOYMENT = process.env.VERCEL_ENV === "preview";

-- HappyTails product suitability metadata
-- Keeps product_code/category generation and all existing product rows intact.

ALTER TABLE public.products
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pet_types text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}';

DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conrelid = 'public.products'::regclass
      AND conname = 'products_pet_types_allowed'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.products
      ADD CONSTRAINT products_pet_types_allowed
      CHECK (pet_types <@ ARRAY['dog', 'cat']::text[]);
  END IF;
END $$;

-- Replace the SuperAdmin-only management policy with Admin + SuperAdmin.
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Only superadmin can manage products" ON public.products;

CREATE POLICY "Admins and superadmins can manage products"
ON public.products
FOR ALL
TO public
USING (
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.profiles
    WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid()
      AND profiles.role IN ('admin', 'superadmin')
  )
)
WITH CHECK (
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.profiles
    WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid()
      AND profiles.role IN ('admin', 'superadmin')
  )
);

-- Existing public SELECT policies are intentionally left unchanged.

This is a [Next.js](https://nextjs.org) project bootstrapped with [`create-next-app`](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/cli/create-next-app).

## Getting Started

First, run the development server:

```bash
npm run dev
# or
yarn dev
# or
pnpm dev
# or
bun dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) with your browser to see the result.

You can start editing the page by modifying `app/page.tsx`. The page auto-updates as you edit the file.

This project uses [`next/font`](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/optimizing/fonts) to automatically optimize and load [Geist](https://vercel.com/font), a new font family for Vercel.
